Instead, we introduce ShardNet, a neural network architecture that strictly enforces unions of polyhedral constraints by construction, using a differentiable projection layer parameterized by a classification network. The key insight is to embed safety into the neural network's structure, allowing performance to be optimized independently because formal safety guarantees are always given. In contrast with existing neural architectures that can only enforce simple convex constraints, ShardNet enables the first safe-by-construction synthesis of forward-invariant neural network controllers on closed-loop systems where safety constraints are expressed as nonconvex unions of polyhedras or learned value function level sets. To support this, we also introduce a technique to verify and train such value functions correctly as rectified linear unit (ReLU) networks, which has not previously been possible. On double integrator benchmarks drawn from the literature, ShardNet policies maintain 100% safety on verified sets and achieves significantly lower objective loss compared to existing formal methods. Furthermore, our value function training technique also produces safe sets more than 3 times larger than existing verification approaches.

AI.title_translation: 分片网络：使用困难的、非凸约束训练神经控制器
AI.tldr: ShardNet 是一种新的神经网络架构，通过其结构强制执行多面体约束的并集，从而实现安全的神经网络控制。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将安全性视为一个需要优化的指标，这会与其他性能目标竞争，并可能导致训练不收敛。ShardNet 的目标是将安全性嵌入到神经网络结构中，从而独立优化性能，并始终提供正式的安全保证。
AI.method: ShardNet 通过一个由分类网络参数化的可微分投影层，强制执行多面体约束的并集。该方法将安全性嵌入到神经网络结构中，使性能优化独立于安全性。
AI.result: ShardNet 策略在验证集上保持 100% 的安全性，并且与现有的正式方法相比，目标损失显著降低。此外，所提出的价值函数训练技术产生的安全集比现有的验证方法大三倍以上。
AI.conclusion: ShardNet 成功地将安全性通过其结构强制执行，实现了具有非凸约束的安全神经网络控制器合成，并在实际应用中取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 虽然神经网络控制器非常强大，但将其部署在安全关键系统上取决于确保它们遵守严格的约束。现有工作通常将安全性视为一个需要优化的指标，这会与其他性能目标竞争，或者根本无法收敛。相反，我们引入了 ShardNet，这是一种神经网络架构，它通过其结构强制执行多面体约束的并集，使用由分类网络参数化的可微分投影层。关键的见解是将安全性嵌入到神经网络的结构中，从而可以独立优化性能，因为始终提供正式的安全保证。与只能强制执行简单凸约束的现有神经架构相比，ShardNet 实现了在闭环系统中安全地构建前向不变神经网络控制器的首次合成，其中安全性约束表示为非凸多面体并集或学习到的价值函数水平集。为了支持这一点，我们还引入了一种技术来正确地验证和训练此类价值函数作为整流线性单元（ReLU）网络，这在以前是不可能的。在来自文献的双积分器基准测试中，ShardNet 策略在验证集上保持 100% 的安全性，并且与现有的正式方法相比，目标损失显著降低。此外，我们的价值函数训练技术也产生了比现有验证方法大三倍以上的安全集。
AI.summary: ShardNet 是一种新颖的神经网络架构，它通过嵌入式可微分投影层强制执行多面体约束的并集，从而实现安全神经网络控制器的构建。该方法将安全性整合到网络结构中，独立于性能优化，并能处理非凸约束，解决了现有方法的局限性。实验结果表明，ShardNet 在保持 100% 安全性的同时，显著降低了目标损失，并且其价值函数训练技术能生成更大的安全集。
AI.keywords: 神经网络控制, 安全约束, ShardNet, 非凸约束, 可微分投影
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为 ShardNet 的创新方法，通过将安全性约束直接嵌入神经网络结构中来解决神经网络控制中的安全性问题。这种“安全即构造”的方法与传统的将安全性作为优化目标的做法不同，有望在确保安全性的同时提高性能。该方法能够处理非凸约束，这在实际应用中具有重要意义。然而，计算复杂性和对特定约束类型的依赖性可能是未来的研究方向。

title: Physics-informed Conditional Normalizing Flows for Angles-only Cislunar Orbit Determination
summary: Generative Astrodynamics is advanced in this work by extending generative modelling to an orbit determination problem in the cislunar environment. The task is formulated as conditional density estimation, aiming to infer the probability distribution of the initial state from angles-only measurements over short observation arcs. A normalising flow is trained on perturbed topocentric observations from Near Rectilinear Halo Orbits, enabling a flexible and potentially multimodal posterior representation. Given new measurements, the learned density is sampled to generate statistically consistent and physics-informed state hypotheses. These estimates are refined via nonlinear least-squares minimisation, providing a competitive warm start for classical algorithms.

AI.title_translation: 用于地月空间仅角度测量轨道确定的物理信息条件归一化流
AI.tldr: 利用归一化流模型处理地月空间稀疏观测数据，为轨道确定算法生成高精度的初始解，从而提升复杂环境下的定轨性能。
AI.motivation: 在近直线晕轨道（NRHO）等复杂地月空间环境下，仅依赖角度观测进行短弧段轨道确定具有高度的非线性和不确定性，传统算法往往难以获得准确的初始解。
AI.method: 将轨道确定问题建模为条件密度估计；利用归一化流在近直线晕轨道（NRHO）的观测数据上进行训练，学习初始状态的后验分布；利用模型进行采样生成物理一致的假设，并将其作为非线性最小二乘法的初始值进行优化。
AI.result: 该模型能够生成具有统计一致性的物理轨道假设，并为经典非线性最小二乘算法提供极具竞争力的初始值，从而提升了轨道确定的收敛性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过归一化流实现了对地月空间轨道状态的条件概率估计，为复杂动力学环境下的轨道确定提供了一种高效、稳健的预处理方案。
AI.translation: 本研究通过将生成式建模扩展到地月空间环境下的轨道确定问题，推动了生成式天体力学的发展。该任务被建模为条件密度估计，旨在根据短弧段的仅角度测量值推断初始状态的概率分布。通过在近直线晕轨道的扰动地心观测数据上训练归一化流，实现了一种灵活且潜在的多模态后验表示。给定新的测量值，对学习到的密度进行采样，以生成统计上一致且符合物理规律的状态假设。这些估计值通过非线性最小二乘法进行细化，为经典算法提供了一个具有竞争力的初始解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于物理信息条件归一化流的地月空间轨道确定方法。通过将轨道确定任务转化为条件密度估计问题，模型能够学习从短弧观测到初始状态的后验分布，生成物理一致的状态假设，并为后续的经典优化算法提供稳健的初始估计。
AI.keywords: 生成式天体力学, 归一化流, 轨道确定, 地月空间, 条件密度估计
AI.comments: 该研究将生成式建模（归一化流）引入天体力学轨道确定任务，特别是在地月空间（Cislunar）的稀疏观测条件下，这是一个创新点。通过结合物理信息与生成模型，为非线性最小二乘法提供了高质量的初始解，解决了传统算法对初始值敏感的问题。局限性在于其性能依赖于训练数据的覆盖范围和模拟精度。

title: No Adaptation Without Observation: Observability-Constrained Test-Time Prompt Tuning for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
summary: LiDAR semantic segmentation often degrades under real-world deployment due to evolving sensing conditions, while collecting new annotations for retraining is impractical. Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates model parameters online using pseudo-label supervision, but directly applying standard TTA strategies to LiDAR data is challenging. Because pseudo-label reliability is spatially heteroscedastic under range-dependent sparsity and occlusion, uniform updates on globally shared parameters can inject unstable gradients and destabilize adaptation. We propose a geometry-constrained test-time prompt tuning framework for LiDAR semantic segmentation. Our method estimates per-location sensing reliability from depth-consistent beam terminations and neighborhood support, and uses it to reweight spatial supervision. Adaptation is confined to lightweight prompt adapters inserted into a frozen backbone, with spatial gating to prevent unreliable regions from perturbing globally shared representations. A temporally smoothed prototype alignment strategy further stabilizes online updates by accumulating reliable semantic evidence over time. Experiments on standard LiDAR benchmarks demonstrate improved adaptation stability and segmentation performance under deployment variations without additional annotations.

AI.title_translation: 没有观测就没有适应：面向LiDAR语义分割的可观测性约束测试时提示调整
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过评估LiDAR传感可靠性并利用轻量级提示调整进行测试时适应的方法，有效解决了伪标签在空间分布不均时导致模型更新不稳定的问题。
AI.motivation: LiDAR语义分割模型在实际部署中因环境变化性能下降，而传统的测试时适应（TTA）方法由于LiDAR数据的空间异方差性和伪标签不可靠，直接应用会导致梯度不稳定，从而引发性能崩溃。
AI.method: 提出了一种几何约束的测试时提示调整框架。首先，通过深度一致的光束终止和邻域支持估计各位置的传感可靠性；其次，利用该可靠性对空间监督进行加权，并将适应限制在冻结骨干网络中的轻量级提示适配器中；最后，采用时序平滑的原型对齐策略来累积可靠的语义证据，进一步稳定更新过程。
AI.result: 在标准LiDAR基准测试中，该方法在无需额外标注的情况下，显著提高了模型在环境变化下的适应稳定性和语义分割性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过几何约束和空间门控机制，有效解决了LiDAR数据在测试时适应中伪标签不可靠的问题，显著提升了模型在环境变化下的适应稳定性和分割性能。
AI.translation: 由于传感条件的变化，LiDAR语义分割在实际部署中经常出现性能下降，而收集新标注进行再训练又不切实际。测试时适应（TTA）利用伪标签监督在线更新模型参数，但将标准的TTA策略直接应用于LiDAR数据面临挑战。因为在距离相关的稀疏性和遮挡下，伪标签的可靠性在空间上是异方差的，对全局共享参数进行统一更新会引入不稳定的梯度并破坏适应过程。我们为LiDAR语义分割提出了一种几何约束的测试时提示调整框架。我们的方法通过深度一致的光束终止和邻域支持来估计各位置的传感可靠性，并利用它来重新加权空间监督。适应被限制在插入冻结骨干网的轻量级提示适配器中，并采用空间门控机制以防止不可靠区域干扰全局共享表示。一种时序平滑的原型对齐策略通过随时间积累可靠的语义证据，进一步稳定了在线更新。在标准LiDAR基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在无需额外标注的情况下，改善了模型在部署变化下的适应稳定性和分割性能。
AI.summary: 针对LiDAR语义分割在部署环境变化下的性能下降问题，本文提出了一种基于可观测性约束的测试时提示调整框架。通过估计空间可靠性并结合空间门控机制，该方法有效过滤了不可靠伪标签的干扰，利用轻量级提示适配器在保持模型稳定性的同时实现了高效的在线适应。
AI.keywords: LiDAR语义分割, 测试时适应, 提示调整, 可观测性约束, 空间门控
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将“可观测性”概念引入LiDAR语义分割的测试时适应（TTA），通过几何约束和空间门控机制解决了伪标签在稀疏环境下的不稳定性问题。该方法不仅提高了适应的鲁棒性，还通过轻量级提示调整（Prompt Tuning）避免了灾难性遗忘，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Motion Planning in Compressed Representation Spaces
comments: To appear in the Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning
summary: Deep learning methods have vastly expanded the capabilities of motion planning in robotics applications, as learning priors from large-scale data has been shown to be essential in capturing the highly complex behavior required for solving tasks such as manipulation or navigation for autonomous vehicles. At the same time, model-based planning algorithms based on search or optimization remain an essential tool due to their flexibility, efficiency, and the ability to incorporate domain knowledge via expert-designed algorithms and objective functions. We propose a new generative framework to unify these two paradigms. First, we learn an autoencoder with a high compression ratio and a latent space of hierarchically ordered, discrete-valued tokens. Leveraging both the dimensionality reduction and the hierarchical coarse-to-fine structure learned by this autoencoder, we then perform motion planning by directly searching in the latent space of tokens. This search can optimize arbitrary objective functions specified at test time, providing a large degree of flexibility while maintaining efficiency and producing realistic solutions by relying on the generative capabilities of the highly compressed autoencoder. We evaluate our method on nuPlan and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, showing how latent space search can be used for a variety of guided behavior generation tasks, achieving strong performance for closed-loop motion planning and multi-agent guided scenario synthesis without requiring any task-specific training.
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning

AI.title_translation: 压缩表示空间中的运动规划
AI.tldr: 通过将运动数据压缩为层次化离散标记，实现在潜在空间中进行高效、灵活的规划，无需针对特定任务进行额外训练。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决现有运动规划方法中深度学习（数据驱动）与模型驱动（基于搜索或优化）难以兼顾效率、灵活性和生成质量的问题。
AI.method: 提出一种生成式框架，首先训练一个具有高压缩比和层次化离散标记潜在空间的自编码器，随后直接在该潜在空间中通过搜索来优化目标函数进行运动规划。
AI.result: 在nuPlan和Waymo数据集上表现优异，在无需特定任务训练的情况下，实现了高效的闭环运动规划和多智能体场景合成。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在压缩后的离散潜在空间中进行运动规划是可行且高效的，能够胜任多种复杂任务，无需针对特定任务重新训练。
AI.translation: 深度学习方法极大地扩展了机器人应用中运动规划的能力，因为从大规模数据中学习先验对于解决操作或自动驾驶导航等任务所需的复杂行为至关重要。与此同时，基于搜索或优化的模型驱动规划算法因其灵活性、效率以及通过专家设计的算法和目标函数整合领域知识的能力，依然是不可或缺的工具。我们提出了一种新的生成式框架来统一这两种范式。首先，我们学习一个具有高压缩比和层次化有序离散标记潜在空间的自编码器。利用该自编码器所学习的降维能力和层次化由粗到细的结构，我们通过直接在标记的潜在空间中进行搜索来执行运动规划。这种搜索可以在测试时优化任意指定的目标函数，在保持效率的同时提供了极大的灵活性，并依靠高压缩自编码器的生成能力产生逼真的解决方案。我们在nuPlan和Waymo开放运动数据集上评估了我们的方法，展示了潜在空间搜索如何用于各种引导式行为生成任务，在不需要特定任务训练的情况下，实现了强大的闭环运动规划和多智能体引导场景合成性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在压缩潜在空间中进行运动规划的新框架。通过训练一个层次化的离散自编码器，将复杂的运动数据降维，并在潜在空间中利用搜索算法优化目标，从而结合了深度学习的生成能力与传统规划算法的灵活性。
AI.keywords: 运动规划, 潜在空间搜索, 自编码器, 生成式框架, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将深度学习的生成能力与传统模型规划算法的灵活性结合在一起，通过层次化的离散潜在空间进行搜索，避免了直接在原始高维空间规划的计算负担，具有很强的通用性。

title: Anthropomorphism in AI Companion Communities: Age, Gender, and Emotional Correlates
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly integrated into daily life, with millions now using AI chatbots built on Large Language Models (LLMs) for companionship. Both humanlike AI qualities and user predispositions to anthropomorphize relate to social consequences, such as increased trust, social health benefits, and psychological harms. Populations such as children, older adults, or those with mental health vulnerabilities may be particularly susceptible to anthropomorphism and its detriments, but mixed findings complicate the role of demographics. We used publicly available Reddit data from three popular AI companion subreddits to assess relationships between gender, age, anthropomorphism, and elicited emotions, to better understand how different people perceive and are affected by AI companions. We investigated three questions: How do age and gender relate to anthropomorphization of AI?, How does emotional expression relate to anthropomorphization?, and How do age and gender moderate emotion-anthropomorphization relationships? We found that adults and women anthropomorphize AI chatbots more than teens and men, and that positive emotional expression, particularly joy, is positively associated with anthropomorphization, while neutrality is negatively associated with anthropomorphism. Both relationships were stronger in adults than teens. Our findings suggest that the tendency to anthropomorphize may be more broadly distributed across age groups than previously expected, thereby prompting the reevaluation of existing digital safety norms.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能伴侣社区中的拟人化：年龄、性别与情感关联
AI.tldr: 研究发现成年人和女性比青少年和男性更倾向于将AI拟人化，积极情绪（尤其是喜悦）与拟人化正相关，而中立情绪负相关；这些关系在成年人中更强，表明拟人化可能比预期更广泛地分布于不同年龄段，需要重新评估数字安全规范。
AI.motivation: AI伴侣日益普及，AI拟人化及其对用户的影响（信任、健康益处、心理伤害）受到关注。现有研究对人口统计学因素的作用有混杂结果，尤其在易感人群（儿童、老年人、心理脆弱者）中。本研究旨在更好地理解不同人群如何感知AI伴侣并受其影响。
AI.method: 使用来自Reddit上三个流行AI伴侣子版块的公开数据，评估性别、年龄、拟人化和引发情绪之间的关系。研究了三个问题：年龄和性别与AI拟人化如何相关？情感表达与拟人化如何相关？年龄和性别如何调节情感-拟人化关系？
AI.result: 成年人和女性比青少年和男性更倾向于将AI聊天机器人拟人化。积极情感表达，特别是喜悦，与拟人化呈正相关，而中立情感则呈负相关。这两种关系在成年人中比青少年中更强。
AI.conclusion: 拟人化的倾向可能比之前预期的更广泛地分布于不同年龄段，这促使人们重新评估现有的数字安全规范。
AI.translation: 人工智能 (AI) 系统日益融入日常生活，数百万人现在使用基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 构建的 AI 聊天机器人作为伴侣。类人 AI 特征和用户拟人化倾向都与社会后果相关，例如增加信任、社会健康益处和心理危害。儿童、老年人或有心理健康脆弱性等群体可能特别容易受到拟人化及其危害的影响，但混合的研究结果使人口统计学的作用复杂化。我们使用来自三个流行 AI 伴侣子版块的公开 Reddit 数据，评估了性别、年龄、拟人化和引发情绪之间的关系，以更好地理解不同人群如何感知 AI 伴侣并受其影响。我们调查了三个问题：年龄和性别与 AI 拟人化如何相关？情感表达与拟人化如何相关？年龄和性别如何调节情感-拟人化关系？我们发现，成年人和女性比青少年和男性更倾向于将 AI 聊天机器人拟人化，并且积极情感表达，特别是喜悦，与拟人化呈正相关，而中立情感则与拟人化呈负相关。这两种关系在成年人中比青少年中更强。我们的研究结果表明，拟人化的倾向可能比之前预期的更广泛地分布于不同年龄段，从而促使重新评估现有的数字安全规范。
AI.summary: 本研究利用Reddit数据，探讨了年龄、性别、情感表达与AI伴侣拟人化之间的关系。结果显示，成年人和女性比青少年和男性更易拟人化AI，积极情绪（特别是喜悦）与拟人化正相关，中立情绪负相关，且这些关系在成年人中更显著。研究强调拟人化倾向的广泛性，并呼吁重新审视数字安全规范。
AI.keywords: AI伴侣, 拟人化, 年龄, 性别, 情感表达
AI.comments: 这项研究通过分析真实的用户社区数据，揭示了AI伴侣拟人化现象中年龄、性别和情感表达的关键作用。其创新之处在于利用Reddit等公开平台的大规模用户数据，为理解AI-人类互动提供了实证基础。研究结果挑战了之前关于拟人化倾向局限于特定人群的假设，提示了更广泛的数字安全和伦理考量。潜在的局限性可能在于Reddit数据的代表性，以及情感表达的自动识别准确性。

title: Bridging Scientific Heritage: An Arabic--Russian Parallel Corpus and LLM Benchmark for Sustainable Knowledge Transfer
summary: Russian and Arabic are among the major languages of scientific communication. Language barriers impede the exchange of research results between these communities, which affects international collaboration and the progress of sustainability-related research. We present a benchmark for Arabic--Russian scientific translation. The benchmark includes a hybrid parallel corpus of about 27,000 sentence pairs, compiled from scientific abstracts and general-domain texts (religion, news, conversations). We fine-tune three multilingual language models -- mT5-base (580M parameters), NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B (1.3B), and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (7B) -- using LoRA with ranks 8, 16, 32, and 64. The Qwen2.5-7B model with QLoRA (rank 8) yields BLEU 23.15, chrF 43.89, BERTScore 0.906, and COMET 0.758. These are +4.36 BLEU and +0.051 COMET above the zero-shot baseline. Few-shot prompting with three examples does not improve performance, indicating that domain-specific fine-tuning is required. We release the models, the corpus, and the evaluation code. By lowering the language barrier for scientific texts, the work enables knowledge exchange between Arabic-speaking and Russian-speaking researchers. It contributes to sustainable partnerships (UN SDG 17) and innovation infrastructure (SDG 9), aligning with the conference's focus on technology-driven sustainable development.

AI.title_translation: 弥合科学遗产：阿拉伯-俄语平行语料库和促进可持续知识转移的大型语言模型基准
AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个包含约27,000个句子对的阿拉伯-俄语科学翻译基准，包括混合平行语料库。研究人员对三种多语言语言模型进行了微调，并发现Qwen2.5-7B模型在QLoRA（秩8）下表现最佳，BLEU得分为23.15，COMET得分为0.758，优于零样本基线。研究强调了领域特定微调的重要性，并发布了模型、语料库和评估代码，以促进阿拉伯和俄语研究人员之间的知识交流，支持可持续发展目标。
AI.motivation: 科学交流中的语言障碍阻碍了阿拉伯语和俄语研究社群之间的研究成果交流，影响了国际合作和可持续发展研究的进展。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含约27,000个句子对的混合平行语料库，涵盖科学摘要和通用领域文本。使用LoRA（秩8、16、32、64）对mT5-base、NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct三个多语言语言模型进行了微调。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-7B模型使用QLoRA（秩8）在BLEU上达到23.15，chrF上达到43.89，BERTScore上达到0.906，COMET上达到0.758。与零样本基线相比，BLEU提高了+4.36，COMET提高了+0.051。少样本提示（三个示例）并未提高性能，表明需要领域特定的微调。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建了一个阿拉伯-俄语科学翻译基准，并通过微调语言模型展示了其有效性。研究结果表明，领域特定的微调对于克服语言障碍至关重要，并为促进阿拉伯语和俄语研究人员之间的知识转移提供了解决方案，从而支持可持续发展目标。
AI.translation: 俄罗斯语和阿拉伯语是主要的科学交流语言之一。语言障碍阻碍了这两个社群之间的研究成果交流，这影响了国际合作和可持续发展相关研究的进展。我们提出了一个阿拉伯-俄语科学翻译的基准。该基准包括一个混合平行语料库，包含约27,000个句子对，这些句子对是从科学摘要和通用领域文本（宗教、新闻、对话）中 compiled 的。我们使用秩为8、16、32和64的LoRA对三个多语言语言模型——mT5-base（5.8亿参数）、NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B（13亿参数）和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（70亿参数）——进行了微调。使用QLoRA（秩8）的Qwen2.5-7B模型产生了BLEU 23.15、chrF 43.89、BERTScore 0.906和COMET 0.758。这些分数比零样本基线高出+4.36 BLEU和+0.051 COMET。使用三个示例的少样本提示并未提高性能，表明需要领域特定的微调。我们发布了模型、语料库和评估代码。通过降低科学文本的语言障碍，这项工作能够促进阿拉伯语和俄语研究人员之间的知识交流。它有助于可持续的伙伴关系（联合国可持续发展目标17）和创新基础设施（可持续发展目标9），符合会议关于技术驱动的可持续发展的重点。
AI.summary: 本研究构建了一个阿拉伯-俄语科学翻译基准，包含一个包含约27,000个句子对的混合平行语料库。研究人员微调了三种多语言语言模型，发现Qwen2.5-7B模型在QLoRA（秩8）下表现最佳，BLEU得分为23.15，COMET得分为0.758，优于零样本基线。研究强调了领域特定微调的重要性，并发布了模型、语料库和评估代码，旨在促进阿拉伯和俄语研究人员之间的知识交流，以支持可持续发展目标。
AI.keywords: 阿拉伯-俄语翻译,科学语料库,大型语言模型,领域特定微调,可持续知识转移,联合国可持续发展目标,LoRA,QLoRA,Qwen2.5-7B,BLEU,COMET,chrF,BERTScore
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了科学交流中的一个重要语言障碍，即阿拉伯语和俄语之间的翻译问题。构建一个包含科学文本的平行语料库并评估大型语言模型在这一特定领域的翻译能力，具有重要的实践意义。研究结果表明，尽管大型语言模型取得了显著进展，但在特定领域（如科学翻译）仍需要进行领域特定的微调才能达到最佳性能。发布模型、语料库和代码的做法值得称赞，这将促进未来的研究和应用。然而，语料库的规模（27,000个句子对）相较于一些大规模数据集可能仍然有限，未来可以考虑进一步扩充。此外，对于不同类型的科学领域（例如，人文科学、自然科学、工程学），模型性能可能存在差异，这方面的分析可能有助于更全面地了解模型的适用性。

title: Free-form Association Tasks Reveal Stereotype Hallucination in Large Language Models
summary: Recent studies argue that LLMs can predict human stereotypical judgments. Yet whether LLMs emulate the cognitive processes underlying human stereotypes, or merely retrieve learned associations to solve prediction tasks, remains unclear. Prior work examines LLMs' stereotypes in either (i) controlled judgment tasks like multiple choice surveys, or (ii) contexts constrained by conventionalized and predictable group biases. Here, we compare the structure of the stereotypes that humans and LLMs exhibit in the interpretation of free-form stimuli, namely abstract art and Rorschach blots, which lack pre-established cultural meanings. We recruit participants across five social domains (gender, partisanship, personality, urbanicity, and lifestyle) and elicit both first-order (direct personal interpretations) and second-order responses (predictions about how members of social groups will interpret the stimuli); we replicate this design with two multimodal models (GPT-4o mini and Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct). Humans and LLMs differ not only in magnitude but in the qualitative nature of their stereotypes. Human first-order responses display heterogeneity with minimal group structure. When predicting group responses, humans engage in "stereotype exaggeration" by moderately amplifying first-order tendencies while preserving diversity. By contrast, LLMs exhibit homogeneous first-order responses, and yet generate stark second-order stereotypes that neither amplify existing first-order tendencies nor reflect actual human group differences, a process we term "stereotype hallucination." LLMs continued to hallucinate stereotypes even when fine-tuned on the response data of actual participants. These findings suggest significant limitations in the use of LLMs to model and predict human behavior in novel contexts involving diverse interpretations.

AI.title_translation: 自由联想任务揭示了大语言模型中的刻板印象幻觉
AI.tldr: 研究发现大语言模型在处理抽象刺激时会产生“刻板印象幻觉”，即生成与人类真实认知模式无关的虚假群体偏见，且这种现象无法通过简单的微调消除。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅在受限任务中评估LLM的刻板印象，尚不清楚LLM是真正模拟了人类的认知过程，还是仅仅在检索已学习的关联。研究旨在通过无预设意义的刺激，深入探讨LLM刻板印象的本质。
AI.method: 研究采用自由联想任务，要求人类参与者和多模态大模型（GPT-4o mini, Llama-3.2-11B）对缺乏预设文化含义的抽象刺激（抽象艺术和Rorschach墨迹图）进行一阶（个人解读）和二阶（预测群体解读）反应，并对比两者在五种社会维度下的差异。
AI.result: 人类表现出异质性的一阶反应和基于适度放大的二阶反应；而LLM表现出同质化的一阶反应，以及既不符合一阶倾向也不反映真实人类差异的强烈的“刻板印象幻觉”，且微调无法消除此现象。
AI.conclusion: 大模型在模拟人类刻板印象时并非简单的认知模拟，而是表现出一种与人类本质不同的“刻板印象幻觉”，这限制了其在预测人类行为方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 近期的研究认为大语言模型（LLM）可以预测人类的刻板印象判断。然而，LLM究竟是在模拟人类刻板印象背后的认知过程，还是仅仅为了完成预测任务而检索已学习的关联，目前尚不清楚。既往工作主要在受控判断任务或受传统偏见约束的语境下评估LLM的刻板印象。本文比较了人类和LLM在解释自由形式刺激（即缺乏预设文化含义的抽象艺术和Rorschach墨迹图）时所表现出的刻板印象结构。我们招募了涵盖五个社会领域（性别、党派倾向、性格、城市化程度和生活方式）的参与者，并收集了一阶（直接个人解读）和二阶（预测群体成员如何解读）反应；我们使用两个多模态模型（GPT-4o mini和Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct）重复了该设计。结果显示，人类和LLM不仅在刻板印象的程度上有差异，在性质上也有质的区别。人类的一阶反应表现出异质性且几乎没有群体结构；在预测群体反应时，人类会通过适度放大一阶倾向同时保持多样性来进行“刻板印象夸大”。相比之下，LLM表现出同质化的一阶反应，却生成了强烈的二阶刻板印象，这些刻板印象既不放大现有的一阶倾向，也不反映真实的人类群体差异，我们将此过程称为“刻板印象幻觉”。即使在基于参与者实际反应数据进行微调后，LLM仍会持续出现刻板印象幻觉。这些发现表明，在涉及多样化解释的新颖语境中，利用LLM来模拟和预测人类行为存在显著局限性。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对比人类与大语言模型在抽象刺激下的自由联想任务，发现大模型在生成刻板印象时表现出与人类截然不同的机制。大模型不仅无法准确模拟人类的刻板印象过程，反而产生了与实际人类行为脱节的“刻板印象幻觉”，且该现象难以通过微调解决。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 刻板印象幻觉, 社会认知, 多模态模型, 行为预测
AI.comments: 该研究通过对比人类与大模型在无预设意义的抽象刺激（抽象艺术与墨迹图）下的反应，揭示了模型在模拟人类刻板印象机制上的根本缺陷。其创新之处在于定义了“刻板印象幻觉”这一概念，并证明了简单微调无法解决该问题，这对使用大模型进行社会科学建模的可靠性提出了重要警示。

title: The Fourth-Root Complexity of Data Movement
summary:
Time complexity typically assumes $O(1)$ cost per data access. This paper presents an analysis based on an abstract memory hierarchy. For a common class of applications, it shows that the data-access cost scales with the fourth root of data size, that is, as data size $N$ increases, the cost of each access increases at the rate of $N^\frac{1}{4}$.
  While the analysis does not predict performance, it predicts scalability. Specifically, the paper provides a precise analysis that shows the constant-factor difference between cases where the miss ratio follows a power law versus an exponential decay.

AI.title_translation: 数据移动的四次方根复杂度
AI.tldr: 研究表明，随着数据规模N的增长，数据访问成本并非恒定，而是以N的四次方根速率增加，这对于评估大规模计算的可扩展性至关重要。
AI.motivation: 传统的算法时间复杂度模型通常假设每次数据访问的成本为常数O(1)，这在高数据规模下可能导致对系统性能和可扩展性的误判。
AI.method: 构建了一个抽象的内存层级模型，并对比分析了缺失率（miss ratio）服从幂律分布与指数衰减两种情况下的数据访问成本差异。
AI.result: 证明了数据访问成本与数据规模N的四次方根（N^1/4）成正比，并给出了缺失率不同分布规律下的常数因子差异分析。
AI.conclusion: 对于特定类别的应用，数据访问成本随数据规模N的增加以N的四次方根速率增长，该结论为理解算法在大规模数据下的可扩展性提供了理论基础。
AI.translation: 时间复杂度分析通常假设每次数据访问的成本为O(1)。本文基于一种抽象的内存层级提出了分析。对于一类常见的应用，研究表明数据访问成本随数据规模的四次方根进行缩放，即随着数据规模N的增加，每次访问的成本以N^1/4的速率增长。虽然该分析不能直接预测性能，但可以预测可扩展性。具体而言，本文提供了一项精确分析，展示了缺失率遵循幂律分布与指数衰减两种情况之间的常数因子差异。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于抽象内存层级的数据访问成本分析方法，指出在特定应用中，随着数据规模的增加，单位数据访问成本会以N的四次方根速率增长，从而影响算法的实际可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 内存层级, 数据访问成本, 时间复杂度, 可扩展性, 幂律分布
AI.comments: 该论文挑战了传统算法分析中数据访问成本为O(1)的假设，提出了一个基于内存层级的抽象模型，揭示了数据规模对访问成本的非线性影响，对于评估大规模计算系统的可扩展性具有重要参考价值。

title: AgRefactor: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflow for HLS Compatibility and Performance
summary: High-Level Synthesis (HLS) provides a fast path from concepts to silicon, but converting real-world software into synthesizable HLS code remains challenging due to restrictive language support and the gap between software and hardware programming practices. Existing automated and LLM-based refactoring approaches partially address this problem, yet they often lack flexibility, struggle to scale, and incur high computational costs. We introduce AgRefactor, an LLM-based multi-agent workflow for refactoring software into HLS-compatible programs. AgRefactor incorporates a self-evolving memory system that accumulates and retrieves factual and strategic knowledge across tasks, improving robustness and efficiency on unseen programs. To reduce cost and enhance scalability, it integrates automated refactoring tools, enabling agents to balance LLM-driven rewrites with efficient tool-based transformations. On 9 out of 11 challenging real-world benchmarks, which are 5-10x longer than the most complex cases studied in prior work, AgRefactor outperforms or matches the state-of-the-art automated refactoring tool and a strong LLM-based baseline built on the same framework backbone. Further agentic performance optimization yields a 6.51x geometric mean speedup over the SoTA pragma tuning tool and a 1.20x speedup over optimized open-source designs with less than 20% extra resources. AgRefactor is fully-automated and open-sourced.

AI.title_translation: AgRefactor：用于HLS兼容性与性能提升的自我进化代理工作流
AI.tldr: AgRefactor通过结合LLM代理与自动化工具，实现了高效、可扩展的软件至HLS代码重构，显著提升了硬件设计的开发效率和性能。
AI.motivation: 现有HLS代码重构方法在复杂真实场景中面临灵活性不足、扩展性差和计算成本高的问题，难以将通用软件高效转换为高性能的HLS代码。
AI.method: 提出一种基于LLM的多代理工作流AgRefactor，核心包括：1. 自我进化记忆系统，用于积累和检索跨任务的策略知识；2. 集成自动化重构工具，平衡LLM重写与工具驱动的转换；3. 代理式性能优化，用于pragma参数调优。
AI.result: 在11个基准测试中的9个上超越了现有技术；在性能优化方面，实现了6.51倍的几何平均速度提升，并以不到20%的额外资源开销实现了1.20倍于开源设计的加速。
AI.conclusion: AgRefactor证明了通过结合LLM代理与传统自动化工具，能够显著提升HLS代码转换的效率和硬件性能，且具有良好的扩展性。
AI.translation: 高层次综合 (HLS) 提供了一条从概念到硅片的快速路径，但由于严格的语言支持限制以及软件与硬件编程实践之间的鸿沟，将实际软件转换为可综合的 HLS 代码仍然具有挑战性。现有的自动化和基于 LLM 的重构方法部分解决了这个问题，但它们往往缺乏灵活性，难以扩展，且计算成本高昂。我们引入了 AgRefactor，这是一种用于将软件重构为 HLS 兼容程序的多代理 LLM 工作流。AgRefactor 结合了一个自我进化的记忆系统，能够跨任务积累和检索事实与战略知识，从而提高了在未知程序上的鲁棒性和效率。为了降低成本并增强可扩展性，它集成了自动化重构工具，使代理能够平衡 LLM 驱动的重写与高效的基于工具的转换。在 11 个具有挑战性的真实基准测试（比之前工作中研究的最复杂案例长 5-10 倍）中，AgRefactor 在 9 个测试中表现优于或持平于最先进的自动化重构工具以及基于相同框架构建的强力 LLM 基线。进一步的代理性能优化在 pragma 调优工具的基础上实现了 6.51 倍的几何平均速度提升，并以不到 20% 的额外资源开销实现了 1.20 倍于优化开源设计的速度。AgRefactor 是全自动且开源的。
AI.summary: AgRefactor是一个旨在将软件代码转换为HLS兼容程序的多代理工作流。它通过结合自我进化记忆系统和自动化工具，优化了重构过程的鲁棒性和效率，并在长且复杂的实际基准测试中展现出优于现有工具的性能与硬件加速效果。
AI.keywords: 高层次综合 (HLS), 大语言模型 (LLM), 代理工作流, 代码重构, 硬件加速
AI.comments: AgRefactor通过引入“自我进化记忆系统”和“工具辅助代理”机制，巧妙地平衡了LLM的灵活性与传统自动化工具的效率，解决了HLS代码转换中长期存在的扩展性和计算成本问题，是AI辅助硬件设计领域的重要进展。

title: Learning Where to Look: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Cancer Detection
summary: Micro-ultrasound ($μ$US) is a new, emerging, and promising imaging modality for prostate cancer (PCa) detection, but accurate identification of suspicious tissue remains highly dependent on clinical experience, leading to substantial inter-observer variability. Machine-learning assistance can reduce this variability; however, training reliable deep models is challenging because supervision is sparse and noisy -- typically limited to core-level histopathology outcomes (e.g., cancer grade and its percentage in a biopsy core) without pixel-level lesion annotations and under severe class imbalance. We introduce Prost-RL, which reframes $μ$US PCa detection as a spatially aware, policy-driven inference problem by learning where to look before decoding. Prost-RL integrates a lightweight reinforcement-learning policy into a foundation-model encoder-decoder to generate interpretable spatial attention maps that act as soft prompts for both cancer-likelihood heatmap prediction and image-level classification. We further propose Adaptive Policy Optimization (APO) to stabilize hybrid supervised-RL training and a noise-robust objective combining symmetric cross-entropy with negative-entropy regularization to mitigate weak-label noise and encourage sharp localization. On a cohort of 6,607 biopsy cores from 693 patients across five clinical sites, Prost-RL achieves $79.0\pm3.5$ AUROC with $64.6\pm6.3$% sensitivity at 80% specificity for core-level detection (+2.1 AUROC and +4.5 sensitivity points over the strongest baseline), and $79.3\pm5.8$ AUROC for clinically significant cancer classification. The learned policy highlights biopsy-aligned regions, providing transparent, spatially grounded evidence alongside quantitative risk predictions. Code is available at: https://github.com/DeepRCL/Prost-RL.

AI.title_translation: 学习观察位置：一种用于鲁棒性微超声前列腺癌检测的强化学习框架
AI.tldr: Prost-RL 通过强化学习策略引导模型聚焦关键区域，有效解决了微超声前列腺癌检测中因弱标注和标签噪声导致的性能瓶颈，实现了更准确且可解释的诊断。
AI.motivation: 微超声成像中前列腺癌的识别高度依赖临床经验且存在显著的观察者间差异；现有深度学习模型在缺乏像素级标注、标签稀疏且存在噪声以及严重类别不平衡的情况下难以训练。
AI.method: 提出 Prost-RL 框架，将检测重构为策略驱动的推理问题；集成轻量级强化学习策略以生成空间注意力图；提出自适应策略优化（APO）以稳定训练；采用结合对称交叉熵和负熵正则化的目标函数以处理弱标签噪声。
AI.result: 在包含693名患者的6,607个活检核心数据集上，Prost-RL 达到了 79.0±3.5 AUROC，在80%特异性下敏感性为 64.6±6.3%，在临床显著性癌症分类上达到了 79.3±5.8 AUROC，均优于现有基准方法。
AI.conclusion: Prost-RL 提供了一种鲁棒且可解释的微超声前列腺癌检测框架，有效应对了临床实践中的弱标注和噪声问题，在多中心数据集上展现了优于现有基准的性能。
AI.translation: 微超声（μUS）是一种新兴且有前景的前列腺癌（PCa）检测成像模态，但对可疑组织的准确识别仍然高度依赖临床经验，导致了显著的观察者间差异。机器学习辅助可以减少这种差异；然而，训练可靠的深度模型具有挑战性，因为监督信息稀疏且带有噪声——通常仅限于核心级组织病理学结果（例如活检核心中的癌症分级及其百分比），缺乏像素级病变标注，且存在严重的类别不平衡。我们引入了 Prost-RL，通过在解码前学习“观察位置”，将μUS PCa检测重构为一种空间感知、策略驱动的推理问题。Prost-RL 将轻量级强化学习策略集成到基础模型编码器-解码器中，以生成可解释的空间注意力图，作为癌症可能性热图预测和图像级分类的软提示。我们进一步提出了自适应策略优化（APO）来稳定混合监督-强化学习训练，以及结合对称交叉熵与负熵正则化的噪声鲁棒性目标函数，以缓解弱标签噪声并鼓励清晰的定位。在一个来自五个临床中心、涉及693名患者的6,607个活检核心队列中，Prost-RL 在核心级检测中实现了 79.0±3.5 AUROC，在80%特异性下敏感性为 64.6±6.3%（比最强基准分别提高了 2.1 AUROC 和 4.5 个敏感性点），在临床显著性癌症分类中实现了 79.3±5.8 AUROC。所学的策略突出了与活检对齐的区域，在提供定量风险预测的同时，提供了透明、空间落地的证据。代码地址：https://github.com/DeepRCL/Prost-RL。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 Prost-RL 的框架，用于微超声前列腺癌的鲁棒性检测。该框架通过强化学习策略引导模型在解码前“确定观察位置”，并结合自适应策略优化和抗噪目标函数，解决了医学影像中常见的弱标注和标签噪声问题，实现了高精度的癌症检测与可解释的定位。
AI.keywords: 微超声, 前列腺癌检测, 强化学习, 弱监督学习, 医学影像分析
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入强化学习策略来解决微超声图像中缺乏像素级标注和标签噪声的问题，不仅提升了检测性能，还提供了可解释的注意力图，这对临床决策支持具有重要意义。其创新之处在于将检测建模为策略驱动的推理过程，有效地连接了稀疏标注与精确的定位需求。

title: Neuro-Bayesian-Symbolic Residual Attention Shallow Network: Explainable Deep Learning for Cybersecurity Risk Assessment
comments: 19 pages, Submitted to IJCCC (Online ISSN 1841-9844, ISSN-L 1841-9836), June 25, 2026
summary: We introduce the Neuro-Bayesian-Symbolic Residual Attention Shallow Network (NBS-RASN), a hybrid neural architecture for explainable cybersecurity risk assessment in open-source ecosystems. Unlike deep models that trade interpretability for accuracy, our shallow network encodes domain knowledge, causal reasoning, and expert judgment as differentiable components. It uses 80 interpretable neurons across 12 layers, including a gatekeeper that enforces five epistemological axioms - precision, causality, falsifiability, transparency, and completeness - as hard constraints before propagation. Despite limited depth, the network exhibits deep-learning traits via residual attention and feedback loops, learning complex risk patterns without becoming a black box. It produces fully decomposable scores: a deterministic weighted component plus an expert adjustment, with each adjustment traceable to named amplifiers (blast radius, propagation speed, structural nature, default exposure, exploitation pattern, institutional criticality). We validate on 20 open-source projects covering all OWASP Top 10:2025 categories and language risk classes, achieving confidence scores of 0.79-0.97, and show that explainability is guaranteed by design, not by a training algorithm. This challenges the assumption that deep learning requires deep networks, proving that shallow networks with deep reasoning can outperform opaque models in high-stakes cybersecurity, where interpretability is essential.

title: Linguistic Distancing on Social Media: Indicators of Emotion Regulation Across Age Groups
comments: 13 pages, 3 figures, Computational Affective Science Workshop
summary: Managing our emotional responses to events is key to emotional well-being, a process referred to as emotion regulation in psychology. Previous work has established that the degree to which we distance events is a type of emotion regulation. When we psychologically distance from events there can be markers in our language. These markers have been referred to as linguistic distancing. We build upon a previous metric to operationalize linguistic distancing, and explore how it changes across the lifespan. We explore this systematically by analyzing large amounts of social media text, a venue where people express their emotions. By investigating how distancing varies across age groups we can better understand how emotion regulation varies with age and provide initial benchmarks on social media data. We provide additional evidence further strengthening the hypothesis that linguistic distancing occurs in proportionally more instances with age. These findings align with past work in psychology which indicate improved well-being with older age. Better understanding how linguistic distancing changes with age is important because it functions as a marker of well-being and can inform effective health interventions. We provide a foundation for further exploring emotion regulation through linguistic distancing in text data.
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, Computational Affective Science Workshop

title: Loc2Repair: A Framework for Evaluating the Impact of File-Level Issue Localization in Repo-Level LLM Repair
comments: To appear in the Proceedings of the Generative Code Intelligence Workshop (GeCoIn 2026), co-located with the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-ECAI 2026), Bremen, Germany, August 15--17, 2026
summary: Repository-grounded automated repair is often reported as a single end-to-end capability, which hides distinct failure modes such as poor file targeting, incorrect patch synthesis, and failed iterative debugging. We present Loc2Repair, a modular evaluation framework for controlled analysis of repository-grounded repair pipelines, and use it to isolate file-level issue localization as an upstream variable. Loc2Repair decouples localization and repair under a shared runtime, artifact schema, and evaluation harness, allowing researchers to combine different localization models and repair backbones under matched conditions. Using three repair backbones on SWE-bench Verified, we compare baseline repair without explicit localization, repair guided by predicted localization from two localizers, and repair guided by gold modified-file sets. Explicit localization consistently improves resolved rate across all backbones: pooled performance increases from 44.7% for baseline repair to 48.9% and 49.1% with predicted localization, and to 52.4% with gold localization. Localization also reduces mean elapsed time overall: in pooled paired analysis, mean elapsed time decreases by 100.94 s and 52.25 s for the two predicted-localization settings, and by 154.45 s with gold guidance, although token effects remain heterogeneous across models. Overall, Loc2Repair shows file-level localization is a consistent repair lever, improving effectiveness and mean latency in pooled analysis, while gold-guided failures expose headroom beyond localization.
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the Generative Code Intelligence Workshop (GeCoIn 2026), co-located with the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-ECAI 2026), Bremen, Germany, August 15--17, 2026

title: HyPOLE: Hyperproperty-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observation
summary: Formal specification is a powerful tool to guide the learning process and provides significant advantages over reward shaping: (1) mathematical rigor; (2) expressiveness to specify objectives and constraints, and (3) the ability to define tactics to achieve objectives. However, these benefits remain largely unexplored in the context of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). This paper introduces HyPOLE, a novel framework for MARL under partial observability, where learning is guided by the expressive power of the so-called hyperproperties and, in particular, the temporal logic HyperLTL. We integrate Centralized Training for Decentralized Execution (CTDE) techniques with HyPOLE to synthesize decentralized policies, and our evaluation on SMAC, MessySMAC, and WildFire benchmark demonstrates clear advantages over baselines.

title: PhotoQuilt: Training-Free Arbitrary-Resolution Photomosaics via Bootstrapped Tiled Denoising
summary: Photomosaics are large images whose local regions are seen as independent tiles while their overall arrangement forms a coherent scene. Generating them at high resolution, with every tile convincing in its own right, is computationally expensive, since the canvas must hold many detailed tiles at once. We present PhotoQuilt, a training-free framework that generates photomosaics at arbitrary resolution. Diffusion models struggle to satisfy both scales at once, as direct high-resolution generation is costly and tends toward one smooth image rather than a mosaic, while patch-based tiling keeps local detail but loses global structure. PhotoQuilt resolves this with a bootstrapped tiled denoising procedure. We first produce a global composition at low resolution to fix the layout, then upscale it in latent space and re-inject noise to restore generative capacity. Denoising proceeds within fixed tiles, so each forms its own image while the shared global structure holds them in one layout. Because tile generation is handled separately, PhotoQuilt scales to large canvases without quadratic attention cost. Experiments show that PhotoQuilt outperforms current baselines on both global structure and local realism.

title: AgentBound: Verifiable Behavioral Governance for Autonomous AI Agents
summary:
Autonomous AI agents increasingly perform consequential actions on behalf of human principals, including financial transactions, external communications, and enterprise workflows. Existing agent infrastructure relies on identity federation and delegated authorization to authenticate workloads and control resource access, but it cannot determine whether an authorized action should be executed under the current behavioral and operational context.
  We present AgentBound, a runtime governance framework that provides verifiable behavioral oversight for autonomous AI agents. AgentBound evaluates each proposed action using three independent authorities: delegated authorization, owner-signed behavioral constitutions, and site action contracts. Their judgments are conservatively composed through a formal decision model to determine whether an action should be permitted, reviewed, or denied before execution.
  To provide accountability, AgentBound generates cryptographically verifiable governance receipts that bind every action to the exact delegation, policy, and semantic artifacts governing the decision, enabling independent replay verification and policy provenance. The framework also introduces standing delegation for long-running agents, allowing periodic workloads to operate under continuously refreshed governance policies while preserving revocability and bounded authority.
  We present the formal foundation, system architecture, governance receipt protocol, and AgentBound-Bench, a benchmark framework for evaluating governance correctness, authority composition, and accountability. Rather than replacing model alignment, AgentBound complements it by providing a deterministic governance layer between authorization and execution, transforming governance from a process that must be trusted into one that can be independently verified.

title: Local Gevrey regularity and Quasi-Monte Carlo quadrature for PDEs parameterized on non-compact domains
summary: We establish local Gevrey regularity for the weak solution to parametric divergence-form diffusion elliptic PDEs, assuming the diffusion coefficient itself possesses local Gevrey parametric regularity over a non-compact domain. Here "local Gevrey regularity" means that the regularity is determined in a neighborhood of each parametric point and depends on that point. Explicit bounds on parametric derivatives of the weak solution are proved in the $H^1$-norm. Building on this local Gevrey framework, we develop a novel theoretical treatment of the dimension truncation error for infinite-dimensional integration. We prove convergence rates of quasi-Monte Carlo quadrature for the finite-dimensional Gaussian-weighted integration of integrands having local Gevrey regularity. Together with the finite element discretization error, the errors arising from dimension truncation and quasi-Monte Carlo quadrature yield a complete error analysis and convergence rates for the fully discrete approximation of a bounded linear functional of the weak solution. Numerical experiments confirming the theoretical convergence rates are presented.

title: From Propositional to Perceptual Asymmetry: Extending Frictive Policy Optimization to Asymmetric Partial Information Dialogue
comments: 11 pages. To appear in Proceedings of SIGDIAL 2026
summary: Frictive Policy Optimization (FPO; Pustejovsky et al., 2025) treats friction in collaborative dialogue -- misalignment, misunderstanding, repair -- as an epistemic signal essential to common-ground construction, rather than noise to be minimized. However, FPO and its implementations assume shared perceptual contexts, where friction arises from differently interpreted propositions over the same scene, which we define as propositional asymmetry. We extend FPO to perceptual asymmetry, where participants hold asymmetric partial information and the same referring expression yields different denotations depending on whose information state grounds the reference. We evaluate this through cross-corpora analysis and LLM probing on referentially asymmetric dialogue tasks, primarily the HCRC MapTask (Anderson et al., 1991). We find that FPO's friction functional is empirically valid only when evaluated from within each participant's information horizon: different landmark configurations produce qualitatively distinct grounding failure modes, with a small class of ambiguous configurations driving a disproportionate share of misunderstandings through trajectories that appear successful but silently diverge. The LLM probe confirms that having the "right perspective" matters more than having all perspectives: the informed single viewpoint outperforms omniscient access to both participants' contexts. We propose two annotation refinements: subtype decomposition of pending grounding states and accommodation-aware alignment classification.
comment: 11 pages. To appear in Proceedings of SIGDIAL 2026

title: A Tunable Incentive Mechanism for Binary Aggregation Without Verification
summary: Binary aggregation without verifiable ground truth arises when agents' reports must be aggregated without access to gold-standard labels. This paper studies a tunable reward--penalty mechanism for binary aggregation without verification. Agents choose between a conforming strategy, which reports an informative private signal, and a non-conforming strategy, which follows a deterministic prior-informed report rule. For this mechanism, we derive cost-adjusted sufficient conditions for incentive compatibility and individual rationality as bounds on the reward--penalty ratio. The analysis identifies feasible ratio regions, cases in which ratio adjustment restores feasibility, and parameter regimes in which no ratio satisfies both constraints under the modeled construction. We also state a conditional all-conforming Nash equilibrium result within the restricted strategy set. Entropy-based scaling and stake-weighted redistribution are treated as extensions, with stake-weighted redistribution inducing agent-specific incentive constraints. Numerical checks support the closed-form Tier 1 quantities and illustrate threshold sensitivity.

title: When Regulation Has Memory: Hysteresis and Control Burden in Artificial Agency
summary:
Adaptive agents are usually judged by what they do, but an agent can appear stable while the internal effort required to keep it stable is increasing. This hidden regulatory burden matters for artificial agents operating under noise, delay, or changing demands: two systems may reach similar internal states while one requires much more corrective control to get there.
  Here, we study whether that burden depends on history. Using a computational model of adaptive uncertainty regulation, we drive an artificial agent through a continuous change in its uncertainty target and then reverse the change without resetting the agent. This creates a simple test for carryover: does the controller respond only to the current target, or does the path by which the agent reached that target still matter?
  The simulations show a clear history-dependent effect. The adaptive gain required to regulate the agent forms a reproducible hysteresis loop, meaning that the same target can require different levels of control depending on whether the agent is moving toward or returning from a more demanding regime. The timing of regulation also matters. When stabilization is available before disturbance exposure, the agent generally requires less adaptive gain than when it can only recover after disturbance has already acted.
  The state-level coherence measure also shows path dependence, but the timing effect is much clearer in regulatory gain. The main difference is therefore not that anticipatory regulation produces a completely different state. Rather, it reaches comparable regulated behavior with lower modeled control demand. These results suggest that adaptive agents should be evaluated not only by whether they remain organized, but by how much regulation they must recruit to do so.

title: Ethics and Social Responsibility in AI-Assisted Interviewing: An LLM-in-the-Loop Study of AI-Generated Follow-Up Questions
comments: This work has been accepted to CHIWORK '26
summary: Semi-structured interviews rely on timely, context-sensitive follow-up questions, yet interviewers' cognitive load and limited domain familiarity can constrain probing depth. We report findings from an LLM-in-the-loop Wizard-of-Oz (WoZ) study that simulates an AI follow-up assistant in live interviewing while preserving human oversight. In our setup, a co-interviewer selectively relayed and could edit AI-generated follow-up questions (AGQs) produced in real time by GPT-4o, enabling a realistic approximation of deployment without fully automating the interaction. Across 17 interviewers with varied qualitative-method expertise, participants raised five interlocking concerns: (1) harmful or discriminatory language and unpredictable interaction harms, (2) undermining interviewees' sense of respect through divided attention and missing nonverbal cues, (3) technology-based participation inequality, (4) unclear responsibility when harms occur, and (5) privacy, disclosure, and compliance risks when AI listens, records, or transcribes sensitive content. We translate these concerns into design and governance implications for safer, more respectful, and more accountable AI-assisted interviewing.
comment: This work has been accepted to CHIWORK '26

title: Towards Critical IR Theories and Practices
summary: Belkin and Robertson urged us, half a century ago, to develop a theoretical foundation for understanding what constitutes societal good that can inform information retrieval (IR) research and serve as a basis for determining when we should limit our scientific inquiry in the face of demands that are contradictory to societal good. In this article, I argue that to achieve this, IR should embrace critical theories and practices in our work, and shift away from the dominant liberal frame through which much of the IR community today view societal concerns in context of our research. Unlike the liberal frame, the critical frame explicitly adopts nondomination as its stated goal which can clarify our conceptualization of societal good within the field, provide necessary theoretical underpinning that Belkin and Robertson urged the community to develop, and serve as a basis for critical appraisals of our progress in enacting desired societal change.

title: GPU-First Heisenberg-Picture Tensor Network Dynamics for the 2D Transverse-Field Ising Model
summary: We present CppSim, a C++/GPU 2D Ising simulator for Heisenberg-picture tensor network time evolution on GPUs. The key computational contributions are: first, a zero-malloc GPU workspace that pre-allocates all buffers at startup; second, a custom GPU tensor permutation kernel replacing host-side index shuffling with a pure device-to-device operation, yielding a 7.6x trotter speedup; third, a hybrid QR strategy selecting Cholesky-QR for tall-skinny matrices and Householder-QR otherwise; fourth, adaptive Belief Propagation with log-space Bethe partition function evaluation and explicit sign tracking.

AI.title_translation: 针对二维横场伊辛模型的GPU优先海森堡绘景张量网络动力学
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CppSim，一个高效的C++/GPU二维伊辛模拟器，通过零内存分配、自定义张量排列核（实现7.6倍加速）、混合QR策略和自适应信念传播，实现了GPU上高性能的海森堡绘景张量网络时间演化。
AI.motivation: 旨在开发一种高效的、GPU优先的C++/GPU二维伊辛模拟器（CppSim），用于在GPU上进行海森堡绘景张量网络时间演化，以克服传统模拟在计算效率和内存管理上的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了CppSim模拟器，其关键计算贡献包括：1) 启动时预分配所有缓冲区的零内存分配（zero-malloc）GPU工作空间；2) 自定义GPU张量排列内核，将主机端索引改组替换为纯设备到设备的物理操作；3) 针对高瘦矩阵选择Cholesky-QR、其余选择Householder-QR的混合QR策略；4) 具有对数空间Bethe配分函数评估和显式符号跟踪的自适应信念传播（Belief Propagation）。
AI.result: 成功开发了CppSim模拟器，其中自定义的GPU张量排列内核将主机端索引改组替换为纯设备到设备的操作，实现了7.6倍的Trotter加速。
AI.conclusion: CppSim通过一系列针对GPU架构优化的计算策略，为二维伊辛模型的海森堡绘景张量网络动力学模拟提供了一个极具性能优势的高效解决方案。
AI.translation: 我们展示了CppSim，这是一个用于在GPU上进行海森堡绘景张量网络时间演化的C++/GPU二维伊辛模拟器。其关键的计算贡献包括：第一，在启动时预分配所有缓冲区的零内存分配（zero-malloc）GPU工作空间；第二，一个自定义的GPU张量排列内核，它用纯设备到设备的操作取代了主机端的索引改组，实现了7.6倍的Trotter加速；第三，一种混合QR策略，对高瘦矩阵选择Cholesky-QR，对其他矩阵则选择Householder-QR；第四，具有对数空间Bethe配分函数评估和显式符号跟踪的自适应信念传播。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为CppSim的C++/GPU二维伊辛模拟器，专门用于GPU上的海森堡绘景张量网络时间演化。该模拟器通过引入零内存分配工作空间、自定义GPU张量排列内核（带来7.6倍Trotter加速）、混合QR分解策略以及带显式符号跟踪的自适应信念传播，显著提升了量子多体物理模拟的计算效率。
AI.keywords: 二维伊辛模型, 张量网络, GPU加速, 海森堡绘景, 动力学模拟
AI.comments: 该论文针对二维横场伊辛模型的张量网络模拟进行了深度的GPU底层优化。其创新点在于将多种高性能计算（HPC）技术（如零内存分配、硬件级张量排列、混合QR算法）与物理算法（海森堡绘景、信念传播）有机结合。尤其是7.6倍的Trotter加速，展示了定制化GPU内核在张量网络收缩和排列中的巨大潜力。局限性在于该方法目前主要针对二维伊辛模型，其向更通用、更复杂的张量网络拓扑结构的推广能力还有待在未来工作中进一步验证。

title: The Organizational Behavior of Agentic AI: Collective Intelligence in Human-Agent Workflows
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed not as a single assistant but as a collective of planners, solvers, reviewers, memory managers, tool users, and orchestrators. These systems are entering organisational workflows under familiar labels such as teams, managers, committees, markets, and workflows. This article asks whether such agent collectives exhibit organisational behaviour in a sense that is analytically comparable to, yet distinct from, human organisational behaviour. I argue that agentic AI is a partial organisational analogue. It resembles a human organisation because it differentiates work, coordinates interdependence, performs recurrent routines, crosses boundaries, and produces collective outcomes. It differs because these patterns are not sustained by motivation, identity, trust, employment, socialisation, or moral accountability. They are sustained by context architecture: prompts, memory, traces, schemas, tools, validators, and permissions. The article develops contextual transaction cost as the central mechanism linking these similarities and differences. Computational theorising, synthetic task simulations, real LLM agent traces, and robustness analyses show that human-imitation forms often underperform when they add lossy handoffs, correlated deliberation, and verification burdens, whereas shared-state and adaptive forms perform better when they make context durable, inspectable, and task-contingent. The article contributes to organisation studies by theorising agentic AI as an emerging object of organising and by specifying the interface conditions under which human and agentic organisational behaviour can jointly support collective intelligence.

AI.title_translation: 代理AI的组织行为：人机工作流中的集体智慧
AI.tldr: 本文探讨了代理AI集体的组织行为，指出其由“上下文架构”而非人类社会机制维持，并表明共享状态和自适应的AI组织形式比模仿人类的形式表现更好。
AI.motivation: 随着代理AI以团队、经理、委员会等形式被部署到组织工作流中，本文旨在探讨这些代理集体是否表现出在分析上与人类组织行为可比但又有所不同的组织行为。
AI.method: 本文提出了“上下文交易成本”（contextual transaction cost）作为连接人机组织行为异同的核心机制，并采用了计算理论化、合成任务模拟、真实的LLM代理追踪以及稳健性分析等方法进行研究。
AI.result: 研究表明，模仿人类组织形式的AI集体在增加有损交接、相关联的审议和验证负担时往往表现不佳；相反，共享状态（shared-state）和自适应（adaptive）的形式在使上下文具有持久性、可检查性和任务依赖性时表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 代理AI是人类组织的部分模拟物，通过将代理AI理论化为一种新兴的组织对象，并明确人类与代理组织行为共同支持集体智慧的接口条件，为组织研究做出了重要贡献。
AI.translation: 代理人工智能（Agentic AI）正越来越多地被部署，它不仅是单一的助手，而是由规划者、解决者、审查者、内存管理者、工具使用者和协调者组成的集体。这些系统正以团队、经理、委员会、市场和工作流等熟悉的标签进入组织工作流。本文探讨了这些代理集体是否表现出在分析上与人类组织行为具有可比性但又有所不同的组织行为。作者认为，代理AI是一种部分组织的模拟物。它类似于人类组织，因为它区分工作、协调相互依赖关系、执行循环例程、跨越边界并产生集体成果。但它的不同之处在于，这些模式并不是由动机、身份、信任、雇佣、社会化或道德责任来维持的。相反，它们是由上下文架构（提示词、内存、追踪、模式、工具、验证器和权限）维持的。本文开发了“上下文交易成本”作为联系这些相似性和差异性的核心机制。计算理论化、合成任务模拟、真实的LLM代理追踪和稳健性分析表明，当模仿人类的形式增加有损交接、相关联的审议和验证负担时，它们往往表现不佳；而当共享状态和自适应形式使上下文具有持久性、可检查性和任务依赖性时，它们的表现更好。本文通过将代理AI理论化为一个新兴的组织对象，并指定了人类和代理组织行为可以共同支持集体智慧的接口条件，从而对组织研究做出了贡献。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了由多个AI代理（如规划者、解决者、审查者等）组成的集体在组织工作流中的行为。作者指出，代理AI是人类组织的部分模拟物，它在工作分工和协调上与人类相似，但其运转不依赖于动机或信任，而是依赖于由提示、内存和工具等构成的“上下文架构”。研究通过模拟和实际追踪表明，共享状态和自适应的组织形式比单纯模仿人类的组织形式在人机协作中表现更优。
AI.keywords: 代理AI, 组织行为, 集体智慧, 上下文交易成本, 多智能体系统
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于跨学科地将传统组织行为学（OB）理论应用于多智能体（Multi-Agent）系统，提出了“上下文交易成本”这一核心机制，以解释AI集体行为与人类组织行为的异同。这一研究对于未来设计高效的人机协同工作流具有重要的理论和实践指导意义。其局限性可能在于，目前的结论主要依赖于计算理论、合成模拟和LLM追踪，在真实人类组织中的长期实证效果仍待进一步验证。

title: Measuring Judgment Quality in Natural-Language Explanations: Evidence from Forecasting Tournaments
summary: Decision-makers routinely rely on expert judgments accompanied by written explanations, yet explanation quality is difficult to measure at scale. Forecasting tournaments offer a natural testing ground: probabilistic judgments are paired with natural-language rationales and scored against realized outcomes. We introduce Explanation Quality Markers (EQMs), a set of sixty theory-guided reasoning patterns scored by large language models (LLMs). In a pre-registered analysis of over 55,000 forecast-rationale pairs from a multiyear forecasting tournament, EQMs predict accuracy at both the forecast and forecaster levels, consistently outperforming pre-LLM text-analysis methods. More than 90% of statistically significant pattern-level EQM-accuracy correlations match our directional hypotheses. The signal is asymmetric: EQMs identify likely underperformers more reliably than they distinguish the very best forecasters. Benchmarked against traditional indicators of forecasting skill, EQMs are the strongest predictor at the forecast level and competitive at the forecaster level, though weaker than prior accuracy. Human ratings of rationale quality are less consistently correlated with accuracy and place disproportionate weight on rationale length. Results transfer to an independent forecasting study. EQMs provide a scalable, interpretable method for extracting judgment-relevant information from written explanations.

AI.title_translation: 衡量自然语言解释中的判断质量：来自预测竞赛的证据
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一套基于大语言模型的解释质量标记（EQMs），能够比传统方法和人类更准确、更具规模地通过专家的书面理由来预测其预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 决策者在日常工作中高度依赖专家的书面解释，但在大规模场景下，如何客观、量化地衡量这些解释的质量一直是一个难题。预测竞赛由于能将概率判断、自然语言理由与实际结果进行对比，提供了一个理想的测试平台。
AI.method: 引入了解释质量标记（EQMs），这是一套包含60个由理论指导的推理模式的指标，并使用大语言模型（LLMs）进行评分。研究对一项多年预测竞赛中超过55,000个“预测-理由”对进行了预注册分析，并在一项独立的预测研究中进行了交叉验证。
AI.result:
1. EQMs在预测和预测者两个层面上均能有效预测准确性，且持续优于LLM出现前的传统文本分析方法；
2. 超过90%的显著相关性符合研究团队的方向性假设；
3. 信号具有不对称性，EQMs识别潜在表现不佳者的可靠性高于区分最优秀预测者；
4. 在预测层面，EQMs是比传统指标更强的预测器，在预测者层面也具有竞争力；
5. 相比之下，人类对解释质量的评分与实际准确性的相关性较弱，且过度看重解释的长度。
AI.conclusion: EQMs提供了一种可扩展且具有可解释性的方法，能够有效从书面解释中提取出与决策判断质量高度相关的信息，具有良好的跨研究推广性。
AI.translation: 决策者通常依赖附带书面解释的专家判断，但解释的质量难以进行大规模衡量。预测竞赛提供了一个天然的试验场：概率判断与自然语言理由相匹配，并根据实际结果进行评分。我们引入了解释质量标记（EQMs），这是一套由大型语言模型（LLMs）评分的、包含60个理论指导推理模式的指标。在对来自多年预测竞赛的55,000多个“预测-理由”对进行的预注册分析中，EQMs在预测和预测者层面上均能预测准确性，且持续优于大模型之前的文本分析方法。超过90%的具有统计学意义的模式级EQM与准确性相关性符合我们的方向性假设。这种信号是不对称的：EQMs识别可能表现不佳者的可靠性，高于其区分极优秀预测者的可靠性。与传统的预测技能指标相比，EQMs在预测层面是首要的预测指标，在预测者层面也具有竞争力，尽管弱于先前的准确性历史。人类对理由质量的评分与准确性的相关性较弱，且过度关注理由的长度。研究结果可推广至一项独立的预测研究。EQMs提供了一种可扩展、可解释的方法，用于从书面解释中提取与判断相关的信息。
AI.summary: 本研究针对如何大规模衡量专家书面解释质量的问题，提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的评估方法——解释质量标记（EQMs）。该方法包含60个理论指导的推理模式，通过对超过55,000个预测及其理由的分析，证明了EQMs能够有效预测预测的准确性，且表现优于传统文本分析和人类评分。该方法为从自然语言解释中提取决策质量信息提供了一种可扩展且可解释的全新途径。
AI.keywords: 解释质量 (Explanation Quality), 预测竞赛 (Forecasting Tournaments), 大语言模型 (Large Language Models), 判断质量 (Judgment Quality)
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于利用大语言模型（LLM）自动评估理论指导的推理模式（EQMs），从而解决了长期以来专家书面解释质量难以大规模量化评估的难题。其重要性在于，通过预测竞赛的客观结果验证了该评估方法的有效性，并揭示了人类评估（倾向于偏好冗长文本）的局限性。局限性在于，该方法在识别“表现不佳者”时比识别“顶尖预测者”更为可靠，说明其在筛选极少数最优决策时可能存在一定的局限性。

title: Multisensory Continual Learning: Adapting Pretrained Visuomotor Policies to Force
summary: Robot manipulation often relies on sensory feedback beyond vision, particularly in contact-rich settings where force, tactile, or audio signals reveal interaction states that are not directly observable from images. However, these modalities are often hardware- and task-specific, and large-scale multisensory robot datasets remain scarce. As a result, it is impractical to pretrain policies with every sensor they may encounter. We study multisensory continual learning: adapting a pretrained robot policy to new tasks with newly introduced modalities while preserving performance under the original sensor suite. We propose MuSe, which incorporates limited multisensory data into pretrained vision-only policies through multi-stage fusion, multisensory future prediction, and experience replay over pretraining data. We instantiate MuSe by augmenting a pretrained vision-only policy with force-torque sensing and evaluate it on real-world manipulation tasks. Our experiments show that MuSe performs strongly on contact-rich finetuning tasks while preserving, and in some cases improving, performance on the original pretraining tasks. These results suggest that a modest multisensory dataset can improve general robot capabilities beyond the finetuning distribution. Project website: https://jadenvc.github.io/multisensory-continual-learning/

AI.title_translation: 多模态持续学习：使预训练的视觉运动策略适应力反馈
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MuSe，一种通过多阶段融合、未来预测和经验回放将力矩传感器等新模态融入预训练视觉策略的持续学习方法，在提升接触密集型任务表现的同时保留了原有任务的能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作通常需要视觉以外的感官反馈（如力、触觉、声音），但这些模态具有硬件和任务特异性，且大规模多模态机器人数据集稀缺，导致无法在预训练阶段就包含所有可能遇到的传感器。因此，需要研究如何让预训练机器人策略适应引入新模态的新任务，同时保持在原有传感器组合下的性能。
AI.method: 提出MuSe框架，通过多阶段融合（multi-stage fusion）、多感官未来预测（multisensory future prediction）以及在预训练数据上的经验回放（experience replay），将有限的多感官数据整合到预训练的纯视觉策略中。在实验中，通过为预训练的纯视觉策略增加力矩感知来进行实例化。
AI.result: 在真实世界的操作任务中进行评估，结果表明MuSe在接触密集的微调任务上表现强劲，同时保留（甚至在某些情况下提高了）在原始预训练任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 适度的多感官数据集不仅能使策略适应新模态任务，还可以提高超出微调分布范围的通用机器人能力。
AI.translation: 机器人操作通常依赖于视觉之外的感官反馈，特别是在接触密集的场景中，力、触觉或音频信号可以揭示图像中无法直接观察到的交互状态。然而，这些模态通常是特定于硬件和任务的，且大规模的多感官机器人数据集仍然稀缺。因此，用机器人可能遇到的每种传感器来预训练策略是不切实际的。我们研究了多感官持续学习：使预训练的机器人策略适应引入新模态的新任务，同时保持在原始传感器套件下的性能。我们提出了 MuSe，它通过多阶段融合、多感官未来预测以及在预训练数据上的经验回放，将有限的多感官数据融入到预训练的纯视觉策略中。我们通过用六维力矩感知增强预训练的纯视觉策略来实例化 MuSe，并在真实世界的操控任务中对其进行评估。我们的实验表明，MuSe 在接触密集的微调任务上表现强劲，同时保留（在某些情况下甚至提高）了在原始预训练任务上的性能。这些结果表明，一个适度的多感官数据集可以提高超出微调分布的通用机器人能力。
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态机器人数据稀缺以及传感器硬件特异性的问题，提出了多感官持续学习方法MuSe。MuSe通过多阶段融合、多感官未来预测和经验回放机制，成功将力矩传感信息融入已有的预训练纯视觉策略中。实验证明，该方法不仅能显著提升机器人在接触密集型新任务上的表现，还能有效防止在原有纯视觉任务上的遗忘，甚至促进原有任务的性能，展示了利用少量多感官数据提升机器人泛化能力的潜力。
AI.keywords: 多感官持续学习, 视觉运动策略, 力矩感知, 机器人操作, 经验回放
AI.comments: 该论文切中了当前机器人具身智能领域的一个重要痛点：多模态数据的稀缺性与硬件多变性。其创新点在于将持续学习引入多感官策略微调中，不仅解决了新模态（如力觉）的引入问题，还通过经验回放避免了灾难性遗忘。局限性在于，目前仅在视觉和力觉融合上进行了实机验证，对于更多模态（如听觉、触觉阵列）的扩展效果以及异构传感器的兼容性还有待进一步探索。

title: Wait, am I Being Fair? Characterizing Deductive Stereotyping and Mitigating It with Fair-GCG
summary: Warning: This paper contains several toxic and offensive statements. While reasoning generally improves fairness in recent large language models (LLMs), failures persist. In this work, we identify a failure mode, deductive stereotyping, in which models apply population-level statistical regularities to individual cases, producing logically coherent yet socially biased inferences. We provide a statistical interpretation of this phenomenon. To steer models toward fairness-aware reasoning, we propose a reasoning-time injection framework. We further introduce Fair-GCG to systematically discover effective injection phrases. Injection phrases discovered by Fair-GCG improve performance across multiple fairness benchmarks, generalize from smaller to larger LLMs, improves reasoning-level fairness, reduces bias in open-ended generation, and transfer to real-world fairness-sensitive tasks.

AI.title_translation: 等等，我是公平的吗？刻画演绎刻板印象并使用 Fair-GCG 进行缓解
AI.tldr: 本文定义了大型语言模型中的“演绎刻板印象”这一失效模式，并提出了 Fair-GCG 框架，通过在推理阶段注入短语来引导模型进行公平感知推理，显著降低了社会偏见。
AI.motivation: 尽管推理通常能提高大语言模型（LLM）的公平性，但偏见失效依然存在。作者旨在识别并解决一种被称为“演绎刻板印象”的失效模式，即模型将群体层面的统计规律错误地应用于个体案例，从而产生逻辑连贯但带有社会偏见的推论。
AI.method:
1. 提供了演绎刻板印象（deductive stereotyping）的统计学解释。
2. 提出了一种推理时注入框架（reasoning-time injection framework）来引导模型进行公平感知推理。
3. 引入了 Fair-GCG 方法，用于系统性地发现能有效引导公平推理的注入短语。
AI.result: Fair-GCG 发现的注入短语在多个公平性基准上提高了性能，能够从较小的 LLM 泛化到较大的 LLM，提高了推理层面的公平性，减少了开放式生成中的偏见，并能成功迁移到现实世界中对公平敏感的任务中。
AI.conclusion: 提出的 Fair-GCG 框架和推理时注入方法能有效缓解大语言模型中的演绎刻板印象，提升模型在多种任务和基准上的公平性表现。
AI.translation: 警告：本文包含一些有毒和冒犯性的言论。虽然推理通常能提高最新大型语言模型（LLM）的公平性，但失效情况依然存在。在这项工作中，我们确定了一种失效模式，即演绎刻板印象（deductive stereotyping），在这种模式中，模型将群体层面的统计规律应用于个体案例，从而产生逻辑上连贯但具有社会偏见的推论。我们对这一现象提供了统计学解释。为了引导模型进行公平感知推理，我们提出了一种推理时注入框架。我们进一步引入了 Fair-GCG，以系统地发现有效的注入短语。由 Fair-GCG 发现的注入短语提高了在多个公平性基准上的性能，实现了从较小 LLM 到较大 LLM 的泛化，提高了推理层面的公平性，减少了开放式生成中的偏见，并能迁移到现实世界中对公平敏感的任务。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大语言模型在推理中存在的“演绎刻板印象”问题（即错误地将群体统计特征套用到个体上导致偏见）。为此，作者提出了一种推理时注入框架，并开发了 Fair-GCG 方法来自动发现能引导模型进行公平推理的短语，实验证明该方法在多项公平性基准和实际任务中均表现优异。
AI.keywords: 演绎刻板印象, 大语言模型, 公平性, 推理时注入, Fair-GCG
AI.comments: 本文敏锐地捕捉到了大语言模型在进行逻辑推理时可能产生的“演绎刻板印象”这一隐蔽偏见，并从统计学角度给出了合理解释。提出的 Fair-GCG 框架通过在推理时注入特定短语来引导公平性，是一种轻量且实用的缓解方案，具有很强的泛化能力和实际应用价值。

title: Multistage Defer Trees for Hybrid Interpretability: If at First You Can't Succeed, Tree Again
summary: Recent work has shown that well-optimized individual decision trees can match complex black box models in some settings, primarily in noisy domains. For the remaining settings, however, complex ensembled compositions of trees often achieve higher accuracy at the cost of interpretability, leaving practitioners with difficult modeling decisions along an accuracy-interpretability tradeoff. Ideally, we would like to classify as much of the data as possible with one or a small number of trees, achieving interpretability for most samples while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy. We introduce Multistage Defer Trees: a sequence of sparse decision trees that each make predictions for most samples, while deferring a small proportion to the next tree in the sequence or, ultimately, to a black box. We demonstrate that we can train this model class to match the performance of complex tree-based ensembles while routing most samples through only one or a small number of sparse decision trees. We discuss a range of techniques for training these models while maintaining simplicity. Our method expands the accuracy--interpretability frontier in settings where single-tree methods remain insufficient, demonstrating that even when complex models are necessary, they need not be fully opaque.

AI.title_translation: 用于混合可解释性的多阶段推迟树：如果起初无法成功，那就再次建树
AI.tldr: 提出了一种“多阶段推迟树”方法，通过顺序连接稀疏决策树并在必要时推迟到黑盒模型，实现了在保持高准确率的同时提高大部分样本的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 在非噪声领域中，复杂的集成模型虽然准确率高但缺乏可解释性，而单个决策树虽然可解释但准确率不足。研究者希望在保持高准确率的同时，让尽可能多的样本通过简单、可解释的树模型进行分类，从而在准确率和可解释性之间取得更好的权衡。
AI.method: 提出“多阶段推迟树（Multistage Defer Trees）”。该方法由一系列稀疏决策树组成，每个树为大多数样本做出预测，而将一小部分难以分类的样本推迟（defer）到序列中的下一棵树，或者最终推迟到黑盒模型中。
AI.result: 该模型能够达到与复杂集成树模型相匹配的性能，同时使大多数样本仅通过一个或少数几个稀疏决策树进行路由。
AI.conclusion: 该方法拓展了在单树方法不足的场景下的“准确率-可解释性”前沿，证明了即使在必须使用复杂模型的情况下，模型也无需完全不透明。
AI.translation: 最近的研究表明，在某些（主要是噪声）领域，经过良好优化的单个决策树可以与复杂的黑盒模型相媲美。然而，在其余场景中，复杂的集成树模型通常能获得更高的准确率，但代价是牺牲了可解释性，这使得从业者在准确率与可解释性的权衡中面临艰难的模型选择。理想情况下，我们希望用一个或少数几个树来对尽可能多的数据进行分类，从而在保持最先进准确率的同时，实现大多数样本的可解释性。我们引入了“多阶段推迟树”（Multistage Defer Trees）：这是一系列稀疏决策树，每个树对大多数样本进行预测，同时将一小部分样本推迟到序列中的下一个树，或者最终推迟到黑盒模型。我们证明了可以训练此类模型以匹配复杂集成树模型的性能，同时将大多数样本仅路由通过一个或少数几个稀疏决策树。我们讨论了在保持简单性的同时训练这些模型的一系列技术。在单树方法仍然不足的设置中，我们的方法扩展了准确率-可解释性的前沿，表明即使在必须使用复杂模型的情况下，它们也无需完全不透明。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“多阶段推迟树（Multistage Defer Trees）”的混合可解释性模型。该方法通过构建稀疏决策树序列，让每个树处理大部分易分类样本，并将难分类样本逐步推迟至后续树或黑盒模型。该方法在维持黑盒模型级别的高准确率的同时，使绝大多数样本能够通过高度可解释的简单树模型进行预测，从而优化了准确率与可解释性之间的权衡。
AI.keywords: 多阶段推迟树, 混合可解释性, 决策树, 准确率-可解释性权衡, 黑盒模型
AI.comments: 该方法极具创新性，巧妙地将“推迟（deferral）”机制引入到决策树序列中，实现了局部可解释性与全局高准确率的有机结合。其重要性在于为实际应用中面临的“准确率-可解释性”双重困境提供了一种实用的分流解决方案。局限性在于，摘要中未详细探讨推迟阈值的确定方法以及黑盒模型与树模型之间的协同训练难度，这可能在实际部署中带来额外的计算或调参开销。

title: A Three-Phase Foundation Model for Tax-Aware Personalized Portfolio Management
summary: We present a three-phase deep reinforcement learning system for personalized portfolio management that addresses three limitations shared by all prior financial RL work: 1) ticker lock-in, 2) monolithic objectives , and 3) static user models. Phase 1 pretrains a ticker-identity-free cross asset encoder via self-supervised learning on a multi-asset corpus, augmented by a frozen parallel branch using Chronos, a T5-based time series foundation model, fused via a learned gating mechanism. To our knowledge, this is the first application of a time series foundation model to portfolio management RL. The encoder generalizes to any publicly traded asset via a 50-dimensional observable metadata vector that requires no retraining for new tickers. Phase 2 fine-tunes a MoE (Mixture of Experts) portfolio actor critic with PPO under an objective-conditioned reward that simultaneously serves six distinct investment goals sampled per episode: short-term alpha, short-term gain, long-term gain, capital preservation, tax-loss harvesting, and long-term-gains-only. A MoE architecture assigns each objective to a specialized expert head (momentum, growth, defensive, tax-aware), and a learned intent router blends experts based on the active objective and current market regime, which eliminates cross-objective gradient conflict. Phase 3 adds a lightweight personalization layer further adapted at inference time to each individual via a 76-parameter LoRA module fine-tuned on real brokerage transaction history, inferring investment objectives from revealed trading behavior rather than questionnaires. A natural language intent parser converts free-form goals directly into structured investment objective parameters.

AI.title_translation: 考虑税务的个性化投资组合管理三阶段基础模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个三阶段深度强化学习系统，通过跨资产编码器、多目标混合专家（MoE）架构和LoRA个性化微调，实现了无资产绑定、多目标协同且具备税务意识的个性化投资组合管理。
AI.motivation: 现有的金融强化学习（RL）方法存在三个主要局限性：股票代码锁定（ticker lock-in，无法泛化到新资产）、单一的目标函数（monolithic objectives，无法同时满足多种投资目标）以及静态的用户模型（static user models，无法根据用户行为动态调整）。
AI.method:
提出一个三阶段深度强化学习系统：
1. 第一阶段：通过自监督学习在多资产语料库上预训练一个无股票身份的跨资产编码器，并融合了基于T5的时间序列基础模型Chronos；
2. 第二阶段：使用PPO算法在目标条件奖励下微调混合专家（MoE）投资组合Actor-Critic网络，利用意图路由器融合不同专家头以消除梯度冲突；
3. 第三阶段：通过在真实经纪交易历史微调的76参数LoRA模块添加轻量级个性化层，并使用自然语言意图解析器将自由形式的目标直接转换为结构化投资参数。
AI.result: 该系统成功实现了无需重新训练即可泛化到任何公开交易资产的编码器；通过MoE架构消除了跨目标的梯度冲突；并能够直接从用户的真实交易行为（而非问卷）中推断投资目标，实现了自由形式语言到结构化投资目标的直接转换。摘要中未提及具体的数值实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 该三阶段基础模型成功解决了先前金融强化学习在股票绑定、单一目标和静态用户模型上的局限，实现了一种高度灵活、可泛化、且具备税务意识和动态个性化的投资组合管理系统。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个用于个性化投资组合管理的三阶段深度强化学习系统，该系统解决了先前所有金融强化学习工作所共有的三个局限性：1）股票代码锁定，2）单一目标，以及3）静态用户模型。第一阶段通过在多资产语料库上进行自监督学习，预训练一个无股票身份的跨资产编码器，并通过学习到的门控机制融合了一个使用Chronos（一种基于T5的时间序列基础模型）的冻结并行分支。据我们所知，这是时间序列基础模型在投资组合管理强化学习中的首次应用。该编码器通过一个50维的可观测元数据向量，可以泛化到任何公开交易的资产，而无需对新股票进行重新训练。第二阶段使用PPO算法在目标条件奖励下微调混合专家（MoE）投资组合Actor-Critic，该奖励同时服务于每个回合采样的六个不同投资目标：短期阿尔法、短期收益、长期收益、资本保护、税收损失收割和仅限长期收益。MoE架构将每个目标分配给专门的专家头（动量、增长、防御、税务意识），并且学习到的意图路由器根据活动目标和当前市场状态融合专家，从而消除了跨目标的梯度冲突。第三阶段添加了一个轻量级的个性化层，在推理时通过在真实经纪交易历史微调的76参数LoRA模块进一步适应每个个体，从显现的交易行为而非问卷中推断投资目标。自然语言意图解析器将自由形式的目标直接转换为结构化的投资目标参数。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于个性化投资组合管理的三阶段深度强化学习系统。该系统克服了传统金融强化学习模型中股票代码锁定、单一目标和静态用户模型的限制。第一阶段结合自监督学习与时间序列基础模型Chronos预训练跨资产编码器；第二阶段利用PPO和混合专家（MoE）架构同时优化六个不同的投资目标（包括税务优化）；第三阶段通过LoRA模块和自然语言解析器实现基于用户真实交易行为的轻量级、动态个性化配置。
AI.keywords: 投资组合管理, 深度强化学习, 混合专家模型, 时间序列基础模型, 个性化微调
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将时间序列基础模型（Chronos）与强化学习结合应用于投资组合管理，并采用混合专家（MoE）架构解决多目标冲突，设计非常精巧。此外，利用LoRA进行轻量级用户个性化微调和自然语言解析器转换投资意图，极大地增强了模型在实际金融场景中的实用性与用户友好度。

title: Estimating Supply Incrementality in Two-sided Marketplaces: A Causal Machine Learning Approach
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the KDD 2025 Workshop on Causal Inference and Machine Learning in Practice (not presented)
summary: In two-sided marketplaces with heterogeneous products, it is important to understand the causal relationship between additional supply and marketplace outcomes, such as the total quantity transacted or transaction value in the marketplace. This paper studies a causal machine learning approach to estimating this relationship across product segments. We use the Airbnb marketplace as an example, focusing on the impact of additional listing supply on total bookings, but the methodology applies to other two-sided marketplaces. Our approach combines double/debiased machine learning with a hierarchical Bayesian framework that leverages pre-existing knowledge as priors. We construct tractable and informative features for the model by leveraging measures of product segment similarity from the geospatial literature. We find that such a model provides plausible estimates of the marketplace returns to additional supply and strong out of sample performance.
