summary: Long-context Large Language Model inference is severely bottlenecked by the massive Key-Value (KV) cache, yet existing sparse attention methods often suffer from static fixed-budget (Top-k) retrieval or rely on proxy scores that are computationally expensive and biased. To address these limitations, we propose RaBitQCache, a novel sparse attention framework that utilizes randomized rotated binary quantization and high-throughput binary-INT4 arithmetic to efficiently estimate attention weights. Our proxy score serves as an unbiased estimator with a proven error bound, enabling adaptive Top-p retrieval that dynamically adjusts the token budget based on actual attention sparsity. We further implement a hardware-aware system with asynchronous pipelining and lazy updates to mask overhead. Evaluations demonstrate that RaBitQCache significantly accelerates inference and reduces memory I/O while preserving generation quality compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Sakuraaa0/RaBitQCache.git.

title: FinPersona-Bench: A Benchmark for Longitudinal Psychometric Stability of Autonomous Financial Agents
comments: 29 pages, includes figures and tables; formalizes Mandate Salience Decay and introduces FinPersona-Bench
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous financial agents initialized with explicit behavioral mandates such as "preserve capital" or "avoid speculative bets" that are meant to govern every decision throughout deployment. In practice, however, as market context accumulates over long horizons, these mandates gradually lose their behavioral influence, a phenomenon we formalize as Mandate Salience Decay (MSD). To measure MSD objectively, we introduce FinPersona-Bench, a simulation benchmark in which a synthetic market decouples observable price from hidden fundamental value, enabling falsifiable evaluation across three failure modes: trading without signal in calm markets, panic-selling during crashes, and ignoring fundamental value during speculative bubbles. Evaluating 18 leading frontier and open-source LLMs, each assigned one of three behavioral profiles ranging from strict capital preservation to aggressive growth, shows that MSD compounds over time and is model-dependent. In crash scenarios, the behavioral gap between static agents and those receiving periodic mandate re-grounding grows 4.4x from the first to the final quarter of the simulation. The effects of mandate re-grounding are not uniformly positive: it consistently helps conservative agents in low-signal markets but actively worsens behavior for aggressive agents in the same setting. These findings suggest that reliable long-horizon deployment requires selective, mandate-aware re-grounding based on agent profile and market regime.
comment: 29 pages, includes figures and tables; formalizes Mandate Salience Decay and introduces FinPersona-Bench

title: On the Convergence of Self-Improving Online LLM Alignment
summary: The Self-Improving Alignment (SAIL) algorithm addresses distribution shift by reducing a bilevel formulation of the problem to an efficient, single-level method. Empirically, SAIL has demonstrated strong performance on this task. However, a formal analysis of its convergence properties has been lacking. We identify a key theoretical challenge: the standard SAIL objective function is not guaranteed to be strongly concave due to unfavorable properties of its Hessian. To address this limitation, we propose a regularized objective, SAIL-RevKL, which incorporates a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence penalty to improve the optimization landscape. Our central theoretical contribution is to prove that this regularized objective satisfies the Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition within a bounded parameter space. We establish global convergence guarantees, achieving a near-linear sample complexity. We further validate the effectiveness and stability of SAIL-RevKL through empirical evaluations, demonstrating that it outperforms the vanilla SAIL on both MuJoCo benchmarks and LLM alignment tasks.

title: Graph Scheduling with Group Completion Times
summary: In the Graph Scheduling problem we schedule a given multiset of edges on discrete time steps, such that at each step the set of edges forms a matching. The goal is to minimize the sum of weighted group completion times, where a group is a set of edges and it completes when the last edge has been scheduled. Two popular variants of this problem are Coflow Scheduling and Data Migration. Our main result is extending a recent iterated rounding approach from Coflow Scheduling, roughly corresponding to the bipartite case, to the general Graph Scheduling problem. This yields an essentially tight $(2+ε)$-approximation for the asymptotic setting where OPT is assumed to be large. For this we rely on polyhedral techniques from general matching, namely odd-set inequalities, and graph theoretical results on edge colorings in multigraphs. The state-of-the-art approximation algorithm for Data Migration is a $(1 + φ)$-approximation that improves when OPT is small. Taking the best of this and our main result, we obtain an improvement of the approximation rate for Data Migration in any regime.

title: A time-series classification framework for individual-level absenteeism prediction under severe class imbalance
summary: Staff absenteeism imposes substantial operational costs in high-demand work environments such as healthcare, emergency services, meat processing, construction, and courier and delivery services, where proactive workforce planning depends on reliable individual-level absence prediction. Existing regression and classification approaches share a structural limitation; they map features observed at time t to labels at the same time t, reproducing already-realised outcomes rather than predicting future events, and discard the sequential behavioural structure inherent in individual attendance histories. We propose a Time Series Classification (TSC) framework that separates historical attendance sequences from future absence labels, enabling genuinely proactive prediction. Due to the lack of public longitudinal attendance data, we construct a reproducible simulated dataset calibrated to the UCI dataset. We analyse Binary Focal Loss (BFL) and Geometric Mean (G-Mean) loss under severe class imbalance using only the imbalance ratio $ρ$. For BFL, the initial gradient ratio is $ρα/(1-α)$, implying the balanced weight $α= 1/(1+ρ) \approx 0.023$. Experiments show that performance is governed mainly by $α$, with BFL achieving specificity 0.813 and balanced accuracy 0.888, comparable to G-Mean. Unlike BFL, G-Mean adapts automatically without parameter calibration. Among three deep learning architectures evaluated, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and the hybrid LSTM-Fully Convolutional Network (LSTM-FCN), the LSTM-FCN delivers strong precision and specificity. Stable performance is obtained with batch sizes >= 64 and window sizes between 40-80 days, yielding balanced accuracy of approximately 80% on held-out test data.

title: MV-GEL: Language-Driven Multi-View Geometric Entity Localization on Meshes
summary: Identifying and grounding precise geometric entities, such as edges, planar regions, and curved surfaces within 3D objects, is foundational to computer-aided design (CAD), robotic manipulation, and scientific simulation. Although modern Vision Language Models (VLMs) have advanced referring segmentation (RIS) in the image domain, extending such language-driven localization to structured 3D geometry is substantially harder. The 3D object appearance is highly sensitive to viewpoints; a single perspective may render a target entity clearly observable, while another may suffer from severe occlusion or foreshortening. In this work, we attempt to solve these challenges with MV-GEL (Multi-View Geometric Entity Localization), a framework for localizing fine-grained geometric entities on polygon meshes from natural language queries. Our key insight is that reliable CAD entity (i.e., faces, edges or solids) localization depends on selecting views that make the queried entity maximally interpretable. We introduce GELviews, a prompt-conditioned ranking module that prioritizes viewpoints based on language prompted observability of geometric CAD entities. Selected views are processed by a VLM-based reasoning segmentation backbone, and predicted masks are lifted to the corresponding meshes via geometry-aware ray casting. Our framework is completely CAD agnostic and relies only on 3D meshes. Experiments show up to a 1.7X improvement in face-level IoU and over 4.5X gains in edge-level F1 compared to vanilla baselines, substantially outperforming CLIP-based and random view sampling, particularly for thin and view-sensitive structures.The dataset, code and trained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/kbali1297/MV-GEL.

title: PEERS: A Parallel and Exact Effective Resistance Solver via Implicit Inversion and Augmented Symbolic Analysis
comments: 14 pages, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems (TCAD)
summary: High-precision effective resistance computation is a cornerstone of Electronic Design Automation (EDA) sign-off, yet it remains a fundamental bottleneck in large-scale power grid analysis, spectral sparsification, and circuit reliability. Existing approaches face a prohibitive "precision-memory impasse": approximate methods lack the stringent accuracy required for high-stakes industrial sign-off, while exact methods either suffer from redundant query overheads or trigger $O(n^2)$ memory explosions. To resolve this, we propose PEERS, a Parallel and Exact Effective Resistance Solver powered by an implicit inverse computing model of the Cholesky factor. By integrating a state-inherited augmented depth-first search (DFS) with a dynamic query update mechanism, PEERS eliminates numerical redundancy and evaluates all-edge resistance queries in a single parallel sweep. We provide a rigorous Work-Span analysis, proving that for graphs satisfying an $O(n^α)$ separator theorem, PEERS achieves a theoretically optimal parallel span of $O(n^α)$ while strictly maintaining $O(nnz(L))$ space complexity. Numerical evaluations on industrial benchmarks demonstrate that PEERS achieves an average speedup of 83.3x over state-of-the-art parallel solvers under identical memory constraints. Notably, PEERS processes a 1-million-node industrial graph in just 18.8 seconds and scales to 17 million nodes in under an hour, providing the first computationally feasible path for exact all-edge resistance analysis in multi-million-gate designs.
comment: 14 pages, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems (TCAD)

title: Beyond the Expressivity-Trainability Paradox: A Dynamical Lie Algebra Perspective on Navigating Barren Plateaus in Quantum Machine Learning
summary: As Quantum Machine Learning (QML) transitions toward practical implementation, the field faces a critical architectural bottleneck that challenges the fundamental assumptions of classical statistical learning theory. In classical deep learning, increasing model capacity typically risks overfitting. However, this study advances a counter-intuitive paradigm: unstructured contemporary QML architectures suffer from a profound state of quantum underfitting, driven by the "expressivity-trainability paradox." We demonstrate that the vast Hilbert space capacity of Parameterized Quantum Circuits (PQCs)-traditionally chased as the source of quantum advantage is the direct mathematical cause of Barren Plateaus (BPs), where gradient landscapes become exponentially flat. By synthesizing recent breakthroughs in Dynamical Lie Algebras (DLAs) and Geometric QML, we establish a comprehensive framework linking the algebraic dimension of circuit generators to their optimization dynamics. Furthermore, we empirically validate this framework on a non-linear binary classification task, illuminating a uniquely quantum manifestation of the bias-variance tradeoff: while unstructured architectures achieve near-perfect training accuracy via unscalable parameterization (quantum overfitting), embedding group-theoretic geometric priors acts as a structural regularizer. By restricting the DLA growth to a polynomial regime, our symmetry-preserving approach sacrifices raw memorization capacity to guarantee scalable, gradient-rich training landscapes, offering a robust roadmap for "Trainability-by-Design" in scalable quantum neural networks.

title: DataEvolver: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Data Construction for Text-Rich Image Generation
summary: Text-rich image generation is one of the most challenging settings in image generation, since models must simultaneously produce visually realistic images and render legible, semantically aligned, and layout-consistent text. Existing data pipelines usually follow a static crawl-filter-freeze paradigm. They collect candidate samples, filter them once, and freeze the accepted data for training. However, rejected samples are usually discarded, although they often contain useful failure signals such as OCR errors and semantic mismatches. As a result, later construction rounds may repeat the same failure modes. To address these limitations, we propose DataEvolver, a self-evolving multi-agent framework for text-rich image data construction. DataEvolver treats data construction as feedback-driven construction policy evolution. A Retriever collects candidate samples, a Verifier assigns quality scores and rejection causes, a Critic summarizes round-level feedback into semantic feedback, and a Generator completes under-covered regions through targeted synthesis. The updated feedback memory then guides the next construction round. Experiments on text-rich image generation benchmarks show that DataEvolver produces more useful training data than fixed-dataset baselines under matched data budgets. At the 0.75M scale on PixArt-alpha, DataEvolver improves OCR-F1 over the strongest baseline by 85.3 percent on TextScenesHQ and 35.3 percent on LongTextBench. The improvements are consistent across both evaluated benchmarks and also transfer to Show-o2, indicating that the benefit of DataEvolver is not tied to a single downstream generator. These results suggest that rejected samples can provide actionable feedback for improving text-rich image data construction.

title: Modality-Driven Search with Holistic Trace Judging for ARC-AGI-2
comments: 37 pages, 4 figures; source code available at https://github.com/beetree/ARC-AGI
summary:
Large language models can produce fluent, internally coherent reasoning traces for abstract reasoning tasks while still being confidently wrong - making selection among candidates, not just generation, the central challenge. I present a solver for ARC-AGI-2, a few-shot visual reasoning benchmark, built around two principles: (i) treating reasoning modalities as search operators, generating diverse candidates independently across text, image, and code channels, and (ii) context-preserving holistic judging, in which a judge model jointly compares all candidate reasoning traces within a single long-context prompt. Unlike self-consistency or majority voting, this approach reliably recovers correct minority hypotheses on tasks where the modal answer is wrong.
  On the ARC Prize semi-private evaluation set, the solver achieves 72.9 percent at USD 38.99 per task - the highest score on the verified leaderboard at the time of writing, exceeding the best standalone frontier models, GPT-5.2 Pro at 54.2 percent and Gemini 3 Pro at 54.0 percent, by +18.7 percentage points. On the public evaluation set, it achieves 76.1 percent at USD 19.69 per task. I release the full source code and document extensive negative results, including the finding that prescriptive prompting templates and iterative refinement systematically reduce hypothesis diversity and degrade performance.
comment: 37 pages, 4 figures; source code available at https://github.com/beetree/ARC-AGI

title: AutoTrainess: Teaching Language Models to Improve Language Models Autonomously
summary: Training language models (LMs) remains a highly human-intensive process, even as frontier language model agents become increasingly capable at software engineering and other long-horizon tasks. A central challenge is that autonomous post-training is not just a coding problem: it requires the agent to repeatedly plan iterations, construct benchmark-aligned data, run stable training jobs, evaluate checkpoints, and preserve experiment state across many hours of interaction. We present AutoTrainess, a LM agent that exposes these operations as a repository of agent-computer interfaces for planning, data preparation, training, evaluation, and logging. Rather than leaving the agent to operate in a raw CLI environment with an underspecified action space, AutoTrainess externalizes prior human experience as explicit workflows, rules, and execution constraints that guide the agent toward effective and reliable training behavior. On PostTrainBench, AutoTrainess consistently outperforms CLI-only baselines, achieving 26.94 average score with GPT-5.4 (Codex) versus 23.21 for CLI-only. It also generalizes across models and harnesses, improving DeepSeek-V4-Flash (OpenCode) from 12.13 to 19.58.

title: In-situ Indexing via Memristive Content-Addressable Memory
summary: Processing-in-Memory (PIM) is a proven paradigm for overcoming the ``memory wall". However, while data indexing is severely bottlenecked by this same wall, it remains unclear how indexing can effectively benefit from PIM's unique capabilities. We present PATH, an in-situ indexing architecture that bridges this gap by leveraging the massive parallelism and inherent data-movement of PIMs. Specifically, we first reformulate the fundamental indexing operations, namely Insert, Search, Update, and Delete, into highly parallel in-situ content-addressable memory operations executed directly within memory arrays. Taking hash indexes as a typical case, we elaborate how PATH breaks the inherent trade-off among memory accesses, load factor, and process latency in conventional hashing schemes. By adopting ultra-large logical buckets and in-memory moving, PATH virtually eliminates the cost of hash collision resolution and significantly reduces resizing overhead. Compared with state-of-the-art schemes, PATH achieves $4.7-7.8\times$ higher throughput, $>14.5\times$ lower tail latency, and $>61.4\%$ fewer memory accesses under insertions, laying a scalable foundation for next-generation data-centric computing.

title: AugSplat: Radiance Field-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Settings
summary: Generating high-quality novel views at real-time frame rates remains a central challenge in 3D vision, particularly in sparse-view scenarios. Neural radiance fields have demonstrated robust reconstruction from limited observations, but their reliance on volumetric rendering leads to high computational cost and slow inference. In contrast, Gaussian Splatting methods achieve real-time rendering through rasterization, but their optimization is highly sensitive to the quality of the initial geometry. This sensitivity becomes especially problematic in sparse-view settings, where limited observations often lead to incomplete or noisy point-cloud reconstructions. In this work, we present AugSplat, a simple framework for improving Gaussian Splatting in sparse-view regimes using radiance-field-based view augmentation. We first train a radiance field on the sparse input views and use it to synthesize additional images from nearby novel viewpoints, increasing the effective view-space coverage available for supervision. These synthetic views are then used as auxiliary supervision during Gaussian Splatting optimization. We study two variants: Staged AugSplat, which uses synthetic views for an initial optimization phase before switching to real images, and Dual AugSplat, which jointly trains on real and synthetic views with a decaying synthetic loss weight. Experiments on sparse-view mip-NeRF 360 scenes show that AugSplat improves reconstruction quality over standard Gaussian Splatting. Staged AugSplat achieves the strongest average performance, while Dual AugSplat provides a closely performing formulation that keeps real-image supervision active throughout training, and both variants preserve real-time rendering at inference.

title: CVE-TTP KG: Knowledge Graph Linking Software Vulnerabilities to Attack Behaviors
summary: In the evolving threat landscape, adversaries exploit software vulnerabilities to launch sophisticated attacks, challenging traditional defenses. Although databases like CVE and NVD provide detailed technical information, they often lack links to attacker behaviors such as tactics and techniques, limiting effective threat interpretation and response. This work bridges this gap by connecting vulnerabilities with behavioral patterns from the MITRE ATT&CK framework. We construct a CVE-TTP Knowledge Graph that links CVEs to tactics and techniques using classification and relation extraction. Transformer-based models are developed for behavior identification, with CySecBERT achieving macro F1-scores of 87.71% (techniques) and 96.16% (tactics). Also, we created an annotated dataset with 24,820 entities and 43,608 relations for entity and relation extraction. The pipeline-based approach achieves macro F1-scores of 0.86 (entity extraction) and 0.99 (relation extraction), while a span-based joint model achieves 0.78. These outputs are integrated into a Neo4j-based Cyber Threat Knowledge Graph, enabling structured visualization of vulnerabilities.

title: Directed Low Diameter Decomposition for Structured Digraphs
summary:
Low diameter decompositions, or LDDs for short, are a fundamental primitive in the design of efficient graph algorithms. Roughly speaking, an LDD is a distribution over partitions of the vertices into bounded-diameter clusters such that nearby vertices are likely to be clustered together. Recently, there has been growing interest in lifting the notion of LDDs into \emph{directed graphs}. In particular, there are two natural directed analogues. The first is a directed LDD, where after removing a random subset of edges, every strongly connected component has a small diameter. The second is a quasipartition, which imposes the stronger requirement that whenever one vertex can still reach another after the edge removal, the two vertices must be close in the original directed metric. Every quasipartition yields an LDD, but the converse does not necessarily hold.
  In this work, we initiate the systematic study of LDDs in structured directed graphs. As our first main result, we show that any directed graph with pathwidth $\mathsf{pw}$ admits an $(O(\mathsf{pw}), Δ)$-LDD. This improves upon the previous best-known $(2^{O(\mathsf{pw}^2)}, Δ)$-LDD construction, which was implicitly derived from the quasipartition result of Salmasi, Sidiropoulos, and Sridhar [SODA'19].
  As our second result, we show that the integrality gap of the Directed Non-Bipartite Sparsest-Cut LP relaxation on an $n$-vertex graph with treewidth $\mathsf{tw}$ is $O(\mathsf{tw} \log n)$. This improves upon the $O(\mathsf{tw}\log^2 n)$ bound of Mémoli, Sidiropoulos, and Sridhar [ICALP'16, Algorithmica'18]. We obtain this result through the refined analysis of the quasipartition construction of Mémoli et al. for bounded treewidth graphs.

title: Stabilization Learning: A Paradigm Transition Bridging Control Theory and Machine Learning
summary: Stabilization learning is an interdisciplinary paradigm that bridges control theory and machine learning. Its core idea is to enable systems to adjust their policies under perturbations or environmental changes through real-time feedback and adaptive mechanisms. It takes stability as its primary goal, distinguishing itself from certificate learning, which focuses on formal proofs, and reinforcement learning, which pursues optimality. It encompasses a range of methods, including Lyapunov-based analysis and design, deep feature extraction, and data-driven feedback synthesis, and is applicable to complex high-dimensional, nonlinear systems. This paper elaborates on the two major categories of stability in stabilization learning, as well as three typical application scenarios: control, observation, and recognition. It constructs a unified mathematical framework based on a six-tuple, and expands into two types of seven-tuple models: constrained learning with barrier spaces and tracking problems with targets. It also analyzes the roles, meanings, and implementation choices of key elements such as state space, controlled system, metrics, and policy. Through the formal reformulation of 11 types of problems, including multi-agent cooperative tracking, visual servo robot position stabilization, chess games, and Push-T tasks, this paper illustrates the potential applicability of the framework across multiple domains. Finally, it points out that future stabilization learning will focus on two major directions: constructing a unified problem framework and achieving efficient and robust learning, providing solutions for complex system control that combine theoretical rigor with engineering practicality.

title: ACE: Pluggable Adaptive Context Elasticizer across Agents
summary: The increasing complexity of agentic tasks has led to rapidly growing trajectory lengths, which poses significant challenges for large language model (LLM) based agents with fixed context windows. Existing context management techniques, such as truncation and summarization, suffer from inherent inflexibility and irreversibility: once information is discarded or compressed, it cannot be recovered even when it becomes critically relevant in later decision steps. To address these limitations, we propose the Adaptive Context Elasticizer (ACE), a plug-and-play module that elastically orchestrates historical step information into the agent's context at each decision step. ACE maintains a lossless message maintenance layer that stores both raw messages and compressed abstractions for each historical step, while a context orchestration layer adaptively assigns each step an elastic type as raw, abstract, or drop, at every decision step based on the current task state. This reversible design ensures that the main LLM always receives a compact yet information-rich context. We adapt ACE to four diverse agent frameworks, including ReAct, DeepAgent, WebThinker, and MiroFlow, without training or architectural modifications. Experiments show that ACE consistently outperforms truncation and summarization baselines, and brings consistent performance gains across all four agent frameworks.

title: Fast Risk Certification of Candidate Trajectories under Uncertain Time-Varying Constraints
summary: This paper studies the certification of a fixed candidate trajectory on a finite certification grid under parametric uncertainty. For each constraint-time pair, we define a scalar measure of constraint violation and aggregate the resulting pointwise chance constraints into a worst-case Value-at-Risk (VaR) margin. The goal is not to generate a new trajectory, but to assess online whether a trajectory produced by a planner or predictive controller is sufficiently safe on the certification grid. Direct evaluation requires repeated uncertainty propagation and is often too expensive for computationally demanding models. We therefore adopt an offline-online scheme: offline, a surrogate of the constraint violation map along the candidate trajectory is constructed using polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) when the uncertainty law is known, or kernel regression when only sampled input-output data are available; online, the surrogate is sampled to evaluate conservative VaR bounds at low computational cost. On the theoretical side, we derive a finite-sample upper bound for the grid-based VaR margin using empirical quantiles, the Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz (DKW) inequality, and a union bound over all constraint-time pairs, without assuming a parametric family for the underlying violation distribution. We also show how a uniform surrogate error bound transfers to the certified VaR margin. The approach is illustrated on a crystallization population balance model, where the surrogate-based risk estimates track direct Monte Carlo results while substantially reducing online evaluation time.

title: FLARE-AI: Flaw Reporting for AI
summary: Flaw reporting for deployed AI systems is fundamental to identifying system failures and improving AI safety. Yet the AI reporting ecosystem is fragmented: researchers who identify flaws often do not know what or where to report, and groups who receive reports rarely share them with other relevant stakeholders. As a result, good-faith reporters duplicate effort by submitting many different forms, and recipients lack standardized, triage-ready information. We audit 12 reporting systems published by AI developers, cybersecurity groups, and AI flaw aggregators, identifying five recurring design challenges spanning discoverability, scope, information collection, coordination, and guidance for strict-liability cases. Building on this analysis and feedback from 49 experts across 32 organizations representing developers, security researchers, and ecosystem coordinators, we introduce FLARE-AI, an open-source AI flaw reporting system designed for interoperability with existing systems. FLARE-AI streamlines flaw report creation by collecting triage-relevant information through conditional logic and early classification, then enables optional dissemination of standardized, machine-readable reports to multiple developers, coordinators, and incident registries from a single submission. By lowering barriers to reporting AI flaws and improving interoperability across stakeholders, FLARE-AI helps break down silos and accelerate remediation across the AI ecosystem.

title: Mitigating Positional Leakage in 3D Masked Autoencoders for Robust Representation Learning
summary: Masked autoencoding has emerged as a prominent paradigm for self-supervised learning on 3D point clouds, achieving competitive performance across downstream tasks. Unlike its 2D counterpart, 3D masked autoencoding directly reconstructs spatial coordinates, making it inherently susceptible to positional leakage. In this work, we identify that the decoder in existing 3D MAE frameworks tends to over-rely on positional information, which weakens semantic representation learning and leads to suboptimal feature quality. To address this issue, we propose MPL-MAE, a masked point learning framework that mitigates positional over-reliance while enhancing the utilization of encoder features. Specifically, we introduce a recalibrated positional embedding module that suppresses metric-dominant coordinate signals while preserving geometric topology, together with a gated positional interface module that dynamically regulates positional injection during reconstruction. These designs promote a more balanced interaction between spatial priors and semantic features, yielding robust and informative representations. Extensive experiments across downstream tasks demonstrate that MPL-MAE consistently achieves competitive performance, validating its effectiveness. Code is available at https://github.com/yanx57/MPL-MAE.

title: FormIDEAble: Safe and Socially-aware Autonomous Systems
summary: Autonomous agents operating in socio-critical settings must coordinate with humans under uncertainty while respecting explicit safety constraints. Existing approaches either account for social dynamics without formal guarantees or provide formal assurance while abstracting away human behaviour. We introduce FormIDEAble, a formally grounded approach for synthesising socially-aware cooperation strategies with safety guarantees. The cooperation between humans and the autonomous agent is modelled as a Priced Timed Markov Decision Process, and decision-making is formulated as a cost-bounded reachability problem. We illustrate the approach using an emergency evacuation scenario. Initial experimental evidence demonstrates the effectiveness of the approach and highlights the trade-offs between optimisation and safety guarantees. FormIDEAble provides a principled foundation for formally assured, socially-aware decision-making in socio-critical systems.

title: Temperature Field Reconstruction of Tungsten Monoblock Divertor on EAST using Physics-aware Neural Operator Transformer
summary: Accurate modeling of the divertor temperature field is essential for preventing material melting and damage and for extending the service life of fusion devices. However, conventional numerical methods, such as the Finite Element Method (FEM), are computationally expensive and therefore unsuitable for real-time applications. Therefore, a fast and generalizable method is required for real-time reconstruction of the divertor temperature field and subsequent real-time control. To address the above issue, we propose a Physics-aware Neural Operator Transformer (PNOT) to characterize the spatiotemporal evolution of the divertor temperature field. It models boundary heat-flux relations as a structured graph and employs graph attention to explicitly capture spatial physical dependencies. Inspired by physics-aware attention, we further develop a physics-aware neural operator module to aggregate query points with similar physical conditions via slicing and model heat diffusion, while a gradient-constrained Sobolev regularization loss enforces consistency between function values and their derivatives. Experimental results show that these physical constraints improve prediction accuracy while preserving physical consistency. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion

title: Which Tokens Matter? Adaptive Token Selection for RLVR with the Relative Surprisal Index
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful tool for propelling Large Language Models (LLMs) beyond imitation-based training towards more robust reasoning capabilities. Among existing approaches, RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for advancing LLM reasoning. Despite its empirical success, recent studies have offered different insights. One line of inquiry advocates prioritizing high-entropy token positions during training, while another perspective cautions against allowing low-probability tokens to dominate gradient updates. Notably, although high-entropy tokens are usually correlated with low probability, both paradigms empirically yield substantial performance gains. In this work, we argue that evaluating sampled-token probability or entropy in isolation is insufficient to capture the policy optimization dynamics. To resolve this tension, we introduce the Relative Surprisal Index (RSI), a principled, information-theoretic metric that naturally couples the token's entropy with the probability of the selected token. We show that, under mild conditions, RSI is related to the local ratio between the first-order variations of the logit-gradient norm and predictive entropy under a selected-logit perturbation. Building on RSI, we propose RSI Selection (RSI-S), an entropy-adaptive token filtering method that retains tokens within a stable RSI interval. RSI-S successfully reconciles previous contradictory paradigms and filters out both redundant low-surprisal tokens and unstable high-surprisal tail tokens. Empirical evaluations show that RSI-S achieves higher avg@32 accuracy across different model scales (Qwen2.5-1.5B, 3B, and 7B) on AIME and AMC benchmarks: RSI-S improves avg@32 accuracy by 2--3 percentage points over GRPO. Overall, RSI offers a promising perspective for RLVR improvement.

title: Introduction to Stochastic Differential Equations for Generative Machine Learning: A Variational Perspective
summary: The use of ordinary and stochastic differential equations has led to substantial progress in generative machine learning with applications to, for example, image, video and biomolecule generation. This paper provides a self-contained and informal introduction to the differential equations, the probabilistic framework for using them in generative modeling and the Fokker--Planck equation that governs the temporal evolution of the marginal distribution of the stochastic variables of the differential equations. The variational lower bound on the log-likelihood (the evidence lower bound, ELBO) is derived and used as a general starting point for a discussion of diffusion models, score matching, and flow matching. All of these approaches may be viewed as specific parameterizations of the most general variational approach. A one-dimensional density modeling problem is used as a simple example to compare different parameterizations.

title: Localized Conformal Prediction for Image Classification with Vision-Language Models
comments: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, code availables, accepted to EUVIP 2025
summary: Conformal predictions have attracted significant attention in the field of uncertainty quantification, mainly because of their strong marginal coverage guarantees. Full conditional guarantee is not an attainable goal, a well known fact in conformal predictions literature. As a result, several approaches have tried to approximate this behavior by adapting the conformal sets of test-time samples according to their similarity to calibration examples. Although the latter has gained traction and shown impressive performances for regression problems, its application to image classification remains under-explored. We conduct an extensive benchmarking on natural image classification tasks with vision-language models (VLMs), using our open source implementation of a recent localized conformal prediction algorithm. We show that straightforward usage of the cosine similarity between test-time and calibration visual features, an intuitive choice for VLMs, is not sufficient to improve over the non-local baselines. In response, we propose a simple non-linear transformation of the cosine similarities, which conserves marginal coverage guarantees and achieves statistically significant mean set sizes reduction. Code is available at https://github.com/cfuchs2023/lcp-vlm/.
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, code availables, accepted to EUVIP 2025

title: Holonic Active Distillation for Scalable Multi-Agent Learning in Multi-Sensor Systems
comments: 21 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, accepted to EMAS 2025
summary:
The rapid expansion of sensor-based networks introduces major challenges in scalability, adaptability, and knowledge transfer, especially in open environments where new subsystems can dynamically join or leave. In this work, we propose a Holonic Active Distillation architecture within a Holonic Multi-Agent System (HMAS) to address these issues. Our approach integrates Clustered Stream-Based Active Distillation (CSBAD), a framework in which specialized student models collect local data, query pseudo-labels from teacher models, and cluster into groups of similar sensors.
  Results show that the holonic organization balances local specialization with global generalization, while efficiently adapting to sensor departures and re-integrations. We also analyzed trade-offs among incremental model updates, system reorganization, and scalability limits.
  Our findings highlight the advantages of holonic learning for multi-sensor systems while identifying key challenges related to model drift and long-term adaptation.
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, accepted to EMAS 2025

title: DualBrep: A Dual-Field Continuous Representation for B-rep Modelling
comments: Published in SIGGRAPH 2026; Code is available at https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/DualBrep
summary: Boundary Representation (B-rep) is the most commonly used data format in Computer-Aided Design (CAD) due to its analytical precision and direct support for parametric editing. However, its heterogeneous structure--continuous parametric geometry combined with discrete topological graphs--poses fundamental challenges for deep learning. Existing methods often predict the heterogeneous B-rep graph directly, using fixed-size padding or sequential tokenization to handle varying primitive counts. These approaches struggle with the combinatorial complexity of CAD models. Furthermore, the discrete, non-differentiable nature of graph data prevents end-to-end optimization of geometry and watertightness. In this work, we introduce DualBrep, a novel continuous representation that unifies B-rep geometry and topology within a fully structured Euclidean domain. DualBrep encodes a CAD model using dual scalar fields: a Signed Distance Function (SDF) representing global shape geometry, and an Unsigned Distance Field (UDF) implicitly encoding topological structure via a Voronoi partitioning of surface elements. Rather than processing these fields independently, we compress them into a single latent space. While the dual-field formulation alone provides a flexible, primitive-free segmentation signal that adapts to arbitrary face counts and surface types, the shared latent makes generation tractable. A Flow Matching model can sample geometry and topology jointly from a single code, avoiding the error accumulation that plagues sequential B-rep predictors. Finally, a neural rebuilder extracts explicit B-rep models--comprising both prismatic and free-form primitives--directly from our continuous dual fields. We demonstrate that DualBrep is a robust backbone for CAD learning, achieving strong performance in point cloud reverse engineering and generative modeling via latent flow matching.
comment: Published in SIGGRAPH 2026; Code is available at https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/DualBrep

AI.title_translation: DualBrep：用于 B-rep 建模的双场连续表示
AI.tldr: 本文提出 DualBrep，一种将 CAD 模型的几何（SDF）与拓扑（UDF）统一在单一连续潜在空间中的双场表示方法，克服了传统 B-rep 深度学习在处理离散拓扑时的不可微和组合复杂度难题。
AI.motivation: 边界表示（B-rep）是 CAD 的核心格式，但其结合了连续参数化几何与离散拓扑图的异构结构给深度学习带来了巨大挑战。现有方法直接预测离散图结构，面临组合复杂度高的问题，且图数据的离散、不可微特性导致无法对几何和水密性（watertightness）进行端到端的优化。
AI.method:
提出 DualBrep 表征方法，其核心包含：
1. 双标量场编码：使用有符号距离场（SDF）表示全局形状几何，使用无符号距离场（UDF）通过表面元素的 Voronoi 划分隐式编码拓扑结构。
2. 共享潜在空间：将双场压缩至统一的潜在空间，并使用流匹配（Flow Matching）模型进行几何与拓扑的联合采样。
3. 神经重建器：直接从连续的双场中提取出包含棱柱体和自由形状基元的显式 B-rep 模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，DualBrep 可以作为一个强大的 CAD 学习骨干网络，在点云逆向工程（reverse engineering）和基于潜在流匹配的生成建模（generative modeling）任务中均取得了优异的表现。
AI.conclusion: DualBrep 成功克服了传统 B-rep 深度学习中离散拓扑图带来的挑战，为 CAD 模型的联合几何与拓扑学习提供了一种连续、可微且高效的全新表征范式，是 CAD 深度学习领域的重大进展。
AI.translation: 边界表示（B-rep）由于其解析精度和对参数化编辑的直接支持，是计算机辅助设计（CAD）中最常用的数据格式。然而，其异构结构——连续的参数化几何与离散的拓扑图相结合——给深度学习带来了根本性的挑战。现有方法通常直接预测异构的 B-rep 图，使用固定大小的填充或顺序标记化来处理变化的基元数量。这些方法难以应对 CAD 模型的组合复杂性。此外，图数据的离散、不可微特性阻止了几何和水密性的端到端优化。在这项工作中，我们引入了 DualBrep，这是一种新颖的连续表示方法，它在完全结构化的欧几里得域内统一了 B-rep 的几何和拓扑。DualBrep 使用双标量场对 CAD 模型进行编码：表示全局形状几何的有符号距离函数（SDF），以及通过表面元素的沃罗诺伊（Voronoi）划分隐式编码拓扑结构的无符号距离场（UDF）。我们没有独立处理这些场，而是将它们压缩到单个潜在空间中。虽然双场公式本身提供了一种灵活、无基元的分割信号，能够适应任意的面数量和表面类型，但共享的潜在空间使得生成变得可行。流匹配（Flow Matching）模型可以从单个代码中联合采样几何和拓扑，从而避免了困扰顺序 B-rep 预测器的误差累积。最后，神经重建器直接从我们的连续双场中提取显式的 B-rep 模型（包括棱柱形和自由形式的基元）。我们证明了 DualBrep 是 CAD 学习的强大骨干，在点云逆向工程和通过潜在流匹配进行的生成建模中实现了强大的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 DualBrep 的双场连续表示方法，旨在解决 CAD 中 B-rep 数据的几何与拓扑异构性给深度学习带来的挑战。该方法通过有符号距离场（SDF）和无符号距离场（UDF）分别编码几何与拓扑，并将其统一压缩至单个潜在空间中。结合流匹配技术和神经重建器，DualBrep 实现了几何与拓扑的联合生成以及显式 B-rep 模型的直接提取，在点云逆向工程和生成建模中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 边界表示 (B-rep), 双场表示, 计算机辅助设计 (CAD), 流匹配 (Flow Matching), 深度学习
AI.comments: 这项工作最大的创新点在于将传统 B-rep 异构的图结构（离散拓扑）通过无符号距离场（UDF）和 Voronoi 划分转化为连续的标量场，从而实现了几何与拓扑在统一潜在空间中的端到端可微优化。这种方法巧妙地避开了离散图神经网络在处理复杂 CAD 模型时的组合爆炸问题。不过，由于其依赖神经重建器从连续场中提取显式 B-rep 几何，在面对需要极高工业级精度的解析面拼接时，可能仍会受到神经网络拟合精度的限制。

title: LASER: Load-Aware Serving with Early-Exit for Reasoning LLMs at the Edge
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) such as DeepSeek-R1 have achieved strong performance through extended chain-of-thought (CoT) generation. However, deploying them on edge devices raises a conflict between long CoT sequences and constrained resources. Recent confidence-based early exit methods reduce CoT length for individual requests, yet they apply fixed thresholds from a single-request perspective, ignoring multi-request concurrency and load fluctuation in edge serving. To bridge this gap, we propose \underline{L}oad-\underline{A}ware \underline{S}erving with \underline{E}arly-exit for \underline{R}easoning (LASER). LASER couples two complementary designs: (1) a load-aware adaptive exit threshold that adjusts the confidence bar based on real-time system load within an empirically validated robust range, and (2) a difficulty- and load-aware reasoning budget pre-allocation that assigns compute resources by request difficulty and system capacity. We formulate the problem as a joint optimization of reasoning quality and service latency. Experiments on two reasoning models, four benchmarks, and diverse load conditions show that LASER reduces average latency by 17--38\% and improves service-level objective (SLO) satisfaction by 3--6\% over fixed-threshold baselines, at an average accuracy cost of only 1\%.

AI.title_translation: LASER：边缘端推理大语言模型的负载感知及提前退出服务框架
AI.tldr: LASER通过结合自适应退出阈值和推理预算预分配，实现了边缘端推理大模型在多请求并发和负载波动下的高效服务，大幅降低延迟并提升SLO，而准确率几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRM）依靠长思维链（CoT）获得强表现，但在边缘端部署时受限于计算资源。现有的基于置信度的提前退出方法采用固定阈值，忽略了边缘服务中的多请求并发和负载波动。
AI.method: 提出LASER框架，包含两个互补设计：（1）负载感知的自适应退出阈值，根据实时系统负载在经验验证的鲁棒范围内动态调整置信度标准；（2）难度与负载感知的推理预算预分配，根据请求难度和系统容量分配计算资源。该方法将问题建模为推理质量与服务延迟的联合优化。
AI.result: 在两个推理模型、四个基准测试和多种负载条件下的实验表明，与固定阈值基线相比，LASER将平均延迟降低了17-38%，并将服务水平目标（SLO）达标率提高了3-6%，而平均准确率仅损失1%。
AI.conclusion: LASER能够有效缓解边缘端部署推理大模型时的资源冲突，通过动态平衡推理质量与服务延迟，在保障准确率的同时显著提升了边缘服务性能。
AI.translation: 大型推理模型（如DeepSeek-R1）通过延长的思维链（CoT）生成实现了强大的性能。然而，将它们部署在边缘设备上面临着长CoT序列与受限资源之间的冲突。最近基于置信度的提前退出方法减少了单个请求的CoT长度，但它们从单请求的角度应用固定阈值，忽略了边缘服务中的多请求并发和负载波动。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了用于推理的负载感知提前退出服务（LASER）。LASER结合了两个互补的设计：（1）负载感知的自适应退出阈值，根据实时系统负载在经验验证的鲁棒范围内调整置信度标准；（2）难度和负载感知的推理预算预分配，根据请求难度和系统容量分配计算资源。我们将该问题表述为推理质量和服务延迟的联合优化。在两个推理模型、四个基准测试和不同负载条件下的实验表明，与固定阈值基线相比，LASER将平均延迟降低了17-38%，并将服务水平目标（SLO）达标率提高了3-6%，而平均准确率损失仅为1%。
AI.summary: 本文针对边缘端部署大型推理模型时由于长CoT序列导致的资源受限问题，提出了LASER服务框架。该框架通过引入负载感知的自适应退出阈值和难度与负载感知的推理预算预分配，动态平衡推理质量与服务延迟。实验证明，LASER在几乎不损失准确率的情况下，显著降低了服务延迟并提升了SLO达标率。
AI.keywords: 边缘服务 (Edge Serving), 提前退出 (Early-Exit), 推理大模型 (Reasoning LLMs), 负载感知 (Load-Aware)
AI.comments: 该论文切中当前推理大模型（如DeepSeek-R1）在边缘端落地的一大痛点，即长CoT带来的高计算延迟与边缘端受限资源之间的冲突。其核心创新在于打破了传统“单请求”视角下固定的提前退出阈值，将“提前退出”策略与边缘服务的“实时负载”和“请求并发”相结合，通过系统级与算法级的协同优化，实现了服务延迟与推理质量的高效权衡，具有极强的实用价值。

title: Robustness of neural networks to random noise perturbations of their inputs
summary: We investigate the problem of the robustness of a trained neural network to the perturbation of its input values. More specifically, we examine the interplay between the accuracy of the network, as measured by the mean squared error, and robustness. Accordingly, we present a robustness measure, which, with high probability, suggests an upper bound on the mean squared error of the network, with respect to an input data set, for a given perturbation of the input values of the network. The measure we propose is both simple and efficient to compute, treating the neural network as a black box. We provide experimental results on several real-world data sets showing the efficacy of the proposed method. We also introduce the concept of robustness curves, which allows us to further analyse robustness within and between data sets.

AI.title_translation: 神经网络对输入随机噪声扰动的鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种简单高效的黑盒度量方法，能以高概率给出输入扰动下神经网络均方误差的上界，并引入“鲁棒性曲线”来分析不同数据集下的网络鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 探讨已训练神经网络在输入值受到随机噪声扰动时的鲁棒性，并研究网络预测准确性（以均方误差衡量）与鲁棒性之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 提出了一种简单、高效且将神经网络视为黑盒的鲁棒性度量方法，该方法能以高概率给出给定输入扰动下网络均方误差的上界；同时引入了“鲁棒性曲线”的概念来分析数据集内外的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明了所提度量方法的有效性，并且引入的鲁棒性曲线能够有效分析数据集内部和数据集之间的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的黑盒鲁棒性度量和鲁棒性曲线是评估和分析神经网络在输入扰动下性能（均方误差）表现的有效且实用的工具。
AI.translation: 我们研究了已训练神经网络对输入值扰动的鲁棒性问题。具体而言，我们探讨了以均方误差衡量的网络准确性与鲁棒性之间的相互作用。因此，我们提出了一种鲁棒性度量方法，在给定网络输入值扰动的情况下，该方法能够以高概率给出网络相对于输入数据集的均方误差上界。我们提出的度量方法既简单又计算高效，且将神经网络视为黑盒。我们在几个真实世界的数据集上提供了实验结果，展示了所提方法的有效性。我们还引入了鲁棒性曲线的概念，这使我们能够进一步分析数据集内部和数据集之间的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了神经网络对输入随机噪声扰动的鲁棒性，重点探讨了均方误差（准确性）与鲁棒性之间的关系。作者提出了一种简单、高效的黑盒鲁棒性度量方法，该方法能够以高概率预测输入扰动下网络均方误差的上界。此外，文章引入了“鲁棒性曲线”以深化对数据集内外鲁棒性的分析，并在真实数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 神经网络, 鲁棒性度量, 随机噪声扰动, 均方误差, 鲁棒性曲线
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种将神经网络视为黑盒的鲁棒性度量方法，既简单又计算高效，并且能够给出均方误差的概率上界，这为非侵入式地评估网络鲁棒性提供了便利。引入的“鲁棒性曲线”概念为比较不同数据集或同一数据集内部的鲁棒性提供了直观的工具。其局限性在于，摘要中未详细探讨该度量在面对非随机（如对抗性）扰动时的泛化能力。

title: A Large-Scale Empirical Evaluation of MMAO Under Fair-Budget Continuous and Discrete Benchmarks
summary: This paper evaluates the Metabolic Multi-Agent Optimizer (MMAO) under a stricter empirical protocol rather than reintroducing the framework itself. The study asks whether MMAO's closed-loop resource-allocation principle remains credible under broader, more standard, and more explicitly budget-controlled continuous and discrete benchmarks. The main completed matrix covers eight CEC2017 functions at 10D and 30D with 20 seeds each, and five TSPLIB instances with 20 seeds each, together with stronger reproducible baselines including PSO-lite, ES-lite, and an iterated-greedy 2-opt route baseline. We further add trajectory-level diagnostics for communal budget, success rate, role evolution, and population turnover, plus an auxiliary OR-Library multiple-knapsack slice to extend the discrete evidence beyond routing. Under this protocol, MMAO clearly outperforms the external baseline set on the continuous side and on the TSPLIB side, while the ablation variants remain much closer to the full method than the external baselines are. We therefore position MMAO as a benchmark-backed cross-domain adaptive framework whose most clearly validated value is endogenous resource redistribution under evidence pressure, while also noting that the strongest remaining gap is not basic workability but sharper mechanism isolation and broader competition-grade comparison.

AI.title_translation: 公平预算连续与离散基准下MMAO的大规模经验评估
AI.tldr: 本文在严格控制预算的连续和离散基准上对MMAO进行了大规模经验评估，结果表明其在资源分配和跨领域自适应上表现优异，显著优于PSO-lite和ES-lite等强基线。
AI.motivation: 探讨代谢多智能体优化器（MMAO）的闭环资源分配原理在更广泛、更标准且显式控制预算的连续和离散基准下是否依然可靠，并通过更严格的经验评估协议对其进行检验，而非仅仅重新介绍该算法框架。
AI.method: 在更严格、显式控制预算的经验协议下进行测试。测试基准包括：在10D和30D下的8个CEC2017函数（每个20个种子），5个TSPLIB实例（每个20个种子），以及辅助的OR-Library多维背包问题。对比基线包括PSO-lite、ES-lite和迭代贪婪2-opt路由基线。此外，引入了轨迹级诊断（涵盖公共预算、成功率、角色演化和种群更替）以及消融变体进行深度分析。
AI.result: 在严格的评估协议下，MMAO在连续基准和TSPLIB基准上均显著优于外部基线集。同时，消融变体的表现与完整MMAO方法非常接近，且两者均明显优于外部基线。
AI.conclusion: MMAO可以被定位为一个由基准测试支持的、跨领域的自适应框架。其最明确的价值在于在证据压力下进行内生的资源重新分配。目前该方法面临的最大挑战并非基本可行性，而是需要进行更清晰的机制隔离以及更广泛的竞赛级对比。
AI.translation: 本文在一个更严格的经验协议下对代谢多智能体优化器（MMAO）进行了评估，而不是重新介绍该框架本身。本研究旨在探讨MMAO的闭环资源分配原理在更广泛、更标准且显式控制预算的连续和离散基准下是否依然可靠。主要测试矩阵涵盖了10D和30D下的八个CEC2017函数（每个函数20个种子），以及五个TSPLIB实例（每个实例20个种子），并结合了更强大的可复现基线，包括PSO-lite、ES-lite和迭代贪婪2-opt路由基线。我们还增加了针对公共预算、成功率、角色演化和种群更替的轨迹级诊断，以及辅助的OR-Library多维背包切片，以将离散证据扩展到路由问题之外。在这种协议下，MMAO在连续端和TSPLIB端显然优于外部基线集，而消融变体与完整方法的关系比外部基线要近得多。因此，我们将MMAO定位为一个有基准支持的跨领域自适应框架，其最明确验证的价值在于证据压力下的内生资源重新分配，同时也指出，最强的剩余差距不是基本的可行性，而是更清晰的机制隔离和更广泛的竞赛级对比。
AI.summary: 本文在严格控制预算的连续（CEC2017）和离散（TSPLIB及多维背包）基准下，对代谢多智能体优化器（MMAO）进行了大规模的经验评估。通过与PSO-lite、ES-lite等强基线对比及轨迹级诊断，研究证实了MMAO在跨领域自适应及内生资源重新分配方面的显著优势。
AI.keywords: 代谢多智能体优化器 (MMAO), 经验评估, 资源分配, 连续与离散基准, 跨领域自适应
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：本文的创新之处在于不局限于算法本身的提出，而是针对已有的代谢多智能体优化器（MMAO），在严格控制预算的跨领域（连续和离散）基准下设计了严谨的经验评估协议，并引入了精细的轨迹级诊断指标。
2. 重要性：该研究为多智能体优化算法的公平比较树立了榜样，证实了MMAO在动态资源分配和跨领域自适应方面的强大性能，对自适应优化算法的实际应用具有重要参考价值。
3. 局限性：如摘要所述，目前的研究在“机制隔离”（即精确剖析各子模块对性能的具体贡献）以及与当前最顶尖的竞赛级（competition-grade）算法进行更广泛的对比方面仍存在不足。

title: DPPE: Rethinking Camera-Based Positional Encoding for Scaling Multi-View Transformers
summary:
The remarkable scalability of Transformers has expanded their application to 3D computer vision, where camera-aware positional encoding is crucial for providing spatial cues in multi-view geometry. Recent advancements have established the practice of using camera parameters -- such as extrinsics or projection matrices -- as relative positional encoding into the query, key, and value vectors of the attention mechanism. However, when scaling up the training recipe of novel view synthesis (NVS) models with the camera-based positional encoding, we observe a significant issue: model performance stagnates in the late stages of training.
  In this paper, we investigate the cause of the performance bottleneck when scaling up and demonstrate that storing rotation and translation given by the positional encoding in the same dimensions of the value vector causes indeterminacy in their independent identification, hindering training scalability. To address this, we propose Decoupled Pose Positional Encoding (DPPE), a novel camera-based positional encoding that explicitly decouples rotation and translation. Extensive evaluations on NVS tasks demonstrate that DPPE enables stable long-term training even in scaled-up training setup. Furthermore, it exhibits superior generalization performance in extrapolation settings, such as handling an increased number of viewpoints and zoom-in scenarios.

AI.title_translation: DPPE：重新思考用于扩展多视角Transformer的基于相机的位置编码
AI.tldr: 本文提出了DPPE（解耦位姿位置编码），通过显式解耦值向量中的旋转和平移信息，解决了多视角Transformer在大规模训练后期性能停滞的问题，显著提升了训练稳定性和外推泛化性。
AI.motivation: 在扩展新视角合成（NVS）模型的训练规模时，使用传统的基于相机的绝对/相对位置编码会导致模型在训练后期出现性能停滞。作者发现，这是因为在注意力机制的值（Value）向量的相同维度中同时存储旋转和平移信息，会导致它们在独立识别时产生不确定性（歧义），从而阻碍了训练的可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出了解耦位姿位置编码（DPPE, Decoupled Pose Positional Encoding），这是一种新型的基于相机的绝对/相对位置编码方法，它在编码设计中显式地将相机的旋转和平移信息进行解耦，避免在值（Value）向量的相同维度中混合存储。
AI.result: 在新视角合成（NVS）任务上的广泛评估表明，DPPE能够在规模化训练设置中实现稳定的长期训练，避免后期性能停滞。此外，它在数据集外推设置（如处理更多数量的视点和场景放大）中表现出优异的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: DPPE通过显式解耦相机位置编码中的旋转和平移信息，成功克服了传统编码方式在大规模训练中的性能瓶颈，为多视角Transformer的扩展提供了更稳定、泛化性更强的解决方案。
AI.translation: Transformer显著的可扩展性已将其应用扩展到三维计算机视觉，其中相机感知的位置编码对于在多视角几何中提供空间线索至关重要。最近的进展确立了将相机参数（如外参或投影矩阵）作为相对位置编码引入注意力机制的查询（Query）、键（Key）和值（Value）向量中的做法。然而，当使用基于相机的位置编码来扩展新视角合成（NVS）模型的训练方案时，我们观察到一个显著的问题：模型性能在训练后期停滞不前。在本文中，我们调查了规模扩大时性能瓶颈的原因，并证明在值向量的相同维度中存储由位置编码给出的旋转和平移会导致它们在独立识别时产生不确定性，从而阻碍了训练的可扩展性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了解耦位姿位置编码（DPPE），这是一种新型的基于相机的位置编码，它显式地将旋转和平移解耦。在NVS任务上的广泛评估表明，即使在大规模训练设置中，DPPE也能实现稳定的长期训练。此外，它在数据集外推设置中表现出优异的泛化性能，例如处理增加的视点数量和放大场景。
AI.summary: 本文针对多视角Transformer在扩展训练时因相机位置编码导致后期性能停滞的问题展开研究。作者指出，在注意力机制的值向量相同维度中混合存储旋转和平移会导致识别歧义。为此，本文提出了DPPE（解耦位姿位置编码），通过显式解耦旋转与平移信息，实现了在大规模训练下的稳定长期训练，并在视点增加和场景放大等外推场景中展现出更强的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 多视角Transformer, 位置编码, 新视角合成, 位姿解耦, 模型扩展性
AI.comments: 本文敏锐地发现了多视角Transformer在扩展训练规模时的一个关键瓶颈，即相机位置编码中旋转和平移信息的耦合导致了训练后期的性能停滞。通过提出DPPE进行显式解耦，不仅在理论上定位了问题，还在实验中证明了该方法对长期训练稳定性和外推泛化性（如视角增加、变焦）的显著提升。这一工作对于未来构建更大规模、更鲁棒的3D/多视角生成与重建模型具有重要的参考价值。

title: ZEBRA: Zero-Shot Entropy-Regularized Prompt Learning for Base-to-Novel Generalization in Audio-Language Models
summary: Audio-Language Models (ALMs) achieve strong zero-shot performance by aligning audio with textual class descriptions. Although prompt learning improves accuracy on base classes through few-shot supervised adaptation, we observe a critical trade-off: it often degrades performance on novel classes, sometimes falling below zero-shot accuracy. This exposes a base-to-novel generalization gap in prompt learning for ALMs. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{ZEBRA} (Zero-shot Entropy-Regularized Prompt Learning for Base-to-Novel Generalization), a plug-and-play framework that fuses zero-shot logits with prompt-learning logits, and employs self-entropy regularization to reduce overfitting to base classes. Experiments across multiple audio classification datasets show that ZEBRA consistently improves novel-class performance while maintaining strong base accuracy, significantly reducing the base-to-novel gap compared to standard prompt learning. The code is available at: https://github.com/asif-hanif/zebra.

AI.title_translation: ZEBRA：音频-语言模型中面向基类到新类泛化的零样本熵正则化提示学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出ZEBRA框架，通过融合零样本与提示学习的logits并引入自熵正则化，有效解决了音频-语言模型中提示学习导致的新类泛化性能退化问题。
AI.motivation: 虽然提示学习可以通过少样本监督微调提高音频-语言模型在基类上的准确率，但它往往会导致模型在新类上的性能下降，甚至低于零样本分类的准确率，存在显著的基类到新类泛化差距。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为ZEBRA的即插即用框架，该框架通过将零样本logits与提示学习logits进行融合，并引入自熵正则化（self-entropy regularization）来减少模型对基类的过拟合。
AI.result: 在多个音频分类数据集上的实验表明，ZEBRA在保持强大的基类准确率的同时，一致性地提高了新类的分类性能，相比于传统的提示学习方法，显著缩小了基类到新类的泛化差距。
AI.conclusion: ZEBRA框架能够有效缓解音频-语言模型在提示学习过程中的基类到新类泛化退化问题，在保持基类高准确率的同时显著提升新类性能。
AI.translation: 音频-语言模型（ALMs）通过将音频与文本类别描述进行对齐，实现了强大的零样本（zero-shot）性能。尽管提示学习（prompt learning）通过少样本监督自适应提高了在基类上的准确率，但我们观察到一个关键的权衡：它往往会降低在新类上的性能，有时甚至低于零样本的准确率。这暴露了音频-语言模型中提示学习在基类到新类泛化上的差距。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了ZEBRA（面向基类到新类泛化的零样本熵正则化提示学习），这是一个即插即用的框架，它融合了零样本对数几率（logits）与提示学习对数几率，并采用自熵正则化来减少对基类的过拟合。在多个音频分类数据集上的实验表明，ZEBRA在保持强大的基类准确率的同时，一致地提高了新类的性能，与标准提示学习相比，显著缩小了基类到新类的差距。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/asif-hanif/zebra。
AI.summary: 本文针对音频-语言模型（ALMs）在提示学习中面临的“基类到新类”泛化性能退化问题，提出了一种名为ZEBRA的即插即用框架。该框架通过融合零样本预测结果与提示学习预测结果，并采用自熵正则化来抑制对基类的过拟合。实验表明，ZEBRA在不牺牲基类性能的前提下，显著提升了模型在新类上的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 音频-语言模型, 提示学习, 基类到新类泛化, 熵正则化, 零样本学习
AI.comments: 该论文针对音频-语言模型中提示学习的过拟合与泛化退化问题，提出了一个简单且即插即用的解决方案（ZEBRA）。其创新之处在于将零样本的先验知识（logits）与提示学习相结合，并通过自熵正则化来约束模型，从而在维持基类性能的同时显著提升了新类的泛化能力。该方法具有较强的实用价值。

title: Power law scaling for classification accuracy in physical neural networks
summary: Physical neural networks (PNNs) harness the intrinsic complexity of physical systems to perform neural computation, potentially at speeds and energy efficiencies inaccessible to conventional digital hardware. Yet, a principled framework for quantifying and predicting their computing accuracy across diverse substrates has remained elusive. Here we introduce the Hotelling Trace Criterion (HTC), a task-conditioned measure of PNN- state separability that can be evaluated without training. We demonstrate that it predicts PNN classification performance with high fidelity across highly nonlinear optical fibres, vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers, and coupled nonlinear oscillator networks, for benchmark tasks of different difficulty. Classification loss follows a power law in HTC, with Pearson correlation coefficients exceeding 0.99 for MNIST and $\approx$0.97 for Fashion-MNIST, noteworthy experimental and simulated data from physically distinct systems collapse onto a single scaling curve determined by the task rather than the substrate. Applying HTC layer-by-layer during training further reveals that gradient-based optimisation distributes representational capacity unevenly across PNN layers, providing a quantitative diagnostic of training and architecture efficiency invisible to standard loss monitoring. Crucially, once the scaling exponent is established from a small number of trained calibration systems, all further performance predictions require no training since performance can be derived from the much more efficient HTC measurement. These results establish HTC as a substrate-agnostic figure of merit for comparing and scaling PNNs, advancing the field further towards a complete theory connecting fundamental hardware parameters to task performance through universal scaling laws.

AI.title_translation: 物理神经网络中分类准确率的幂律缩放规律
AI.tldr: 本文引入了无需训练的霍特林迹标准（HTC），发现不同物理神经网络的分类损失与HTC之间存在由任务决定的普适幂律缩放规律，实现了对物理硬件性能的高效预测。
AI.motivation: 尽管物理神经网络（PNNs）具有高速度和高能效的巨大潜力，但目前仍缺乏一个能够量化和预测其在不同物理介质上计算准确率的系统性框架。
AI.method: 引入了霍特林迹标准（Hotelling Trace Criterion, HTC），这是一种无需训练即可评估的、基于具体任务的物理神经网络（PNN）状态可分性度量。通过在多种物理系统（非线性光纤、垂直腔面发射激光器和耦合非线性振荡器网络）中测试，并结合逐层HTC分析来定量诊断梯度优化过程中的表示能力分布。
AI.result:
1. HTC能高保真度地预测PNN分类性能，分类损失与HTC呈幂律关系，在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上的皮尔逊相关系数分别超过0.99和约0.97。
2. 来自不同物理系统的实验和模拟数据塌缩到由任务本身（而非物理介质）决定的单一缩放曲线上。
3. 逐层HTC分析揭示了梯度优化在PNN各层间不均匀分配表示能力的现象。
4. 一旦通过少量校准系统确定了缩放指数，后续的性能预测无需任何训练，可直接通过高效的HTC测量推导得出。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了HTC作为一种与介质无关的品质因数，可用于比较和缩放PNN，推动了将底层硬件参数通过普适缩放定律与任务性能相联系的完整理论的发展。
AI.translation: 物理神经网络（PNNs）利用物理系统的固有复杂性来进行神经计算，其运行速度和能量效率有潜力达到传统数字硬件无法企及的高度。然而，目前仍缺乏一个原则性的框架来量化和预测它们在不同物理介质上的计算准确率。在这里，我们引入了霍特林迹标准（HTC），这是一种无需训练即可评估的、基于具体任务的PNN状态可分性度量。我们证明，在高度非线性的光纤、垂直腔面发射激光器以及耦合非线性振荡器网络等不同物理系统上，对于不同难度的基准任务，HTC都能以极高的保真度预测PNN的分类性能。分类损失在HTC中遵循幂律规律，在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上的皮尔逊相关系数分别超过0.99和约0.97；值得注意的是，来自物理上完全不同的系统的实验和模拟数据，都塌缩到了由任务而非物理介质决定的单一缩放曲线上。在训练过程中逐层应用HTC还表明，基于梯度的优化在PNN各层之间不均匀地分配了表示能力，这为训练和架构效率提供了一种标准损失监测手段所无法察觉的定量诊断。至关重要的是，一旦通过少量已训练的校准系统确定了缩放指数，所有后续的性能预测都无需再进行训练，因为性能可以直接从更高效的HTC测量中推导出来。这些结果确立了HTC作为一种与介质无关的品质因数，可用于比较和缩放PNN，从而推动该领域向连接底层硬件参数与任务性能的通用缩放定律完整理论迈进。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种无需训练的评估指标——霍特林迹标准（HTC），用于量化和预测物理神经网络（PNN）在不同物理介质（如光纤、激光器和振荡器网络）上的分类性能。研究发现分类损失与HTC之间存在普适的幂律缩放规律，该规律由任务而非硬件介质决定。此外，HTC还可用于逐层诊断PNN的架构效率，为物理计算硬件的设计与优化提供了强大的理论与实用工具。
AI.keywords: 物理神经网络, 霍特林迹标准, 幂律缩放, 状态可分性, 硬件计算
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：该研究提出了一种无需训练、与物理介质无关的评估指标HTC，首次实现了将不同物理硬件（光纤、激光器、振荡器等）的分类性能统一到由任务决定的单一幂律缩放曲线上。
2. 重要性：为物理神经网络（PNN）的设计、比较和缩放提供了系统性的理论框架，极大地降低了评估新型硬件计算性能的时间和算力成本。
3. 局限性：摘要中主要展示了在图像分类任务（如MNIST和Fashion-MNIST）上的效果，对于更复杂的生成任务或回归任务的适用性尚待进一步验证。

title: From Failure to Alignment: A Requirements Engineering Framework for Machine Learning Systems
summary:
Organisations designing, developing, and deploying machine learning systems (MLS) need to be able to check that these systems are trustworthy, and communicate this clearly to their stakeholders, be they different categories of users, engineers, or wider society. By focusing on stakeholders, Requirements Engineering is well positioned to drive the design and engineering of MLS that align with the needs of their stakeholders. Yet, we still need a systematic process for modelling and reasoning about requirements for MLS that is driven both by stakeholders' needs and constraints for MLS development.
  This paper proposes a framework entitled REAL (Requirements Engineering for mAchines that Learn - and Fail) to help develop MLS that align with stakeholders' needs by adopting a requirements engineering approach. This model-based framework is based on three principles. First, weaving together requirements for data, models, and the system as a whole. Second, using failure to drive the exploration of alternative requirements. Third, iterative and traceable refinement of MLS requirements.
  We demonstrate the proposed framework using an example from autonomous driving and show that REAL supports the development of MLS that better align with stakeholders' requirements. A replication package is available online.

AI.title_translation: 从失败到对齐：一种针对机器学习系统的需求工程框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了REAL框架，这是一种基于模型的需求工程框架，通过融合数据、模型与系统需求并利用失败驱动需求探索，帮助机器学习系统更好地与利益相关者需求相对齐。
AI.motivation: 组织需要确保机器学习系统的可信性并向利益相关者清晰传达。尽管需求工程方法很适用，但目前仍缺乏一种系统化的流程，能够同时结合利益相关者的需求和机器学习系统开发的约束，来对系统需求进行建模和推理。
AI.method: 提出了名为REAL（Requirements Engineering for mAchines that Learn - and Fail）的基于模型的框架。该框架基于三个原则：1) 将数据、模型和整体系统的需求编织在一起；2) 利用失败来驱动对替代需求的探索；3) 对机器学习系统需求进行迭代且可追溯的细化。
AI.result: 通过自动驾驶领域的示例演示了REAL框架，结果表明该框架能够支持开发出更好地与利益相关者需求相一致的机器学习系统，并且该研究的复现包已在线发布。
AI.conclusion: REAL框架通过采用需求工程方法，能够有效帮助开发出与利益相关者需求相一致、更具可信性的机器学习系统。
AI.translation:
设计、开发和部署机器学习系统（MLS）的组织需要能够检查这些系统是否值得信赖，并向其利益相关者（无论是不同类别的用户、工程师还是更广泛的社会）进行清晰的沟通。通过关注利益相关者，需求工程非常适合推动符合其利益相关者需求的MLS的设计和工程。然而，我们仍然需要一个系统化的过程来对MLS的需求进行建模和推理，该过程既由利益相关者的需求驱动，也由MLS开发的约束驱动。
本文提出了一个名为REAL（Requirements Engineering for mAchines that Learn - and Fail，针对学习及失败机器的需求工程）的框架，通过采用需求工程方法来帮助开发与利益相关者需求相一致的MLS。该基于模型的框架基于三个原则：第一，将数据、模型和整个系统的需求交织在一起；第二，利用失败来驱动对替代需求的探索；第三，对MLS需求进行迭代和可追溯的细化。
我们使用自动驾驶的示例演示了所提出的框架，并表明REAL支持开发更好地与利益相关者需求相一致的MLS。在线提供了复现包。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为REAL的需求工程框架，旨在解决机器学习系统（MLS）与利益相关者需求对齐的问题。该框架基于三个核心原则：融合数据、模型与系统需求，利用失败驱动替代需求探索，以及进行迭代和可追溯的需求细化。通过自动驾驶案例的演示，证实了该框架在促进MLS与利益相关者需求对齐方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 需求工程, 机器学习系统, 利益相关者对齐, 失败驱动
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将“失败”作为驱动需求探索的核心要素，并将数据、模型和系统需求进行有机结合，这为具有高度不确定性的机器学习系统提供了系统化的需求工程方法。其局限性在于摘要中仅提到了自动驾驶领域的单一示例演示，该框架在更广泛、更复杂的实际应用场景中的通用性和扩展性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Digital Sovereignty as a Quality Attribute for Software Architectures
summary: Digital sovereignty (DS) is an increasingly important concept and political agenda throughout the world, including in the European Union (EU). However, the concept is also regrettably vague. With this critical point in mind, the paper presents an analysis of digital sovereignty as a quality attribute for software architectures in the context of cloud computing and the EU's policy frameworks for it. The analysis reveals that DS can be sharpened analytically by conceptualizing it as a quality attribute. The analysis further demonstrates how DS satisfies many of the classical properties of quality attributes for software architectures, including their measurability and validation, the trade-offs they involve, and the scenario-based methodology commonly used for analyzing them.

AI.title_translation: 数字主权作为软件架构的质量属性
AI.tldr: 本文提出将“数字主权”概念化为软件架构的质量属性，以解决其定义模糊的问题，并展示了如何利用经典的软件工程方法对其进行测量、权衡和场景化分析。
AI.motivation: 数字主权（DS）在全球（包括欧盟）已成为一个日益重要的概念和政治议程，但该概念目前仍然非常模糊，缺乏在软件系统设计中进行具体分析和落地的明确定义。
AI.method: 在云计算以及欧盟政策框架的背景下，将数字主权（DS）作为软件架构的一种质量属性进行分析，并探讨其如何满足经典质量属性的特征，包括可测量性、验证、权衡分析以及基于场景的分析方法。
AI.result: 分析表明，通过将数字主权概念化为质量属性，可以显著提升其在技术和分析上的精确度。此外，研究证明了数字主权确实满足软件架构质量属性的许多经典特性，能够进行测量、验证、权衡以及基于场景的分析。
AI.conclusion: 将数字主权概念化为软件架构的质量属性，能够使其在分析上更加精确，并允许研究人员和架构师利用现有的软件工程工具和方法（如可测量性、权衡分析和基于场景的方法）来评估和设计满足数字主权要求的系统。
AI.translation: 数字主权（DS）在世界各地（包括欧盟）是一个日益重要的概念和政治议程。然而，该概念也遗憾地显得模糊不清。考虑到这一关键点，本文在云计算及欧盟相关政策框架的背景下，对数字主权作为软件架构质量属性进行了分析。分析表明，通过将数字主权概念化为一种质量属性，可以使其在分析上更加敏锐。分析还进一步证明了数字主权如何满足软件架构质量属性的许多经典特性，包括它们的可测量性与验证、它们所涉及的权衡，以及常用于分析它们的基于场景的方法。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在云计算及欧盟政策背景下，如何将“数字主权（DS）”这一模糊的政治概念转化为软件架构的质量属性。研究表明，通过这种概念化，数字主权不仅在分析上变得更加清晰，而且能够适用软件架构质量属性的经典分析方法（如可测量性、权衡和基于场景的评估），从而为软件设计和合规性提供了实用的工程化路径。
AI.keywords: 数字主权, 软件架构, 质量属性, 云计算, 欧盟政策
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：本文将宏观的政治与政策概念“数字主权”引入软件工程领域，并将其具象化为软件架构的“质量属性”，提供了一种全新的跨学科视角。
2. 重要性：在当前全球（尤其是欧盟）高度重视数据主权和技术自主的背景下，该研究为系统架构师在云环境下设计和评估合规系统提供了具体的方法论指导。
3. 局限性：摘要中未提及具体的实证研究或在实际工业项目中的应用案例，其提出的基于场景的分析方法在复杂多变的实际业务中的有效性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Evil Spectra: How Optimisers can Amplify or Suppress Emergent Misalignment
summary: Emergent misalignment (EM) is a recently discovered phenomenon in LLMs where fine-tuning on a narrow misaligned task, such as writing insecure code, leads to broadly misaligned behaviour on unrelated prompts. Previous work has noted that the severity of EM is highly sensitive to training choices; however, we still lack a systematic characterisation of this sensitivity. We perform a sweep over several Qwen3 models, optimisers, datasets, and batch sizes, and find that the choice of optimiser has the largest effect, producing a 7x spread in misalignment rate. Surprisingly, model size has a negligible effect within the Qwen3 family. An additional sweep over 12 models from three families using Adam confirms that model scale (1B-235B) and family have negligible effects for that optimiser. Analysing the loss-alignment relationship on Qwen3-8B, we find that final log training loss is a strong predictor of alignment, and that stratifying by optimiser captures nearly all the residual variance. Training dynamics reveal that each optimiser follows a different trajectory through loss-alignment space, and that after significant training, the optimiser becomes more important than training loss as a predictor of alignment. Muon, the adaptive optimiser that preserves alignment the best, implicitly regularises for a more uniform distribution of singular values of the LoRA adapter. We evaluate this insight by training with an additional loss term that incentivises a flatter singular value spectrum, and find that this substantially recovers alignment for the more EM-prone adaptive optimisers (Adam and Lion), with negligible cost to training loss. These results identify optimiser choice as a key factor in EM severity, but show that spectral regularisation can substantially mitigate the effects of EM-prone optimisers.

AI.title_translation: 邪恶光谱：优化器如何放大或抑制涌现的对齐失调
AI.tldr: 研究表明，优化器的选择是导致大语言模型涌现对齐失调（EM）的关键因素，而通过引入谱正则化（使LoRA适配器的奇异值分布更平坦）可以显著缓解Adam和Lion等优化器带来的失调问题。
AI.motivation: 涌现对齐失调（EM）是大语言模型在微调窄任务时导致在无关提示词上出现广泛对齐失调的现象。虽然已知EM的严重程度对训练选择高度敏感，但目前缺乏对其敏感性的系统性刻画。
AI.method:
1. 在多个Qwen3模型、优化器、数据集和批次大小上进行系统性扫参，并分析训练动力学及损失-对齐关系；
2. 揭示了Muon优化器通过隐式正则化保持LoRA适配器更均匀的奇异值分布来维持对齐的机制；
3. 提出一种谱正则化方法，在训练中加入额外的损失项，以激励LoRA适配器产生更平坦的奇异值谱。
AI.result:
1. 优化器选择对EM严重程度影响最大（导致高达7倍的失调率差异），而模型规模（1B-235B）和系列的影响微乎其微；
2. 训练后期，优化器本身比训练损失更适合作为对齐的预测指标，其中Muon优化器最能保持对齐；
3. 采用谱正则化可以大幅恢复Adam和Lion等易产生EM的自适应优化器的对齐性能，且对训练损失的负面影响可以忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 优化器的选择是决定涌现对齐失调（EM）严重程度的关键因素，但通过引入谱正则化可以显著减轻易产生EM的优化器（如Adam和Lion）所带来的负面影响，为安全微调提供了新的技术路径。
AI.translation: 涌现对齐失调（EM）是最近在LLM中发现的一种现象，即在狭窄的对齐失调任务（如编写不安全的代码）上进行微调，会导致在不相关的提示词上出现广泛的对齐失调行为。先前的研究指出，EM的严重程度对训练选择高度敏感；然而，我们仍然缺乏对这种敏感性的系统性刻画。我们对多个Qwen3模型、优化器、数据集和批次大小进行了扫参，发现优化器的选择影响最大，导致对齐失调率出现7倍的差距。令人惊讶的是，在Qwen3系列中，模型大小的影响微乎其微。对来自三个系列的12个模型使用Adam进行额外扫参确认，对于该优化器而言，模型规模（1B-235B）和系列的影响可以忽略不计。通过分析Qwen3-8B上的损失-对齐关系，我们发现最终的对数训练损失是对齐的强预测因子，且按优化器进行分层可以捕获几乎所有的残差方差。训练动力学表明，每个优化器在损失-对齐空间中遵循不同的轨迹，并且在显著训练后，优化器作为对齐预测因子的重要性超过了训练损失。最能保持对齐的自适应优化器Muon，隐式地对LoRA适配器的奇异值进行更均匀分布的正则化。我们通过使用一个额外的损失项进行训练来评估这一见解，该损失项可以激励更平坦的奇异值谱，并发现这可以实质性地恢复易受EM影响的自适应优化器（Adam和Lion）的对齐，且对训练损失的成本微乎其微。这些结果表明优化器选择是EM严重程度的关键因素，但表明谱正则化可以显著减轻易受EM影响的优化器的作用。
AI.summary: 本文系统研究了微调过程中大语言模型产生涌现对齐失调（EM）的敏感性。研究发现，优化器的选择（而非模型大小或系列）是决定EM严重程度的最关键因素。作者揭示了不同优化器在损失-对齐空间中的轨迹差异，并发现性能较好的优化器能隐式地使LoRA适配器的奇异值分布更平坦。基于此，作者提出了一种谱正则化方法，通过引入额外损失项来约束奇异值谱，从而在几乎不增加训练损失的前提下，显著降低了Adam和Lion等优化器带来的对齐失调风险。
AI.keywords: 涌现对齐失调, 优化器选择, 谱正则化, 大语言模型, 奇异值谱
AI.comments: 本文首次系统性地将大模型的涌现对齐失调（EM）与优化器选择联系起来，并从矩阵奇异值谱（谱正则化）的独特视角给出了理论解释和实用的解决方案。其创新性在于打破了“模型越大越容易/不易失调”的直觉，转而关注优化器在权重空间（尤其是LoRA奇异值）上的隐式正则化效应。局限性在于该研究主要基于LoRA微调场景，谱正则化在全参数微调下的适用性及表现仍有待进一步探索。

title: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning based Intrusion Detection in Realistic IoT Networks
summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) is rapidly growing and expanding into various sectors, such as healthcare, transportation, smart homes, and more. Despite the benefits of using IoT devices, they present several challenges. Given the significant role these devices play in our lives, it is crucial to address issues related to their security and privacy. These devices are limited in resources, which complicates their security and the protection of the data that they manage. The paper aims to examine intrusion detection systems using the Gotham2025 dataset, generated through the Gotham testbed, which consists of 78 emulated IoT devices utilising various protocols, including MQTT, CoAP, and RTSP, to assist in safeguarding IoT networks from attacks. We conduct a comparative analysis between five machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Deep Neural Network. We demonstrate that the Random Forest Classifier was the top-performing model, achieving an F1-score of 0.99 in classifying attacks.

AI.title_translation: 基于机器学习的现实物联网网络入侵检测的比较分析
AI.tldr: 该研究比较了五种机器学习算法在现实物联网网络入侵检测中的性能，发现随机森林分类器表现最佳，F1分数达到0.99。
AI.motivation: 物联网设备在我们的生活中扮演着重要角色，但其资源有限性给安全和隐私带来了挑战。因此，解决物联网网络的安全问题，特别是入侵检测，至关重要。
AI.method: 论文使用通过Gotham测试平台生成的Gotham2025数据集，该数据集包含78个模拟物联网设备，利用MQTT、CoAP和RTSP等协议。研究对随机森林、XGBoost、逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯和深度神经网络这五种机器学习算法进行了比较分析。
AI.result: 随机森林分类器是表现最佳的模型，在分类攻击方面达到了0.99的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 随机森林算法在现实物联网网络中进行入侵检测表现出卓越的性能，能够有效保护物联网网络免受攻击。
AI.translation: 物联网 (IoT) 正在快速增长并扩展到各个领域，如医疗保健、交通、智能家居等。尽管使用物联网设备有诸多好处，但它们也带来了一些挑战。鉴于这些设备在我们的生活中扮演的重要角色，解决其安全和隐私问题至关重要。这些设备的资源有限，这使得它们的安全和所管理数据的保护变得复杂。本文旨在利用Gotham2025数据集（由Gotham测试平台生成，包含78个模拟物联网设备，使用MQTT、CoAP和RTSP等多种协议）来研究入侵检测系统，以帮助保护物联网网络免受攻击。我们对五种机器学习算法进行了比较分析，包括随机森林、XGBoost、逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯和深度神经网络。结果表明，随机森林分类器是表现最佳的模型，在分类攻击方面达到了0.99的F1分数。
AI.summary: 本文针对物联网设备资源受限导致的安全和隐私挑战，利用Gotham2025数据集（包含78个模拟IoT设备及多种协议），比较分析了随机森林、XGBoost、逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯和深度神经网络五种机器学习算法在入侵检测中的性能。研究发现随机森林分类器表现最优，在攻击分类上F1分数达到0.99，表明其在保护物联网网络方面具有高效性。
AI.keywords: 物联网安全, 入侵检测, 机器学习, 随机森林, Gotham2025
AI.comments: 该研究通过在现实的物联网测试平台（Gotham2025数据集）上进行机器学习算法的比较分析，为物联网入侵检测提供了实用且高性能的解决方案。随机森林分类器高达0.99的F1分数显示了其在实际应用中的巨大潜力，尤其是在资源受限的物联网环境中。这项工作的创新之处在于其对现实IoT网络环境的模拟和对主流ML算法的全面比较，为未来IoT安全研究提供了有价值的参考。

title: Dilemmadata: On the Interoperability of Heterogeneous Roman Numeral Datasets
comments: in proceedings of the Music Encoding Conference 2026
summary: In recent years, there has been growing effort to annotate and collect large-scale corpora of Roman numeral analyses in support of data-driven studies in tonal harmony. We introduce dilemmadata, the first resource to reconcile two major collections, the AugmentedNet Dataset (AN) and the Distant Listening Corpus (DLC), making them interoperable through a shared note-wise TSV schema. The reconciliation confronts four families of dilemmata: annotation-standard (the two encode the same musical fact differently in terms of vocabulary size, syntax, conventions for chord extensions, inventory of special chord functions), representational (what counts as a row, and which information survives the conversion), toolchain (incompatible Python ecosystems built around music21 vs. ms3+dimcat), and curatorial (which pieces to include, exclude, or retain twice). We resolve each by deliberately transforming, augmenting, and omitting information, formalising the mismatches, preserving musical semantics, and flagging transformations that may subtly affect annotation fidelity. Consistency checks and qualitative inspections offer a preliminary assessment of post-conversion validity and a basis for critiquing the theoretical assumptions embedded in each original standard. After removing duplicates and merging the two collections, the resulting dilemmadata (1,621 pieces and aprox. 2.8 M note-wise annotations) is the largest homogeneous Roman-numeral corpus currently available, albeit far from perfect. Crucially, we retain 84 pieces common to both corpora under each of their original analyses, yielding a shared reference set in which two equally legitimate analytical traditions can be compared note-for-note over identical musical material. Released on Zenodo, dilemmadata supports interoperability, comparative harmonization modeling, and future refinement of Roman-numeral encoding standards.
comment: in proceedings of the Music Encoding Conference 2026

AI.title_translation: Dilemmadata：关于异构罗马数字数据集的互操作性研究
AI.tldr: 本文推出了 dilemmadata，这是首个通过共享的逐音符 TSV 模式调和并合并了两个主流罗马数字数据集（AN 和 DLC）的开源资源，提供了目前最大的同质化罗马数字语料库。
AI.motivation: 尽管近年来在收集大规模罗马数字分析语料库以支持数据驱动的调性和声研究方面取得了进展，但现有的主要数据集（如 AN 和 DLC）在标注标准、数据表示、工具链和文献策展上面临严重的不一致，导致它们无法直接互操作。
AI.method: 提出了一种共享的逐音符（note-wise）TSV 模式，通过主动转换、增强和省略信息，形式化不匹配之处，保留音乐语义，并标记可能影响标注保真度的转换，从而调和了两个数据集。此外，还通过一致性检查和定性检查对转换后的有效性进行了评估。
AI.result: 成功合并了 AN 和 DLC 数据集，去除了重复项，生成了包含 1,621 首乐曲和约 280 万个逐音符标注的 dilemmadata 数据集，这是目前最大的同质化罗马数字语料库。此外，还保留了 84 首两数据集共有的乐曲及其各自的原始分析，形成了一个可用于对比研究的共享参考集。该资源已在 Zenodo 上发布。
AI.conclusion: dilemmadata 成功实现了异构罗马数字数据集的互操作性，为比较和声建模、计算音乐学研究以及未来罗马数字编码标准的精细化提供了强有力的支持。
AI.translation: 近年来，人们在标注和收集用于支持调性和声数据驱动研究的大规模罗马数字分析语料库方面做出了越来越多的努力。我们推出了 dilemmadata，这是首个调和了两个主要数据集——AugmentedNet 数据集（AN）和 Distant Listening 语料库（DLC）——的资源，通过共享的逐音符 TSV 模式使它们能够互操作。这一调和过程面临四类困境：标注标准（两者在词汇量、语法、和弦延伸约定、特殊和弦功能分类方面对同一音乐事实的编码不同）、表示形式（什么算作一行，以及转换后保留了哪些信息）、工具链（围绕 music21 与 ms3+dimcat 构建的不兼容 Python 生态系统）以及文献策展（哪些乐曲应该包含、排除或保留两次）。我们通过有意识地转换、增强和省略信息，形式化这些不匹配，保留音乐语义，并标记可能微妙影响标注保真度的转换来解决这些问题。一致性检查和定性检查对转换后的有效性进行了初步评估，并为批判每个原始标准中嵌入的理论假设提供了基础。在去除重复并合并这两个集合后，最终生成的 dilemmadata（包含 1,621 首乐曲和约 280 万个逐音符标注）是目前可用的最大同质罗马数字语料库，尽管它远非完美。至关重要的是，我们保留了两个语料库中共同拥有的 84 首乐曲，并保留了它们各自的原始分析，从而产生了一个共享的参考集，在此参考集中，可以针对相同的音乐材料对两种同样合理的分析传统进行逐音符的对比。dilemmadata 已在 Zenodo 上发布，支持互操作性、对比和声建模以及未来罗马数字编码标准的精细化。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 dilemmadata，这是首个旨在调和并统一两个主流罗马数字分析数据集（AugmentedNet Dataset 和 Distant Listening Corpus）的开源资源。通过克服标注标准、表示形式、工具链和数据策展等四个层面的冲突，该项目构建了目前最大的同质化罗马数字语料库，并保留了共有乐曲的双重分析版本，极大地促进了计算音乐学中的数据互操作性与对比研究。
AI.keywords: 罗马数字分析, 数据集互操作性, 调性和声, 音乐信息检索, 语料库调和
AI.comments: 该研究具有很高的实用价值，成功地将两个主流但互不兼容的音乐分析数据集进行了深度整合，解决了音乐信息检索（MIR）领域长期存在的数据孤岛和标准不一的问题。其核心创新点在于不仅进行了简单的数据格式转换，还深入探讨并形式化了不同音乐分析流派之间的理论差异，特别是保留了84首共有乐曲的双重分析，为比较音乐学研究提供了宝贵的基准。局限性在于，由于原始标准的异构性，转换过程中不可避免地存在信息主动省略或保真度受损的风险，且作者也承认最终数据集“远非完美”。

title: Orienting Unrooted Binary Networks Faster: Focus on the Generator
summary: The problem of orienting an unrooted network to obtain a specific class of rooted phylogenetic networks is known to be NP-hard in many cases. In this paper, we introduce two algorithmic frameworks that yield significantly improved fixed-parameter tractable (FPT) algorithms parameterized by the network level $\ell$. Our first main contribution shows that for several prominent network classes, the core algorithmic difficulty lies in finding a directed spanning tree on the network's undirected generator. By enumerating these spanning trees in $O(5.3334^\ell + \ell)$ time and orienting all remaining edges in polynomial time, we solve the orientation problem in $O(5.3334^\ell \cdot n)$ time for tree-based networks and in $O(5.3334^\ell \cdot n^2)$ time for orchards, where $n$ is the number of vertices of the graph. Extending this approach with further branching yields $O(10.6667^\ell \cdot n^2)$-time algorithms for tree-child and normal networks. Our second technique bypasses spanning trees by directly guessing the placement of reticulations on the generator. This framework provides $O(12.2071^\ell \cdot n^2)$-time algorithms for temporal, reticulation-visible, and tree-sibling networks. Finally, we demonstrate the versatility of the reticulation-guessing framework by showing that even computing an orientation with minimum scanwidth is single-exponential FPT with respect to the level. Together, these results significantly improve the best-known running times for phylogenetic network orientation.

AI.title_translation: 更快地定向无根二叉网络：专注于生成器
AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种基于生成器的算法框架，显著提高了将无根网络定向为特定有根系统发育网络类别的固定参数可解（FPT）算法的运行效率。
AI.motivation: 将无根网络定向以获得特定类别的有根系统发育网络在许多情况下是NP-hard的。现有的定向算法在计算效率上仍有提升空间，特别是在利用网络级别（level） $\ell$ 作为参数时。
AI.method: 提出了两种算法框架：第一种框架专注于在无根生成器上寻找有向生成树，通过在 $O(5.3334^\ell + \ell)$ 时间内枚举这些生成树，并在多项式时间内定向其余边；第二种框架避开生成树，直接通过猜测生成器上网状事件（reticulations）的位置来进行定向。
AI.result:
1. 对于树基网络和果园网络，分别在 $O(5.3334^\ell \cdot n)$ 和 $O(5.3334^\ell \cdot n^2)$ 时间内解决定向问题。
2. 对于树子网络和正规网络，通过进一步分支将运行时间缩短至 $O(10.6667^\ell \cdot n^2)$。
3. 对于时序网络、网状可见网络和树同胞网络，在 $O(12.2071^\ell \cdot n^2)$ 时间内解决。
4. 证明了计算具有最小扫描宽度的定向关于网络级别也是单指数FPT的。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的算法框架显著改进了目前已知最快的系统发育网络定向运行时间，展示了基于生成器分析方法的强大性能。
AI.translation: 将无根网络定向以获得特定类别的有根系统发育网络在许多情况下被已知是NP-hard的。在本文中，我们引入了两种算法框架，它们显著改进了以网络级别 $\ell$ 为参数的固定参数可解（FPT）算法。我们的第一个主要贡献表明，对于几种著名的网络类别，核心的算法难点在于在其无向生成器上寻找一个有向生成树。通过在 $O(5.3334^\ell + \ell)$ 时间内枚举这些生成树并在多项式时间内定向所有剩余的边，我们在 $O(5.3334^\ell \cdot n)$ 时间内解决了树基网络的定向问题，在 $O(5.3334^\ell \cdot n^2)$ 时间内解决了果园网络的定向问题，其中 $n$ 是图的顶点数。通过进一步的分支扩展该方法，可以为树子网络和正规网络提供 $O(10.6667^\ell \cdot n^2)$ 时间的算法。我们的第二种技术通过直接猜测生成器上网状事件的位置来绕过生成树。该框架为时序网络、网状可见网络和树同胞网络提供了 $O(12.2071^\ell \cdot n^2)$ 时间的算法。最后，我们通过证明即使计算具有最小扫描宽度的定向关于网络级别也是单指数FPT的，展示了网状猜测框架的多功能性。总之，这些结果显著提高了系统发育网络定向的已知最佳运行时间。
AI.summary: 本文针对无根系统发育网络定向这一NP-hard问题，提出了两种基于网络生成器的全新FPT算法框架。第一种框架通过高效枚举无向生成器上的有向生成树，优化了树基网络、果园网络、树子网络及正规网络的定向效率；第二种框架通过直接预测生成器上的网状事件位置，加速了时序网络、网状可见网络和树同胞网络的定向。该研究大幅降低了多类系统发育网络定向算法的时间复杂度。
AI.keywords: 系统发育网络, 网络定向, 固定参数可解算法, 生成器, 时间复杂度
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将复杂的网络定向问题巧妙地转化为在无向生成器上寻找有向生成树或猜测网状事件位置的子问题，从而利用网络级别 $\ell$ 作为参数，极大地降低了算法的时间复杂度。这一突破对于系统发育网络重构和生物信息学中的演化历史分析具有重要的理论与计算价值。

title: Token-Sparse Medical Multimodal Reasoning via Dual-Stream Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) combining reinforcement learning (RL) ignite remarkable progress in multimodal reasoning, yet still struggle with medical images, which typically exhibit extremely sparse visual evidence to inform clinical decision-making. We recognize that pruning visual tokens outside the grounding region greatly enhances medical reasoning. However, a united RL framework for active visual token pruning (VTP) and medical multimodal reasoning remains unestablished. Here, we propose a dual-stream RL framework, ViToS, to fulfill token pruning and question answering. ViToS trains one policy model with two task branches, where one focuses on grounding while the other conducts token-sparse reasoning after VTP.
