AI.title_translation: 基于语言的安全性与时间插入式监督器
AI.tldr: 本文使用代数方法定义进程的基于语言的安全性。引入一个监督器，通过控制进程动作或插入定时动作，使不安全进程在监督器和攻击者信息不完整的情况下变得安全。研究了此类监督器存在的条件、属性和局限性。
AI.motivation: 在监督器和攻击者信息不完整的情况下，通过控制或插入定时动作来禁用不安全进程的不良行为，使其变得安全。
AI.method: 采用代数方法定义进程的基于语言的安全性。引入一个监督器，通过控制进程的部分动作或插入定时动作来禁用不安全行为。
AI.result: 研究了此类监督器存在的条件、属性和局限性。
AI.conclusion: 研究了在信息不完整情况下，此类时间插入式监督器使其不安全进程安全的条件、属性和局限性。
AI.translation: 本文采用代数方法定义进程的基于语言的安全性。引入了一个监督器，它可以通过控制不安全进程的某些动作或插入定时动作来禁用其不良行为，从而使不安全进程变得安全。我们假设监督器和攻击者都无法完全了解正在进行的系统行为。我们研究了此类监督器存在的条件、其属性和局限性。
AI.summary: 该研究利用代数方法定义进程的基于语言的安全性，并提出一个时间插入式监督器。该监督器在监督者和攻击者信息不完整的情况下，通过控制或插入定时动作来确保不安全进程的安全性。论文探讨了此类监督器存在的条件、属性及其局限性。
AI.keywords: 基于语言的安全性, 时间插入式监督器, 代数方法, 不完整信息
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于引入了时间插入式监督器，并在监督器和攻击者均信息不完整的情况下探讨了其在语言级别保障进程安全性的能力。这对于处理现实世界中信息不对称的安全问题具有重要意义。

title: Causal-Invariant Cross-Domain Out-of-Distribution Recommendation
comments: Corrected author affiliation. Accepted by ACM TOIS for publication
summary: Cross-Domain Recommendation (CDR) aims to leverage knowledge from a relatively data-richer source domain to address the data sparsity problem in a relatively data-sparser target domain. While CDR methods need to address the distribution shifts between different domains, i.e., cross-domain distribution shifts (CDDS), they typically assume independent and identical distribution (IID) between training and testing data within the target domain. However, this IID assumption rarely holds in real-world scenarios due to single-domain distribution shift (SDDS). The above two co-existing distribution shifts lead to out-of-distribution (OOD) environments that hinder effective knowledge transfer and generalization, ultimately degrading recommendation performance in CDR. To address these co-existing distribution shifts, we propose a novel Causal-Invariant Cross-Domain Out-of-distribution Recommendation framework, called CICDOR. In CICDOR, we first learn dual-level causal structures to infer domain-specific and domain-shared causal-invariant user preferences for tackling both CDDS and SDDS under OOD environments in CDR. Then, we propose an LLM-guided confounder discovery module that seamlessly integrates LLMs with a conventional causal discovery method to extract observed confounders for effective deconfounding, thereby enabling accurate causal-invariant preference inference. Extensive experiments on two real-world datasets demonstrate the superior recommendation accuracy of CICDOR over state-of-the-art methods across various OOD scenarios.
comment: Corrected author affiliation. Accepted by ACM TOIS for publication

AI.title_translation: 因果不变跨域域外推荐
AI.tldr: 本文提出了CICDOR框架，通过学习双层因果结构和LLM引导的混淆因子发现模块，解决了跨域推荐中普遍存在的跨域和单域分布偏移问题，从而在域外环境中提高了推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 跨域推荐（CDR）方法通常假设目标域内训练和测试数据之间是独立同分布（IID）的，但现实世界中这一假设很少成立，导致单域分布偏移（SDDS）。此外，CDR本身就需要处理跨域分布偏移（CDDS）。这两种并存的分布偏移导致域外（OOD）环境，阻碍了有效的知识迁移和泛化，最终降低了CDR的推荐性能。本文旨在解决这些并存的分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个名为CICDOR的因果不变跨域域外推荐框架。在CICDOR中，首先学习双层因果结构，以推断域特定和域共享的因果不变用户偏好，从而应对CDR中OOD环境下的CDDS和SDDS。其次，提出了一个LLM引导的混淆因子发现模块，该模块将大型语言模型（LLM）与传统因果发现方法无缝集成，以提取观测到的混淆因子进行有效去混淆，从而实现准确的因果不变偏好推断。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，CICDOR在各种OOD场景下，推荐准确性优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的CICDOR框架通过学习双层因果结构和LLM引导的混淆因子发现模块，有效解决了跨域推荐中并存的跨域和单域分布偏移问题，显著提高了域外环境下的推荐性能。
AI.translation: 跨域推荐（CDR）旨在利用数据相对丰富的源域知识来解决数据相对稀疏的目标域中的数据稀疏问题。虽然CDR方法需要解决不同域之间的分布偏移，即跨域分布偏移（CDDS），但它们通常假设目标域内训练和测试数据之间是独立同分布（IID）的。然而，由于单域分布偏移（SDDS），这种IID假设在现实世界中很少成立。上述两种并存的分布偏移导致域外（OOD）环境，阻碍了有效的知识迁移和泛化，最终降低了CDR中的推荐性能。为了解决这些并存的分布偏移，我们提出了一个新颖的因果不变跨域域外推荐框架，称为CICDOR。在CICDOR中，我们首先学习双层因果结构，以推断域特定和域共享的因果不变用户偏好，从而应对CDR中OOD环境下的CDDS和SDDS。然后，我们提出了一个LLM引导的混淆因子发现模块，该模块将大型语言模型（LLM）与传统因果发现方法无缝集成，以提取观测到的混淆因子进行有效去混淆，从而实现准确的因果不变偏好推断。在两个真实世界数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，CICDOR在各种OOD场景下，推荐准确性优于最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为CICDOR的新型因果不变跨域域外推荐框架，旨在解决跨域推荐（CDR）中普遍存在的跨域分布偏移（CDDS）和单域分布偏移（SDDS）导致的域外（OOD）环境问题。CICDOR通过学习双层因果结构来推断因果不变的用户偏好，并引入一个LLM引导的混淆因子发现模块进行有效去混淆。实验结果表明，CICDOR在多个OOD场景下均优于现有先进方法，显著提升了推荐准确性。
AI.keywords: 因果不变性, 跨域推荐, 域外推荐, 分布偏移, LLM
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次明确提出并尝试解决跨域推荐中同时存在的跨域和单域分布偏移问题，并将其统一到域外推荐的范畴。通过引入因果不变性原理和结合LLM进行混淆因子发现，为解决复杂分布偏移提供了新的视角和有效方法，对于提升推荐系统在真实复杂环境下的鲁棒性和准确性具有重要意义。

title: Improved Immiscible Diffusion: Accelerate Diffusion Training by Reducing Its Miscibility
summary: The substantial training cost of diffusion models hinders their deployment. Immiscible Diffusion recently showed that reducing diffusion trajectory mixing in the noise space via linear assignment accelerates training by simplifying denoising. To extend immiscible diffusion beyond the inefficient linear assignment under high batch sizes and high dimensions, we refine this concept to a broader miscibility reduction at any layer and by any implementation. Specifically, we empirically demonstrate the bijective nature of the denoising process with respect to immiscible diffusion, ensuring its preservation of generative diversity. Moreover, we provide thorough analysis and show step-by-step how immiscibility eases denoising and improves efficiency. Extending beyond linear assignment, we propose a family of implementations including K-nearest neighbor (KNN) noise selection and image scaling to reduce miscibility, achieving up to >4x faster training across diverse models and tasks including unconditional/conditional generation, image editing, and robotics planning. Furthermore, our analysis of immiscibility offers a novel perspective on how optimal transport (OT) enhances diffusion training. By identifying trajectory miscibility as a fundamental bottleneck, we believe this work establishes a potentially new direction for future research into high-efficiency diffusion training. The code is available at https://github.com/yhli123/Immiscible-Diffusion.

AI.title_translation: 改进的非混溶扩散：通过降低其混溶性加速扩散训练
AI.tldr: 本文通过提出一种更广泛的混溶性降低方法，改进了非混溶扩散，以加速扩散模型的训练，并在多种任务中实现了超过4倍的训练加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型巨大的训练成本阻碍了它们的部署。现有的非混溶扩散方法通过线性分配减少噪声空间中的扩散轨迹混合来加速训练，但该方法在高批量大小和高维度下效率低下。因此，需要扩展非混溶扩散以解决这些效率问题。
AI.method: 本文将非混溶扩散的概念推广到在任何层和通过任何实现方式进行更广泛的混溶性降低。具体而言，经验性地证明了去噪过程与非混溶扩散的双射性质，确保了生成多样性。提出了包括K-近邻（KNN）噪声选择和图像缩放等一系列实现方法来降低混溶性，以替代线性的分配。
AI.result: 实现了在无条件/有条件生成、图像编辑和机器人规划等多种模型和任务中超过4倍的训练加速。分析了非混溶性如何简化去噪并提高效率，并为最优传输（OT）如何增强扩散训练提供了新视角。
AI.conclusion: 通过将轨迹混溶性识别为一个基本瓶颈，这项工作为未来高效扩散训练的研究开辟了一个潜在的新方向。
AI.translation: 扩散模型巨大的训练成本阻碍了它们的部署。非混溶扩散最近表明，通过线性分配减少噪声空间中的扩散轨迹混合可以简化去噪过程，从而加速训练。为了将非混溶扩散扩展到高批量大小和高维度下低效的线性分配之外，我们改进了这一概念，使其成为在任何层级和通过任何实现方式进行的更广泛的混溶性降低。具体来说，我们经验性地证明了去噪过程对于非混溶扩散的双射性质，确保了其生成多样性的保持。此外，我们提供了彻底的分析，并逐步展示了非混溶性如何简化去噪并提高效率。除了线性分配，我们提出了一系列实现方法，包括K-近邻（KNN）噪声选择和图像缩放，以降低混溶性，在无条件/有条件生成、图像编辑和机器人规划等多种模型和任务中实现了超过4倍的训练加速。此外，我们对非混溶性的分析为最优传输（OT）如何增强扩散训练提供了新颖的视角。通过将轨迹混溶性识别为一个基本瓶颈，我们相信这项工作为未来高效扩散训练的研究开辟了一个潜在的新方向。代码可在https://github.com/yhli123/Immiscible-Diffusion 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种改进的非混溶扩散方法，旨在通过更广泛地降低扩散模型训练中的轨迹混溶性来加速训练。该方法扩展了现有的线性分配限制，通过经验证明去噪过程的双射性质来保持生成多样性，并引入了KNN噪声选择和图像缩放等新实现方式。实验结果显示，在多种生成任务中实现了超过4倍的训练加速，并为高效扩散训练提供了新的研究方向。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 训练加速, 非混溶扩散, 混溶性降低, 最优传输
AI.comments: 这项工作通过将轨迹混溶性识别为扩散模型训练中的一个基本瓶颈，并提出了一系列超越传统线性分配的混溶性降低实现方法，展示了显著的创新性。其在多种任务中实现超过4倍的训练加速，突显了其在提高扩散模型实用性方面的重要性。通过分析混溶性与最优传输的关系，也为未来的研究提供了新的视角。

title: ISAC: Training-Free Instance-to-Semantic Attention Control for Multi-Instance Generation
summary: Recent open-weight text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models still struggle with multi-instance prompts, often omitting or merging instances and mixing semantics among similar objects. We trace these failures to early denoising steps, before instance boundaries are reliably stabilized. Existing training-free guidance is largely driven by cross-attention or other token-conditioned semantic signals. Such guidance can separate concepts at the token level, but largely assumes that distinct instance regions have already emerged. In early denoising steps, it cannot reliably carve out these regions, so count failures and semantic mixing persist. By contrast, self-attention exposes class-agnostic instance layouts during early denoising. To exploit this asymmetry, we propose $\textbf{ISAC}$ ($\textbf{I}$nstance-to-$\textbf{S}$emantic $\textbf{A}$ttention $\textbf{C}$ontrol), a training-free, model-agnostic objective that first stabilizes self-attention layouts and then binds cross-attention semantics within them, without fine-tuning or external vision models. Across T2I-CompBench, HRS-Bench, and our newly curated IntraCompBench, ISAC consistently outperforms prior training-free methods. Furthermore, ISAC enhances layout-to-image controllers by refining coarse, overlapping bounding boxes into dense instance masks. Code and IntraCompBench are available at https://shjo-april.github.io/ISAC.

AI.title_translation: ISAC：多实例生成中免训练的实例到语义注意力控制
AI.tldr: 文生图（T2I）扩散模型在多实例生成上表现不佳，因为早期去噪步骤中实例边界不稳定。现有免训练方法假设实例区域已存在，无法解决早期问题。ISAC利用自注意力在早期去噪中暴露的类无关实例布局，通过稳定自注意力布局并绑定交叉注意力语义来解决，无需训练，并在多个基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的文生图（T2I）扩散模型在处理多实例提示时表现不佳，经常遗漏或合并实例，并在相似对象之间混淆语义。这些失败源于早期去噪步骤，此时实例边界尚未可靠稳定。现有的免训练指导方法主要依赖交叉注意力，但它们假设独立的实例区域已经出现，无法在早期去噪步骤中可靠地划分这些区域。
AI.method: 本文提出ISAC（Instance-to-Semantic Attention Control），这是一种免训练、模型无关的目标函数。它首先稳定自注意力布局，然后将交叉注意力语义绑定到这些布局中。此方法无需微调或外部视觉模型。
AI.result: ISAC在T2I-CompBench、HRS-Bench和新创建的IntraCompBench上始终优于先前的免训练方法。此外，ISAC通过将粗糙、重叠的边界框细化为密集的实例掩码，增强了布局到图像控制器。
AI.conclusion: ISAC通过利用自注意力在早期去噪中暴露的实例布局，并结合交叉注意力语义，有效解决了文生图模型在多实例生成中的挑战，并在多个基准测试中表现出卓越的性能。
AI.translation: 近期开源的文生图（T2I）扩散模型在处理多实例提示时仍然面临挑战，经常遗漏或合并实例，并在相似对象之间混淆语义。我们将这些失败追溯到早期去噪步骤，即实例边界尚未可靠稳定之前。现有的免训练指导方法主要由交叉注意力或其他受token条件限制的语义信号驱动。这种指导可以在token层面分离概念，但很大程度上假设已出现不同的实例区域。在早期去噪步骤中，它无法可靠地划分这些区域，因此计数失败和语义混淆仍然存在。相比之下，自注意力在早期去噪过程中暴露了与类别无关的实例布局。为了利用这种不对称性，我们提出了ISAC（Instance-to-Semantic Attention Control），这是一个免训练、模型无关的目标函数，它首先稳定自注意力布局，然后将交叉注意力语义绑定到这些布局中，无需微调或外部视觉模型。在T2I-CompBench、HRS-Bench和我们新整理的IntraCompBench上，ISAC始终优于先前的免训练方法。此外，ISAC通过将粗糙、重叠的边界框细化为密集的实例掩码，增强了布局到图像控制器。代码和IntraCompBench可在https://shjo-april.github.io/ISAC 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出ISAC，一种免训练、模型无关的方法，旨在解决文生图扩散模型在多实例生成中遇到的实例遗漏、合并和语义混淆问题。这些问题源于早期去噪阶段实例边界的不稳定。ISAC利用自注意力在早期去噪中揭示的类无关实例布局，通过先稳定自注意力布局再绑定交叉注意力语义来解决。实验表明，ISAC在多个基准测试中显著优于现有免训练方法，并能改进布局到图像控制器，生成更精细的实例掩码。
AI.keywords: 多实例生成, 文生图扩散模型, 免训练控制, 自注意力, 交叉注意力
AI.comments: ISAC的创新点在于它识别并利用了自注意力在早期去噪阶段提供类无关实例布局的能力，这与传统交叉注意力指导的假设形成对比。通过在早期阶段稳定实例布局，ISAC有效地解决了多实例生成中的核心挑战，为文生图模型提供了一种无需训练即可提升性能的通用方法。其模型无关性也增加了其实用价值。

title: Position: Collaborative Agentic AI Needs Interoperability Across Ecosystems
summary: Collaborative agentic AI is projected to transform entire industries by enabling AI-powered agents to autonomously perceive, plan, and act within digital environments. Yet, current solutions in this field are all built in isolation, and we are rapidly heading toward a landscape of fragmented, incompatible ecosystems. In this position paper, we argue that interoperability, achieved by the adoption of minimal standards, is essential to ensure open, secure, web-scale, and widely-adopted agentic ecosystems. To this end, we devise a minimal architectural foundation for collaborative agentic AI, named Web of Agents, which is composed of four building blocks: agent-to-agent messaging, interaction interoperability, state management, and agent discovery. Web of Agents adopts existing standards and reuses existing infrastructure where possible. With Web of Agents, we take the first but critical step toward interoperable agentic systems and offer a pragmatic path forward before ecosystem fragmentation becomes the norm.

AI.title_translation: 立场：协作式智能体AI需要跨生态系统的互操作性
AI.tldr: 协作式智能体AI正面临生态系统碎片化问题，本论文提出“Web of Agents”这一最小化架构基础，旨在通过互操作性来确保开放、安全、网络规模和广泛采用的智能体生态系统，并避免碎片化成为常态。
AI.motivation: 当前的协作式智能体AI解决方案都是独立构建的，导致生态系统碎片化且不兼容。为了确保开放、安全、网络规模和广泛采用的智能体生态系统，互操作性至关重要。
AI.method: 提出一个名为“Web of Agents”的协作式智能体AI最小架构基础，该基础由四个构建模块组成：智能体到智能体消息传递、交互互操作性、状态管理和智能体发现。它尽可能采用现有标准并重用现有基础设施。
AI.result: Web of Agents被设计为实现可互操作智能体系统的第一步也是关键一步，为在生态系统碎片化成为常态之前提供了一条务实的前进道路。
AI.conclusion: 通过采用最小标准实现的互操作性对于防止协作式智能体AI生态系统碎片化并确保其广泛采用至关重要，而“Web of Agents”提供了一个实现这一目标的实用路径。
AI.translation: 协作式智能体AI预计将通过使AI驱动的智能体能够自主地感知、规划和行动于数字环境中来改变整个行业。然而，目前该领域的解决方案都是独立构建的，我们正迅速走向一个碎片化、不兼容的生态系统格局。在这篇立场论文中，我们认为，通过采用最小标准实现的互操作性对于确保开放、安全、网络规模和广泛采用的智能体生态系统至关重要。为此，我们设计了一个名为“Web of Agents”的协作式智能体AI的最小架构基础，它由四个构建模块组成：智能体到智能体消息传递、交互互操作性、状态管理和智能体发现。“Web of Agents”尽可能采用现有标准并重用现有基础设施。通过“Web of Agents”，我们迈出了实现可互操作智能体系统的第一步也是关键一步，并在生态系统碎片化成为常态之前提供了一条务实的前进道路。
AI.summary: 这篇立场论文指出，当前协作式智能体AI解决方案的孤立发展正导致生态系统碎片化。为解决此问题，论文提出了“Web of Agents”——一个由智能体到智能体消息传递、交互互操作性、状态管理和智能体发现四个构建模块组成的最小架构基础。该方案旨在通过采纳现有标准和基础设施，实现跨智能体系统的互操作性，从而确保未来AI智能体生态系统的开放性、安全性、网络规模和广泛采用，并避免碎片化。
AI.keywords: 协作式智能体AI, 互操作性, Web of Agents, 生态系统, 标准
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了智能体AI领域一个关键且迫切的新兴挑战。它强调互操作性并通过利用现有标准来实现的务实方法，对于协作式AI智能体的可扩展和安全部署至关重要，使其成为未来发展的重要基础性工作。

title: Private Rate-Constrained Optimization with Applications to Fair Learning
summary: Many problems in trustworthy ML can be expressed as constraints on prediction rates across subpopulations, including group fairness constraints (demographic parity, equalized odds, etc.). In this work, we study such constrained minimization problems under differential privacy (DP). Standard DP optimization techniques like DP-SGD rely on objectives that decompose over individual examples, enabling per-example gradient clipping and noise addition. Rate constraints, however, depend on aggregate statistics across groups, creating inter-sample dependencies that violate this decomposability. To address this, we develop RaCO-DP, a DP variant of Stochastic Gradient Descent-Ascent (SGDA) that solves the Lagrangian formulation of rate constraint problems. Through careful design, the extra privacy cost incurred by incorporating these constraints in our approach is limited to that of privately estimating a histogram over each mini-batch at every step. We prove the convergence of our algorithm through a novel analysis of SGDA that leverages the linear structure of the dual parameter. Empirical results show that our method Pareto-dominates existing private learning approaches under group fairness constraints and also achieves strong privacy-utility-fairness performance on neural networks.

AI.title_translation: 私有率约束优化及其在公平学习中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文提出了RaCO-DP，一种差分隐私的随机梯度下降-上升(SGDA)方法，用于解决率约束优化问题（如公平学习），通过处理样本间依赖性，显示出卓越的性能。
AI.motivation: 可信赖机器学习中的许多问题可表示为跨子群体的预测率约束，例如群体公平性约束。标准的差分隐私(DP)优化技术（如DP-SGD）依赖于可分解的个体示例目标函数，但率约束依赖于群体聚合统计数据，产生违反这种可分解性的样本间依赖关系，因此现有方法难以处理。
AI.method: 本文开发了RaCO-DP，一种随机梯度下降-上升(SGDA)的差分隐私变体，用于解决率约束问题的拉格朗日公式。通过精心设计，将纳入这些约束所产生的额外隐私成本限制为每一步对每个小批量私有估计直方图的成本。通过对SGDA进行新颖分析，利用对偶参数的线性结构，证明了算法的收敛性。
AI.result: 实证结果表明，在群体公平性约束下，我们的方法在帕累托意义上优于现有的私有学习方法。此外，它在神经网络上实现了强大的隐私-效用-公平性性能。
AI.conclusion: RaCO-DP有效地解决了率约束优化问题中差分隐私的挑战，特别是在公平学习方面，通过提供一种既能确保隐私又能保持强大效用和公平性的方法。
AI.translation: 许多可信机器学习问题可以表示为跨亚群的预测率约束，包括群体公平性约束（人口统计学均等、机会均等）。在这项工作中，我们研究了差分隐私（DP）下的此类约束最小化问题。标准的DP优化技术，如DP-SGD，依赖于可分解为单个示例的目标函数，从而实现逐示例梯度裁剪和噪声添加。然而，率约束依赖于跨群体的聚合统计数据，这产生了违反这种可分解性的样本间依赖关系。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了RaCO-DP，这是一种随机梯度下降-上升（SGDA）的DP变体，它解决了率约束问题的拉格朗日公式。通过精心设计，我们的方法中纳入这些约束所产生的额外隐私成本仅限于在每一步对每个小批量私有估计直方图的成本。我们通过对SGDA进行新颖的分析，利用对偶参数的线性结构，证明了我们算法的收敛性。实证结果表明，我们的方法在群体公平性约束下帕累托优于现有的私有学习方法，并且在神经网络上实现了强大的隐私-效用-公平性性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为RaCO-DP的新型差分隐私随机梯度下降-上升（SGDA）算法，旨在解决可信赖机器学习中的率约束优化问题，例如群体公平性。与难以处理聚合率约束的标准DP方法不同，RaCO-DP通过求解拉格朗日公式，将隐私成本限制在小批量直方图估计。该算法证明了收敛性，并在经验上展示了其在隐私-效用-公平性权衡方面优于现有私有学习方法，尤其是在神经网络上。
AI.keywords: 差分隐私, 率约束优化, 公平学习, SGDA, 群体公平性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于有效地将差分隐私与率约束优化相结合，这对于公平机器学习至关重要。通过解决率约束的样本间依赖问题，RaCO-DP提供了一个实用且理论上可靠的解决方案，其性能优于现有方法，对隐私保护和公平AI做出了重大贡献。

title: Linear Production Games with Non-transferable Utilities
comments: 26th ACM Conference on Economics and Computation (EC '25)
summary: We introduce non-transferable utility linear production (NTU LP) games, a non-transferable utility analogue of classical linear production games, as a framework for the study of cooperative behavior in the production or establishment of public goods with pooled resources. NTU LP games combine the game-theoretic tensions inherent in public decision-making with the modeling flexibility of linear programming. We derive structural properties regarding the non-emptiness, representability and complexity of the core, a solution concept that models the viability of cooperation. In particular, we provide fairly general sufficient conditions under which the core of an NTU LP game is guaranteed to be non-empty, prove that determining membership in the core is co-NP-complete, and develop a cutting plane algorithm to optimize various social welfare objectives subject to core membership. We apply these results in a data-driven case study on service plan optimization for the Chicago bus system. As our study illustrates, cooperation is necessary for the successful deployment of transportation service plans and similar public goods, but it may also have adverse or counterintuitive distributive implications.
comment: 26th ACM Conference on Economics and Computation (EC '25)

AI.title_translation: 线性生产非转移效用博弈
AI.tldr: 本文引入了非转移效用线性生产（NTU LP）博弈，作为研究公共物品生产中合作行为的框架。研究了核心的非空性、可表示性和复杂性，提出优化算法，并通过芝加哥公交系统案例研究表明合作的必要性及其潜在的分配影响。
AI.motivation: 研究在公共物品生产或建立中使用集合资源时的合作行为。该框架结合了公共决策的博弈论张力与线性规划的建模灵活性，以更好地理解和建模此类情境下的合作。
AI.method: 引入了非转移效用线性生产（NTU LP）博弈，结合博弈论和线性规划。推导了核心的结构性质，包括非空性、可表示性和复杂性。提供了核心非空的充分条件，证明了核心成员资格判断是co-NP完全的。开发了用于优化社会福利目标的割平面算法，并通过芝加哥公交系统服务计划优化的数据驱动案例研究进行应用和验证。
AI.result: 1. 引入了非转移效用线性生产（NTU LP）博弈框架。2. 推导了核心的结构性质，包括非空性、可表示性和复杂性。3. 提供了核心非空的通用充分条件。4. 证明了确定核心成员资格是co-NP完全的。5. 开发了优化各种社会福利目标的割平面算法。6. 案例研究表明，合作对于公共服务计划的成功部署是必要的，但也可能产生不利或反直觉的分配影响。
AI.conclusion: 合作对于交通服务计划和类似公共物品的成功部署是必要的，但它也可能产生不利或反直觉的分配影响。
AI.translation: 我们引入了非转移效用线性生产（NTU LP）博弈，它是经典线性生产博弈的一种非转移效用形式，作为研究在公共物品生产或建立中使用集合资源时的合作行为的框架。NTU LP 博弈结合了公共决策中固有的博弈论张力与线性规划的建模灵活性。我们推导了关于核心（一种模拟合作可行性的解决方案概念）的非空性、可表示性和复杂性的结构性质。特别是，我们提供了相当通用的充分条件，在这些条件下，NTU LP 博弈的核心保证是非空的，证明了确定核心成员资格是co-NP完全的，并开发了一种割平面算法来优化受核心成员资格约束的各种社会福利目标。我们将这些结果应用于芝加哥公交系统服务计划优化的数据驱动案例研究中。正如我们的研究所示，合作对于交通服务计划和类似公共物品的成功部署是必要的，但它也可能产生不利或反直觉的分配影响。
AI.summary: 本文引入了非转移效用线性生产（NTU LP）博弈，作为研究公共物品生产中合作行为的框架。该博弈结合了博弈论与线性规划的特点，并深入分析了其核心（合作可行性概念）的结构性质，包括非空性条件、可表示性和co-NP完全的成员资格判断。此外，文章还开发了基于核心成员资格的社会福利优化割平面算法，并通过芝加哥公交系统的案例研究验证了合作的必要性及其潜在的反直觉分配影响。
AI.keywords: 非转移效用博弈, 线性生产, 合作行为, 核心, 公共物品
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入NTU LP博弈，为研究公共物品生产中的合作行为提供了一个新颖且实用的理论框架。其创新点在于将非转移效用概念与线性生产博弈和线性规划相结合，并对核心的结构特性进行了深入的理论分析，包括非空性条件和计算复杂性。论文不仅提供了理论洞察，还通过割平面算法和实际案例研究展示了其实用价值，特别是在解决公共服务优化问题上的潜力。其局限性可能在于，虽然提供了核心非空的充分条件，但实际应用中可能需要更具体的指导或对其他非核心解概念的探讨。

title: Testing Suffixient Sets
summary: Suffixient sets are a novel prefix array (PA) compression technique based on subsampling PA (rather than compressing the entire array like previous techniques used to do): by storing very few entries of PA (in fact, a compressed number of entries), one can prove that pattern matching via binary search is still possible provided that random access is available on the text. In this paper, we tackle the problems of determining whether a given subset of text positions is (1) a suffixient set or (2) a suffixient set of minimum cardinality. We provide linear-time algorithms solving these problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了线性时间算法来解决确定给定文本位置子集是否为充分集或最小基数充分集的问题。
AI.motivation: 确定给定的文本位置子集是否是充分集，以及是否是最小基数的充分集。
AI.method: 提供了解决这些问题的线性时间算法。
AI.result: 本文提出了线性时间算法，能够确定给定文本位置子集是否为充分集或最小基数充分集。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提供了解决充分集判定问题的线性时间算法。
AI.translation: 充分集是一种新颖的前缀数组（PA）压缩技术，其基础是对PA进行子抽样（而不是像以前的技术那样压缩整个数组）：通过存储PA中非常少的条目（实际上是压缩数量的条目），可以证明在文本上随机访问可用时，通过二分查找进行模式匹配仍然是可能的。在本文中，我们解决了确定给定文本位置子集是否为（1）充分集或（2）最小基数充分集的问题。我们提供了解决这些问题的线性时间算法。
AI.summary: 充分集是一种基于前缀数组子抽样的新型压缩技术，允许通过二分查找进行模式匹配。本文提出了线性时间算法，用于判断给定文本位置子集是否为充分集，以及是否为最小基数的充分集。
AI.keywords: 充分集, 前缀数组, 压缩, 模式匹配, 线性时间算法
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新的前缀数组压缩方法——充分集，它通过子抽样而非完全压缩来减少存储。其核心贡献在于提供了线性时间算法来验证和识别充分集及其最小基数形式，这对于高效的模式匹配和数据压缩具有重要意义。

title: MetricHMSR:Metric Human Mesh and Scene Recovery from Monocular Images
summary: We introduce MetricHMSR, a novel framework for recovering metric human meshes and 3D scenes from a single monocular image. Existing methods struggle to recover metric scale due to monocular scale ambiguity and weak-perspective camera assumptions. Moreover, their fully coupled feature representations make it difficult to disentangle local pose from global translation, often requiring multi-stage pipelines that introduce accumulated errors. To address these challenges, we propose MetricHMR (Metric Human Mesh Recovery), which incorporates a bounding camera ray map representation to provide explicit metric cues for human reconstruction,together with a Human Mixture-of-Experts (HumanMoE) that dynamically routes image features to specialized experts, enabling the disentangled perception of local human pose and global metric position. Leveraging the recovered metric human as a geometric anchor, we further refine monocular metric depth estimation to achieve more accurate 3D alignment between humans and scenes.Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both human mesh recovery and metric human-scene reconstruction. Project Page: https://Metaverse-AI-Lab-THU.github.io/MetricHMSR.

AI.title_translation: MetricHMSR：基于单目图像的度量级人体网格与场景恢复
AI.tldr: MetricHMSR通过引入相机射线图和混合专家模型，解决了单目视觉中尺度恢复和特征解耦的难题，实现了高精度的度量级人-场景重建。
AI.motivation: 现有的单目人体网格恢复方法受限于尺度歧义和弱透视相机假设，难以恢复准确的度量尺度；此外，完全耦合的特征表示导致局部姿态与全局位移难以解耦，且多阶段流水线易导致误差累积。
AI.method: 1. 引入边界相机射线图（bounding camera ray map）提供显式度量线索；2. 使用人体混合专家模型（HumanMoE）实现局部人体姿态与全局度量位置的解耦；3. 将恢复出的度量人体作为几何锚点，优化单目度量深度估计，实现人体与场景的精确对齐。
AI.result: 在人体网格恢复和度量级人-场景重建任务上均取得了当前最优（SOTA）的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: MetricHMSR通过引入显式度量线索和解耦的专家模型，成功实现了单目图像下高精度的度量级人体网格与场景恢复，达到了SOTA水平。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了MetricHMSR，这是一种从单个单目图像中恢复度量人体网格和3D场景的新型框架。现有的方法由于单目尺度歧义和弱透视相机假设，难以恢复度量尺度。此外，它们完全耦合的特征表示使得将局部姿态与全局平移解耦变得困难，通常需要引入累积误差的多阶段流水线。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MetricHMR，它结合了边界相机射线图表示，为人体重建提供显式的度量线索，并配有人体混合专家模型（HumanMoE），将图像特征动态路由到专业专家，从而实现局部人体姿态和全局度量位置的解耦感知。利用恢复出的度量人体作为几何锚点，我们进一步细化了单目度量深度估计，以实现人体与场景之间更准确的3D对齐。综合实验表明，我们的方法在人体网格恢复和度量人体-场景重建方面均达到了最先进的性能。项目页面：https://Metaverse-AI-Lab-THU.github.io/MetricHMSR。
AI.summary: MetricHMSR是一个从单目图像恢复度量人体网格与3D场景的新框架。它通过边界相机射线图提供度量线索，并利用HumanMoE模型解耦局部姿态与全局位置。此外，该方法以恢复的人体作为几何锚点，优化了场景深度估计，从而实现了更精准的人体与场景3D对齐。
AI.keywords: 单目人体网格恢复, 场景恢复, 度量尺度, 混合专家模型, 几何对齐
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了边界相机射线图表示和HumanMoE架构，有效地解决了单目图像中尺度歧义和局部/全局特征解耦的难题。其将人体作为几何锚点来优化场景深度估计的方法思路清晰，对于AR/VR等需要高精度人体-场景交互的应用具有重要的参考价值。

title: From Multimodal Perception to Strategic Reasoning: A Survey on AI-Generated Game Commentary
summary: The advent of artificial intelligence has propelled AI-Generated Game Commentary (AI-GGC) into a rapidly expanding research area, offering advantages such as scalable availability and personalized narration. However, existing studies remain fragmented, and a systematic survey that unifies prior efforts is still lacking. To bridge this gap, our survey introduces a unified framework that systematically organizes the AI-GGC landscape. We present a novel taxonomy focused on three core commentator capabilities: Live Observation, Strategic Analysis, and Historical Recall, and further categorize commentary into three corresponding types: Descriptive Commentary, Analytical Commentary, and Background Commentary. Building on this structure, we provide an in-depth review of methods, datasets, and evaluation metrics, analyzing their strengths and limitations. Finally, we highlight key challenges and point out promising directions for future research in AI-GGC.

AI.title_translation: 从多模态感知到战略推理：AI生成游戏解说综述
AI.tldr: 本综述统一了AI生成游戏解说（AI-GGC）领域分散的研究，引入了一个系统框架和新颖的分类法，回顾了方法、数据集和评估，并指出了未来的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现有关于AI生成游戏解说（AI-GGC）的研究仍然分散，缺乏一个系统性的综述来整合先前的努力。本综述旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 本综述提出了一个统一的框架来系统地组织AI-GGC领域，并引入了一种新颖的分类法，该分类法侧重于三个核心解说员能力（现场观察、战略分析和历史回顾）和三种相应的解说类型（描述性解说、分析性解说和背景解说）。在此基础上，深入回顾了方法、数据集和评估指标，并分析了它们的优缺点。
AI.result: 该综述为AI-GGC提供了一个统一的框架和新颖的分类法，系统地组织了该领域，回顾了现有方法并分析了它们的优缺点。
AI.conclusion: 该综述强调了AI-GGC领域的主要挑战，并指出了未来研究的有前景的方向。
AI.translation: 人工智能的出现推动了AI生成游戏解说（AI-GGC）成为一个快速发展的研究领域，它具有可扩展的可用性和个性化叙述等优势。然而，现有研究仍然分散，缺乏一个统一先前工作的系统性综述。为了弥补这一空白，我们的综述引入了一个统一的框架，系统地组织了AI-GGC的图景。我们提出了一种新颖的分类法，专注于三个核心解说员能力：现场观察、战略分析和历史回顾，并进一步将解说分为三种相应的类型：描述性解说、分析性解说和背景解说。在此结构的基础上，我们深入回顾了方法、数据集和评估指标，分析了它们的优缺点。最后，我们强调了AI-GGC领域的主要挑战，并指出了未来研究的有前景的方向。
AI.summary: 本论文综述了AI生成游戏解说（AI-GGC）这一快速发展但研究分散的领域。它提出了一个统一的框架和新颖的分类法，基于解说员能力（现场观察、战略分析、历史回顾）和解说类型（描述性、分析性、背景）。综述回顾了当前的方法、数据集和评估指标，讨论了它们的优缺点，并指出了未来的研究挑战和方向。
AI.keywords: AI生成游戏解说, AI-GGC, 综述, 游戏解说, 分类法
AI.comments: 本综述具有重要意义，因为它解决了AI-GGC这一快速扩张领域中的碎片化问题，提供了一个急需的系统性组织和新颖的分类法。它提供了全面的概述，并指出了关键的未来研究方向，这对进入或在该领域工作的研究人员将非常有价值。

title: Step-by-Step Video-to-Audio Synthesis via Negative Audio Guidance
summary: We propose a step-by-step video-to-audio (V2A) generation method that provides finer control over the generation process and more realistic audio synthesis. Inspired by traditional Foley workflows, our approach enables incremental generation of complementary sounds, allowing users to author multiple sound events induced by a video. To avoid the need for costly multi-reference video-audio datasets, each generation step is formulated as a negatively guided V2A process that discourages duplication of sounds already present in previously generated tracks. The guidance model is trained by finetuning a pre-trained V2A model on audio pairs from non-overlapping segments of the same video, encouraging it to leverage acoustic context while remaining visually grounded, and enabling training with standard single-reference audiovisual datasets. Objective and subjective evaluations demonstrate that our method enhances the separability of generated sounds at each step and improves the overall quality of the final composite audio, outperforming existing baselines. Our project page is available at: https://ahykw.github.io/sbsv2a/.

AI.title_translation: 通过负向音频引导实现分步视频到音频合成
AI.tldr: 提出一种受拟音启发的视频到音频生成方法，通过负向引导机制分步生成音频，在无需大规模多参考数据集的前提下，显著提升了音频的真实感与可分离性。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频到音频生成方法在处理复杂的多音源场景时，往往导致音频混叠且缺乏细粒度控制，且通常依赖昂贵的多参考音视频数据集。
AI.method: 提出一种受传统拟音工作流启发的分步V2A生成方法。利用负向音频引导（Negative Audio Guidance）机制，在生成新音轨时抑制已生成音轨的重复音频；通过在同一视频的非重叠段对上微调预训练模型来训练引导模型。
AI.result: 客观和主观评估表明，该方法在每一步生成的音频可分离性上表现更好，且最终合成音频的整体质量优于现有基准模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功提出了一种分步视频到音频生成方法，通过负向音频引导机制，有效提升了复杂场景下多音源的生成质量和可分离性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种分步视频到音频（V2A）生成方法，该方法提供了对生成过程的更细致控制以及更逼真的音频合成。受传统拟音（Foley）工作流的启发，我们的方法能够增量生成互补声音，允许用户创作由视频引发的多个声音事件。为了避免对昂贵的多参考音视频数据集的需求，每个生成步骤都被表述为一个负向引导的V2A过程，该过程抑制了先前生成的轨道中已存在的声音的重复。引导模型通过在同一视频的非重叠片段的音频对上微调预训练的V2A模型进行训练，鼓励其在保持视觉基础的同时利用声学上下文，并支持使用标准的单参考音视频数据集进行训练。客观和主观评估表明，我们的方法增强了每一步生成声音的可分离性，并提高了最终合成音频的整体质量，优于现有的基准模型。项目页面：https://ahykw.github.io/sbsv2a/。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种分步视频到音频合成方法，模拟拟音工作流，通过负向音频引导机制实现音频的增量生成，从而在无需额外多参考数据集的情况下，有效提升了多音源场景下的音频合成质量与可控性。
AI.keywords: 视频到音频合成, 拟音工作流, 负向引导, 多音源生成, 音频上下文
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将传统的拟音（Foley）工作流引入视频到音频（V2A）生成领域，通过分步生成和负向引导机制解决音频混叠问题，无需昂贵的多参考数据集即可实现高质量音频合成，具有很强的实用价值。

title: Reasoning in machine vision by learning fast and slow thinking
summary: Reasoning is a hallmark of human intelligence, enabling adaptive decision-making in complex unfamiliar scenarios. In contrast, machine intelligence remains bound to training data, unable to dynamically refine solutions at inference. While recent advances have explored machine reasoning - trading inference-time compute for improved performance - they focus on verbal domains such as mathematical problem-solving where explicit rules govern step-by-step solution generation. Many tasks lack sufficient labelled data and require alternative performance improvement mechanisms, such as inference-time compute. Here we present a paradigm for machine reasoning in vision, enabling performance improvements with increasing thinking time (inference-time compute), even with limited labelled data. Our approach is inspired by dual-process theories of human cognition, integrating a fast-thinking System I module for generating and verifying solutions in familiar tasks, with a slow-thinking System II module that iteratively refines predictions using self-play reinforcement learning, even when task-specific data is limited. This paradigm involves proposing, competing over, and refining solutions until convergence. We demonstrate that extended inference-time compute yields superior performance compared to large-scale supervised learning, foundation models, and human experts in vision tasks. These include computer-vision benchmarks and cancer localisation across five organs, highlighting the potential of inference-time compute for data-scarce problems.

AI.title_translation: 通过学习快慢思维在机器视觉中进行推理
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种受人类双过程理论启发的机器视觉推理范式，通过增加推理时间，即使在有限标注数据下也能显著提升性能，并在视觉任务中超越现有方法和人类专家。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器智能受限于训练数据，无法在推理时动态优化解决方案，尤其是在数据稀缺的任务中，需要一种新的机制，如推理时计算，来提升性能。
AI.method: 该方法借鉴人类认知的双过程理论，整合了快思维（System I）模块用于生成和验证熟悉任务的解决方案，以及慢思维（System II）模块，通过自博弈强化学习迭代地完善预测，即使在任务特定数据有限的情况下也能工作。该范式通过提出、竞争和完善解决方案直至收敛。
AI.result: 延长推理时计算在计算机视觉基准和跨五个器官的癌症定位等视觉任务中，表现出优于大规模监督学习、基础模型和人类专家的性能。
AI.conclusion: 推理时计算在解决数据稀缺问题方面具有巨大潜力。
AI.translation:
推理是人类智能的一个标志，它能够在复杂陌生的场景中实现自适应决策。相比之下，机器智能仍然受限于训练数据，无法在推理时动态地完善解决方案。尽管最近的进展探索了机器推理——以推理时计算换取性能提升——但它们主要集中在语言领域，例如数学问题解决，其中明确的规则指导分步解决方案的生成。许多任务缺乏足够的标注数据，需要替代的性能改进机制，例如推理时计算。
本文提出了一种机器视觉推理范式，即使在标注数据有限的情况下，也能通过增加思考时间（推理时计算）来提升性能。我们的方法灵感来源于人类认知的双过程理论，它整合了一个用于在熟悉任务中生成和验证解决方案的快思维系统I模块，以及一个慢思维系统II模块，该模块即使在特定任务数据有限的情况下，也能使用自博弈强化学习迭代地完善预测。这种范式涉及提出、竞争和完善解决方案，直到收敛。
我们证明，与大规模监督学习、基础模型和人类专家相比，在视觉任务中，延长推理时计算会产生卓越的性能。这些任务包括计算机视觉基准和跨五个器官的癌症定位，突出了推理时计算在数据稀缺问题中的潜力。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种受人类双过程理论启发的机器视觉推理范式，通过整合快思维（System I）和慢思维（System II，利用自博弈强化学习）模块，在推理时动态完善解决方案。该方法即使在标注数据有限的情况下，也能通过增加推理时间来显著提升性能，并在计算机视觉基准和癌症定位等任务中超越了大规模监督学习、基础模型和人类专家，凸显了推理时计算在解决数据稀缺问题上的潜力。
AI.keywords: 机器视觉推理, 双过程理论, 推理时计算, 自博弈强化学习, 数据稀缺问题
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于将人类双过程认知理论引入机器视觉推理，通过在推理时进行“慢思考”来动态优化解决方案，而非仅仅依赖预训练模型。这对于解决数据稀缺问题具有重要意义，因为它允许模型在没有大量标注数据的情况下，通过内部迭代和自博弈来提升性能。其在医疗影像等对数据标注要求高且数据量有限的领域，展现出巨大的应用潜力。

title: Room Scene Discovery and Grouping in Unstructured Vacation Rental Image Collections
comments: Presented at the Two-sided Marketplace Optimization Workshop, KDD 2025
summary: The rapid growth of vacation rental (VR) platforms has led to an increasing volume of property images, often uploaded without structured categorization. This lack of organization poses significant challenges for travelers attempting to understand the spatial layout of a property, particularly when multiple rooms of the same type are present. To address this issue, we introduce an effective approach for solving the room scene discovery and grouping problem, as well as identifying bed types within each bedroom group. This grouping is valuable for travelers to comprehend the spatial organization, layout, and the sleeping configuration of the property. We propose a computationally efficient machine learning pipeline characterized by low latency and the ability to perform effectively with sample-efficient learning, making it well-suited for real-time and data-scarce environments. The pipeline integrates a supervised room-type detection model, a supervised overlap detection model to identify the overlap similarity between two images, and a clustering algorithm to group the images of the same space together using the similarity scores. Additionally, the pipeline maps each bedroom group to the corresponding bed types specified in the property's metadata, based on the visual content present in the group's images using a Multi-modal Large Language Model (MLLM) model. We evaluate the aforementioned models individually and also assess the pipeline in its entirety, observing strong performance that significantly outperforms established approaches such as contrastive learning and clustering with pretrained embeddings.
comment: Presented at the Two-sided Marketplace Optimization Workshop, KDD 2025

AI.title_translation: 假期租赁非结构化图像集合中的房间场景发现与分组
AI.tldr: 针对假期租赁平台中非结构化房屋图片，提出一种机器学习流程，用于发现和分组房间场景，并识别卧室中的床型，以帮助旅行者理解房屋布局和睡眠配置。
AI.motivation: 假期租赁平台图片缺乏结构化分类，导致旅行者难以理解房产的空间布局，尤其是在存在多个相同类型房间时。
AI.method: 提出一个计算高效的机器学习流程，具有低延迟和样本高效学习的特点。该流程包含：监督式房间类型检测模型、监督式重叠检测模型（识别两张图片间的重叠相似性）、聚类算法（使用相似性分数将同一空间的图片分组），以及多模态大语言模型（MLLM）根据视觉内容和元数据将每个卧室组映射到对应的床型。
AI.result: 提出的模型在单独评估和整个流程评估中都表现出强大的性能，显著优于对比学习和使用预训练嵌入的聚类等现有方法。
AI.translation: 度假租赁（VR）平台的快速增长导致房产图片数量不断增加，这些图片通常未经结构化分类就上传。这种缺乏组织性给旅行者理解房产的空间布局带来了巨大挑战，尤其是在存在多个相同类型房间的情况下。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种有效的方法来解决房间场景发现和分组问题，并识别每个卧室组中的床型。这种分组对于旅行者理解房产的空间组织、布局和睡眠配置非常有价值。我们提出了一种计算高效的机器学习流程，其特点是低延迟和能够通过样本高效学习有效执行，使其非常适合实时和数据稀缺的环境。该流程集成了一个监督式房间类型检测模型、一个监督式重叠检测模型来识别两张图片之间的重叠相似性，以及一个聚类算法，利用相似性分数将同一空间的图片分组。此外，该流程还利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM），根据组内图片的视觉内容，将每个卧室组映射到房产元数据中指定的相应床型。我们单独评估了上述模型，并对整个流程进行了评估，观察到强大的性能，显著优于对比学习和使用预训练嵌入的聚类等现有方法。
AI.summary: 这篇论文提出了一种针对假期租赁平台非结构化图片集的机器学习流程，旨在解决房间场景发现、分组以及卧室床型识别问题。该流程结合了监督式房间类型检测、重叠检测和聚类算法，并利用多模态大语言模型匹配床型。实验结果表明，该方法在理解房产空间布局和睡眠配置方面表现出色，并优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: 假期租赁, 房间场景发现, 图像分组, 床型识别, 机器学习流程
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个端到端的机器学习流程，有效解决了假期租赁平台图片非结构化带来的挑战。其结合监督学习、聚类和多模态大语言模型的综合方法，在实时和数据稀缺环境下具有实用价值。该方法对于提升用户体验和房产信息呈现具有重要意义。

title: Robust 3D-Masked Part-level Editing in 3D Gaussian Splatting with Regularized Score Distillation Sampling
summary: Recent advances in 3D neural representations and instance-level editing models have enabled the efficient creation of high-quality 3D content. However, achieving precise local 3D edits remains challenging, especially for Gaussian Splatting, due to inconsistent multi-view 2D part segmentations and inherently ambiguous nature of Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) loss. To address these limitations, we propose RoMaP, a novel local 3D Gaussian editing framework that enables precise and drastic part-level modifications. First, we introduce a robust 3D mask generation module with our 3D-Geometry Aware Label Prediction (3D-GALP), which uses spherical harmonics (SH) coefficients to model view-dependent label variations and soft-label property, yielding accurate and consistent part segmentations across viewpoints. Second, we propose a regularized SDS loss that combines the standard SDS loss with additional regularizers. In particular, an L1 anchor loss is introduced via our Scheduled Latent Mixing and Part (SLaMP) editing method, which generates high-quality part-edited 2D images and confines modifications only to the target region while preserving contextual coherence. Additional regularizers, such as Gaussian prior removal, further improve flexibility by allowing changes beyond the existing context, and robust 3D masking prevents unintended edits. Experimental results demonstrate that our RoMaP achieves state-of-the-art local 3D editing on both reconstructed and generated Gaussian scenes and objects qualitatively and quantitatively, making it possible for more robust and flexible part-level 3D Gaussian editing. Code is available at https://janeyeon.github.io/romap.

AI.title_translation: 基于正则化分数蒸馏采样，在3D高斯泼溅中实现鲁棒的3D掩码部分级编辑
AI.tldr: RoMaP提出了一种新的局部3D高斯编辑框架，通过鲁棒的3D掩码生成和正则化的SDS损失，实现了精确和彻底的部分级修改，解决了3D高斯泼溅中局部编辑的挑战。
AI.motivation: 在3D高斯泼溅中实现精确的局部3D编辑仍然具有挑战性，原因在于多视角2D部分分割不一致以及分数蒸馏采样（SDS）损失固有的模糊性。
AI.method: 本文提出了RoMaP，一个新颖的局部3D高斯编辑框架。首先，引入了一个鲁棒的3D掩码生成模块，其中包含3D几何感知标签预测（3D-GALP），利用球谐（SH）系数建模视点依赖的标签变化和软标签特性，以实现跨视点的准确一致部分分割。其次，提出了正则化SDS损失，结合了标准SDS损失和额外的正则化器，特别是通过计划潜空间混合和部分（SLaMP）编辑方法引入L1锚点损失，生成高质量的部分编辑2D图像并限制修改在目标区域。此外，高斯先验移除等正则化器增强了灵活性，鲁棒的3D掩码防止了意外编辑。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，RoMaP在重建和生成的高斯场景和物体上，定性和定量地实现了最先进的局部3D编辑。
AI.conclusion: RoMaP使得更鲁棒和灵活的部分级3D高斯编辑成为可能。
AI.translation: 最近3D神经表示和实例级编辑模型的进展使得高效创建高质量3D内容成为可能。然而，实现精确的局部3D编辑仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于高斯泼溅，这主要是由于多视角2D部分分割的不一致性以及分数蒸馏采样（SDS）损失固有的模糊性。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了RoMaP，一个新颖的局部3D高斯编辑框架，能够实现精确和彻底的部分级修改。首先，我们引入了一个鲁棒的3D掩码生成模块，其中包含我们的3D几何感知标签预测（3D-GALP），它使用球谐（SH）系数来建模视点依赖的标签变化和软标签特性，从而在不同视点下产生准确且一致的部分分割。其次，我们提出了一种正则化SDS损失，它将标准SDS损失与额外的正则化器结合起来。特别是，通过我们的计划潜空间混合和部分（SLaMP）编辑方法引入了L1锚点损失，它生成高质量的部分编辑2D图像并将修改仅限制在目标区域，同时保持上下文连贯性。额外的正则化器，例如高斯先验移除，通过允许超出现有上下文的变化进一步提高了灵活性，而鲁棒的3D掩码则防止了意外编辑。实验结果表明，我们的RoMaP在重建和生成的高斯场景和物体上，定性和定量地实现了最先进的局部3D编辑，使得更鲁棒和灵活的部分级3D高斯编辑成为可能。代码可在https://janeyeon.github.io/romap获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RoMaP，一个用于3D高斯泼溅中精确局部3D编辑的新框架。针对现有方法在多视角一致性差和SDS损失模糊性方面的挑战，RoMaP引入了3D几何感知标签预测（3D-GALP）以生成鲁棒的3D掩码，确保跨视点一致的部分分割。此外，它设计了一种正则化SDS损失，结合L1锚点损失（通过SLaMP实现）和高斯先验移除，以实现高质量、区域受限且灵活的编辑。实验证明RoMaP在局部3D编辑方面达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 3D高斯泼溅, 局部编辑, 3D掩码, 分数蒸馏采样, RoMaP
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于结合了鲁棒的3D掩码生成（3D-GALP）和改进的正则化SDS损失，解决了3D高斯泼溅中局部编辑的关键挑战。特别是通过引入L1锚点损失和高斯先验移除，极大地提升了编辑的精确性、灵活性和上下文一致性，对于3D内容创作具有重要意义。

title: LLM-Aided Joint Secrecy Precoding and Trajectory for RSMA-Based Heterogeneous UAV Networks
summary: This paper investigates secure communications in rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) enabled heterogeneous UAV networks, where multiple UAVs collaboratively serve ground terminals in the presence of eavesdroppers. By jointly considering secrecy rate maximization and propulsion energy consumption minimization, we formulate a multi-objective optimization problem involving UAV trajectory design, service association, power allocation, and secrecy precoding under mobility, collision-avoidance, service-capacity, and communication constraints. The formulated problem is highly non-convex due to the coupling among UAV trajectories, RSMA transmission variables, and secrecy constraints. To address the resulting non-convex and highly coupled optimization problem, we propose a hierarchical optimization framework. The inner layer uses a semidefinite relaxation (SDR)-based S2DC algorithm combining penalty functions and difference-of-convex (D.C.) programming to solve the secrecy precoding problem with fixed UAV positions. The outer layer introduces a Large Language Model (LLM)-guided heuristic multi-agent reinforcement learning approach (LLM-HeMARL) for trajectory optimization. LLM-HeMARL efficiently incorporates LLM-generated expert heuristic policy, enabling UAVs to learn energy-aware, security-driven trajectories without the inference overhead of real-time LLM calls. The simulation results show that our method outperforms existing baselines in secrecy rate and energy efficiency, with consistent robustness across varying UAV swarm sizes and random seeds.

AI.title_translation: 基于LLM辅助的RSMA异构UAV网络联合保密预编码与轨迹优化
AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种结合LLM的强化学习方法，用于优化RSMA异构UAV网络的保密预编码和轨迹，以最大化保密速率并最小化能耗，仿真结果优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在RSMA异构UAV网络中，需要解决安全通信问题，即在考虑窃听者存在的情况下，最大化保密速率并最小化无人机推进能耗。
AI.method: 提出了一种分层优化框架：内层使用基于SDR的S2DC算法解决保密预编码问题；外层使用LLM引导的启发式多智能体强化学习方法（LLM-HeMARL）进行轨迹优化。
AI.result: 所提出的LLM-HeMARL方法在保密速率和能效方面优于现有基线方法，并且在不同无人机数量和随机种子下表现出一致的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的LLM-HeMARL方法能够有效地解决RSMA异构UAV网络中的联合保密预编码和轨迹优化问题，实现了保密速率最大化和能耗最小化。
AI.translation: 本论文研究了在存在窃听者的情况下，速率分裂多址（RSMA）赋能的异构无人机（UAV）网络中的安全通信问题，其中多个无人机协同为地面终端提供服务。通过联合考虑保密速率最大化和推进能耗最小化，我们构建了一个多目标优化问题，该问题涉及无人机轨迹设计、服务关联、功率分配和保密预编码，同时受到移动性、碰撞避免、服务容量和通信约束。由于无人机轨迹、RSMA传输变量和保密约束之间的耦合，所提出的问题具有高度非凸性。为了解决由此产生的非凸性和高度耦合的优化问题，我们提出了一种分层优化框架。内层使用基于半定松弛（SDR）的S2DC算法，结合惩罚函数和凸差（D.C.）规划，来解决固定无人机位置的保密预编码问题。外层引入了一种大型语言模型（LLM）引导的启发式多智能体强化学习方法（LLM-HeMARL）进行轨迹优化。LLM-HeMARL能够有效地整合LLM生成的专家启发式策略，使无人机能够在没有实时LLM调用推理开销的情况下学习具有能量感知和安全驱动的轨迹。仿真结果表明，我们的方法在保密速率和能效方面优于现有基线方法，并且在不同无人机群大小和随机种子下表现出一致的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的LLM辅助分层优化框架，用于解决RSMA异构UAV网络中的联合保密预编码和轨迹优化问题。该框架结合了SDR-S2DC算法和LLM引导的多智能体强化学习（LLM-HeMARL），旨在同时最大化保密速率并最小化能耗。仿真结果证明了该方法在提高网络性能和鲁棒性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: RSMA, 异构UAV网络, 保密预编码, 轨迹优化, LLM, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将LLM的能力融入到无人机网络优化中，提出了一种有效的LLM-HeMARL框架，解决了复杂的非凸优化问题。LLM在其中扮演了提供先验知识的角色，指导强化学习代理进行高效学习，从而在不增加实时计算负担的情况下优化了无人机轨迹和保密预编码。这种方法在提升网络安全性和能效方面显示出巨大潜力，尤其是在大规模异构无人机网络场景下。未来的工作可以进一步探索LLM在更广泛的无人机通信场景中的应用，以及优化LLM与强化学习的集成方式。

title: Hierarchical Message-Passing Policies for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Decentralized Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) methods allow for learning scalable multi-agent policies, but suffer from partial observability and induced non-stationarity. These challenges can be addressed by introducing mechanisms that facilitate coordination and high-level planning. Specifically, coordination and temporal abstraction can be achieved through communication (e.g., message passing) and Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) approaches to decision-making. However, optimization issues limit the applicability of hierarchical policies to multi-agent systems. As such, the combination of these approaches has not been fully explored. To fill this void, we propose a novel and effective methodology for learning multi-agent hierarchies of message-passing policies. We adopt the feudal HRL framework and rely on a hierarchical graph structure for planning and coordination among agents. Agents at lower levels in the hierarchy receive goals from the upper levels and exchange messages with neighboring agents at the same level. To learn hierarchical multi-agent policies, we design a novel reward-assignment method based on training the lower-level policies to maximize the advantage function associated with the upper levels. Results on relevant benchmarks show that our method performs favorably compared to the state of the art.

AI.title_translation: 多智能体强化学习中的分层消息传递策略
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的分层消息传递策略，用于解决分散式多智能体强化学习（MARL）中的部分可观测性和非平稳性挑战。该方法结合了封建分层强化学习框架、分层图结构和新颖的奖励分配机制，在相关基准测试中表现优于现有技术。
AI.motivation: 分散式多智能体强化学习（MARL）方法虽然能够学习可扩展的多智能体策略，但受限于部分可观测性和由此导致的非平稳性。虽然通过通信（如消息传递）和分层强化学习（HRL）可以解决协调和时间抽象问题，但优化问题限制了分层策略在多智能体系统中的应用，导致这些方法的结合尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种学习多智能体分层消息传递策略的新颖有效方法。该方法采用封建分层强化学习（HRL）框架，并依赖于分层图结构进行智能体之间的规划和协调。层次结构中较低层的智能体接收来自上层的目标，并与同级别的相邻智能体交换消息。为了学习分层多智能体策略，设计了一种新颖的奖励分配方法，该方法基于训练较低层策略以最大化与上层相关的优势函数。
AI.result: 在相关基准测试中的结果表明，本文提出的方法与现有技术相比表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的多智能体分层消息传递策略能够有效解决分散式多智能体强化学习中的协调和规划挑战，并在性能上超越了现有技术。
AI.translation: 分散式多智能体强化学习（MARL）方法能够学习可扩展的多智能体策略，但受限于部分可观测性和由此导致的非平稳性。这些挑战可以通过引入促进协调和高层规划的机制来解决。具体而言，协调和时间抽象可以通过通信（例如消息传递）和分层强化学习（HRL）决策方法实现。然而，优化问题限制了分层策略在多智能体系统中的适用性。因此，这些方法的结合尚未被充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新颖有效的方法，用于学习多智能体分层消息传递策略。我们采用封建HRL框架，并依赖于分层图结构进行智能体之间的规划和协调。层次结构中较低层的智能体接收来自上层的目标，并与同级别的相邻智能体交换消息。为了学习分层多智能体策略，我们设计了一种新颖的奖励分配方法，该方法基于训练较低层策略以最大化与上层相关的优势函数。在相关基准测试中的结果表明，我们的方法与现有技术相比表现出色。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的分层消息传递策略，旨在解决分散式多智能体强化学习（MARL）中的部分可观测性和非平稳性问题。该方法将封建分层强化学习（HRL）框架与分层图结构相结合，用于智能体间的规划和协调。通过设计一种新颖的奖励分配机制，使下层策略最大化上层优势函数，实现了多智能体分层策略的学习。实验结果表明，该方法在相关基准测试中优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: 多智能体强化学习, 分层强化学习, 消息传递, 分散式MARL, 协调
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将分层强化学习（特别是封建HRL框架）与多智能体消息传递机制有效结合，并提出了新颖的奖励分配方法。这为解决分散式MARL中长期存在的协调和规划挑战提供了一个有前景的解决方案，对提高多智能体系统的可扩展性和性能具有重要意义。

title: Disentangling Reasoning Logic to Resolve Explicit Knowledge Conflicts
summary: Explicit knowledge conflicts, occurring when retrieved contexts contain contradictory information, pose a fundamental challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) as they integrate increasingly diverse data sources. The core difficulty lies in the complexity of entangled narratives and heterogeneous conflict patterns, which frequently exceeds the reasoning capacity of standard backbone architectures. We propose \textbf{\textsc{Kcr}} (Knowledge Conflict Reasoning), a framework that adjudicates contradictions by systematically structuring their underlying logic. \textsc{Kcr} disentangles conflicting contexts into discrete sets of reasoning traces, utilizing a hybrid representation of text and graphs to facilitate systematic comprehension. It then employs a Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) paradigm to instill a reasoning policy that maximizes logical consistency while suppressing spurious paths derived from contradictory evidence. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that \textsc{Kcr} yields substantial performance gains. Notably, a 7B model enhanced by \textsc{Kcr} achieves adjudication capabilities that significantly outperform leading proprietary models, including GPT-4o and GPT-5.1, on complex tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/zhengxianda/KCR.

AI.title_translation: 解耦推理逻辑以解决显式知识冲突
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为 KCR 的新框架，通过解耦推理逻辑和使用强化学习来解决大型语言模型中的显式知识冲突问题，并在多项复杂任务上取得了优于现有模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在整合日益多样化的数据源时，会面临检索到的上下文包含矛盾信息（即显式知识冲突）的挑战，而标准的模型架构往往难以处理这种复杂的叙事和异构的冲突模式。
AI.method: KCR框架通过将冲突的上下文分解为离散的推理轨迹集，并结合文本和图的混合表示来促进理解。然后，它采用带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）范式来训练一个推理策略，以最大化逻辑一致性并抑制由矛盾证据产生的虚假路径。
AI.result: KCR框架在解决显式知识冲突方面取得了显著的性能提升。特别是，一个集成了KCR的7B模型在复杂任务上的裁决能力显著优于包括GPT-4o和GPT-5.1在内的领先的专有模型。
AI.conclusion: KCR框架通过系统地构建底层逻辑，能够有效地化解显式知识冲突，并在复杂任务上展现出超越现有先进模型的性能。
AI.translation: 显式知识冲突，当检索到的上下文包含矛盾信息时发生，对大型语言模型（LLMs）提出了根本性挑战，因为它们整合了日益多样化的数据源。核心困难在于纠缠的叙事和异构的冲突模式的复杂性，这常常超出标准骨干架构的推理能力。我们提出了 KCR（知识冲突推理）框架，该框架通过系统地构建其底层逻辑来裁决矛盾。 KCR 将冲突的上下文分解为离散的推理轨迹集，利用文本和图的混合表示来促进系统性的理解。然后，它采用带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）范式来灌输一个推理策略，该策略最大化逻辑一致性，同时抑制由矛盾证据产生的虚假路径。广泛的评估表明，KCR 产生了显著的性能提升。值得注意的是，一个由 KCR 增强的 7B 模型在复杂任务上实现了显著优于包括 GPT-4o 和 GPT-5.1 在内的领先专有模型的裁决能力。代码可在 https://github.com/zhengxianda/KCR 获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为 KCR（知识冲突推理）的新框架，旨在解决大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理包含矛盾信息（显式知识冲突）的检索上下文时面临的挑战。KCR 通过将冲突的上下文分解为离散的推理轨迹，并结合文本和图的混合表示来理解和结构化冲突的逻辑。该框架利用带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来训练一个能够最大化逻辑一致性的推理策略。实验结果表明，KCR 显著提高了 LLMs 的性能，并且集成了 KCR 的 7B 模型在复杂任务上的表现优于 GPT-4o 和 GPT-5.1 等领先模型。
AI.keywords: 知识冲突,推理逻辑,大型语言模型,强化学习,可验证奖励
AI.comments: 该研究提出的 KCR 框架在解决 LLMs 中的显式知识冲突问题上具有创新性，通过解耦推理逻辑和利用 RLVR 来提高模型的判断能力。其在复杂任务上超越领先模型的性能表明了该方法的有效性。然而，对于该方法在不同类型和规模的知识冲突上的泛化能力以及计算成本等方面的进一步研究将是重要的。

title: The Bidirectional Process Reward Model
summary: Process Reward Models (PRMs), which assign fine-grained scores to intermediate reasoning steps within a solution trajectory, have emerged as a promising approach to enhance the reasoning quality of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, most existing PRMs rely on a unidirectional left-to-right (L2R) evaluation scheme, which restricts their utilization of global context. In light of this challenge, we propose a novel bidirectional evaluation paradigm, named Bidirectional Process Reward Model (BiPRM). BiPRM incorporates a parallel right-to-left (R2L) evaluation stream, implemented via prompt reversal, alongside the conventional L2R flow. Then a gating mechanism is introduced to adaptively fuse the reward scores from both streams to yield a holistic quality assessment. Remarkably, compared to the original PRM, BiPRM introduces only a 0.3% parameter increase for the gating module, and the parallel execution of two streams incurs merely 5% inference time latency. Our extensive empirical evaluations spanning diverse benchmarks, LLM backbones, PRM objectives and sampling policies demonstrate that BiPRM consistently surpasses unidirectional baselines, achieving an average relative gain of 10.6% over 54 solution-level configurations and 37.7% in 12 step-level error detection scenarios. Generally, our results highlight the effectiveness, robustness and general applicability of BiPRM, offering a promising new direction for process-based reward modeling.

AI.tldr: BiPRM通过引入双向（从左到右及从右到左）评估流和自适应门控机制，以极小的开销显著提升了LLM推理步骤的质量评估准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的过程奖励模型（PRM）多采用单向评估，限制了对全局上下文的利用，从而影响了推理质量的评估效果。
AI.method: 提出双向过程奖励模型（BiPRM），包含传统的从左到右（L2R）评估流和通过提示反转实现的从右到左（R2L）评估流，并引入门控机制自适应融合两者的奖励分数。
AI.result: BiPRM在各种基准测试中表现优于单向基线，在54种解决方案配置中平均提升10.6%，在12种步骤级错误检测场景中提升37.7%，且仅增加了0.3%的参数量和5%的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: BiPRM通过结合双向评估流和自适应门控机制，有效提升了LLM推理过程的评估准确性，为过程奖励建模提供了一个高效且鲁棒的新范式。
AI.translation: 过程奖励模型（PRMs）通过为解决方案轨迹中的中间推理步骤分配细粒度分数，已成为提高大语言模型（LLMs）推理质量的一种有前景的方法。然而，大多数现有的PRMs依赖于单向（L2R）评估方案，这限制了它们对全局上下文的利用。针对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新的双向评估范式，称为双向过程奖励模型（BiPRM）。BiPRM在传统的L2R流程之外，结合了一个通过提示反转实现的并行从右到左（R2L）评估流。随后引入了一种门控机制，自适应地融合来自两个流的奖励分数，以产生整体的质量评估。值得注意的是，与原始PRM相比，BiPRM仅为门控模块增加了0.3%的参数，且两个流的并行执行仅导致5%的推理时间延迟。我们在各种基准测试、LLM骨干、PRM目标和采样策略上的广泛实证评估表明，BiPRM始终优于单向基线，在54种解决方案级配置中实现了10.6%的平均相对增益，在12种步骤级错误检测场景中实现了37.7%的增益。总的来说，我们的结果突显了BiPRM的有效性、鲁棒性和通用性，为基于过程的奖励建模提供了一个有前景的新方向。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BiPRM，一种通过引入反向评估流和自适应门控机制来增强LLM推理评估的新型过程奖励模型，在保持极低额外开销的同时，显著提升了模型在复杂推理任务中的表现。
AI.keywords: 过程奖励模型, 大语言模型, 双向评估, 推理质量, 门控机制
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的双向过程奖励模型（BiPRM），通过引入反向评估流弥补了传统单向PRM缺乏全局上下文的缺陷。其最大的亮点在于以极小的参数开销（0.3%）和推理延迟（5%）实现了显著的性能提升，具有很强的实用价值和通用性。

title: Registering the 4D Millimeter Wave Radar Point Clouds Via Generalized Method of Moments
summary: 4D millimeter wave radars (4D radars) are new emerging sensors that provide point clouds of objects with both position and radial velocity measurements. Compared to LiDARs, they are more affordable and reliable sensors for robots' perception under extreme weather conditions. On the other hand, point cloud registration is an essential perception module that provides robot's pose feedback information in applications such as Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). Nevertheless, the 4D radar point clouds are sparse and noisy compared to those of LiDAR, and hence we shall confront great challenges in registering the radar point clouds. To address this issue, we propose a point cloud registration framework for 4D radars based on Generalized Method of Moments. The method does not require explicit point-to-point correspondences between the source and target point clouds, which is difficult to compute for sparse 4D radar point clouds. Moreover, we show the consistency of the proposed method. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets show that our approach achieves higher accuracy and robustness than benchmarks, and the accuracy is even comparable to LiDAR-based frameworks.

AI.title_translation: 基于广义矩估计的4D毫米波雷达点云配准
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需显式点对点匹配的广义矩估计框架，有效解决了4D毫米波雷达稀疏点云的配准难题，性能媲美激光雷达。
AI.motivation: 4D毫米波雷达在恶劣天气下比激光雷达更具性价比和可靠性，但其点云稀疏且含噪的特性使得传统的点云配准方法难以应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于广义矩估计（Generalized Method of Moments）的配准框架，该方法无需计算源点云和目标点云之间的显式点对点对应关系。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比基准算法具有更高的精度和鲁棒性，甚至达到了与激光雷达框架相当的精度。
AI.conclusion: 基于广义矩估计的配准框架能够有效处理4D毫米波雷达稀疏且含噪的点云，在无需显式点对点对应的情况下实现高精度和鲁棒的位姿估计。
AI.translation: 4D毫米波雷达（4D雷达）是一种新兴传感器，能够提供包含位置和径向速度测量的物体点云。与激光雷达相比，它们在极端天气条件下是更经济、更可靠的机器人感知传感器。另一方面，点云配准是为机器人提供位姿反馈信息（如在同步定位与建图SLAM中）的重要感知模块。然而，与激光雷达相比，4D雷达点云稀疏且含噪，因此在配准雷达点云时面临巨大挑战。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于广义矩估计的4D雷达点云配准框架。该方法不需要源点云和目标点云之间的显式点对点对应关系，而这对于稀疏的4D雷达点云来说很难计算。此外，我们证明了所提方法的一致性。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法比基准算法实现了更高的精度和鲁棒性，其精度甚至可与基于激光雷达的框架相媲美。
AI.summary: 针对4D毫米波雷达点云稀疏、噪声大的特点，本文提出了一种基于广义矩估计的配准框架。该方法通过规避显式点对点匹配，实现了稳健的位姿估计，并在实验中展现出优于现有基准且媲美激光雷达的性能。
AI.keywords: 4D毫米波雷达, 点云配准, 广义矩估计, SLAM, 传感器融合
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的基于广义矩估计的方法来解决4D毫米波雷达点云配准问题，巧妙地避开了传统方法中难以处理的稀疏点云对应关系计算。其重要性在于提升了雷达在恶劣天气下作为低成本、高可靠性传感器在SLAM等应用中的感知能力，且实验证明其精度可媲美激光雷达。

title: Talking Surveys: How Photorealistic Embodied Conversational Agents Shape Response Quality, Engagement, and Satisfaction
summary: Embodied conversational agents (ECAs) are increasingly more realistic and capable of dynamic conversations. In online surveys, anthropomorphic agents could help address issues like careless responding and satisficing, which originate from the lack of personal engagement and perceived accountability. However, there is a lack of understanding of how ECAs in user experience research may affect participant engagement, satisfaction, and the quality of responses. As a proof of concept, we propose an instrument that enables the incorporation of conversations with a virtual avatar into surveys, using on AI-driven video generation, speech recognition, and Large Language Models. In our between-subjects study, 80 participants (UK, stratified random sample of general population) either talked to a voice-based agent with an animated video avatar, or interacted with a chatbot. Across surveys based on two self-reported psychometric tests, 2,265 conversation responses were obtained. Statistical comparison of results indicates that embodied agents can contribute significantly to more informative, detailed responses, as well as higher yet more time-efficient engagement. Furthermore, qualitative analysis provides valuable insights for causes of no significant change to satisfaction, linked to personal preferences, turn-taking delays and Uncanny Valley reactions. These findings support the pursuit and development of new methods toward human-like agents for the transformation of online surveys into more natural interactions resembling in-person interviews.

title: PRECISE: Private Regulatory Compliance for Cyberattack Detection on Critical Infrastructure Systems
summary: Industrial control systems are a fundamental component of critical infrastructure networks (CIN) such as gas, water, and power. With the growing risk of cyberattacks, regulatory compliance requirements are also increasing for large scale critical infrastructure systems comprising multiple utility stakeholders. The primary goal of regulators is to ensure overall system stability with recourse to trustworthy stakeholder attack detection. However, adhering to compliance requirements requires stakeholders to also disclose sensor and control data to regulators, raising privacy concerns. In this paper, we present a cyberattack detection framework PRECISE, that utilizes differentially private (DP) hypothesis tests geared towards enhancing regulatory confidence while alleviating privacy concerns of CIN stakeholders. The hallmark of our approach is a two phase privacy scheme applying Laplacian DP to covariance matrix disclosures and Gaussian Differential Privacy (GDP) to state-space residuals derived from a Non-Linear Kalman Filter LSTM model. We formally characterize the GDP-induced test statistic via the non-central chi-squared distribution and derive tight bounds on misclassification rates and equivalent DP levels of significance. Theoretically, we show that our method induces a misclassification error rate comparable to the non-DP cases while delivering robust privacy guarantees. Using real-world HAI and ORNL-PS datasets, we demonstrate that under strong differential privacy guarantees on both covariance and residual disclosures, PRECISE matches non-DP detection outcomes in over 88% of cases within 600 seconds of attack onset for the HAI dataset and over 92% for the ORNL-PS dataset, while maintaining false alarm rates below 9% across all tested DP parameter configurations.

title: VGGSounder: Audio-Visual Evaluations for Foundation Models
comments: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) 2025
summary: The emergence of audio-visual foundation models underscores the importance of reliably assessing their multi-modal understanding. The VGGSound dataset is commonly used as a benchmark for evaluation audio-visual classification. However, our analysis identifies several limitations of VGGSound, including incomplete labelling, partially overlapping classes, and misaligned modalities. These lead to distorted evaluations of auditory and visual capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce VGGSounder, a comprehensively re-annotated, multi-label test set that extends VGGSound and is specifically designed to evaluate audio-visual foundation models. VGGSounder features detailed modality annotations, enabling precise analyses of modality-specific performance. Furthermore, we reveal model limitations by analysing performance degradation when adding another input modality with our new modality confusion metric.
comment: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) 2025

title: Physics-Constrained Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching Models for Generation and Inverse Problems
summary: We present a framework for fine-tuning flow-matching generative models to enforce physical constraints and solve inverse problems in scientific systems. Starting from a model trained on low-fidelity or observational data, we apply a differentiable post-training procedure that minimizes weak-form residuals of governing partial differential equations (PDEs), promoting physical consistency and adherence to boundary conditions without distorting the underlying learned distribution. To infer unknown physical inputs, such as source terms, material parameters, or boundary data, we augment the generative process with a learnable latent parameter predictor and propose a joint optimization strategy. The resulting model produces physically valid field solutions alongside plausible estimates of hidden parameters, effectively addressing ill-posed inverse problems in a data-driven yet physicsaware manner. We validate our method on canonical PDE benchmarks, demonstrating improved satisfaction of PDE constraints and accurate recovery of latent coefficients. Our approach bridges generative modelling and scientific inference, opening new avenues for simulation-augmented discovery and data-efficient modelling of physical systems.

title: Dataset Construction for Training LLM to Learn Analog Circuit Knowledge
summary: This paper constructs a textual dataset for training large language models (LLMs) to learn analog circuit knowledge and customizes LLM training techniques. For dataset construction, high-quality textbooks are collected and decomposed into fine-grained learning nodes, which are then used to construct structured question-thinking-solution-answer (QTSA) quadruples using a multi-agent framework to capture both final answers and thought processes. The resulting dataset consists of 7.26M tokens of unlabeled data for continual pre-training (CPT) and 112.65M tokens of labeled data for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We customize the training techniques including initial model selection, training paradigms, regularization techniques, and practical implementation references. Instruct models are identified as suitable training initialization points, an SFT-centric training paradigm is established (finding that CPT provides marginal benefits compared with SFT due to imbalanced data distribution), and SFT with KL divergence regularization can achieve a 2.71 percentage-point improvement over SFT alone. A practical training implementation method is provided for resource-constrained scenarios. Experiments demonstrate that the dataset and training techniques enhance LLMs' analog circuit knowledge. The trained 32B instruct model achieves 84.59% accuracy on the AMSBench-TQA benchmark, showing a 15.67 percentage-point improvement over the initial model. The trained model also shows capability in the operational amplifier design task based on the Atelier framework.

title: L-SR1: Learned Symmetric-Rank-One Preconditioning
comments: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Project page: https://gallif.github.io/lsr1/
summary: End-to-end deep learning has achieved impressive results but often relies on large labeled datasets, exhibits limited generalization to unseen scenarios, and incurs substantial computational cost. Classical optimization methods, in contrast, are more data-efficient and lightweight but frequently suffer from slow convergence. Learned optimizers aim to bridge this gap, yet existing approaches have focused primarily on first-order methods, while learned second-order optimization has received much less attention. We introduce L-SR1, a learned second-order optimizer inspired by the classical Symmetric Rank-One (SR1) method. At its core, L-SR1 employs a Projection-Guided Secant Mechanism (PGSM) that generates positive semi-definite preconditioners and biases meta-training toward the quasi-Newton secant relation. Through controlled analytic benchmarks, we study stability, generalization across problem dimensions, and search direction quality, and further evaluate L-SR1 on Monocular Human Mesh Recovery (HMR), where it outperforms both classical and learned optimization-based baselines. With a compact model and no reliance on task-specific fine-tuning or annotated data, L-SR1 demonstrates strong generalization and can be integrated into a broad range of iterative optimization problems to accelerate convergence and reduce the required number of iterations.
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Project page: https://gallif.github.io/lsr1/

title: One Shot vs. Iterative: Rethinking Pruning Strategies for Model Compression
summary: Pruning is a core technique for compressing neural networks to improve computational efficiency. This process is typically approached in two ways: one-shot pruning, which involves a single pass of training and pruning, and iterative pruning, where pruning is performed over multiple cycles for potentially finer network refinement. Although iterative pruning has historically seen broader adoption, this preference is often assumed rather than rigorously tested. Our study presents one of the first systematic and comprehensive comparisons of these methods, providing rigorous definitions, benchmarking both across structured and unstructured settings, and applying different pruning criteria and modalities. We find that each method has specific advantages: one-shot pruning proves more effective at lower pruning ratios, while iterative pruning performs better at higher ratios. Building on these findings, we advocate for patience-based pruning and introduce a hybrid approach that can outperform traditional methods in certain scenarios, providing valuable insights for practitioners selecting a pruning strategy tailored to their goals and constraints. Source code is available at https://github.com/janumiko/pruning-benchmark.

title: The Digital Life of Parisian Parks: Multifunctionality and Urban Context Uncovered by Mobile Application Traffic
summary: Urban parks support public health, but landscape architecture typically examines them through form and function. Prior equitable access research focused on park form, while functional studies relied on small-scale surveys, movement data, or broad usage metrics, missing specific activities and visit motivations. This gap limits our grasp of parks' functional diversity. We address this with a novel method refining mobile base station coverage via antenna azimuths to isolate park-specific traffic from surroundings. Using Paris as a case study, we process 492 million hourly per-app mobile records (35% market share) from 45 urban parks. We test the central-city hypothesis (multifunctional parks in dense, high-rent zones due to land constraints) and socio-spatial hypothesis (parks reflecting neighborhood routines and preferences). Results reveal parks' unique mobile traffic signatures, distinct from urban contexts and each other. Clustering by temporal and app patterns identifies three types: lunchbreak, cultural, and recreational parks, linked to health-promoting visitation motives. Central parks show diverse apps and peak usage; suburban recreational parks mirror local demographics, like income-aligned app preferences. This demonstrates mobile traffic's power as a proxy for urban green space activities, with key implications for park design, public health, and well-being strategies.

title: Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem with Time Windows and Pickup-Delivery: integrating classical and quantum optimization
summary: We propose the Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem with Time Windows and Pickup and Delivery, an advanced and practical extension of classical routing models. This variant integrates the characteristics of the Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem with time-window constraints, pickup and delivery operations and vehicle capacity limitations. These features closely mirror the complexities of contemporary logistics challenges, including last-mile distribution, reverse logistics and on-demand service scenarios. To tackle the inherent computational difficulties of this NP-hard problem, we propose two specialized mathematical formulations: an arc-based model and a node-oriented model, each designed to capture distinct structural aspects of the problem. We further introduce a preprocessing reduction method that eliminates redundant arcs, significantly enhancing computational performance and scalability. We also introduce a benchmark instance generator designed to create diverse and scalable test scenarios, providing a flexible framework for assessing the performance and robustness of both classical and quantum optimization methods. Both formulations are implemented using classical and quantum optimization approaches. In particular, the classical models are solved with Gurobi, whereas the quantum implementation is carried out on D-Wave's LeapCQMHybrid platform, a hybrid quantum-classical environment that integrates quantum annealing with classical optimization techniques for constrained problem solving. Numerical experiments are conducted to validate the proposed formulations and the preprocessing reduction method. The analyses performed assess the structural properties of the two models, their computational behavior, and the impact of preprocessing on problem size and solution efficiency.

title: Multipole Semantic Attention: A Fast Approximation of Softmax Attention for Pretraining
summary: Pretraining transformers on long sequences (entire code repositories, collections of related documents) is bottlenecked by quadratic attention costs. We present Multipole Semantic Attention (MuSe), which accelerates 64k-context pretraining by 36% while matching baseline loss, requiring no architectural changes. MuSe clusters queries and keys separately in representation space. This yields query-specific summaries that substantially outperform spatial blocking at matched sparsity, while also enabling drop-in compatibility with existing pretrained models; we validate on Llama 3.1-8B and 3.2-1B without retraining. We pretrain language models up to 1B parameters at 64k context on code and scientific documents, confirming that MuSe preserves quality and long-context utilization during training.

title: Layout-Conditioned Autoregressive Text-to-Image Generation via Structured Masking
summary: Although autoregressive (AR) models have demonstrated remarkable success in image generation, extending these models to layout-conditioned generation remains challenging due to the sparse nature of layout conditions and the risk of feature entanglement. We present \textbf{S}tructured \textbf{M}asking for \textbf{AR}-based \textbf{L}ayout-to-\textbf{I}mage (SMARLI), a novel framework that effectively integrates spatial layout constraints into the AR generation process. To equip AR models with layout control, a structured masking strategy is applied to the attention computation to govern the interaction among the global prompt, layout, and image tokens. This design prevents the misassociation of different regions with their corresponding descriptions while enabling the sufficient injection of layout constraints into the generation process. To alleviate the exposure bias of AR models and further enhance generation quality and layout accuracy, we incorporate a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training scheme. We adapt it to the next-set-based paradigm and introduce a specifically designed layout reward, which is coordinated with an image quality reward to guide policy optimization in a balanced manner. Experimental results demonstrate that SMARLI seamlessly integrates layout tokens with text and image tokens without compromising generation quality, and the proposed masking strategy and post-training scheme can also be transferred to standard next-token-based AR models. The proposed framework achieves superior layout control while maintaining the structural simplicity and generation efficiency of AR models.

title: Good Vibrations? A Qualitative Study of Co-Creation, Communication, Flow, and Trust in Vibe Coding
summary: Vibe coding, a term coined by Andrej Karpathy in February 2025, has quickly become a compelling and controversial natural language programming paradigm in AI-assisted software development. Centered on iterative co-design with an AI assistant, vibe coding emphasizes flow and experimentation over strict upfront specification. While initial studies have begun to explore this paradigm, most focus on analyzing code artifacts or proposing theories with limited empirical backing. There remains a need for a grounded understanding of vibe coding as it is perceived and experienced by developers. We present the first systematic qualitative investigation of vibe coding perceptions and practice. Drawing on over 190,000 words from semi-structured interviews, Reddit threads, and LinkedIn posts, we characterize what vibe coding is, why and how developers use it, where it breaks down, and which emerging practices aim to support it. We propose a qualitatively grounded theory of vibe coding centered on conversational interaction with AI, co-creation, and developer flow and joy. We find that AI trust regulates movement along a continuum from delegation to co-creation and supports the developer experience by sustaining flow. We surface recurring pain points and risks in areas including specification, reliability, debugging, latency, code review burden, and collaboration. We also present best practices that have been discovered and shared to mitigate these challenges. We conclude with implications for the future of AI dev tools and directions for researchers investigating vibe coding.

title: Few to Big: Prototype Expansion Network via Diffusion Learner for Point Cloud Few-shot Semantic Segmentation
summary: Few-shot 3D point cloud semantic segmentation aims to segment novel categories using a minimal number of annotated support samples. However, prototypes derived from the limited non-structural point cloud support set are often misaligned and have a small capacity, hindering effective gen eralization to novel categories. This stems from two core issues: i) the prototype possess limited representational capacity fails to cover the full intra-class diversity of a novel category, and ii) the prototypes suffer from misalignment with the query space due to the inter-set inconsistency between support and query sets. To address these issues, our work focuses on leveraging the few support samples to construct a well-aligned big-capacity prototype. Motivated by the powerful generative capabilities of diffusion models, we re-purpose its pre-trained conditional encoder to provide rich feature components for prototype ex pansion. Subsequently, a push-pull force aligns this expanded prototype towards the query feature space. Under this setup, we introduce the Prototype Expansion Network (PENet), a framework that constructs aligned big-capacity prototypes from two complementary feature sources. Specifically, PENet employs a dual-stream learner architecture: it retains a conventional fully supervised Intrinsic Learner (IL) to distill representative features, while introducing a novel Diffusion Learner (DL) to provide rich generalizable features. The resulting dual prototypes are then processed by a Prototype Assimilation Module (PAM), which adopts a push-pull attention block to align the prototypes with the query space. Furthermore, a Prototype Calibration Mechanism (PCM) regularizes the final big-capacity prototype to prevent semantic drift. Extensive experiments on the S3DIS and ScanNet datasets demonstrate that PENet outperforms state-of-the-art methods across various few-shot settings.

title: A Scalable Whole-body Motion Transfer via Implicit Kinodynamic Motion Retargeting
summary: Human-to-humanoid imitation learning presents a promising pathway to address the severe data scarcity bottleneck in robotics by utilizing abundant, large-scale human motion collections. However, scaling this paradigm requires addressing two key challenges. First, human motion data acquired from videos, motion capture systems, or generative models often contains spatial noise, jitter, and frame-level flickering, which can be amplified during retargeting and lead to unsafe or physically infeasible robot motions. Second, existing motion retargeting methods typically rely on frame-by-frame numerical optimization, making them too computationally expensive for large-scale dataset synthesis. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Implicit Kinodynamic Motion Retargeting (IKMR), a highly scalable, neural-based data transformation pipeline. IKMR leverages a skeleton-based graph convolutional dual autoencoder to map cross-structural human and humanoid kinematic configurations into a shared topological latent space. To guarantee the physical viability of the generated data, the framework incorporates a physics-informed refinement phase that utilizes simulated physical tracking feedback to learn a robust motion prior. This implicit formulation fundamentally resolves both challenges. By shifting the computational burden from online optimization to offline inference, IKMR achieves an unprecedented data conversion throughput exceeding 5000 frames per second. Furthermore, leveraging the learned motion prior, it functions as an intrinsic data curation mechanism and naturally filters out high-frequency noise and spatial jitters from source data, yielding smooth trajectories that ensure physical hardware safety. Extensive evaluations, including real-world whole-body control deployments on humanoid robot, confirm that IKMR bridges the gap between human motion and robotic data.

title: GraphMend: Code Transformations for Fixing Graph Breaks in PyTorch 2
summary: This paper presents GraphMend, a compiler technique that automatically fixes FX graph breaks in PyTorch 2 programs. Although PyTorch 2 introduced TorchDynamo and TorchInductor to enable just-in-time graph compilation, certain code patterns still cause graph breaks that force execution to fall back to Python eager mode, introducing costly CPU-GPU synchronization and reducing optimization opportunities. Our investigation of 195 Hugging Face models reveals that 13.8% of models exhibit graph breaks. GraphMend automatically eliminates fixable breaks through source-level program analysis and transformations. It analyzes AST-level program structure to identify graph-break patterns and applies transformations only when their semantic preservation can be statically established. These transformations enable PyTorch to capture larger, uninterrupted FX graphs without manual refactoring by developers. We evaluate GraphMend on all 27 models found to exhibit graph breaks in our investigation. GraphMend eliminates 107 of 147 graph breaks (73%), fully fixing all breaks in 21 models. In our experiments on NVIDIA GPUs, GraphMend achieves up to 26x cold-start speedup, 5x on average, and up to 1.39x steady-state forward pass speedup. These results demonstrate that semantics-aware source-level analysis and transformation are effective complements to PyTorch's dynamic JIT compilation pipeline, substantially improving both usability and performance.

title: Graph Coloring for Multi-Task Learning
summary: When different objectives conflict with each other in multi-task learning, gradients begin to interfere and slow convergence, thereby potentially reducing the final model's performance. To address this, we introduce SON-GOKU, a scheduler that computes gradient interference, constructs an interference graph, and then applies greedy graph-coloring to partition tasks into groups that align well with each other. At each training step, only one group (color class) of tasks are activated, and the grouping partition is constantly recomputed as task relationships evolve throughout training. By ensuring that each mini-batch contains only tasks that pull the model in the same direction, our method improves the effectiveness of any underlying multi-task learning optimizer without additional tuning. Since tasks within these groups will update in compatible directions, multi-task learning will improve model performance rather than impede it. Empirical results on six different datasets show that this interference-aware graph-coloring approach consistently outperforms baselines and state-of-the-art multi-task optimizers. We provide extensive theory showing why grouping and sequential updates improve multi-task learning, with guarantees on descent, convergence, and the ability to accurately identify what tasks conflict or align.

title: SPFSplatV2: Efficient Self-Supervised Pose-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Views
summary: We introduce SPFSplatV2, an efficient feed-forward framework for 3D Gaussian splatting from sparse multi-view images, requiring no ground-truth poses during training or inference. The framework employs a shared feature extraction backbone to jointly predict 3D Gaussian primitives and camera poses in a canonical space from unposed inputs. To enable efficient and accurate pose estimation, we introduce a masked attention mechanism for target-view pose prediction and a reprojection loss that enforces pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives, providing stronger geometric constraints. We further demonstrate the compatibility of our training framework with different reconstruction architectures, resulting in two model variants. Remarkably, despite the absence of pose supervision, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-domain and out-of-domain novel view synthesis, even under extreme viewpoint changes and limited image overlap. It also surpasses many methods that rely on geometric supervision in relative pose estimation. By eliminating dependence on ground-truth poses, our method offers the scalability to leverage larger and more diverse datasets. Code and pretrained models will be available on our project page: https://ranrhuang.github.io/spfsplatv2/.

title: Interactive Semantic Segmentation for Phosphene Vision Neuroprosthetics
comments: Pending significant revision of the statistical analysis
summary: Visual impairments present significant challenges to individuals worldwide, impacting daily activities and quality of life. Visual neuroprosthetics offer a promising solution, leveraging advancements in technology to provide a simplified visual sense through devices comprising cameras, computers, and implanted electrodes. This study investigates user-centered design principles for a phosphene vision algorithm, utilizing feedback from visually impaired individuals to guide the development of a gaze-controlled semantic segmentation system. We conducted interviews revealing key design principles. These principles informed the implementation of a gaze-guided semantic segmentation algorithm using the Segment Anything Model (SAM). In a simulated phosphene vision environment, participants performed object detection tasks under SAM, edge detection, and normal vision conditions. SAM improved identification accuracy over edge detection, remained effective in complex scenes, and was particularly robust for specific object shapes. These findings demonstrate the value of user feedback and the potential of gaze-guided semantic segmentation to enhance neuroprosthetic vision.
