title: DeXposure-Claw: An Agentic System for DeFi Risk Supervision
summary: Decentralized finance exposes supervisors to fast-moving, networked credit risks. General-purpose LLM agents fit this setting poorly: they over-read weak evidence and recommend high-stakes interventions, while existing evaluations offer no regulator-aligned way to measure the resulting false alarms. We introduce DeXposure-Claw, a forecast-grounded agentic supervision system that routes LLM decisions through structured evidence: (1) DeXposure-FM, a graph time-series foundation model, forecasts future exposure networks; (2) deterministic monitors and stress scenarios then turn those forecasts into typed alerts, attribution signals, and scenario evidence; and (3) data-health and confidence gates constrain escalation before DeXposure-Claw emits auditable supervisory tickets with rationales. We further develop DeXposure-Bench, a six-axis evaluation harness, whose decision axis scores tickets against a regulator-aligned absolute-loss ground truth and an explicit false-intervention rate. Experiments on five years of weekly real data fully support our system. Code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/DeXposure-Claw.

title: PSCT-Net: Geometry-Aware Pediatric Skull CT Reconstruction via Differentiable Back-Projection and Attention-Guided Refinement
summary: Computed Tomography (CT) is essential for diagnosing pediatric craniofacial abnormalities, yet poses radiation risks to developing anatomies. Reconstructing 3D CT from sparse bi-planar X-rays offers a low-dose alternative but is severely ill-posed. Existing methods employ geometry-agnostic feature lifting, naively projecting 2D features into 3D without explicit spatial modeling, causing depth ambiguity and degraded osseous boundaries. We present PSCT-Net, a geometry-aware framework with differentiable back-projection. Differentiable back-projection establishes a spatially faithful volumetric prior, alleviating depth ambiguity. An Attention-Guided Projection (AGP-3D) module then learns non-linear voxel-wise correspondences between 2D regions and 3D locations. A Bidirectional Mamba (BiM-3D) module captures long-range volumetric dependencies with linear complexity. We further curate a private institutional pediatric skull CT cohort, PedSkull-CT, comprising normal and pathological cases for internal evaluation, addressing the gap in adult-centric, trunk-focused datasets.

title: Distill Once, Adapt Life-Long: Exploring Dataset Distillation for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) aims to maintain model performance under evolving target domains by adapting online without labeled data. However, practical deployments often cannot retain the source dataset due to privacy or licensing constraints, and purely source-free CTTA methods tend to become unstable under long-term distribution shift, suffering from compounding self-training errors and catastrophic forgetting. We introduce DO-ALL (Distill Once, Adapt Life-Long), a plug-and-play framework that revisits source information in a compact and privacy-conscious form via Dataset Distillation (DD). Before deployment, DO-ALL performs DD to produce a small set of synthetic distilled anchors that summarize the source distribution. During adaptation, each target sample is matched with its most semantically aligned anchor, which provides a stable reference for various CTTA via source replay, representation alignment, and manifold-smoothing regularization. DO-ALL can be seamlessly integrated into existing CTTA algorithms, consistently improving long-term robustness across CIFAR100-C, ImageNet-C, and the CCC benchmark. This demonstrates the potential of leveraging DD to enable stable and continuous adaptation without retaining raw source data. The code is available at https://github.com/blue-531/DOALL.

title: PIAvatar: Physically Interactive Avatars via Deformation Gradient Decoupling
summary: 3D human avatars have shown impressive visual fidelity driven by pose-conditioned models, yet they still lack the physical ability required for interactions with each other and environments. Although recent studies have made various attempts to incorporate physical characteristics into 3D avatars, they only exhibit limited physical deformations, often leading to constrained interaction behaviors. To resolve this issue, we present PIAvatar, a framework to simultaneously enable physically aware interactions between avatar-avatar and avatar-environment, and a non-rigid deformable human body simulation. In this work, our key insight is to decouple kinematic velocity from deformation gradient. When external forces act on avatars, the kinematic velocity induces stress which hinders the avatar's ability to achieve a desired pose. In addition, we integrate a skeletal framework within the avatar. It allows estimating its poses and real-time tracking in a closed form, even during non-rigid physical interactions. Our approach is implemented within a conventional Material Point Method framework to ensure physically consistent dynamics. We lastly evaluate the method on both human-object and human-human interaction scenarios to assess its behavior under diverse interaction settings.

title: A Neurosymbolic Framework for Interpretable Skeleton-Based Seizure Detection via Concept-Driven Logical Reasoning
summary: Video-based seizure detection is essential for the management of epilepsy patients, offering a non-invasive complement to electroencephalography. While several deep learning approaches have been developed for video-based seizure detection, none are inherently interpretable, limiting their adoption and translation into clinical practice. We present, to our knowledge, the first exploration of a neurosymbolic framework for video-based seizure detection that directly addresses this gap. Our approach (1) extracts patient-centric skeleton sequences from epilepsy monitoring units via a prompt-guided foundation model, (2) predicts binary spatio-temporal concept activations grounded in clinical motor semiology guidelines, and (3) composes them via differentiable logic into interpretable Boolean rules with auditable contributions. Furthermore, to mitigate false positives arising from the traditional binary formulation (seizure vs.\ non-seizure), we sub-classify non-seizure segments into clinically relevant normal activities, providing the model with fine-grained discriminative supervision. Evaluated on two public seizure video benchmarks, our framework achieves 89.78% sensitivity with 0.06 false detections per hour on SAHZU and 85.27%,0.09 on IEEE, while producing complete three-level interpretability: every prediction decomposes into which motor primitives were detected, how they were logically composed, and how much each rule contributed to the clinical decision. We publicly release all annotations, extracted pose sequences, our data pipeline and code, https://github.com/Mr-TalhaIlyas/CDSD/.

title: Topological Neural Dynamics: A Neuron-wise Framework for Sequence Modeling
comments: We found that some claims in our paper were inappropriate and needed to be substantially rephrased
summary: Existing sequence models, including RNNs, LSTMs, continuous-time networks, and Transformers, share a common structural principle: layer-wise dynamics, where all neurons in the same layer co-evolve through a shared parameterized operator, leaving individual neurons no freedom to evolve independently. Yet in many complex dynamical systems, rich global behavior emerges precisely from locally evolving units interacting through structured connectivity. Inspired by this principle, we introduce Topological Neural Dynamics (TND), a sequence modeling framework that shifts computation from layer-wise to neuron-wise dynamics. TND represents a neural system as a directed neuron graph, an interaction operator, and a local dynamics function, where each neuron evolves independently and collective computation emerges from interactions through the explicit graph topology. We instantiate TND as a discrete-time graph-coupled dynamical system and evaluate it as a case study on a behavior cloning task in single-player Pong. Compared with Vanilla RNN, Sparse RNN, LSTM, Closed-form continuous-time neural network (CfC), and Transformer baselines, TND achieves the best catch rate and a mean of 17.47 consecutive catches per round, more than three times that of the strongest baseline. These results suggest that shifting from layer-wise to neuron-wise dynamics provides an effective inductive bias for sequence modeling.
comment: We found that some claims in our paper were inappropriate and needed to be substantially rephrased

title: Protein contacts are already in the attention: a single-forward-pass alternative to the Categorical Jacobian
summary: The Categorical Jacobian of Zhang et al. (2024) reads protein contacts from a language model by perturbing every residue with every alternative amino acid, about $19L$ forward passes. We show the signal it reconstructs is already concentrated in a small subset of attention heads: averaging the top-$K$ contact-relevant heads -- selected on as few as 10 labeled proteins, with no fitted per-pair or per-head weights -- recovers contacts in a single forward pass and matches or beats the Categorical Jacobian for every bidirectional model where it is defined (bar the smallest, 8M). Our primary test is leakage-clean: on a CAMEO split where neither selection nor evaluation touches data the models have plausibly memorized, the head readout beats the Categorical Jacobian on ESM-2-650M by +9pp ($N = 29$, $p < 0.001$), with the within-model margin reproducing across architectures. Ablations localize the gain to labeled head selection, not to averaging: at a matched label budget the unweighted mean ties a supervised $L_1$ logistic regression on the same heads. Both methods fall 30-36pp from their in-distribution Zhang numbers to the leakage-clean split, which we read as an upper bound on how much prior numbers reflect pretraining overlap. We additionally introduce representation-CJ, a hidden-state generalization of the Jacobian to architectures without a masked-LM head (the output-head-independent analogue of logit-CJ), agreeing with the Categorical Jacobian where both are defined (per-protein Pearson $r \approx 0.95$); show that the optimal $K$ tracks how diffusely a model spreads its contact heads; and find both methods lose the signal on the two causal LMs we test, suggesting attention-encoded pair structure may depend on bidirectional pretraining.

title: Improving Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Perception Verified Self-Training
comments: Accepted at The European Conference on Computer Vision 2026
summary: Achieving human-like reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remains a long-standing challenge. Recent approaches leverage Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales generated by human annotators or proprietary models, which are costly and difficult to scale. Self-training offers a promising alternative but often suffers from visual hallucinations and language shortcuts because rationales are filtered only by answer correctness without verifying visual perception. We propose a perception-verified self-training framework that enforces visually grounded reasoning. Our method employs a CoT template (caption-reasoning-conclusion) that disentangles perception from reasoning, enabling independent verification of visual understanding. To compensate for the absence of ground-truth captions, we introduce PerceptEval, an unsupervised method that evaluates caption quality based on its alignment with visual and textual elements in the image. Using caption verification together with answer correctness, we partition the data into easy, medium, and hard subsets and design a two-stage curriculum learning strategy. Stage 1 trains on easy samples, while Stage 2 enhances medium samples by regenerating reasoning conditioned on verified captions and retaining only those with correct conclusions. This ensures training is performed exclusively on perceptually grounded reasoning, reducing hallucinations and language shortcuts. Extensive experiments across diverse domains and models demonstrate improvements of up to 16% over standard self-training baselines, showing that our framework provides a scalable and cost-effective solution for advancing multimodal reasoning without manually annotated CoT rationales.
comment: Accepted at The European Conference on Computer Vision 2026

title: Energy Dissipation Analysis of Implicit-Explicit Linear Multistep Methods for Gradient Flows Using General Multipliers
summary: A unified framework is proposed to establish the energy dissipation of implicit-explicit linear multistep methods (IMEX-LMMs) for gradient flows, based on general multipliers that are linear combinations of first-order differences of numerical solutions. A generalized Dahlquist's theory is developed to establish the energy dissipation of IMEX-LMMs. It is shown that given an IMEX-LMM, to find a multiplier ensuring the energy dissipation is relaxed to solve a linear programming that can be easily solved. Within this framework, two specific multipliers are discovered to establish the energy dissipation of the sixth-order IMEX backward differentiation formula (IMEX-BDF6) method and a seventh-order IMEX weighted and shifted BDF method, and a new eighth-order energy-dissipative IMEX-LMM is provided. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first energy-dissipation results for the IMEX-BDF6 method and the IMEX-LMMs of order higher than six. In addition, this framework can be used directly to establish the $L^2$- or $H^1$-stability of general LMMs for linear parabolic problems. Numerical experiments illustrate the temporal accuracy and energy dissipation of these methods.

title: On Good Authority: Release-Authority Measurement for Registry-Mediated Package Ecosystems
summary:
Dependency graphs reveal where released code can flow; release-authority records reveal how a release reached users. A package can keep the same downstream exposure while its public authority path changes: a new publisher account, a repository relink, a new workflow, a provenance change, a signing-key movement, or a shift in publication mediation. These transitions expose a release-time review surface over public control-plane evidence, before payload evidence or incident attribution is available.
  We introduce a predecessor-aware release-authority record that compares each package release with its immediate predecessor across publisher, repository, workflow, provenance, signing, and mediation evidence. We apply the record to a purposefully sampled, audited April 2024-June 2026 cohort from npm, PyPI, Maven Central, crates.io, and RubyGems: 45,812 releases, 43,100 eligible predecessor comparisons, and 942 package coordinates. We report Go separately as a VCS/proxy/checksum-log boundary adapter. Transparent rules identify 204 public release-path discontinuities and define a 204-release candidate review queue. A uniform semantic-distance rule selects 320 releases and covers 190/204 triggers; a descriptive regime-specific rule selects 337 releases and covers all 204.
  Practitioner review supports the operational reading of this queue. In a blinded 60-row shared core, three practitioners rated 20/30 triggers as immediate review, 9/30 as monitoring, 1/30 as no review, and all 30 controls as no review. External alignment defines the boundary of the surface: exact malicious versions have zero overlap with policy triggers in our cohort. Compromises that reuse the same public release path, unchanged compromised CI, and versions absent from public snapshots require separate evidence beyond this release-authority record.

title: RigorBench: Benchmarking Engineering Process Discipline in Autonomous AI Coding Agents
summary: Agentic coding harnesses - such as Agent-Skills, Superpowers, and Agent-Rigor - are increasingly deployed to augment underlying LLMs for real-world software engineering tasks. Existing benchmarks evaluate these agents almost exclusively on outcome correctness: whether generated code passes tests or resolves issues. We argue that this outcome-only lens is insufficient: an agent that arrives at a correct solution through reckless trial-and-error, without planning, verification, or graceful recovery, is fundamentally less reliable than one that follows sound engineering discipline. We introduce RigorBench, the first benchmark designed to measure process discipline in AI coding agents. RigorBench evaluates these harnesses across five pillars: Planning Fidelity, Verification Coverage, Recovery Efficiency, Abstention Quality, and Atomic Transition Integrity. A composite RigorScore aggregates these dimensions into a single metric via a weighted sum. We curate a suite of 30 tasks spanning five categories - Plan-Then-Build, Verify-Or-Die, Doom Loop Gauntlet, Know When to Fold, and Don't Break the Build-and evaluate leading harnesses in a controlled with/without experimental design against baseline coding assistants. Our results show that structured process discipline not only improves process quality scores by an average of 41% but also raises downstream outcome correctness by 17%, providing the first quantitative evidence that how agents code matters as much as what they produce. We release the full benchmark, scoring rubrics, and trajectory analysis tools as open-source artifacts.

title: The Geometry of Refusal: Linear Instability in Safety-Aligned LLMs
comments: Accepted at TrustNLP 2026 (Sixth Workshop on Trustworthy Natural Language Processing, ACL 2026)
summary: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on extensive safety alignment, yet the mechanistic basis of refusal remains opaque. In this work, we investigate whether safety compliance is a deep semantic decision or a manipulable linear feature. We introduce Contrastive Logit Steering (CLS), a zero-optimization framework that isolates the "refusal direction" by contrasting hidden states derived from safe and unrestricted system prompts. Unlike representation engineering methods that intervene on internal activations, CLS operates directly on the output distribution, serving as a diagnostic probe for alignment fragility. When coupled with prefix injection to bypass initial refusal reflexes, this method induces a phase transition where guardrails collapse. Our experiments on 7 model families reveal that safety implementation is architecturally deterministic. While models like Llama-3.1 exhibit a "Late Decision" topology that is easily bypassed by CLS (reaching 95% ASR in approximately one second), others like Qwen-2.5 demonstrate "Early Divergence" by integrating safety mid-computation. Direct comparison with established activation-level steering methods shows that CLS achieves substantially higher attack success rates on Llama 2 (73% vs. 22.6%) and Qwen 7B (91% vs. 79.2%), demonstrating that logit-level intervention exposes alignment vulnerabilities that hidden-state methods underestimate. Beyond attacks, we show that this linearity enables bidirectional control: inverting the steering vector "hardens" models against jailbreaks without retraining. Our findings suggest that current alignment techniques create a steerable "safety axis" that serves as both a critical vulnerability and a precise primitive for defense.
comment: Accepted at TrustNLP 2026 (Sixth Workshop on Trustworthy Natural Language Processing, ACL 2026)

title: BLUEX v2: Benchmarking LLMs on Open-Ended Questions from Brazilian University Entrance Exams
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in many tasks, their assessment in Portuguese has received less attention, particularly for open-ended, discursive tasks that demand deeper reasoning and generation capabilities. While the original BLUEX benchmark addressed the scarcity of Portuguese evaluation datasets through multiple-choice questions from Brazilian university entrance exams, it did not cover the more challenging second-phase examinations, which require free-form written responses. In this work, we introduce BLUEX v2, a benchmark derived from the second-phase entrance exams of Brazil's two leading universities: UNICAMP (Comvest) and USP (Fuvest), spanning exam years 2022--2025. Our dataset comprises 395 questions unfolding into 919 graded subquestions, with 55.7% of questions containing associated images (represented as context-aware captions during inference to enable evaluation across both vision-capable and text-only models). Each question is annotated with subject area, official reference answers, LLM-generated rubric criteria, and six cognitive capability tags. We evaluate 21 state-of-the-art LLMs using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol. Results reveal a 4.92-point performance spread across models (4.18-9.10 on a 0-10 scale), with Mathematical Reasoning and Image Understanding emerging as the hardest capability dimensions. The evaluation code, model outputs, and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/TropicAI-Research/BLUEXv2 and on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tropic-AI/BLUEX-v2.

title: InteractiveAvatar: Real-Time Streaming Video Generation for Consistent and Intent-Aware Avatars
summary: Recent diffusion-based models have enabled realistic audio-driven avatar generation in real-time streaming. However, existing approaches struggle to maintain visual temporal consistency and fail to explicitly perceive user intent in complex interactive streaming scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose InteractiveAvatar, a real-time infinite-streaming video generation framework that supports visually consistent avatar video generation and intent-aware interactions. With autoregressive distillation, InteractiveAvatar achieves real-time str-eaming generation of human avatars over arbitrarily long durations. For visual consistency, we introduce a Long-Short Visual Memory (LSVM) mechanism that flexibly compresses historical visual information into compact tokens, preserving both short-range coherence and long-term consistency. To generate avatars with speeches and actions aligned with user intent, we propose a Reasoning-Reaction Module (RRM), which incorporates a State-Cycling strategy and a Cache-Switching mechanism. Extensive experimental results over diverse scenarios demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art visual consistency in long-duration generation, while enabling complex user-avatar interaction in real time.

AI.title_translation: InteractiveAvatar：用于一致且具备意图感知能力的数字人的实时流式视频生成
AI.tldr: 本文提出InteractiveAvatar框架，通过自回归蒸馏、长短期视觉记忆及推理-反应模块，实现了支持实时、超长时长、视觉一致且具备意图感知能力的交互式数字人视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散模型的音频驱动数字人生成方法，在复杂的交互式实时流媒体场景中，难以维持视觉上的时间一致性，且无法显式地感知和理解用户的交互意图。
AI.method:
提出InteractiveAvatar框架，主要包含以下核心技术：
1. **自回归蒸馏（Autoregressive Distillation）**：实现任意超长持续时间内的真人数字人实时流式生成。
2. **长短期视觉记忆（LSVM）机制**：将历史视觉信息灵活压缩为紧凑的token，以同时保持短期连贯性和长期一致性。
3. **推理-反应模块（RRM）**：结合状态循环（State-Cycling）策略和缓存切换（Cache-Switching）机制，生成与用户意图对齐的数字人语音和动作。
AI.result: 在多种场景下的广泛实验表明，该方法在长视频生成中实现了最先进的（SOTA）视觉一致性，同时支持实时的复杂用户-数字人交互。
AI.conclusion: InteractiveAvatar成功解决了实时流式数字人生成中视觉不一致和缺乏意图感知的问题。实验证明，该框架在超长时长视频生成中达到了最先进的视觉一致性，并能实现高质量、实时的复杂人机交互。
AI.translation: 最近，基于扩散的模型已经能够在实时流媒体中生成逼真的语音驱动数字人。然而，现有的方法在复杂的交互式流媒体场景中，难以维持视觉上的时间一致性，且无法显式地感知用户意图。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 InteractiveAvatar，这是一个实时无限流式视频生成框架，支持视觉一致的数字人视频生成和意图感知交互。通过自回归蒸馏，InteractiveAvatar 实现了在任意超长持续时间内的真人数字人实时流式生成。为了保证视觉一致性，我们引入了一种长短期视觉记忆（LSVM）机制，该机制将历史视觉信息灵活地压缩为紧凑的 token，从而同时保持短期连贯性和长期一致性。为了生成与用户意图相匹配的、带有语音和动作的数字人，我们提出了一个推理-反应模块（RRM），该模块结合了状态循环策略和缓存切换机制。在各种场景下的广泛实验结果表明，我们的方法在长持续时间生成中实现了最先进的视觉一致性，同时能够实现实时的复杂用户-数字人交互。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为InteractiveAvatar的实时无限流式视频生成框架，用于构建具有视觉一致性和意图感知能力的交互式数字人。该框架利用自回归蒸馏技术实现超长时长的实时生成，通过长短期视觉记忆（LSVM）机制保障视频的长期与短期视觉连贯性，并采用推理-反应模块（RRM）来确保数字人的言行与用户意图高度对齐。实验表明，该方法在长视频一致性和实时交互性能上均达到了领先水平。
AI.keywords: 实时视频生成, 虚拟数字人, 视觉一致性, 意图感知交互, 自回归蒸馏
AI.comments: 这项工作具有很强的实用价值，其创新点在于通过自回归蒸馏解决了无限时长视频生成的实时性问题，并设计了长短期视觉记忆（LSVM）来兼顾局部连贯性与全局一致性。此外，推理-反应模块（RRM）的引入使得数字人能够实时理解并响应用户意图，这对于实时虚拟主播、智能客服等交互场景具有重要意义。局限性方面，摘要中未提及该方法在面对极度复杂的背景或超高速交互时的计算延迟和硬件开销。

title: Decentralized Operations of Decarbonized Chemical Plants with Renewable-driven Transmission Systems
summary: Electrification of ethane cracking offers a promising pathway to industrial decarbonization, provided that the electricity is sourced from renewable energy. However, integrating electrified chemical plant microgrids with a decarbonized power grid requires joint operations planning between Independent System Operators and chemical plants, which is hindered by the highly confidential nature of plant operational data. In this paper, we propose a privacy-friendly decentralized framework based on data isolation that jointly optimizes the Unit Commitment problem in the power system and microgrid scheduling in electrified ethane cracker plants. The framework employs the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers, augmented with an auxiliary system-level penalty that accelerates convergence, allowing each subsystem to solve its local subproblem and share only minimal coordination signals. To reflect real-world conditions, numerical experiments are conducted on the ACTIVSg2000 test case, a synthetic model of the Texas transmission network, with 26 chemical plants identified from Texas mapped to their nearest grid connection points. In doing so, we characterize the cost of privacy-friendly decomposition on joint power and chemical system decisions, showing that data isolation results in consistently small optimality gaps, and that its emissions consequences are load-dependent and non-monotone.

AI.title_translation: 具有可再生能源驱动输电系统的脱碳化工厂去中心化运营
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于ADMM的去中心化优化框架，在严格保护化工厂商业隐私的前提下，实现了电力系统与电气化化工厂的联合调度，且最优性损失极小。
AI.motivation: 乙烷裂解电气化是工业脱碳的重要途径，但这需要电网运营商与化工厂进行联合运营规划。由于化工厂的运营数据属于高度机密，传统的集中式优化方法因隐私问题而难以实施。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于数据隔离的隐私友好型去中心化框架，联合优化电力系统的机组组合问题和电气化乙烷裂解厂的微网调度。该框架采用交替方向乘子法（ADMM），并引入辅助系统级惩罚项以加速收敛，使各子系统仅需共享最少的协调信号即可求解局部子问题。
AI.result: 在德克萨斯州输电网络合成模型（ACTIVSg2000，包含26家真实化工厂）上的数值实验表明，该隐私友好型分解方法带来的最优性差距持续保持在极小水平，且其对碳排放的影响具有负荷依赖性和非单调性特征。
AI.conclusion: 隐私友好型的去中心化分解在协调电力和化工系统决策时，其最优性差距非常小。然而，其对碳排放的影响取决于负荷且呈非单调性。这表明在保护商业隐私的同时，实现电网与化工厂的协同脱碳是可行的。
AI.translation: 乙烷裂解的电气化为工业脱碳提供了一条充满前景的途径，前提是电力来源于可再生能源。然而，将电气化化工厂微电网与脱碳电网相集成需要独立系统运营商与化工厂之间进行联合运营规划，但这受到化工厂运行数据高度机密性的阻碍。在本文中，我们提出了一个基于数据隔离的隐私友好型去中心化框架，该框架联合优化了电力系统中的机组组合问题以及电气化乙烷裂解厂中的微电网调度。该框架采用了交替方向乘子法（ADMM），并辅以加速收敛的辅助系统级惩罚项，允许每个子系统求解其局部子问题并仅共享最少的协调信号。为了反映现实世界的情况，我们在ACTIVSg2000测试案例（德克萨斯州输电网络的合成模型，其中识别出德克萨斯州的26家化工厂并将其映射到最近的电网连接点）上进行了数值实验。在此过程中，我们刻画了隐私友好型分解对电力和化工联合系统决策的成本影响，表明数据隔离导致的最优性差距持续较小，且其排放后果具有负荷依赖性和非单调性。
AI.summary: 本文针对电气化化工厂与脱碳电网联合规划中的数据隐私挑战，提出了一种基于ADMM的去中心化协同优化框架。该框架在不泄露化工厂机密数据的前提下，实现了电力系统机组组合与化工厂微网调度的联合优化。在德州电网合成模型上的实验验证了该方法的高效性，展示了极小的最优性差距，并揭示了排放影响的复杂性。
AI.keywords: 去中心化运营, 工业脱碳, 隐私保护, 交替方向乘子法 (ADMM), 机组组合
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将ADMM分布式优化算法应用到电力系统与工业化工厂微网的联合调度中，并重点解决了工业界高度敏感的数据隐私问题。其局限性在于主要针对乙烷裂解这一特定化工过程进行了建模，对于其他类型化工厂的泛化性有待验证；此外，排放结果的非单调性表明，隐私保护与碳减排之间可能存在复杂的权衡，需要更精细的政策设计。

title: IPO Finance Agent: Benchmark of LLM Financial Analysts Beyond Finance Agent v2, with Automated Rubric Generation, on the SpaceX (SPCX) IPO
summary: Finance Agent v2 (by Vals AI) has emerged as the reference benchmark for evaluating both Anthropic Claude and OpenAI ChatGPT frontier language models on financial tasks. However, it narrowly deals with periodic reporting from publicly traded companies (SEC 10-K and 10-Q filings), and its agentic harness relies on naive, unenriched chunk retrieval. Neither the task design nor the retrieval approach addresses the distinct challenges of IPO due diligence. SEC S-1 filings combine historical financial statements, governance structures, pro forma and common-control accounting treatments, capital-formation narratives, and underwriting-sensitive risk disclosures within substantially longer documents than typical periodic filings. That is why we introduce IPO Finance Agent, which extends the Finance Agent v2 framework along two directions: task domain and retrieval architecture. During our experiments, the original Finance Agent v2 harness basically failed to deliver any output related to the SpaceX S-1 filing, due to document length. We therefore had to improve the agentic harness with contextual retrieval, a more realistic and industry-standard approach for long documents. We also built a dataset of 1,000 IPO-diligence questions, and publicly release 70 questions on the SpaceX (SPCX) S-1 filing to support reproducibility, while the remainder are held private to guard against benchmark contamination. In addition, we introduce an evaluator-optimizer pipeline to automatically generate evaluation rubrics for the benchmark: candidate facts are extracted from model answers, consolidated into draft criteria, then automatically audited for omissions, hallucinations, mistiered items, and redundancy, with LLM feedback driving iterative repair, targeted enrichment, and deduplication. Human experts only review final rubrics before deployment. Results show that the best-performing evaluated model, Zhipu GLM-5.2, reaches 79.8% accuracy, and the most cost-efficient model on the resulting Pareto frontier, Xiaomi MiMo-2.5 Pro, reaches slightly lower accuracy (77.2%) at 0.05 USD per query, while exceeding the current Finance Agent v2 leaderboard ceiling, Google Gemini 3.5 Flash at 57.9% for 2.51 USD per query, and undercutting even FABv2's cheapest entry (MiniMax M3: 48.3% at 0.32 USD) on cost-efficiency. Code and data are released on GitHub https://github.com/benstaf/ipoagent

AI.title_translation: IPO 财务代理：超越 Finance Agent v2 的 LLM 财务分析师基准，具备自动评分细则生成，在 SpaceX (SPCX) IPO 上的应用
AI.tldr: 本文推出了 IPO Finance Agent 基准，通过上下文检索和自动评分细则生成管线，解决了 LLM 在 SpaceX S-1 等超长 IPO 招股书尽职调查中的评估难题，并指出小米 MiMo-2.5 Pro 具有极高的性价比。
AI.motivation: 现有的金融 LLM 评估基准（如 Finance Agent v2）局限于处理上市公司的定期报告（10-K/10-Q），且依赖于简单的分块检索。这种方法无法应对 IPO 尽职调查（SEC S-1 申报文件）的独特挑战，因为 S-1 文件比定期报告更长，且融合了复杂的历史财务、治理结构、备考会计处理、资本形成叙述和风险披露，导致现有框架在处理此类超长文档时通常会检索失败。
AI.method:
1. **任务与架构扩展**：将 Finance Agent v2 扩展至 IPO 尽职调查领域，并引入上下文检索（Contextual Retrieval）架构，以解决原始分块检索无法处理超长 S-1 文档的问题。
2. **数据集构建**：构建了包含 1,000 个 IPO 尽职调查问题的数据集，并公开了 70 个针对 SpaceX S-1 申报文件的测试问题。
3. **自动化评估管线**：设计了一个评估器-优化器（Evaluator-Optimizer）管线，通过提取模型回答的事实、合并标准、自动审计（遗漏、幻觉、冗余等）并利用 LLM 反馈进行迭代修复，自动生成评估评分细则，最后由人类专家进行最终审核。
AI.result:
在 IPO Finance Agent 基准测试中：
1. 表现最出色的模型是**智谱 GLM-5.2**，准确率达到 79.8%。
2. 性价比最高的模型是**小米 MiMo-2.5 Pro**，在每查询仅 0.05 美元的成本下，达到了 77.2% 的准确率。
3. 这一性价比表现显著超越了 Finance Agent v2 当前的领跑者 **Google Gemini 3.5 Flash**（准确率 57.9%，成本 2.51 美元/查询）以及最便宜的参与者 **MiniMax M3**（准确率 48.3%，成本 0.32 美元/查询）。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建并发布了 IPO Finance Agent 基准，证明了通过改进检索架构（上下文检索）和引入自动化评分细则生成管线，可以有效评估和优化大语言模型在复杂、超长金融文档（如 IPO S-1 文件）上的尽职调查能力。同时，测试结果为金融领域寻找高性价比的 LLM 提供了实际参考。
AI.translation: Finance Agent v2（由 Vals AI 提出）已成为评估 Anthropic Claude 和 OpenAI ChatGPT 等前沿语言模型在财务任务上表现的参考基准。然而，它仅局限于处理上市公司的定期报告（SEC 10-K 和 10-Q 申报文件），且其代理框架依赖于朴素的、未增强的分块检索。无论是任务设计还是检索方法，都无法解决 IPO 尽职调查的独特挑战。SEC S-1 申报文件将历史财务报表、治理结构、备考和共同控制会计处理、资本形成叙述以及对承销敏感的风险披露结合在比典型定期申报文件长得多的文档中。这就是我们推出 IPO Finance Agent 的原因，它从任务领域和检索架构两个方向扩展了 Finance Agent v2 框架。在我们的实验中，由于文档长度问题，原始的 Finance Agent v2 框架基本上无法输出任何与 SpaceX S-1 申报文件相关的内容。因此，我们必须使用上下文检索来改进代理框架，这是一种针对长文档更现实且符合行业标准的做法。我们还构建了一个包含 1,000 个 IPO 尽职调查问题的数据集，并公开释放了针对 SpaceX (SPCX) S-1 申报文件的 70 个问题以支持可复现性，而其余问题则保密以防止基准污染。此外，我们引入了一个评估器-优化器管线来自动生成该基准的评估细则：从模型答案中提取候选事实，合并为草案标准，然后自动审计遗漏、幻觉、分级错误和冗余，通过 LLM 反馈驱动迭代修复、针对性丰富和去重。人类专家仅在部署前审查最终的评分细则。结果表明，表现最好的评估模型智谱 GLM-5.2 达到了 79.8% 的准确率，而在所得帕累托前沿上最具成本效益的模型小米 MiMo-2.5 Pro 以每查询 0.05 美元的成本达到了略低的准确率（77.2%），同时超过了当前 Finance Agent v2 排行榜的上限 Google Gemini 3.5 Flash（在 2.51 美元每查询的成本下准确率为 57.9%），在成本效益上甚至低于 FABv2 最便宜的输入（MiniMax M3：在 0.32 美元成本下准确率为 48.3%）。代码和数据已在 GitHub 上发布：https://github.com/benstaf/ipoagent。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有金融LLM基准无法处理超长、复杂的IPO招股说明书（SEC S-1）的问题，推出了全新的“IPO Finance Agent”基准。该研究通过引入上下文检索改进了检索架构，构建了包含1000个IPO尽职调查问题的数据集（并开源了70个关于SpaceX S-1的问题），并开发了一种自动生成评估评分细则的评估器-优化器管线。实验评估了多款前沿LLM，其中智谱 GLM-5.2 取得了 79.8% 的最高准确率，而小米 MiMo-2.5 Pro 则以极低的成本（$0.05/query）实现了 77.2% 的高准确率，展现出极高的实用价值。
AI.keywords: IPO财务代理 (IPO Finance Agent), 金融大模型基准 (Financial LLM Benchmark), 自动评分细则生成 (Automated Rubric Generation), 上下文检索 (Contextual Retrieval), 尽职调查 (Due Diligence)
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：将金融大模型评估从普通的定期报告（10-K/10-Q）拓展到了难度和复杂度极高的IPO招股书（S-1），填补了现有金融LLM基准的空白。
2. 实用性：引入了上下文检索（Contextual Retrieval）来解决超长文档检索失败的问题，并设计了自动化的评分细则生成管线（Evaluator-Optimizer），大幅降低了人工构建基准的成本。
3. 局限性：为了防止基准污染，1000个问题中仅公开了70个，这在一定程度上限制了外部研究者进行完全独立和大规模的本地复现。

title: Measuring & Mitigating Over-Alignment for LLMs in Multilingual Criminal Law Courts
summary:
While the wider applicability of LLMs in the legal field is currently debated due to their reliability and the gravity of any errors, narrow uses with well-understood and mitigated risks have emerged. Notably the Swiss Federal Supreme Court uses small on-premises models for tentative translations and short-passage summarization across the four official languages. However, such usage is challenging in the context of Criminal Law. Since rulings and cases employees work on routinely can contain detailed descriptions of violent and sexual offenses, their legitimate work is compromised by refusals and disclaimers due to the activation of model guardrails (over-alignment).
  To measure this phenomenon, we introduce TF-RefusalBench, a multilingual benchmark for criminal-law translation and summarization derived from public Swiss Supreme Court rulings. TF-RefusalBench contains 5,200 total prompts across French, German, Italian, and English, corresponding to common task prompts and passages likely to trigger refusal. We then use TF-RefusalBench to show that over-alignment is a multifaceted phenomenon, influenced by the model and the prompt and text languages being processed, and that its impact cannot be evaluated solely from an over-refusal perspective, given the disclaimer's impact on task faithfulness. Finally, we evaluate approaches to enable on-premises LLMs for Criminal Law Tasks, demonstrating that while prompting can be effective, abliteration (refusal directions ablation) eliminates refusal with minimal impact on task performance.

AI.title_translation: 衡量和缓解多语言刑事法庭中大型语言模型过度对齐问题
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了TF-RefusalBench，一个多语言刑事法翻译和摘要基准，用于衡量LLM在处理敏感内容时过度对齐（拒绝和免责声明）的问题。研究发现过度对齐是一个多方面现象，并提出“abliteration”方法能有效消除拒绝，同时对任务性能影响最小。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在法律领域的应用因其可靠性和错误严重性而备受争议，但在某些特定场景下，如瑞士联邦最高法院用于翻译和摘要的小型本地模型，其风险可控。然而，在刑事法律领域，由于案件内容可能涉及暴力和性犯罪的详细描述，LLMs的“护栏”机制（过度对齐）会导致模型拒绝或发出免责声明，从而影响合法工作。本研究旨在衡量并缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 为了衡量过度对齐现象，研究引入了TF-RefusalBench，这是一个从公开的瑞士最高法院裁决中提取的多语言（法语、德语、意大利语、英语）刑事法律翻译和摘要基准，包含5200个可能触发拒绝的常见任务提示和文本片段。然后，使用TF-RefusalBench来分析过度对齐的特点，并评估了多种方法来使本地LLMs适用于刑事法律任务，其中包括提示工程（prompting）和“abliteration”（消除拒绝方向）。
AI.result: 研究发现过度对齐是一个多方面现象，受模型、提示语言和文本语言的影响。其影响不能仅仅从过度拒绝的角度来评估，因为免责声明也会影响任务的忠实性。在评估缓解方法时，研究表明提示工程可能有效，但“abliteration”（消除拒绝方向）能够消除拒绝，同时对任务性能影响最小。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型在刑事法律任务中存在过度对齐的问题，这会影响其合法使用。通过引入TF-RefusalBench，研究量化了这一现象，并发现“abliteration”是一种有效且对性能影响小的缓解策略，能够使本地LLMs更好地应用于刑事法律领域。
AI.translation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在法律领域的广泛适用性因其可靠性和任何错误的严重性而备受争议，但风险明确且可控的狭义应用已经出现。值得注意的是，瑞士联邦最高法院使用小型本地模型进行初步翻译和四种官方语言的短篇摘要。然而，这种用法在刑事法律背景下具有挑战性。由于裁决和案件中员工日常处理的内容可能包含暴力和性犯罪的详细描述，他们的合法工作会因模型护栏（过度对齐）的激活导致的拒绝和免责声明而受到损害。为了衡量这一现象，我们引入了TF-RefusalBench，这是一个从公开的瑞士最高法院裁决中提取的多语言刑事法律翻译和摘要基准。TF-RefusalBench包含法语、德语、意大利语和英语共5200个提示，对应于常见的任务提示和可能触发拒绝的文本片段。然后，我们使用TF-RefusalBench来表明过度对齐是一个多方面的现象，受模型以及正在处理的提示和文本语言的影响，并且考虑到免责声明对任务忠实度的影响，其影响不能仅仅从过度拒绝的角度进行评估。最后，我们评估了使本地LLMs适用于刑事法律任务的方法，结果表明虽然提示工程可能有效，但“abliteration”（拒绝方向消融）可以在对任务性能影响最小的情况下消除拒绝。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）在多语言刑事法律环境中因“过度对齐”而产生的拒绝和免责声明问题。为量化此现象，研究开发了TF-RefusalBench，一个包含5200个多语言提示的刑事法律翻译和摘要基准。通过该基准，研究发现过度对齐是一个复杂的现象，受多种因素影响，且不能仅通过拒绝率来衡量。最终，研究提出并验证了“abliteration”方法，该方法能有效消除LLM的拒绝行为，同时最大限度地减少对任务性能的负面影响，从而使LLMs更适用于刑事法律任务。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 过度对齐, 刑事法律, TF-RefusalBench, Abliteration
AI.comments: 本文关注了LLM在特定高风险领域（刑事法律）应用中一个实际且重要的挑战——过度对齐问题。通过构建专门的多语言基准TF-RefusalBench，研究为量化和分析这一现象提供了有力工具。特别是提出的“abliteration”方法，为解决模型在敏感内容上的过度保守行为提供了一个创新的、有前景的解决方案，对于推动LLM在受限但关键领域的实际部署具有重要意义。文章强调了免责声明对任务忠实度的影响，拓宽了对“拒绝”现象的理解。

title: Teaching LLMs String Matching, Backtracking, and Error Recovery to Deduce Bases and Truth Tables for the Combinatorially Exploding Bit Manipulation Puzzles
comments: 22 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. 7th Place Solution for the NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge (Kaggle)
summary:
This paper presents our algorithmic innovations for the NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge, focusing on Bit Manipulation Puzzles. In this task, the objective is to discover a hidden logical rule transforming input binary strings to outputs, then apply it to unseen inputs. Large Language Models (LLMs) notoriously struggle here; traditional methods force them to simulate complex boolean logic and arithmetic, leading to hallucinations. Furthermore, the search space of bitwise operations (combinations of shifts, rotations, and logic gates) suffers from a severe combinatorial explosion. To overcome this computational intractability, we present a novel approach that abandons arithmetic logic entirely in favor of string similarity, structured search, and autonomous error recovery.
  Our core contributions are: 1. Bases and Truth Table Formulation: We reframe logic-gate deduction into a base-selection task, leveraging string similarity (minimal bit flips) to isolate primitive transformations ("bases") and deduce truth tables without complex arithmetic. 2. Backtracking DFS and Error Recovery: We formalize a search process that tests candidate bases, detects logical collisions across examples, and backtracks upon failure to perform robust error recovery. 3. Bit Tokenization and Interactive Reasoning SFT: We force the tokenizer to encode binary strings as individual single-bit tokens. We use dynamic masking to simulate external oracle feedback, training the model to hypothesize, self-evaluate, and backtrack natively.
  Evaluated on bit manipulation puzzles, our approach achieved over 96% validation accuracy. This represents the highest performance in this category, driving our 7th Place overall finish in the contest.
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. 7th Place Solution for the NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge (Kaggle)

AI.title_translation: 教导大型语言模型字符串匹配、回溯和错误恢复，以推断组合爆炸位操作谜题的基和真值表
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，通过字符串相似性、结构化搜索和自主错误恢复，帮助大型语言模型（LLMs）解决位操作谜题，避免了复杂的布尔逻辑和算术，并在NVIDIA Nemotron模型推理挑战赛中取得了96%以上的验证准确率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在位操作谜题上表现不佳，传统方法强迫它们模拟复杂的布尔逻辑和算术，导致幻觉。此外，位操作的搜索空间存在严重的组合爆炸问题，导致计算难以处理。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，完全放弃算术逻辑，转而采用字符串相似性、结构化搜索和自主错误恢复。核心贡献包括：1. 基和真值表公式化：将逻辑门推导重构为基选择任务，利用字符串相似性（最小位翻转）来隔离原始变换（“基”）并推导真值表。2. 回溯DFS和错误恢复：将搜索过程形式化，测试候选基，检测示例间的逻辑冲突，并在失败时回溯以执行鲁棒的错误恢复。3. 位分词和交互式推理SFT：强制分词器将二进制字符串编码为单个位令牌，并使用动态掩码模拟外部预言机反馈，训练模型进行假设、自我评估和原生回溯。
AI.result: 该方法在位操作谜题上的验证准确率超过96%，是该类别中的最高性能，使他们在NVIDIA Nemotron模型推理挑战赛中获得总排名第7。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法通过创新的字符串匹配、回溯和错误恢复策略，成功克服了大型语言模型在位操作谜题上的传统挑战，并在相关竞赛中取得了卓越的性能。
AI.translation:
本文介绍了我们在NVIDIA Nemotron模型推理挑战赛中针对位操作谜题的算法创新。在此任务中，目标是发现将输入二进制字符串转换为输出的隐藏逻辑规则，然后将其应用于未见过的输入。大型语言模型（LLMs）在这方面表现不佳；传统方法强迫它们模拟复杂的布尔逻辑和算术，导致幻觉。此外，位操作（移位、旋转和逻辑门的组合）的搜索空间遭受严重的组合爆炸。为了克服这种计算上的棘手性，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，完全放弃算术逻辑，转而采用字符串相似性、结构化搜索和自主错误恢复。
我们的核心贡献包括：1. 基和真值表公式化：我们将逻辑门推导重构为基选择任务，利用字符串相似性（最小位翻转）来隔离原始变换（“基”）并推导真值表，无需复杂的算术。2. 回溯DFS和错误恢复：我们形式化了一个搜索过程，该过程测试候选基，检测示例间的逻辑冲突，并在失败时回溯以执行鲁棒的错误恢复。3. 位分词和交互式推理SFT：我们强制分词器将二进制字符串编码为单个位令牌。我们使用动态掩码模拟外部预言机反馈，训练模型进行假设、自我评估和原生回溯。
在位操作谜题上进行评估，我们的方法取得了超过96%的验证准确率。这代表了该类别中的最高性能，使我们在竞赛中获得总排名第7。
AI.summary: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLMs）在位操作谜题上的挑战，提出了一种创新方法。该方法放弃传统算术逻辑，转而采用字符串相似性、结构化搜索和自主错误恢复，以推导隐藏的逻辑规则。通过重新定义逻辑门推导为基选择任务，并结合回溯深度优先搜索（DFS）和错误恢复机制，以及位分词和交互式推理的微调，该方法在NVIDIA Nemotron模型推理挑战赛中取得了96%以上的验证准确率，显著优于传统方法。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 位操作谜题, 字符串匹配, 回溯, 错误恢复
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种非常新颖且有效的策略来解决LLMs在处理复杂位操作逻辑时的固有弱点。通过将问题从算术逻辑转换为字符串相似性和结构化搜索，它巧妙地规避了LLMs在符号推理上的局限性，并引入了强大的错误恢复机制。位分词和交互式推理SFT的结合也很有趣，表明了对LLMs内部机制的深入理解和创新应用。这一方法在竞赛中的优异表现证明了其创新性和实用价值。

title: One Year Later...The Harms Persist, But So Do We!
summary: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for mental health-related conversations, yet safety guardrails remain inadequate and inconsistent across clinical conditions. This study evaluates eight proprietary LLMs across 16 DSM-5 conditions using four adversarial attack variants, introducing an eight-dimension harm taxonomy and a multi-dimensional evaluation framework. Results show that safeguards hold reliably only for suicide and self-harm, while conditions such as eating disorders, substance use disorder, and major depressive disorder exhibit failure rates of up to 100\%. We argue that ethical design and deployment of these LLMs demand clearly defined harm categories across clinical conditions and implementation of safeguards accordingly. Until such safeguards are in place, these models pose significant risks to vulnerable populations, making their growing integration into publicly available settings (e.g., schools, search engines, and consumer chatbots) are particularly concerning.

AI.title_translation: 一年后……危害依然存在，但我们依然坚强！
AI.tldr: LLM在心理健康对话中的安全防护措施不足且不一致，对饮食失调、物质使用障碍和重度抑郁症等疾病的失败率高达100%，存在重大风险。
AI.motivation: 评估通用大语言模型（LLMs）在心理健康对话中的安全防护措施，因其在临床条件下的防护措施不充分且不一致。
AI.method: 评估八种专有LLMs在16种DSM-5疾病中的表现，使用四种对抗性攻击变体，并引入八维危害分类法和多维度评估框架。
AI.result: 安全防护仅在自杀和自残方面可靠，而饮食失调、物质使用障碍和重度抑郁症等疾病的失败率高达100%。
AI.conclusion: 伦理设计和部署LLMs需要明确的危害类别和相应的安全措施，否则将对弱势群体构成重大风险。
AI.translation: 通用大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于心理健康相关的对话，但安全防护措施仍然不足，并且在不同的临床条件下不一致。本研究使用四种对抗性攻击变体，在16种DSM-5疾病中评估了八种专有LLMs，并引入了一个八维危害分类法和一个多维度评估框架。结果表明，安全防护仅在自杀和自残方面可靠，而饮食失调、物质使用障碍和重度抑郁症等疾病的失败率高达100%。我们认为，这些LLMs的伦理设计和部署需要明确跨临床条件的危害类别，并据此实施安全措施。在这些安全措施到位之前，这些模型对弱势群体构成重大风险，使其日益集成到公共可用环境（例如学校、搜索引擎和消费者聊天机器人）中尤其令人担忧。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了八种通用大语言模型（LLMs）在处理16种心理健康状况时的安全性，发现其安全防护措施存在显著不足，尤其是在饮食失调、物质使用障碍和重度抑郁症等领域，失败率高达100%。研究提出了一个包含八个维度的危害分类法和多维度评估框架，强调了在部署LLMs前明确危害类别和实施相应安全措施的必要性，以避免对弱势群体造成风险。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 心理健康, 安全防护, 危害分类, 评估框架
AI.comments: 该研究强调了LLM在心理健康领域的安全隐患，其评估方法和危害分类法为后续研究提供了基础。然而，研究仅评估了八种专有LLM，结果的普遍性有待进一步验证。同时，研究提出的解决方案仍需在实践中进行验证和优化。

title: REDI-Match: Rotation-Equivariant Distillation for Efficient and Robust Dense Matching
summary: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) have significantly advanced dense feature matching, yet severe in-plane rotation remains a critical challenge. Existing solutions face a fundamental dilemma: data-driven methods require inefficient parameter scaling to implicitly learn rotations, whereas strictly equivariant networks lack the semantic capacity of modern VFMs. Consequently, current frameworks typically freeze VFMs and shift the entire burden of rotation generalization to the downstream decoder. To break this architectural bottleneck, we propose REDI-Match, an efficient framework driven by a novel Rotation-Equivariant Distillation (REDI) paradigm. Instead of relying on rotation data augmentation to establish rotational correspondences, REDI distills the non-equivariant semantic representations of a VFM into a lightweight, strictly rotation-equivariant encoder, leveraging an equivariant geometric architecture to constrain robust high-dimensional semantics. To fully exploit these features, we equip the decoder with an entropy-driven spatial alignment module. By evaluating discrete rotation hypotheses, this mechanism explicitly locks onto the canonical coordinate system, eliminating global ambiguity before continuous refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REDI-Match establishes a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) across multiple benchmarks. Notably, it achieves a 13.89% absolute pose accuracy improvement on the highly challenging SatAst dataset while operating 1.9x faster than the current SOTA (RoMa v2), enabling real-time inference (~41 FPS) on a single RTX 4090 GPU. Code: https://github.com/YinjiGe/REDI-Match.

AI.title_translation: REDI-Match：用于高效鲁棒密集匹配的旋转等变蒸馏框架
AI.tldr: REDI-Match 通过创新的旋转等变蒸馏技术，在提升密集匹配抗旋转能力的同时，实现了比现有 SOTA 快 1.9 倍的实时推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉基础模型在处理平面内旋转时存在局限，要么依赖低效的参数缩放，要么因缺乏等变性而导致性能下降，且现有框架通常将旋转泛化压力全部推给解码器。
AI.method: 提出一种旋转等变蒸馏（REDI）范式，将 VFM 的语义特征蒸馏至轻量级等变编码器中；并引入基于熵的旋转空间对齐模块，通过评估离散旋转假设来消除全局歧义。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中达到 SOTA 水平，SatAst 数据集上绝对姿态精度提升 13.89%，推理速度比 RoMa v2 快 1.9 倍，在 RTX 4090 上可实现约 41 FPS 的实时推理。
AI.conclusion: REDI-Match 通过创新的旋转等变蒸馏范式，在保持高效推理的同时，大幅提升了密集匹配在旋转场景下的鲁棒性，刷新了多项任务的 SOTA。
AI.translation: 视觉基础模型（VFM）极大地推动了密集特征匹配的发展，但严重的平面内旋转仍然是一个关键挑战。现有的解决方案面临一个根本性的困境：数据驱动的方法需要低效的参数缩放来隐式学习旋转，而严格的等变网络缺乏现代 VFM 的语义能力。因此，目前的框架通常冻结 VFM，并将旋转泛化的全部负担转移给下游解码器。为了打破这一架构瓶颈，我们提出了 REDI-Match，这是一个由新颖的旋转等变蒸馏（REDI）范式驱动的高效框架。REDI 不再依赖旋转数据增强来建立旋转对应关系，而是将 VFM 的非等变语义表示蒸馏到一个轻量级的、严格旋转等变的编码器中，利用等变几何架构来约束鲁棒的高维语义。为了充分利用这些特征，我们为解码器配备了一个熵驱动的空间对齐模块。通过评估离散旋转假设，该机制在连续细化之前明确锁定规范坐标系，消除了全局歧义。大量实验表明，REDI-Match 在多个基准测试中建立了新的最先进（SOTA）水平。值得注意的是，它在极具挑战性的 SatAst 数据集上实现了 13.89% 的绝对姿态精度提升，同时运行速度比当前的 SOTA（RoMa v2）快 1.9 倍，在单张 RTX 4090 GPU 上实现了实时推理（约 41 FPS）。代码：https://github.com/YinjiGe/REDI-Match。
AI.summary: REDI-Match 是一种新型的高效、鲁棒密集匹配框架。它通过旋转等变蒸馏将 VFM 的语义知识迁移到轻量级等变编码器，并结合熵驱动的空间对齐模块，有效解决了平面内旋转带来的匹配难题，实现了高性能与实时性的平衡。
AI.keywords: 密集匹配, 旋转等变, 知识蒸馏, 视觉基础模型, 实时推理
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地解决了视觉基础模型（VFM）在处理平面内旋转时的性能瓶颈，通过知识蒸馏将语义能力迁移到轻量级等变网络，不仅提升了精度，还显著优化了推理速度，展现了极高的实用价值。

title: TIGER: Taming Identity, Geometry, and Generative Priors for High-Quality Face Video Restoration
summary: Face Video Restoration (FVR) aims to recover high-fidelity facial videos from degraded input while preserving identity and semantic consistency across frames. Existing methods often struggle to simultaneously address three key challenges: identity shift, viewpoint-entangled guidance, and perceptual realism. To tackle these issues, we propose TIGER, a structured tri-prior fusion framework that Tames Identity, Geometry, and gEnerative pRiors for high-quality FVR. Specifically, an Identity Prior is first established by injecting subject-discriminative embeddings into the latent space, effectively anchoring the subject's identity against severe degradations. Then, to provide temporally consistent structural guidance for dynamic videos, TIGER constructs a Geometry Prior by lifting 2D reference cues into a disentangled 3D parameter space, creating a geometric anchor through cross-source parameter fusion. Moreover, to achieve maximum efficiency without compromising realism, we harness the video generation model's Generative Prior through a one-step rectified flow. We further design a progressive three-stage training optimization strategy that refines structural fidelity, textural reconstruction, and distribution-level realism to ensure robust optimization. We also construct a large-scale FVR dataset to facilitate robust training and standardized evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TIGER achieves state-of-the-art performance in both identity fidelity and temporal stability, delivering a high-quality, efficient and identity-consistent FVR. Project page: https://yzhoulv.github.io/Tiger/.

AI.title_translation: TIGER：通过驯服身份、几何与生成先验实现高质量人脸视频修复
AI.tldr: TIGER 框架通过融合身份、3D几何与生成先验，解决了人脸视频修复中的身份偏移与时间不一致问题，实现了高质量、高保真的视频修复。
AI.motivation: 现有的人脸视频修复方法在处理身份偏移、视角纠缠引导以及感知真实感这三个核心挑战时存在不足，难以同时保证高质量恢复与时间一致性。
AI.method: 提出 TIGER 框架，利用身份先验注入判别式嵌入，通过将2D参考线索提升至3D参数空间构建几何先验，并利用一步修正流（rectified flow）结合生成先验，配合三阶段渐进式优化策略。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，TIGER 在身份保真度和时间稳定性方面均达到了当前最优（SOTA）水平，且具备高效的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: TIGER 框架通过整合三重先验与渐进式训练策略，在保持身份一致性和时间稳定性的前提下，实现了人脸视频的高质量修复，达到了行业先进水平。
AI.translation: 人脸视频修复（FVR）旨在从退化的输入中恢复高保真的人脸视频，同时保持跨帧的身份和语义一致性。现有方法在同时解决身份偏移、视角纠缠引导和感知真实感这三个关键挑战时往往力不从心。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 TIGER，一个结构化的三重先验融合框架，旨在驯服身份、几何和生成先验以实现高质量的 FVR。具体而言，首先通过将主体判别嵌入注入潜在空间来建立身份先验，从而有效地锚定主体身份以对抗严重退化。然后，为了给动态视频提供时间上一致的结构引导，TIGER 通过将 2D 参考线索提升到解耦的 3D 参数空间中构建几何先验，并通过跨源参数融合创建几何锚点。此外，为了在不牺牲真实感的情况下实现最大效率，我们通过一步修正流（one-step rectified flow）利用了视频生成模型的生成先验。我们进一步设计了一种渐进式三阶段训练优化策略，细化结构保真度、纹理重建和分布级真实感，以确保鲁棒的优化。我们还构建了一个大规模 FVR 数据集，以促进鲁棒的训练和标准化评估。大量实验表明，TIGER 在身份保真度和时间稳定性方面均达到了最先进的性能，提供了高质量、高效且身份一致的 FVR。项目页面：https://yzhoulv.github.io/Tiger/。
AI.summary: TIGER 是一个用于高质量人脸视频修复的结构化三重先验融合框架。它通过整合身份先验、几何先验和生成先验，有效解决了身份偏移和时间不一致的问题，并配合特定的三阶段优化策略和大规模数据集，实现了优异的修复效果。
AI.keywords: 人脸视频修复, 身份保持, 几何先验, 生成模型, 时间一致性
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入身份、几何和生成先验的三重融合框架，有效解决了人脸视频修复中的身份偏移和时间一致性难题。其创新点在于将3D几何信息与生成模型结合，并提出了渐进式三阶段训练策略，具有很高的实用价值和学术参考意义。

title: ATRIA: Adaptive Traceable ECG Reporting with Iterative Agents
summary: Existing ECG report generation is tightly coupled -- interpretation and reporting fused end-to-end, so errors propagate without stage-level recourse -- while agent-based systems decouple tasks but remain single-pass, never revisiting earlier outputs. Clinical ECG reporting instead unfolds iteratively, requiring progressive context integration and bidirectional editing. We present \textsc{ATRIA}, a multi-agent ECG reporting system that mirrors the clinician's iterative workflow: it binds every report claim to its supporting evidence, flags statements unsupported by that evidence, incorporates additional context mid-session, and lets clinicians verify and revise individual findings rather than accept one opaque output. Because its agents use ECG analysis models already in clinical use, the underlying findings are clinically trustworthy; and as a cloud-based web service, \textsc{ATRIA} is ready for immediate deployment. We demonstrate \textsc{ATRIA} through four interaction cases, with a live demo and video available.

title: PatternGSL: A Structured Specification Language for Template-Free and Simulation-Ready 3D Garments
summary: Reconstructing realistic, physically plausible garments from a single image remains a fundamental challenge. Template-free methods capture surface geometry but lack explicit sewing structure for simulation; while programmatic systems are simulation-ready but constrained by predefined templates. This reveals a fundamental representation gap between geometric reconstruction and structured garment construction. We present PatternGSL, a structured garment representation in the form of a template-free and learnable specification language that encodes complete sewing patterns, including panel boundaries, parameterized seams, and explicit stitch topology, in a compact and standardized form. PatternGSL preserves the physical rigor of pattern-based models while removing template dependence, elevating sewing structure as a first-class target for generative modeling. We further propose a vision-language framework that predicts PatternGSL specifications directly from a single image and decodes them into garments using lightweight deterministic validity handling, without optimization-based refinement or manual cleanup. In addition, we introduce PatternGSLData, the first large-scale image-to-GSL paired dataset comprising 300K samples with complete sewing pattern annotations, enabling supervised VLM training for structured garment reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate improved pattern accuracy over prior baselines, explicit sewing-structure recovery, reliable cloth simulation, and pattern-level editing through the same deterministic decoding pipeline. Code and data-processing scripts will be released at https://lagrangeli.github.io/PatternGSL/.

title: Vision-Language Model Reasoning for Contextual Semantic Mapping in Intralogistics
comments: Accepted for publication at the 31st IEEE International Conference on Emerging Technologies and Factory Automation (ETFA)
summary: Autonomous mobile robots operating in intralogistics environments rely on geometric maps for localization and navigation, but lack semantic understanding of objects and their contextual properties. We present a contextual semantic mapping pipeline that combines SLAM-based geometric mapping, SAM-based instance segmentation, instance clustering, and VLM multi-view reasoning to produce a contextual semantic map representation encoding geometric structure, object class, and object movability. By aggregating observations across multiple viewpoints and querying a VLM in a zero-shot, open-vocabulary setting, the pipeline infers contextual object properties--here demonstrated through movability--without requiring task-specific training or predefined object categories. We evaluate three VLMs under two prompting strategies and conduct a component-wise analysis of the pipeline. The proposed pipeline achieves 98.93 % mIoU for semantic classification and 89.17 % mAcc for object movability estimation. Component analysis identifies VLM reasoning as the primary bottleneck for contextual understanding and instance clustering as the main limitation for panoptic performance. The resulting semantic map supports context-aware filtering and robust navigation in dynamic intralogistics environments.

title: Real vs. Complex Spectral Bases for Neural Operators: The Role of Green's Function Alignment
comments: Submitted to/in consideration for the 62nd Allerton Conference on Communication, Control, and Computing
summary: Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) learn solution operators of partial differential equations by parameterizing global convolutions in the complex Fourier domain. For real-valued PDE solutions, the complex FFT carries representational redundancy through conjugate symmetry. We introduce the Hartley Neural Operator (HNO), the exact real-valued mirror of FNO: it replaces the FFT with the purely real Discrete Hartley Transform and learns a single real multiplier per retained spectral mode, with no complex arithmetic. Because the real Hartley spectrum is not halved by conjugate symmetry, HNO retains twice as many frequency corners as FNO but one real weight where FNO carries a complex pair, so the two operators are iso-parametric at equal width and differ only in spectral basis. Our central thesis is that the best basis is a property of the operator. Self-adjoint elliptic operators (Poisson, biharmonic) have real, symmetric Green's functions that the real Hartley multiplier diagonalizes exactly, and HNO is favored there. Time-dependent operators carry phase, from oscillation in the wave equation to transport in advection, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, which a real diagonal multiplier cannot represent, so FNO is favored there, and increasingly so with the operator's phase content, leaving the phaseless heat equation as the borderline case. Training both operators identically and benchmarking across PDE classes, initial-condition families, and boundary conditions, we find an elliptic-versus-time-dependent split that is monotone in operator phase content and matches the Green's-function theory we develop. Rather than a universal winner, our findings give a predictive rule: match the spectral basis to the symmetry of the solution operator.

title: Training for the Model You Return: Improving Optimization for Iterate-Averaged Language Models
summary: Many modern Language Model (LM) pipelines return an averaged model, such as an exponential moving average of the training iterates, rather than the final iterate itself. This raises a fundamental question: given that we will return an iterate average, how should we change training to improve the performance of this average? We study this question by formulating optimizer design for the iterate-average estimator as an optimal-control problem. In a continuous-time stochastic quadratic model, we solve for the control strategy that minimizes the error of the returned average subject to a penalty on the size of the intervention. A practical approximation to this controller yields PACE, a lightweight wrapper around AdamW that pulls the live weights toward their exponential moving average with a clipped, per-coordinate control strength. We prove that a stylized version of PACE converges at the standard stochastic convex optimization rate, up to a factor depending on the averaging rule, while in the quadratic setting it can strictly improve the limiting squared error of the iterate-average estimator and can do so by an arbitrarily large factor on some instances. Empirically, our results suggest that PACE improves over AdamW and EMA-evaluated AdamW in supervised fine-tuning of 1-2B parameter LMs and in GPT-2 pretraining on FineWeb for a wide range of learning rates, decay schedules, and other hyperparameters.

title: Efficient and Trainable Language Model Test-Time Scaling via Local Branch Routing
summary: Test-time scaling improves language-model reasoning, but existing approaches often face a difficult trade-off: long chain-of-thought sampling remains single-threaded, while sentence- or solution-level search can be computationally expensive and hard to train end-to-end. We introduce Local Branch Routing (LBR), a token-level test-time scaling framework that expands a small local lookahead tree, forwards all sampled branches through the language model, and uses a lightweight router to select the depth-1 subtree to commit. By routing over the hidden states of candidate local futures, LBR allows each token decision to use evidence beyond the root next-token distribution while avoiding full solution-level search. The resulting prune-shift-grow decoding process preserves discrete branch identities and defines a tractable tree-trajectory likelihood: newly grown nodes are counted when first sampled, and router decisions are assigned explicit probabilities. This enables end-to-end reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, jointly optimizing the base model and router under the same likelihood-ratio principle as discrete-token RLVR. On synthetic hierarchical-planning tasks, LBR shows that post-candidate hidden states provide useful routing evidence. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, LBR improves both Pass@1 and Pass@32 over discrete chain-of-thought, vanilla discrete-token RLVR, and RL-compatible soft-token branching baselines. These results suggest that lightweight local branching offers an efficient, trainable, and discrete form of language-model test-time scaling.

title: Brevity is the Soul of Inference Efficiency: Inducing Concision in VLMs via Data Curation
comments: 36 pages, see https://datologyai.com for more information
summary: Inference efficiency is typically pursued by shrinking the model: distillation, pruning, quantization, and sparse routing each lower per-token cost while treating token count as fixed. But output length has been inflating, and it is precisely the component the standard toolkit leaves untouched. Here, we argue that brevity is the missing inference-efficiency lever, and that pretraining data curation is a practical way to pull it: a model trained on concise, correct data learns to answer in fewer tokens; i.e. it has a lower Cost-of-Pass. We apply our VLM curation pipeline to the MAmmoTH-VL single-image subset, and compare models trained on our curated data, the standard MAmmoTH-VL data, and external open-weight frontier VLMs. On a controlled 20-evaluation set and 14 VLMs at 1B-4B activated parameters, we hold output length fixed with a per-model regression, separating brevity from quality, and price models in FLOPs per correct answer. Curation buys a 35x Cost-of-Pass advantage over the most verbose 4B comparator (Qwen3.5-4B) within $\sim$1 pp of accuracy (0.41 vs 14.58 TFLOPs per correct answer; 0.691 vs 0.704 mean accuracy). Curation also buys a +17.55-percentage-point matched-length accuracy gain over the uncurated baseline that grows with model scale (from +16.7 pp at 1B to +21.2 pp at 4B). This brevity improvement concedes no quality: generic verbosity buys no accuracy at any capability or scale, and the window where reasoning-structured verbosity still earns its tokens shrinks from 4 of 8 capability groups at 2B to 1 of 8 at 4B. Per example, the concise model even reaches correct answers the verbose reasoning model misses, marking reasoning as a distinct curation target rather than something brevity gives up. Inference efficiency in this regime is a tokens-per-correct problem, and brevity is the lever that targets it directly.

title: Quantization Inflates Reasoning: Token Inflation as a Hidden Cost of Low-Bit Reasoning Models
summary: Quantization is widely used to reduce the inference cost of large language models, but its effect on reasoning models is not fully captured by final-answer accuracy or per-token latency. We show that low-bit post-training quantization can introduce a hidden test-time compute cost: quantized reasoning models often generate longer chains of thought even when they still answer correctly. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, scientific question answering, and agentic tool-use benchmarks, we find that INT4/INT3 quantization can preserve accuracy but increase reasoning-token usage, offsetting the expected per-token speedup. To measure this effect, we introduce the CoT Token Inflation Ratio, which compares reasoning length between quantized and full-precision models averaged across all evaluation benchmarks. We further show that token inflation is accompanied by behavioral changes in the reasoning trace, including more intermediate steps and greater semantic repetition. These changes translate into measurable end-to-end real-world serving penalties. Finally, we evaluate mitigation strategies and find that prompting and decoding-time sampling offer inconsistent accuracy-length trade-offs, while quantization-aware training shows more promise in reducing both accuracy degradation and token inflation. Our results suggest that reasoning-token usage should be reported alongside accuracy when evaluating quantized reasoning models.

title: CodeChat-Eval: Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Turn Code Refinement Dialogues
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering to generate and refine code. In practice, developers often continue from an initial code generation request with follow-up refinement instructions, such as requests to improve style, restructure implementation, or change the execution strategy while preserving the intended behaviour. However, existing benchmarks generally omit this multi-turn code refinement dialogue setting and therefore cannot evaluate whether LLMs maintain functional correctness, i.e., whether the refined code still passes the test suite for the original task. To address this limitation, we introduce CodeChat-Eval, an evaluation framework that constructs evaluation sessions from multi-turn code refinement dialogues using a dynamic instruction selection algorithm. Our empirical study on open-weight and proprietary LLMs observes a statistically significant decrease ranging from 19.2% (GPT-5 Nano) to 69.2% (Llama 3.1 8B) in functional correctness over multi-turn refinement. The largest correctness drops are associated with logic-level refinements and additive change requests. These findings indicate that LLMs struggle to maintain functional correctness during multi-turn code refinement dialogues, and highlight the need for benchmarks that evaluate functionality-preserving refinement beyond single-turn generation.

AI.title_translation: CodeChat-Eval：评估大型语言模型在多轮代码细化对话中的表现
AI.tldr: LLMs在多轮代码细化对话中难以保持功能正确性，CodeChat-Eval框架揭示了显著的正确性下降。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试普遍忽略了多轮代码细化对话场景，无法评估LLMs在细化过程中能否保持功能正确性，即细化后的代码是否仍然通过原始任务的测试套件。
AI.method: 本文引入了CodeChat-Eval评估框架，该框架使用动态指令选择算法从多轮代码细化对话中构建评估会话。
AI.result: 对开源和专有LLMs的实证研究发现，在多轮细化过程中，功能正确性显著下降，范围从19.2%（GPT-5 Nano）到69.2%（Llama 3.1 8B）。最大的正确性下降与逻辑级细化和附加更改请求相关。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在多轮代码细化对话中难以保持功能正确性，并强调了需要评估超越单轮生成的保持功能性的细化能力的基准。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在软件工程中越来越多地用于生成和细化代码。在实践中，开发人员通常在初始代码生成请求后继续提出后续细化指令，例如请求改进样式、重构实现或在保留预期行为的同时改变执行策略。然而，现有基准测试普遍忽略了这种多轮代码细化对话设置，因此无法评估LLMs是否保持功能正确性，即细化后的代码是否仍然通过原始任务的测试套件。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了CodeChat-Eval，一个评估框架，它使用动态指令选择算法从多轮代码细化对话中构建评估会话。我们对开源和专有LLMs的实证研究观察到，在多轮细化过程中，功能正确性显著下降，范围从19.2%（GPT-5 Nano）到69.2%（Llama 3.1 8B）。最大的正确性下降与逻辑级细化和附加更改请求相关。这些发现表明，LLMs在多轮代码细化对话中难以保持功能正确性，并强调了需要评估超越单轮生成的保持功能性的细化能力的基准。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了CodeChat-Eval，一个用于评估大型语言模型在多轮代码细化对话中表现的框架。针对现有基准无法衡量LLMs在多轮细化中保持功能正确性的问题，CodeChat-Eval通过动态指令选择构建评估会话。研究发现，LLMs在多轮代码细化中功能正确性显著下降（19.2%至69.2%），尤其是在逻辑级细化和附加更改请求时。这表明LLMs在复杂多轮交互中维护代码功能性存在挑战，亟需新的评估基准。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 代码细化, 多轮对话, 功能正确性, 评估框架
AI.comments: 本文提出了一个重要的评估框架CodeChat-Eval，填补了现有LLM代码生成评估在多轮细化对话方面的空白。其创新之处在于构建了动态指令选择算法来模拟真实的多轮交互，并明确指出LLMs在此场景下功能正确性显著下降。这对于理解LLM在复杂软件开发任务中的局限性及其未来改进方向具有重要意义。

title: On the Encodability of Reversible Process Calculi
comments: Accepted by 37th International Conference on Concurrency Theory (CONCUR), 1-4 September 2026. Funding information updated; other minor changes
summary: Reversibility, allowing one to execute a program not only forwards as usual, but also backwards, has emerged as a fundamental concept in computing, with applications ranging from debugging and fault tolerance to biological and quantum systems. CCSK, a reversible extension of CCS, is a paradigmatic model of reversible concurrent computation. In this paper, we investigate the encodability of CCSK into classical forward-only concurrent models. We establish a separation theorem showing that there is no basic, success-sensitive encoding of CCSK into CCS or the π-calculus, highlighting the strong impact of reversibility on expressive power. We then present an encoding of CCSK processes with only top-level parallel composition into the internal π-calculus, correct up to strong bisimilarity. We also identify a fundamental limitation: no parallel-preserving encoding of CCSK (with arbitrary parallel composition) into the π-calculus can be correct up to strong bisimilarity. Finally, we provide a parallel-preserving encoding correct under a weaker behavioural correspondence: weak mutual simulation. Our findings extend the literature of encodability results to reversible process calculi.

title: MIMFlow: Integrating Masked Image Modeling with Normalizing Flows for End-to-End Image Generation
summary: Normalizing Flows (NFs) are powerful generative models capable of exact density estimation and sampling. However, their strict invertibility often forces the model to exhaust its capacity on low-level pixel details, hindering the capture of high-level semantic structures. While Masked Image Modeling (MIM) has excelled in representation learning, its integration into generative pipelines has remained largely modular and disjointed. In this paper, we propose MIMFlow, a unified end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes latent semantics, pixel reconstruction, and generative flow. By employing a VAE encoder to infer semantic latent from masked images, MIMFlow achieves a principled decoupling of the generative task: the Normalizing Flow focuses on modeling a simplified, low-frequency semantic manifold, while a specialized decoder handles high-frequency synthesis. This design effectively resolves the inherent capacity bottleneck of NFs, allowing the model to prioritize global structural coherence over redundant noise. Empirical results on ImageNet 256$\times$256 show that MIMFlow-L reaches 71.3\% linear probing accuracy and an FID of 2.50. Despite using only 128 tokens (50\% fewer than standard models), it yields a 32.8\% performance gain over similar-scale NF baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/MIMFlow.

title: Hot AI in Cold Space: Thermal-Crosstalk-Aware Scheduling for Sustainable Orbital AI Clusters
comments: Accepted at HotCarbon'26, camera ready version. Code: https://github.com/Sukiiichan/sdc-sim
summary: Terrestrial AI training faces an unsustainable energy and water crisis, positioning Orbital Data Centers (ODCs) as a "zero operational carbon" alternative. However, the sub-$10μ\text{s}$ communication latency required for synchronized scientific workloads, such as distributed Large Language Model (LLM) training, forces ODCs into extreme physical density, triggering a critical "Proximity-Thermal Paradox." As these high-density systems scale into Monolithic Structures or Proximity Swarms, they suffer from intense thermal-fluid crosstalk (heat traps in shared cooling loops) and thermal-radiative crosstalk (mutual heating that blocks deep-space cooling radiators). If left unmitigated, this persistent heat stagnation not only triggers severe thermal throttling that degrades training throughput, but also induces severe thermal fatigue, drastically shortening hardware lifespans and generating premature space e-waste. To make orbital AI truly sustainable, this position paper challenges traditional uniform load-sharing. We propose the Thermal-Aware Heterogeneity Thesis, which treats spatial cooling variances as a primary resource management dimension. Building on this, we introduce Thermal-Load Balancing (TLB), a software framework that dynamically migrates these intensive workloads to the coolest available units based on instantaneous fluid temperatures or absorbed radiation. Our analysis demonstrates that TLB resolves thermal bottlenecks to restore Model Flops Utilization (MFU), while simultaneously reducing physical thermal stress. Extending the operational lifespan of orbital hardware is crucial to amortize the massive embodied carbon of rocket launches, outlining a necessary pathway to scale orbital AI without accelerating e-waste.

title: Expecting (Targeted Ads)? Network Analysis of User Health Data Leakage in Fertility Tracking Apps
summary: While human factors in the privacy of fertility tracking apps -- health trackers that record users' menstrual or pregnancy data -- has been the subject of extensive study, little attention has been paid to the technical aspects of apps' data handling practices. We conduct a network-based measurement study of a corpus of 20 Android fertility tracking apps from the Google Play Store, focusing on how user data is shared with third party advertising services. After systematizing app features, we conduct a series of standardized user interactions across all apps in an environment that records TLS-stripped network traffic. In a subset of apps (n=5) we identify explicit leakage of user health data as well implicit leakage through highly targeted contextual advertising URL's. Equally importantly, we observe additional apps that use an ad-based monetization model without apparent leakage of user data, as well as several apps the interact only minimally with ad services. These findings provide technical grounding for widespread user concerns, but also underscore the importance of consumer choice in the privacy implications of app-based fertility tracking.

AI.title_translation: 期待（定向广告）？生育追踪应用中用户健康数据泄露的网络分析
AI.tldr: 本研究对20款生育追踪应用进行了网络流量分析，发现部分应用存在显式或隐式的健康数据泄露，证实了用户的隐私担忧，并强调了消费者选择合适应用的重要性。
AI.motivation: 尽管关于生育追踪应用隐私中的人为因素已有广泛研究，但这些应用在数据处理实践的技术层面（如数据如何与第三方广告服务共享）却很少受到关注。
AI.method: 对Google Play商店中的20款Android生育追踪应用进行基于网络的测量研究。研究人员首先系统化了应用功能，随后在能够记录TLS剥离（TLS-stripped）网络流量的环境中，对所有应用进行了一系列标准化的用户交互。
AI.result: 在5款应用中发现了显式的用户健康数据泄露，以及通过高度定向的上下文广告URL进行的隐式泄露。同时，也发现部分采用广告变现模式的应用并无明显数据泄露，还有部分应用与广告服务的交互极少。
AI.conclusion: 这些研究结果为公众对生育追踪应用隐私泄露的担忧提供了技术证据，同时也表明并非所有广告变现的应用都会泄露数据，从而强调了消费者在选择应用时对自身隐私保护的重要性。
AI.translation: 虽然生育追踪应用（记录用户经期或怀孕数据的健康追踪器）隐私中的人为因素已得到广泛研究，但这些应用在数据处理实践方面的技术层面却鲜有关注。我们对来自Google Play商店的20款Android生育追踪应用进行了一项基于网络的测量研究，重点关注用户数据是如何与第三方广告服务共享的。在系统化应用功能后，我们在一个记录TLS剥离（TLS-stripped）网络流量的环境中，对所有应用进行了一系列标准化的用户交互。在其中一部分应用（n=5）中，我们发现了用户健康数据的显式泄露，以及通过高度针对性的上下文广告URL进行的隐式泄露。同样重要的是，我们还观察到其他一些使用广告变现模式但没有明显数据泄露的应用，以及几款与广告服务交互极少的应用。这些发现为用户普遍的担忧提供了技术依据，但也强调了在基于应用的生育追踪隐私影响中，消费者选择的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文对20款Android生育追踪应用进行了网络层面的数据泄露测量研究。通过在受控环境中模拟用户交互并分析网络流量，研究发现部分应用存在显式或隐式的用户健康数据泄露行为，而另一些应用则能在使用广告变现的同时较好地保护数据。该研究证实了用户的隐私担忧，并强调了消费者选择在隐私保护中的作用。
AI.keywords: 生育追踪应用, 数据泄露, 网络分析, 隐私保护, 定向广告
AI.comments: 本研究填补了生育追踪应用在技术数据处理和隐私泄露层面的研究空白，具有很强的现实意义。其创新之处在于通过TLS剥离技术对实际网络流量进行测量，揭示了显式和隐式（如通过定向广告URL）的数据泄露路径。局限性在于样本量相对较小（20款Android应用），且未涵盖iOS平台，但其发现为消费者隐私保护和应用选择提供了重要的技术依据。

title: A Distributed Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm Simulator for Engineering Design Optimization
summary: This paper presents a Qiskit-compatible distributed quantum approximate optimization algorithm (DQAOA) simulator for quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problems arising in engineering design and decision applications. The open-source simulator is available through the RAISE LAB website and GitHub repository, with README documentation for installation, input formatting, configurable parameters, and example workflows. The package addresses the need for a reusable simulator that can solve and compare QUBO instances across different QAOA execution modes. It supports monolithic QAOA on a single quantum processing unit (QPU) and distributed QAOA across a user-specified number of QPUs with configurable capacities. The workflow canonicalizes the QUBO model, maps it to a cost Hamiltonian, allocates variables across QPUs, identifies local and cross-QPU couplings, and constructs the corresponding circuits. Runtime optimizations, including parameterized circuit reuse, objective reuse at fixed depth, batched evaluations, and parallel multi-start execution, reduce repeated overhead. A Streamlit graphical user interface is also provided for entering or uploading QUBO instances, configuring solver settings, running selected modes, and visualizing solution-quality metrics without editing Python scripts. The package is demonstrated on standalone QUBO benchmarks and a power generation unit commitment application. In the unit commitment case, brute force, monolithic QAOA, and distributed QAOA recover the same commitment bitstring and operating cost. Across multiple case studies, the simulator produces results consistent with classical monolithic QAOA references in terms of optimal bitstrings and costs. Staged runtime analysis shows substantial runtime reduction across implementation stages, while distributed QAOA remains more demanding because cross-QPU couplings require remote operations.

AI.title_translation: 用于工程设计优化的分布式量子近似优化算法模拟器
AI.tldr: 本文设计并开源了一款兼容Qiskit的分布式QAOA模拟器，支持单QPU和多QPU分布式计算，可高效求解并对比工程设计中的QUBO问题，并提供了Streamlit可视化界面。
AI.motivation: 在工程设计和决策应用中，存在大量的二次无约束二值优化（QUBO）问题。目前亟需一个可重用的模拟器，以便在不同的量子近似优化算法（QAOA）执行模式（如单QPU和多分布式QPU）下，对这些QUBO实例进行求解和比较。
AI.method: 开发了一个兼容Qiskit的DQAOA模拟器。其工作流包括：对QUBO模型进行规范化，将其映射到成本哈密顿量，跨多个QPU分配变量，识别本地和跨QPU的耦合，并构建相应的量子电路。为了减少开销，该模拟器引入了参数化电路重用、固定深度目标重用、批量评估以及并行多起点执行等运行时优化技术，并提供了一个基于Streamlit的图形用户界面。
AI.result: 该模拟器在独立QUBO基准测试和发电单元组合应用中得到了验证。在单元组合案例中，暴力求解、单机QAOA和分布式QAOA均得到了相同的最优比特串和运行成本，且结果与经典单机QAOA基准一致。阶段性运行分析显示，优化措施大幅减少了运行时间，但由于跨QPU耦合需要远程操作，分布式QAOA的计算需求仍然更高。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发并开源了一个兼容Qiskit的分布式QAOA模拟器，为求解工程设计中的QUBO问题提供了可重用的工具。尽管分布式模式由于跨QPU耦合而带来更高的计算需求，但该模拟器在单机和分布式模式下均能提供与经典QAOA一致的优化结果，且通过多阶段优化显著降低了运行时间。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一种兼容Qiskit的分布式量子近似优化算法（DQAOA）模拟器，用于解决工程设计和决策应用中出现的二次无约束二值优化（QUBO）问题。该开源模拟器可通过RAISE LAB网站和GitHub仓库获取，并配有关于安装、输入格式、可配置参数和示例工作流的README文档。该软件包解决了对可重用模拟器的需求，该模拟器可以跨不同的QAOA执行模式求解并比较QUBO实例。它支持在单个量子处理单元（QPU）上运行的单体QAOA，以及在用户指定数量且具有可配置容量的QPU上运行的分布式QAOA。其工作流规范化了QUBO模型，将其映射到成本哈密顿量，跨QPU分配变量，识别本地和跨QPU的耦合，并构建相应的电路。包括参数化电路重用、固定深度下的目标重用、批量评估和并行多起点执行在内的运行时优化减少了重复开销。此外，还提供了一个Streamlit图形用户界面，用于输入或上传QUBO实例、配置求解器设置、运行选定模式，并在无需编辑Python脚本的情况下可视化求解质量指标。该软件包在独立QUBO基准测试和发电单元组合应用中进行了演示。在单元组合案例中，暴力求解、单体QAOA和分布式QAOA恢复了相同的组合比特串和运行成本。在多个案例研究中，该模拟器产生的结果在最优比特串和成本方面与经典单体QAOA参考一致。阶段性运行时分析表明，各实现阶段的运行时间大幅减少，而分布式QAOA由于跨QPU耦合需要远程操作，因此计算需求更高。
AI.summary: 本文推出了一款开源且兼容Qiskit的分布式量子近似优化算法（DQAOA）模拟器，专门用于求解工程设计与决策中的QUBO问题。该模拟器支持单QPU及多QPU分布式运行模式，并配备了多种运行时优化方案和Streamlit图形界面。测试表明，其在基准测试和实际发电单元组合应用中均能取得与传统单机QAOA一致的精确结果。
AI.keywords: 分布式量子近似优化算法 (DQAOA), 二次无约束二值优化 (QUBO), 量子模拟器, 工程设计优化, Qiskit
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将分布式QAOA（DQAOA）算法实用化、工程化，设计了完整的变量分配与跨QPU耦合识别机制，并结合了多项运行时优化技术（如电路重用、并行多起点执行等）以及直观的GUI界面。其重要性在于为工程设计领域的QUBO问题提供了一个开源、可重用的量子模拟基准工具。局限性在于，正如摘要所述，由于跨QPU耦合需要远程操作，分布式QAOA的运行开销和计算需求仍然显著高于单机模式，这在实际硬件受限时可能是一个瓶颈。

title: DinoLink: A Token-Centric Representation Compression Framework for Bandwidth-Constrained Collaborative V2X Perception
summary: High-precision remote perception is often hindered by the severe bandwidth constraints of Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) networks. We propose \textit{DinoLink}, a token-centric compression framework that replaces raw pixel streaming with discrete semantic communication for vehicle-cloud collaborative inference. DinoLink employs a dual-sparsity architecture: a saliency-aware selector prunes redundant background tokens, while a Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ) module collapses features into compact codebook indices. By transmitting only lightweight indices and positional priors, DinoLink achieves a $139\times$ bitrate reduction compared to uncompressed transmission while maintaining a competitive 32.8\% mAP on the nuScenes dataset. Deployment simulations further demonstrate a $34.5\times$ acceleration in narrow-band environments, such as LoRa. Our results substantiate DinoLink as a robust, bandwidth-efficient frontend for high-fidelity remote perception in constrained V2X scenarios. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/UGA-MOBILITY-LAB/dino_link.

title: Nemotron-Labs-TwoTower: Diffusion Language Modeling with Pretrained Autoregressive Context
comments: Code and model weights available at https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/nemotron-labs-twotower
summary: Diffusion language models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive models due to their potential for parallel and iterative generation. However, existing approaches use a single network for both context representation and iterative denoising, forcing one model to serve both roles and limiting its capacity for either role. We propose TwoTower, a block-wise autoregressive diffusion model that decouples these roles into two towers: a frozen AR context tower that causally processes clean tokens, and a trainable diffusion denoiser tower with bidirectional block attention that refines noisy blocks via cross-attention to the context. Built on Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B, an open-weight 30B hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE model, and trained on approximately 2.1T tokens, Nemotron-Labs-TwoTower retains 98.7% of the autoregressive baseline's quality while offering 2.42X higher wall-clock generation throughput. We release the code and model weights at https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/nemotron-labs-twotower.
comment: Code and model weights available at https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/nemotron-labs-twotower

title: Clinical Harness for Governable Medical AI Skill Ecosystems
summary: Medical AI remains organized around isolated models, whereas care requires accountable capabilities that persist across time. We define clinical AI skills and propose the Clinical Harness, a runtime governance architecture that registers, orchestrates, constrains and monitors them. Using osteoporosis as an exemplar, we show how knowledge-driven, data-driven and physics-enhanced skills can support lifecycle care and provide a governed substrate for future medical agents.

AI.title_translation: 用于可治理医疗AI技能生态系统的临床线束
AI.tldr: 该论文定义了临床AI技能，并提出了临床线束（一种运行时治理架构），用于注册、编排、约束和监控这些技能，以解决当前医疗AI模型孤立的问题，并为未来的医疗代理提供受治理的基础。
AI.motivation: 目前的医疗AI仍然围绕孤立的模型组织，而医疗护理需要可问责且能持续存在的能力。
AI.method: 定义了临床AI技能，并提出了临床线束（Clinical Harness），这是一种运行时治理架构，用于注册、编排、约束和监控这些技能。
AI.result: 以骨质疏松症为例，展示了知识驱动、数据驱动和物理增强的技能如何支持生命周期护理，并为未来的医疗代理提供一个受治理的基础。
AI.conclusion: 临床线束为未来的医疗代理提供了一个受治理的基础，能够支持生命周期护理。
AI.translation: 医疗AI仍然围绕孤立的模型组织，而医疗护理需要可问责且能持续存在的能力。我们定义了临床AI技能，并提出了临床线束，这是一种运行时治理架构，用于注册、编排、约束和监控这些技能。以骨质疏松症为例，我们展示了知识驱动、数据驱动和物理增强的技能如何支持生命周期护理，并为未来的医疗代理提供一个受治理的基础。
AI.summary: 该论文旨在解决当前医疗AI模型孤立的局限性，提出了“临床AI技能”的概念，并设计了“临床线束”这一运行时治理架构。临床线束能够注册、编排、约束和监控这些技能，从而为医疗护理提供可问责且持续的能力。通过骨质疏松症的案例，研究展示了结合知识、数据和物理增强的技能如何支持全生命周期护理，并为未来医疗智能体构建了一个受治理的底层平台。
AI.keywords: 医疗AI, 临床线束, AI技能, 治理架构, 医疗代理
AI.comments: 该论文提出了“临床线束”这一创新概念，旨在解决医疗AI领域中模型孤立和缺乏持续治理能力的问题。其重要性在于为构建一个可问责、可信赖且能支持全生命周期护理的医疗AI生态系统提供了架构基础，特别强调了技能的注册、编排、约束和监控，这对于医疗AI的实际应用和推广至关重要。将知识驱动、数据驱动和物理增强技能相结合的思路也颇具前瞻性。

title: Mask to Concept: Auto-Promptable SAM3 via Efficient Test-Time Concept Embedding Search for Few-Shot Annotation
summary: Transforming foundation segmentation models from human-prompted tools into auto-promptable annotators is critical for scalable medical data annotation. Current methods commonly depend on external feature matchers or auxiliary networks to automate geometric prompting, but introducing architectural overhead and limiting performance scalability.
