AI.title_translation: 利用傅里叶神经算子实现质子治疗中的快速质子输运与中子产生预测
AI.tldr: 利用傅里叶神经算子（FNO）构建代理模型，能以秒级速度准确模拟质子治疗中的中子产生和质子输运，比蒙特卡洛模拟快得多。
AI.motivation: 现有的蒙特卡洛模拟方法在质子治疗实时射程验证中计算成本过高，无法满足实时性需求。
AI.method: 将受照射体模和质子束状态视为深度演化序列，采用自回归方式训练傅里叶神经算子（FNO），学习质子和产生的中子在空间、角度和能量相空间分布的变化。
AI.result: 该模型在质子和中子分布预测上分别达到了0.067和0.137的平均相对L2误差，空间分布的Gamma通过率均超过99%，单束流推理时间平均为23.17秒。
AI.conclusion: 基于FNO的代理模型能够以极快的速度准确预测质子治疗中的质子输运和中子产生，具备替代昂贵蒙特卡洛计算的潜力，适用于实时射程验证。
AI.translation: 目标：基于产生的中子进行实时自适应质子射程验证系统，需要在短时间内获取其非各向同性动量分布的准确信息，而蒙特卡洛（MC）方法计算成本过高。我们提出了一种基于傅里叶神经算子（FNO）的代理模型，用于快速预测质子治疗中的角度和能量分辨的质子输运及中子产生。方法：我们将受照射体模和质子束状态分别视为不同材料的深度演化序列，以及空间、角度和能量相空间密度分布。该任务通过学习质子和产生的中子分布变化，以自回归方式解决。为了训练和评估，我们生成了两个包含不同初始强度的47次MC模拟数据集。模拟几何结构从胸部CT扫描中提取，作为横向均匀材料序列。主要结果：预测的质子和中子分布的平均相对L2差异分别为0.067和0.137。这对应于空间分布中99.95%和99.40%的平均Gamma通过率。使用更高的初始强度进行训练，密度指标提升了12%至30%。在0.5毫米分辨率下，40厘米深度的推理平均每束流需要23.17秒。意义：所提出的质子束代理模型能在几秒钟内生成具有MC级精度的中子空间和动量分布，同时展示了对受照几何结构和束流特征的稳健泛化能力。该方法可用于射程验证系统的原型设计和运行、中子剂量估计等其他任务，并可扩展至包括其他类型的二次发射。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于傅里叶神经算子（FNO）的代理模型，用于快速预测质子治疗中的质子输运和中子产生。该模型通过学习深度演化的相空间分布，在保持高精度的前提下，显著缩短了模拟时间，为实时射程验证提供了高效的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 质子治疗, 傅里叶神经算子, 中子产生, 射程验证, 蒙特卡洛加速
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入傅里叶神经算子（FNO）解决了质子治疗中实时射程验证的计算瓶颈。其创新点在于将质子输运和中子产生过程建模为深度演化的序列问题，利用FNO在处理偏微分方程方面的优势，在保持接近蒙特卡洛模拟精度的同时，实现了数量级的速度提升。这为临床实时应用提供了极具潜力的工具。

title: On the Expressive Power of Inquisitive Team Logic and Inquisitive First-Order Logic
summary: Inquisitive team logic is a variant of inquisitive logic interpreted in team semantics, which has been argued to provide a natural setting for the regimentation of dependence claims. With respect to sentences, this logic is known to be expressively equivalent with first-order logic. In this article we show that, on the contrary, the expressive power of open formulas in this logic properly exceeds that of first-order logic. On the way to this result, we show that if inquisitive team logic is extended with the range-generating universal quantifier adopted in dependence logic, the resulting logic can express finiteness; as a consequence, this logic is not compact and has non-arithmetic complexity. We further extend our results to standard inquisitive first-order logic, showing that some sentences of this logic express non first-order properties of models, thus settling an open problem from the literature.

title: Transition from Statistical to Hardware-Limited Scaling in Photonic Quantum State Reconstruction
summary: The theoretical efficiency of classical shadow tomography is predicated on a perfect Haar-random unitary ensemble, yet this mathematical ideal remains physically unattainable in near-term hardware. Here, we report the experimental discovery of a fundamental accuracy bound on integrated photonic processors: a ``Hardware Horizon'' where the reconstruction error undergoes a sharp phase transition. While the error initially obeys the predicted statistical scaling $\mathcal{O}(M^{-1/2})$, it abruptly saturates at a floor determined by the spectral distortions of the realized unitary group. By deriving a phenomenological error model, we decouple the competing mechanisms of static coherent spectral distortion and dynamic decoherence, demonstrating that this intrinsic noise floor imposes a hard bound that statistical accumulation cannot overcome. These findings establish that the utility of shadow tomography on NISQ (noisy intermediate-scale quantum) hardware is defined by a specific scaling law involving hardware parameters, necessitating active compensation strategies to bridge the gap between theoretical purity and the noisy reality of integrated photonics.

title: LLM-as-a-judge validity in physics assessment depends more on the task than the model
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for automated assessment and feedback, understanding when LLM marking is valid is essential. We evaluate LLM-as-a-judge marking across three physics assessment formats - structured questions, written essays, and scientific plots - comparing GPT-5.2, Grok 4.1, Claude Opus 4.5, DeepSeek-V3.2, Gemini Pro 3, and committee aggregations against human markers under blind, solution-provided, false-solution, and anchored conditions. We distinguish absolute accuracy from rank-order agreement, since a marking system can match the distribution of human marks while failing to order responses by quality. Across task types, performance is sharply task-dependent. For blind university exam questions ($n=771$) and secondary and university structured questions ($n=1151$), models show robust rank-order agreement with human markers (Spearman $ρ> 0.6$), with official solutions reducing error and strengthening agreement. False solutions degrade absolute accuracy, showing that models defer to provided references, but leave rank-ordering intact. Essay marking behaves fundamentally differently. Across $n=55$ scripts ($n=275$ essays), blind AI marking is harsher and more variable than human marking and adding a mark scheme does not improve rank-order agreement. Anchored exemplars shift the AI mean close to the human mean and compress variance below the human standard deviation, but rank-order agreement remains near-zero. For code-based plot elements ($n=1400$), models achieve high rank-order agreement ($ρ> 0.84$) with near-linear calibration. Across all task types, validity tracks the structure of the assessment task - the extent to which marks can be mapped to explicit, observable grading features - and the reliability of the human benchmark, rather than raw model capability.

AI.title_translation: 物理评估中“LLM作为裁判”的有效性更多地取决于任务而非模型
AI.tldr: 研究表明，LLM作为物理评分裁判的有效性主要取决于评估任务的结构和人类基准的可靠性：在结构化问题和图表任务中LLM与人类评分高度一致，但在论文评分中表现极差。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被考虑用于自动化评估和反馈，亟需深入理解在何种条件下LLM的自动评分才是有效且可信的。
AI.method: 在盲评（blind）、提供标准答案（solution-provided）、提供错误答案（false-solution）和提供锚定范例（anchored）四种条件下，对比了多种模型（GPT-5.2、Grok 4.1、Claude Opus 4.5、DeepSeek-V3.2、Gemini Pro 3及委员会聚合）与人类评分者在三种物理评估格式（结构化问题、书面论文、科学图表）上的评分表现，并区分了“绝对准确性”与“排序一致性”。
AI.result: 1）对于结构化问题，模型与人类评分者展现出强大的排序一致性（Spearman ρ > 0.6），标准答案可减少误差，错误答案虽降低绝对准确性但保留了排序；2）对于论文评分，盲评AI比人类更严苛且波动更大，提供评分标准无法改善排序一致性，锚定范例虽能拉近均值并压缩方差，但排序一致性仍接近于零；3）对于科学图表元素，模型实现了极高的排序一致性（ρ > 0.84）和近乎线性的校准。
AI.conclusion: LLM作为裁判在物理评估中的有效性高度取决于评估任务的结构（即评分能否映射到明确、可观察的特征上）以及人类基准的可靠性，而非模型本身的原始能力。在结构化和图表任务中LLM表现优秀，但在论文等主观评估中，其排序一致性极低。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被考虑用于自动评估和反馈，理解LLM评分在何时有效至关重要。我们在盲评、提供标准答案、提供错误答案和锚定条件下，评估了LLM作为裁判在三种物理评估格式（结构化问题、书面论文和科学图表）中的评分表现，并将GPT-5.2、Grok 4.1、Claude Opus 4.5、DeepSeek-V3.2、Gemini Pro 3以及委员会聚合与人类评分员进行了对比。我们区分了绝对准确性与排序一致性，因为评分系统可能与人类评分的分布相匹配，但无法按质量对回答进行排序。在不同任务类型中，其表现表现出强烈的任务依赖性。对于盲评大学考试题（n=771）以及中学和大学结构化问题（n=1151），模型与人类评分员表现出强大的排序一致性（Spearman ρ > 0.6），官方解决方案减少了误差并增强了一致性。错误解决方案降低了绝对准确性，表明模型顺从了提供的参考，但保留了排序。论文评分的表现则根本不同。在55份手稿（275篇论文）中，盲评AI评分比人类评分更严苛且变化更大，添加评分方案并不能提高排序一致性。锚定范例使AI均值接近人类均值并压缩了方差使其低于人类标准差，但排序一致性仍接近于零。对于基于代码的图表元素（n=1400），模型实现了高度的排序一致性（ρ > 0.84）并具有近乎线性的校准。在所有任务类型中，有效性取决于评估任务的结构——即评分在多大程度上可以映射到明确、可观察的评分特征——以及人类基准的可靠性，而不是模型的原始能力。
AI.summary: 本文评估了多种先进LLM在三种物理评估任务（结构化问题、书面论文和科学图表）中作为裁判的有效性。研究表明，LLM的评分表现具有强烈的任务依赖性。在结构化问题和图表评估中，LLM与人类评分具有高度的排序一致性；而在论文评估中，LLM表现较差，即使提供评分方案或锚定范例也无法有效提高排序一致性。研究指出，评估的有效性取决于任务的结构化程度和人类基准的可靠性，而非模型自身的 raw capability。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型裁判, 物理评估, 任务依赖性, 评分有效性, 排序一致性
AI.comments: 本研究的创新之处在于其不仅对比了多种最先进的LLM，更系统地探讨了“任务结构”（结构化问题、图表 vs. 论文）和“参考条件”（盲评、标准答案、错误答案、锚定）对LLM评分有效性的影响。区分“绝对准确性”与“排序一致性”为评估AI裁判能力提供了更科学的维度。其局限性在于，研究仅限于物理这一高度结构化的学科，且摘要中提及的某些模型版本（如GPT-5.2、Grok 4.1等）在当前公开市场中的命名可能属于超前或特定评估版本，结论在人文社科等极具主观性领域的适用性仍待验证。

title: Structured SIR: Efficient and Expressive Importance-Weighted Inference for High-Dimensional Image Registration
summary: Image registration is an ill-posed dense vision task, where multiple solutions achieve similar loss values, motivating probabilistic inference. Variational inference has previously been employed to capture these distributions, however restrictive assumptions about the posterior form can lead to poor characterisation, overconfidence and low-quality samples. More flexible posteriors are typically bottlenecked by the complexity of high-dimensional covariance matrices required for dense 3D image registration. In this work, we present a memory and computationally efficient inference method, Structured SIR, that enables expressive, multi-modal, characterisation of uncertainty with high quality samples. We propose the use of a Sampled Importance Resampling (SIR) algorithm with a novel memory-efficient high-dimensional covariance parameterisation as the sum of a low-rank covariance and a sparse, spatially structured Cholesky precision factor. This structure enables capturing complex spatial correlations while remaining computationally tractable. We evaluate the efficacy of this approach in 3D dense image registration of brain MRI data, which is a very high-dimensional problem. We demonstrate that our proposed method produces uncertainty estimates that are significantly better calibrated than those produced by variational methods, achieving equivalent or better accuracy. Crucially, we show that the model yields highly structured multi-modal posterior distributions, enable effective and efficient uncertainty quantification.

AI.title_translation: Structured SIR：针对高维图像配准的高效且具表现力的重要性权重推理
AI.tldr: 本文提出Structured SIR方法，通过结合低秩协方差与稀疏空间结构化Cholesky精度因子，实现了在3D脑部MRI配准中高效、准确且校准良好的多模态不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 图像配准是一个病态的密集视觉任务，需要概率推理。然而，现有的变分推理方法对后验形式的限制性假设会导致表征不佳、过度自信和样本质量低；而更灵活的后验分布则受限于密集3D图像配准中高维协方差矩阵极高的计算和内存复杂度。
AI.method: 提出一种名为Structured SIR的推理方法。该方法采用样本重要性重采样（SIR）算法，并引入了一种新型的内存高效的高维协方差参数化方法，将其表示为低秩协方差与稀疏、空间结构化Cholesky精度因子之和，从而在保持计算可行性的同时捕获复杂的空间相关性。
AI.result: 在脑部MRI数据的3D密集图像配准任务中，该方法产生的不确定性估计比变分方法校准得明显更好，同时达到了等同或更好的配准准确度，并能够生成高度结构化的多模态后验分布。
AI.conclusion: Structured SIR模型能够提供高度结构化的多模态后验分布，在保持高维图像配准精度的同时，实现了更有效且高效的不确定性量化，克服了传统变分方法的局限性。
AI.translation: 图像配准是一个病态的密集视觉任务，其中多个解可达到相似的损失值，这激发了概率推理的需求。此前，变分推理已被用于捕获这些分布，然而，对后验形式的限制性假设可能导致表征不佳、过度自信以及低质量的样本。更灵活的后验分布通常会受到密集3D图像配准所需的高维协方差矩阵复杂度的瓶颈限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种内存和计算高效的推理方法——结构化SIR（Structured SIR），它能够通过高质量样本实现对不确定性的表达性、多模态表征。我们建议使用样本重要性重采样（SIR）算法，并结合一种新型的、内存高效的高维协方差参数化方法，该方法表示为低秩协方差与稀疏、空间结构化Cholesky精度因子之和。这种结构能够在保持计算可行性的同时，捕获复杂的空间相关性。我们在脑部MRI数据的3D密集图像配准（这是一个非常高维的问题）中评估了该方法的有效性。我们表明，与变分方法产生的不确定性估计相比，我们提出的方法产生的不确定性估计校准得明显更好，同时达到了等同或更好的准确度。至关重要的是，我们表明该模型产生了高度结构化的多模态后验分布，从而实现了有效且高效的不确定性量化。
AI.summary: 本文针对高维3D图像配准中的不确定性估计问题，提出了一种高效且具表现力的推理方法——Structured SIR。该方法通过将高维协方差参数化为低秩协方差与稀疏、空间结构化Cholesky精度因子之和，克服了传统变分推理在处理高维协方差时的计算瓶颈。在脑部MRI配准实验中，该方法在保证配准精度的同时，显著提升了不确定性估计的校准质量，并能有效捕捉多模态后验分布。
AI.keywords: 图像配准, 样本重要性重采样, 不确定性量化, 高维推理, 脑部MRI
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种新颖的协方差参数化方法，将低秩协方差与稀疏、空间结构化的Cholesky精度因子相结合，巧妙地解决了高维3D图像配准中协方差矩阵计算和内存开销巨大的痛点。该方法成功克服了传统变分推理（VI）由于强假设导致的不确定性估计过度自信和样本质量低的问题。局限性方面，虽然引入了重采样，但在极高维空间中，重要性采样仍可能面临粒子退化的问题，其在更大规模或更具挑战性的多模态配准任务中的泛化能力仍有待进一步验证。

title: Relational Semantics for Flat Heyting-Lewis Logic
summary: We introduce relational semantics for "flat Heyting-Lewis logic" HLC-flat. This logic arises as the extension of intuitionistic logic with a Lewis-style strict implication modality that, contrary to its "sharp" counterpart HLC-sharp, does not turn meets into joins in its first argument. We prove completeness and the finite model property for HLC-flat and for several extensions with additional axioms.

AI.title_translation: 平坦海廷-刘易斯逻辑的关系语义
AI.tldr: 本文为“平坦海廷-刘易斯逻辑”HLC-flat引入了关系语义，并证明了其完备性和有限模型性质。
AI.motivation: 引入一种新的逻辑HLC-flat，它扩展了直觉逻辑并具有独特的刘易斯式严格蕴涵模态，与HLC-sharp不同，其不将其第一个参数中的交转换为并。
AI.method: 引入了“平坦海廷-刘易斯逻辑”HLC-flat的关系语义。
AI.result: 证明了HLC-flat及其几个带有附加公理的扩展的完备性和有限模型性质。
AI.conclusion: 成功为HLC-flat及其扩展建立了关系语义，并证明了关键的逻辑性质，如完备性和有限模型性质。
AI.translation: 我们为“平坦海廷-刘易斯逻辑”HLC-flat引入了关系语义。这种逻辑是直觉逻辑的扩展，带有一个刘易斯式的严格蕴涵模态，与它的“尖锐”对应物HLC-sharp不同，它不会将其第一个参数中的交转换为并。我们证明了HLC-flat以及几个带有附加公理的扩展的完备性和有限模型性质。
AI.summary: 本文为“平坦海廷-刘易斯逻辑”HLC-flat引入了关系语义。HLC-flat是直觉逻辑的扩展，具有一种独特的刘易斯式严格蕴涵模态，其特点是不会将交转换为并。研究证明了HLC-flat及其带有附加公理的扩展的完备性和有限模型性质。
AI.keywords: 关系语义, 平坦海廷-刘易斯逻辑, HLC-flat, 完备性, 有限模型性质
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入关系语义为HLC-flat这种新型逻辑奠定了理论基础，并证明了其重要的元逻辑性质，对非经典逻辑领域具有贡献。

title: When does learning pay off? A study on DRL-based dynamic algorithm configuration for carbon-aware scheduling
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has recently emerged as a promising tool for Dynamic Algorithm Configuration (DAC), enabling evolutionary algorithms to adapt their parameters online rather than relying on static tuned configurations. While DRL can learn effective control policies, training is computationally expensive. This cost may be justified if learned policies generalize, allowing the training effort to transfer across instance types and problem scales. Yet, for real-world optimization problems, it remains unclear whether this promise holds in practice and under which conditions the investment in learning pays off. In this work, we investigate this question in the context of the carbon-aware permutation flow-shop scheduling problem. We develop a DRL-based DAC framework and train it exclusively on small, simple instances. We then deploy the learned policy on both similar and more complex unseen instances and compare its performance against a static tuned baseline, which provides a fair point of comparison. Our findings show that the proposed method provides a strong dynamic algorithm control policy that can be effectively transferred to different unseen problem instances. Notably, on simple and cheap to compute instances, similar to those observed during training and tuning, DRL performs comparably with the statically tuned baseline. However, as instance characteristics diverge and computational complexities increase, the DRL-learned policy continuously outperforms static tuning. These results confirm that DRL can acquire robust and generalizable control policies which are effective beyond the training instance distributions. This ability to generalize across instance types makes the initial computational investment worthwhile, particularly in settings where static tuning struggles to adapt to changing problem scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 学习何时能带来回报？一项基于DRL的碳感知调度动态算法配置研究
AI.tldr: 基于DRL的动态算法配置（DAC）在碳感知调度中显示出在未见复杂实例上的泛化能力，优于静态调优，从而证明了训练成本的合理性。
AI.motivation: 研究深度强化学习（DRL）在动态算法配置（DAC）中的计算成本是否能通过其在不同实例类型和问题规模上的泛化能力得到证明，特别是在碳感知调度等现实世界优化问题中。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于DRL的DAC框架，仅在碳感知置换流水车间调度问题的小型、简单实例上进行训练，然后将学习到的策略部署到类似和更复杂的未见实例上，并与静态调优基线进行性能比较。
AI.result: DRL-based DAC提供了一个强大且可迁移的动态算法控制策略。在与训练相似的简单实例上，DRL与静态调优表现相当；但随着实例特征分化和计算复杂性增加，DRL学习到的策略持续优于静态调优。
AI.conclusion: DRL能够获得鲁棒且具有泛化能力的控制策略，其有效性超越了训练实例分布，使得初始计算投资是值得的，尤其是在静态调优难以适应不断变化的问题场景时。
AI.translation: 深度强化学习（DRL）最近已成为动态算法配置（DAC）的一个有前景的工具，它使进化算法能够在线调整其参数，而不是依赖静态调优配置。虽然DRL可以学习有效的控制策略，但训练计算成本高昂。如果学习到的策略具有泛化能力，能够将训练工作转移到不同实例类型和问题规模上，那么这种成本可能是合理的。然而，对于现实世界的优化问题，这种承诺在实践中是否成立以及在何种条件下学习的投入能带来回报，仍然不清楚。在这项工作中，我们针对碳感知置换流水车间调度问题，研究了这个问题。我们开发了一个基于DRL的DAC框架，并仅在小型、简单实例上进行训练。然后，我们将学习到的策略部署到类似和更复杂的未见实例上，并将其性能与静态调优基线进行比较，这提供了一个公平的比较点。我们的研究结果表明，所提出的方法提供了一个强大的动态算法控制策略，可以有效地转移到不同的未见问题实例上。值得注意的是，在与训练和调优期间观察到的实例相似的简单且计算成本低的实例上，DRL与静态调优基线表现相当。然而，随着实例特征的分化和计算复杂性的增加，DRL学习到的策略持续优于静态调优。这些结果证实，DRL可以获得鲁棒且具有泛化能力的控制策略，其有效性超越了训练实例分布。这种跨实例类型泛化的能力使得初始计算投资是值得的，特别是在静态调优难以适应不断变化的问题场景的环境中。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了深度强化学习（DRL）在碳感知调度动态算法配置（DAC）中的实际价值。通过在一个基于DRL的DAC框架上，在简单实例上进行训练，并在各种未见实例上进行测试，研究表明DRL策略能够有效泛化。虽然DRL在简单实例上与静态调优表现相似，但在更复杂和差异更大的实例上，它始终优于静态调优，从而通过其强大的泛化能力证明了高昂训练成本的合理性。
AI.keywords: 深度强化学习, 动态算法配置, 碳感知调度, 泛化能力, 计算成本
AI.comments: 该论文解决了DRL在实际优化中成本效益的关键问题。其发现DRL在训练数据之外具有良好的泛化能力，尤其是在静态方法失效的复杂场景中，突显了其在现实世界应用中的潜力。与静态基线在不同实例复杂性上的比较方法是合理且有效的。

title: Handicap reduction for linear complementarity problems
summary:
Linear Complementarity Problems (LCPs) with sufficient matrices form an important subclass of LCPs, and it remains a significant open question whether problems in this class can be solved in polynomial time. Kojima, Megiddo, Noma, and Yoshise gave an Interior Point Algorithm (IPA) in 1991, that can solve LCPs with sufficient matrices in time bounded polynomially in the input size and the so-called handicap number $\hatκ(M)$ of the coefficient matrix $M$. However, this value can be exponentially large in the bit encoding length. In fact, no upper bounds were previously known on $\hatκ(M)$. Settling an open question raised in de Klerk and E.-Nagy (Math Programming, 2011), we give an exponential upper bound on $\hatκ(M)$ in the bit-complexity of $M$. This is based on a new characterization of sufficient matrices. The new characterization also leads to a simple new proof of Väliaho's theorem on the equivalence of sufficient and $\mathcal{P}^*$-matrices (Linear Algebra and its Applications, 1996).
  Noting that one can obtain an equivalent LCP by rescaling the rows and columns by a positive diagonal matrix, we define $\hatκ^\star(M)$ as the best possible handicap number achievable under such rescalings. Our second main result is an algorithm for LCPs with sufficient matrices, where the running time is polynomially bounded in the input size and in the optimized value $\hatκ^\star(M)$. This algorithm is based on the observation that the set of near-optimal row-rescalings forms a convex set. Our algorithm combines the Ellipsoid Method over the set of row rescalings, and an IPA with running time dependent on the handicap number of the matrix. If the IPA fails to solve the LCP in the desired running time, it provides a separation oracle to the Ellipsoid Method to find a better rescaling.

AI.title_translation: 线性互补问题的障碍数降低
AI.tldr: 本文为线性互补问题（LCP）中充分矩阵的障碍数首次给出了指数上界，并提出了一种结合椭球法和内点法的混合算法，通过矩阵重标度来降低障碍数，从而在多项式及优化后的障碍数时间内求解该问题。
AI.motivation: 具有充分矩阵（sufficient matrices）的线性互补问题（LCP）是否能在多项式时间内求解是一个重大的开放问题。现有的内点算法（IPA）的运行时间受限于系数矩阵的障碍数 $\hat{\kappa}(M)$，而该值可能随比特编码长度呈指数增长，且此前没有任何关于其上界的已知结论。此外，如何通过重标度来降低这一障碍数以加速求解也是一个亟待解决的问题。
AI.method:
1. 基于对充分矩阵的一种新刻画，推导出障碍数 $\hat{\kappa}(M)$ 在比特复杂度下的指数上界。
2. 定义了在正对角矩阵重标度下可能达到的最佳障碍数 $\hat{\kappa}^\star(M)$。
3. 提出了一种结合椭球法（Ellipsoid Method）和内点法（IPA）的新算法。该算法基于“近似最优行重标度集合构成凸集”的性质，在行重标度空间上运行椭球法；若内点法在期望时间内未能求解，则为椭球法提供一个分离oracle以寻找更好的重标度。
AI.result:
1. 解决了 de Klerk 和 E.-Nagy (2011) 提出的开放问题，给出了 $\hat{\kappa}(M)$ 在 $M$ 的比特复杂度下的指数上界。
2. 针对充分矩阵的等价性定理（Väliaho定理）提供了一个简单的新证明。
3. 提出了一种求解具有充分矩阵的LCP的新算法，其运行时间在输入规模和优化后的障碍数 $\hat{\kappa}^\star(M)$ 上呈多项式有界。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入充分矩阵的新刻画和重标度技术，成功为LCP的障碍数确立了理论上界，并设计出一种能够有效降低障碍数从而提高求解效率的混合算法，为解决具有充分矩阵的LCP的多项式时间可解性提供了新的途径。
AI.translation:
具有充分矩阵（sufficient matrices）的线性互补问题（LCP）是LCP的一个重要子类，而该类问题是否能在多项式时间内求解仍然是一个重大的开放问题。Kojima、Megiddo、Noma和Yoshise在1991年提出了一种内点算法（IPA），该算法可以在与输入规模以及系数矩阵 $M$ 的所谓“障碍数”（handicap number） $\hat{\kappa}(M)$ 呈多项式有界的运行时间内求解具有充分矩阵的LCP。然而，这个障碍数在比特编码长度上可能会呈指数级巨大。事实上，此前关于 $\hat{\kappa}(M)$ 的上界一无所知。为了解决 de Klerk 和 E.-Nagy（Math Programming, 2011）提出的一个开放问题，我们基于充分矩阵的一种新刻画，给出了 $\hat{\kappa}(M)$ 在 $M$ 的比特复杂度下的指数上界。这种新刻画还为 Väliaho 关于充分矩阵与 $\mathcal{P}^*$-矩阵等价性的定理（Linear Algebra and its Applications, 1996）提供了一个简单的新证明。
考虑到可以通过用正对角矩阵对行和列进行重标度来获得等价的LCP，我们将 $\hat{\kappa}^\star(M)$ 定义为在此类重标度下可达到的最佳障碍数。我们的第二个主要成果是针对具有充分矩阵的LCP提出了一种算法，其运行时间在输入规模和优化后的值 $\hat{\kappa}^\star(M)$ 上呈多项式有界。该算法基于“近似最优行重标度集合构成凸集”这一观察。我们的算法结合了行重标度集合上的椭球法和运行时间依赖于矩阵障碍数的内点法。如果内点法未能在期望的运行时间内求解该LCP，它会向椭球法提供一个分离oracle，以寻找更好的重标度。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具有充分矩阵的线性互补问题（LCP）的求解复杂性。针对制约内点法运行时间的“障碍数”（handicap number），作者基于对充分矩阵的新刻画，首次给出了其比特复杂度的指数上界，解决了该领域的开放问题。此外，本文定义了重标度下的最佳障碍数，并提出了一种结合椭球法与内点法的混合算法。该算法能够动态寻找更优的重标度，从而在输入规模和优化后障碍数的多项式时间内求解LCP。
AI.keywords: 线性互补问题, 充分矩阵, 障碍数, 内点算法, 椭球法
AI.comments: 本文的创新点非常突出：一是首次给出了LCP中充分矩阵障碍数的理论上界，解决了该领域长期悬而未决的开放问题；二是巧妙地将重标度问题转化为凸优化问题，并结合椭球法和内点法设计了协同求解算法。这种“若内点法失败则为椭球法提供分离oracle”的交互设计思想非常精妙，具有很高的学术价值。其局限性在于，虽然给出了指数上界，但在最坏情况下该上界依然较大，且算法主要针对充分矩阵这一特定类别。

title: Time-varying rPPG signal separation via block-sparse signal model
comments: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP 2026)
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact measurement of cardiac pulse signals by analyzing subtle color changes in facial videos. Nevertheless, extracting rPPG signals remains challenging because of their extremely weak signal strength and susceptibility to illumination noise. In this paper, we propose an rPPG signal extraction method that exploits the quasi-periodic characteristics of rPPG signals. Our approach models quasi-periodicity of the rPPG signal, which arises from the stable cardiac cycle, as a block-sparse structure in the time-frequency domain. To incorporate a block-sparse model and enable adaptive signal separation under illumination fluctuations, we construct a time-varying signal separation framework. Experiments using a public dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
comment: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP 2026)

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于块稀疏信号模型和时变信号分离框架的rPPG信号提取方法，以解决信号提取中的噪声和光照波动问题。
AI.motivation: rPPG信号提取面临信号强度弱和易受光照噪声影响的挑战。
AI.method: 利用rPPG信号的准周期性特征，在时频域中将其建模为块稀疏结构，并构建时变信号分离框架以适应光照变化。
AI.result: 实验证明该方法在公开数据集上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的时变块稀疏模型能够有效提取rPPG信号，并能适应光照变化。
AI.translation: 远程光电容积脉搏图（rPPG）通过分析面部视频中细微的颜色变化，可以实现对心跳脉搏信号的非接触式测量。然而，由于rPPG信号的信号强度极弱且易受光照噪声影响，因此提取rPPG信号仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了一种利用rPPG信号准周期特性的rPPG信号提取方法。我们的方法将源于稳定心动周期的rPPG信号的准周期性建模为时频域中的块稀疏结构。为了结合块稀疏模型并实现光照波动下的自适应信号分离，我们构建了一个时变信号分离框架。使用公共数据集进行的实验证明了我们方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的rPPG信号提取方法，该方法将rPPG信号的准周期性特征建模为时频域中的块稀疏结构，并结合时变信号分离框架来处理光照变化带来的挑战，实验证明了其有效性。
AI.keywords: rPPG, 信号分离, 块稀疏, 时变模型, 光照噪声
AI.comments: 该方法巧妙地利用了rPPG信号的内在特性（准周期性）并将其转化为数学模型（块稀疏），同时考虑了实际应用中的关键挑战（光照变化），具有较强的创新性和实用价值。

title: Sparse POD Mode Selection and Manifold Dimensionality Reduction with Neural Networks
summary: Linear dimensionality reduction methods such as proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) make high-dimensional data amenable to analysis by identifying the principal components, or modes, that capture the most variance, or energy, in the data and constructing a low-dimensional representation in the subspace they span. Such linear methods struggle, however, for data with slowly decaying Kolmogorov $n$-widths, such as advection-dominated and turbulent flows, which require many modes for accurate reconstruction; moreover, energy-based truncation can discard low-energy modes needed to capture small-scale features. Recent nonlinear manifold methods using polynomial mappings with alternating or greedy mode selection achieve better reconstruction with fewer modes, but fix the form of the nonlinear mapping a priori, limiting expressivity. In contrast, neural network (NN) manifolds offer greater expressivity yet employ energy-based selection. We present SparseModesNet, a dimensionality reduction framework that employs linear encoding and nonlinear NN decoding. The decoder leverages LassoNet, a method enforcing hierarchical sparsity through a residual connection with a linear skip layer, to simultaneously select informative modes and learn a nonlinear mapping that minimizes reconstruction error. On benchmark advection-dominated and chaotic flows, SparseModesNet matches or exceeds state-of-the-art performance. For turbulent channel flow at friction Reynolds number $Re_τ= 5200$, our method reduces reconstruction error by 51-78% compared to existing polynomial manifold methods while maintaining interpretability through physically meaningful mode selection.

title: No-Go Theorem for Gaussian Quantum Repeaters from Fractional Extendibility
summary: Photon loss in optical channels fundamentally limits long-range reliable quantum communication. A standard approach to overcoming this limitation is the use of quantum repeater nodes, which typically perform experimentally demanding non-Gaussian operations. However, whether Gaussian repeater protocols can enhance quantum communication rates over bosonic attenuation channels has remained open. In this work, we prove a no-go theorem for Gaussian quantum repeaters in a quantum network. Specifically, we show that any repeater chain composed of Gaussian operations, homodyne measurements, and arbitrary classical communication cannot enhance the quantum capacity of a pure-loss attenuation channel beyond that achievable by direct transmission. Our proof introduces a generalisation of $k$-extendibility to a notion of fractional extendibility for Gaussian states and establishes some of its useful properties, thereby providing a powerful framework for analysing Gaussian quantum networks.

AI.title_translation: 高斯量子中继器的不可行定理（基于分数可扩展性）
AI.tldr: 高斯量子中继器无法在纯损耗信道上提高量子通信速率，其性能上限与直接传输相同。
AI.motivation: 探索高斯量子中继器协议是否能克服光学信道中的光子损耗限制，提高量子通信速率。
AI.method: 引入高斯态的分数可扩展性概念，并证明任何由高斯操作、同调测量和任意经典通信组成的中继器链都无法超越直接传输。
AI.result: 证明了高斯量子中继器无法提高纯损耗衰减信道的量子容量，其性能上限与直接传输相同。
AI.conclusion: 高斯量子中继器无法提高纯损耗衰减信道的量子容量。
AI.translation: 光子在光信道中的损耗从根本上限制了长距离可靠的量子通信。一种克服此限制的标准方法是使用量子中继器节点，这些节点通常执行实验上要求苛刻的非高斯操作。然而，高斯中继器协议是否能提高纯损耗衰减信道的量子通信速率仍是未解之谜。在本研究中，我们证明了高斯量子网络中高斯量子中继器的一个不可行定理。具体来说，我们证明了由高斯操作、同调测量和任意经典通信组成任何中继器链都无法将纯损耗衰减信道的量子容量提高到超过直接传输可实现的水平。我们的证明引入了 $k$-可扩展性到高斯态的分数可扩展性概念的推广，并建立了它的一些有用性质，从而为分析高斯量子网络提供了一个强大的框架。
AI.summary: 本研究通过引入高斯态的分数可扩展性概念，证明了高斯量子中继器在纯损耗衰减信道上的局限性。研究表明，任何仅使用高斯操作、同调测量和经典通信的中继器网络，其量子通信容量无法超过直接传输的性能。
AI.keywords: 高斯量子中继器, 分数可扩展性, 量子容量, 纯损耗信道, 不可行定理
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入“分数可扩展性”这一新颖的数学工具，为高斯量子网络的分析提供了新的视角。证明了高斯量子中继器在纯损耗信道上的根本性限制，对于理解和设计未来的量子通信网络具有重要意义，但也指出了仅依赖高斯操作的局限性。

title: Fixed-Threshold One-Bit Toeplitz Covariance Estimation under Sparse-Ruler Sampling
summary: We estimate the Toeplitz covariance matrix of a centered Gaussian distribution from data that are both coarsely quantized and sparsely sampled. Only the coordinates of a sparse ruler are recorded, and each recorded value is kept as a single bit: the sign of its comparison with a fixed threshold. Such data arise in low-precision sensing front ends and sparse sensor arrays. Because the threshold is nonzero, every bit has a common mean. Each bit is also reused across many of the products that build the covariance, so one bit's error enters many of them. Centering removes the shared error. We prove a Gaussian variance contraction theorem for products of a centered, bounded nonlinearity of a Gaussian vector, the non-smooth one-bit sign included; it sets each lag's variance by how well the ruler covers that lag. The resulting estimator needs neither the signal scale nor the bit mean in advance, since the nonzero threshold makes both identifiable from the marginal bits. A matching minimax lower bound shows the resulting coverage rate is optimal up to constants over a neighborhood of white noise; the bound holds even for the unquantized real-valued samples, so one-bit quantization costs only a constant factor.

title: Can homophily explain public underestimation of climate policy support?
comments: 12 pages, 5 figures, followed by supporting information
summary: Many climate change mitigation policies enjoy large majority support from the U.S. public. Yet, both Republicans and Democrats underestimate public support for climate policies, on average, with Republicans underestimating by more. Explaining this is a major puzzle in climate change politics. Homophily is one possible explanation: if citizens are selectively exposed to views reinforcing their own, then policy opponents might underestimate support more than supporters. Here, we explore how homophily could interact with social network structure to produce misperceptions of policy support, using a stochastic block model and preferential attachment model. Homophily alone can explain opponents underestimating support by more than supporters, but supporters only underestimate support when their homophily is so low that they disproportionately associate with opponents. We then expand our model to combine homophily with Bayesian rescaling, inaccurate priors, or asymmetric prominence of opposing opinions (simulating media bias). With Bayesian rescaling and inaccurate priors, homophily would still need to be highly asymmetric to produce realistic misperception patterns. Media bias combined with realistic, symmetric homophily can produce realistic misperception patterns in our model. However, empirical evidence on media bias in coverage of climate change policy is mixed. Our analyses provide theoretical foundations for advancing understanding of public opinion misperception, on climate change and other issues.
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, followed by supporting information

title: Human Capital, AI, and Labor Commoditization
summary: Has generative AI changed how labor markets value human capital? We study this question using contract-level data from Upwork, a large online labor market. We represent worker profiles with high-dimensional text embeddings, allowing us to capture rich human capital information from unstructured profile text. We then compute the predictive importance of workers' human capital information and posted hourly rates for client demand, and incorporate these measures into a difference-in-differences design around the release of ChatGPT. We find that in more AI-exposed job categories, the importance of human capital declines and the importance of price rises, suggesting a commoditization effect of AI on labor. Two additional findings support commoditization as a mechanism: The demand premium enjoyed by workers with strong human capital declines in more AI-exposed categories, and demand reallocates toward lower-priced workers. Our results have implications for the design of online labor markets, workers' incentives to invest in human capital, and labor welfare.

title: Deterministic and Efficient Ideal Arithmetic via Two-Element Representations
summary: Given an ideal in a number field, it is desirable in many situations to find two elements that generate the ideal over the ring of the integers of the field. Existing algorithms are either randomized, or impractical at cryptographic sizes. In the paper, we present a deterministic polynomial time algorithm to find the two-element representation of an ideal. For a monic irreducible integral polynomial \( f(x) \), let \( K=\Q[x]/(f) \) be the number field, and \( O_K \) be the integral closure. Our algorithm works when the norm of the input ideal is co-prime to the index \( [O_K:\Z[x]/f] \). In particular, it handles all ideals for monogenic \( f(x) \), a class that includes the cyclotomic polynomials widely used in lattice based cryptography. A key technical ingredient in our result is a generalized version of Dedekind criterion.

title: Rate-Splitting Multiple Access Enabled Probabilistic Semantic Communication in UAV Networks
summary: This article proposes an uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) downlink semantic communication framework, where probabilistic knowledge graphs (PKGs) are employed to model user equipment (UE) semantics and decompose semantic information into shared and private components. Leveraging the capability of rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) in addressing such semantic structures, a PKG-assisted RSMA transmission scheme is developed to efficiently deliver multi-user semantic information under severe energy constraints and fast-varying UAV channels. To characterize the strongly coupled energy costs of communication, computation, and flight, a weighted energy minimization problem is formulated to jointly optimize the UAV trajectory, power allocation, beamforming design, and semantic compression ratio. The resulting non-convex problem is efficiently solved using an iterative semantic-aware weighted energy optimization (SWEO) algorithm that integrates Lagrangian dual decomposition and successive convex approximation. Furthermore, a semantic accuracy metric is proposed to quantify the reliability of reconstruction by assigning importance-based weights to informative KG triples. Extensive simulation results verify that the proposed framework achieves superior energy efficiency, enhanced semantic preservation, and consistently better performance than conventional RSMA, non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA), and space division multiple access (SDMA) schemes in benchmarks across various network parameters.

AI.title_translation: 无人机网络中基于速率拆分多址接入的概率语义通信
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合速率拆分多址（RSMA）和概率知识图谱（PKG）的无人机语义通信框架，通过联合优化轨迹、资源分配和语义压缩，在极低能效开销下实现了高效的多用户语义传输。
AI.motivation: 在严重的能量约束和快速变化的无人机信道下，如何高效地传输多用户语义信息，并降低无人机通信、计算和飞行之间强耦合的能量消耗。
AI.method:
1. 采用概率知识图谱（PKG）对用户语义进行建模，并将语义信息分解为共享和私有部分。
2. 提出一种PKG辅助的速率拆分多址（RSMA）传输方案，以匹配这种“共享-私有”的语义结构。
3. 针对通信、计算和飞行能耗的强耦合性，构建了一个加权能量最小化问题，联合优化无人机轨迹、功率分配、波束赋形和语义压缩率。
4. 开发了一种迭代语义感知加权能量优化（SWEO）算法（结合拉格朗日对偶分解和逐次凸逼近）来求解该非凸问题。
5. 提出了一种基于知识图谱三元组重要性权重的语义准确性度量指标。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，在各种网络参数下，所提框架相比传统的RSMA、非正交多址（NOMA）和空分多址（SDMA）方案，实现了更优的能量效率、更强的语义保留能力以及持续更好的系统性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于PKG和RSMA的无人机语义通信框架能够有效应对高动态信道和严苛能量约束下的多用户传输挑战，在降低系统能耗的同时，显著提升了语义传输的准确性和可靠性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种无人机（UAV）下行链路语义通信框架，其中采用概率知识图谱（PKG）来建模用户设备（UE）的语义，并将语义信息分解为共享和私有组成部分。利用速率拆分多址（RSMA）在处理此类语义结构方面的能力，开发了一种PKG辅助的RSMA传输方案，以在严苛的能量约束和快速变化的无人机信道下高效传输多用户语义信息。为了刻画通信、计算和飞行之间强耦合的能量消耗，本文构建了一个加权能量最小化问题，以联合优化无人机轨迹、功率分配、波束赋形设计和语义压缩率。通过集成拉格朗日对偶分解和逐次凸逼近的迭代语义感知加权能量优化（SWEO）算法，高效地解决了所得的非凸问题。此外，提出了一种语义准确性指标，通过向信息化知识图谱三元组分配基于重要性的权重来量化重构的可靠性。广泛的仿真结果证实，在各种网络参数的基准测试中，所提框架相比传统的RSMA、非正交多址（NOMA）和空分多址（SDMA）方案，实现了更优的能量效率、增强的语义保留以及持续更好的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种应用于无人机下行链路的语义通信框架。该框架利用概率知识图谱（PKG）将用户语义信息分解为共享和私有两部分，并采用速率拆分多址（RSMA）技术进行高效传输。为了应对无人机能量受限和信道多变的挑战，本文构建了一个联合优化无人机轨迹、功率分配、波束赋形和语义压缩率的加权能耗最小化问题，并提出SWEO算法进行求解。此外，还引入了基于三元组重要性的语义准确性指标。实验表明，该方案在能效和语义保真度上均显著优于传统多址接入方案。
AI.keywords: 速率拆分多址 (RSMA), 概率知识图谱 (PKG), 语义通信, 无人机网络, 能量效率
AI.comments: 该论文创新地将概率知识图谱（PKG）与速率拆分多址（RSMA）相结合，利用RSMA天然适合传输“共享+私有”信息的特点来匹配语义分解结构，构思非常巧妙。此外，论文全面考虑了无人机场景中通信、计算和飞行能耗的强耦合性，并进行了联合轨迹和资源优化，具有很高的实用价值。局限性在于，在高动态的无人机网络中，PKG的构建、更新以及语义准确性指标的实时计算可能会带来额外的系统开销，这在摘要中未做深入探讨。

title: Transformer-Hypernetwork-Controlled Deep-Unfolded Phase-Aware Channel Estimation Refinement for Phase-Drift-Robust Backscatter Links
summary: This paper proposes a transformer-hypernetwork-controlled deep-unfolded phase-aware channel estimation refinement (THUNDER) for phase-drifting backscatter links. Residual carrier-phase drift across the pilot block renders the backscattered observation phase-nonstationary, and a closed-form phase-aware channel estimation (PACE) compensates only the first-order phase component, leaving a deterministic high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) error floor. THUNDER suppresses this floor by initializing from PACE and refining the estimate through unfolded Gauss-Newton steps on the exact phase-exponential model. A transformer extracts pilot-wide phase context, and a hypernetwork generates bounded controls and pilot-reliability weights. Evaluations show an 8.9 dB normalized mean square error gain over the strongest learning-based channel estimation baseline.

title: Towards a Joint Task-Oriented and Generative Semantic Communication Framework for 6G Networks
summary: Semantic Communication (SC) has emerged as a key enabler for 6G wireless systems by transmitting task-relevant meaning rather than raw data, thereby significantly reducing bandwidth consumption while preserving communication intent. In this work, we propose an end-to-end OFDM-based semantic communication framework that integrates a semantic encoder-decoder pipeline with a neural receiver operating over a 3GPP vehicular channel. The semantic encoder extracts the underlying meaning of a visual scene by transforming it into a graph-based representation consisting of object-level features and relational structure. At the receiver, the reconstructed scene graph is processed by a spatio-temporal graph neural network (ST-GNN)-based module for collision-risk estimation, enabling task-oriented inference. In parallel, a diffusion-based semantic decoder reconstructs the visual scene from the recovered semantics, providing dual functionality: safety prediction and image reconstruction. The proposed framework is evaluated in a MIMO configuration under varying SNR conditions. Experimental results show that it achieves up to 99.1% data compression relative to pixel-domain transmission, outperforming conventional compression-based methods (JPEG and HEVC) while preserving downstream inference performance. Furthermore, the diffusion-based reconstruction attains significantly lower frechet inception distance (FID) scores than existing semantic communication approaches, reflecting superior semantic and perceptual fidelity.

title: Sensing for Reliable UAV Communication: Robust Trajectory and Resource Optimization in Low-Altitude Networks
summary: In low-altitude wireless networks, sensing-aided communication has emerged as a promising integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) paradigm for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) tracking and communication. This paper investigates reliable sensing-aided communication for multiple cellular-connected UAVs under mobility uncertainties. Specifically, we maximize the minimum outage capacity among UAVs by jointly optimizing their real-time predicted positions, as well as the base station (BS) transmit power and bandwidth allocations. To address the non-convex and intractable maximum tolerable outage probability (OP) constraints, two robust optimization schemes are proposed based on a continuous confidence ellipse (CE) and discretized inverse-whitened sectors (IWSs), respectively. For the CE-based scheme, an efficient algorithm is proposed to optimize the predicted UAV positions individually via block successive convex approximation, followed by convex resource allocation. For the IWS-based scheme, an IWS-based OP approximation is proposed to facilitate the robust optimization, based on which a low-complexity IWS selection method is proposed to decouple the optimization variables. Then, a similar sequential optimization algorithm is proposed based on the projected gradient descent approach. The two algorithms are further unified into a common trajectory-resource optimization framework, revealing a low-complexity structure for robust UAV trajectory and resource management. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of our proposed OP approximation, demonstrate the significant outage capacity improvement of the proposed robust optimization schemes over benchmark schemes, and illustrate the superiority of the IWS-based scheme over the CE-based scheme.

title: Resource-Efficient WiFi CSI Sensing via Exploiting the Age of Samples
summary: WiFi channel state information (CSI) sensing must coexist with data communications, which constrains the acquisition rate of fresh CSI measurements. To model this, we formulate CSI-based human activity and identity recognition under a sensing rate constraint that limits the fraction of time slots, within a measurement session, where CSI samples are available. This framework captures sensing-communication resource sharing and uncontrolled packet loss or traffic-driven irregularity. To satisfy the sensing constraint, two fixed CSI sampling policies are considered: a deterministic policy and a stochastic Bernoulli policy. We propose a low-cost age-aware WiFi sensing framework that explicitly incorporates sample freshness into the model training. The age of each retained CSI sample is first encoded and then fused with the CSI embedding via multiplicative fusion. On the NTU-Fi human activity recognition and person identification datasets, the proposed model consistently outperforms both a CSI-only baseline and the state-of-the-art time-aware attention model from the UniFi benchmark. For example, it yields up to a 10-percentage-point improvement over the UniFi method for person identification, with the largest gains observed under strict sensing budgets.

title: A Fair and Transparent Framework for Speech-Based Depression Detection: Balancing Interpretability and Performance
comments: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: While speech provides rich, non-invasive biomarkers for mental-health assessment, clinical adoption is limited by opaque models and potential demographic bias. In this work we propose a methodological framework to evaluate robustness and interpretability for automated depression detection on the extended DAIC-WOZ dataset using low-complexity machine learning baselines (RF, SVM, and MLP) chosen to mitigate overfitting and enhance generalization in combination with human-understandable acoustic features (MFCCs, eGeMAPS). To balance accuracy with clinical trust, we leverage explainability methods (LIME and SHAP) for feature selection, validating our findings with statistical significance tests and demographic fairness analyses to mitigate spurious, artifact-driven correlations. Empirical results demonstrate that an optimized subset of explainable AI (XAI)-selected features combined with an MLP architecture achieves a state-of-the-art test accuracy of 82\%. Ultimately, this work provides a transparent framework for robust and ethical assistive technologies that can be applied to any other binary task.
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: Spatially Coupled Sparse Code Multiple Access (SC-SCMA): A Spectral Graph Approach
summary: This paper presents a spatially coupled sparse code multiple access (SC-SCMA) framework to overcome the performance and scalability limitations of conventional SCMA systems. By analyzing the pairwise error probability associated to multi-user error patterns, we show that spatial coupling projects the superimposed SCMA codewords into a higher-dimensional effective signal space, leading to a strictly improved minimum Euclidean distance (MED) compared with conventional SCMA, while simultaneously enhancing the coding gain through global message propagation and the diversity gain through inter-block resource spreading. Such a distance gain is shown to be governed by the effective access dimensionality (EAD) induced by the coupled factor graph. With the aid of spectral graph theory, we establish a direct relationship between the spectral gap of the factor graph and a lower bound on the EAD, providing a computable structural metric that guarantees MED improvement under various error patterns. Building upon these theoretical insights, we introduce a low-complexity structure-aware codebook design approach, including a spectral-gap-oriented construction of spatially coupled factor matrices and a localized codebook optimization strategy that exploits the dominant error-inducing local user group. Simulation results validate the analysis and demonstrate that the proposed SC-SCMA consistently outperforms conventional SCMA in overloaded massive access channels.

title: Toward Efficient Sensing in Multi-Device ISCC by Removing Frequency Domain Redundancy
summary: Integrated sensing, communication, and computation (ISCC) is envisioned as a key enabler for intelligent services in future wireless networks. However, in multi-device ISCC systems, directly offloading full orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) sensing data to the edge may incur excessive overhead, thereby limiting sensing performance under practical resource constraints. In this paper, we propose a subcarrier selection-based sensing framework for multi-device ISCC systems, where frequency-domain redundancy in OFDM sensing data is removed during local preprocessing to reduce sensing data transmission and processing overhead. Based on the proposed framework, we establish analytical models for sensing accuracy, delay, and energy consumption, and formulate a sensing accuracy maximization problem under practical resource constraints. To solve this problem, we develop an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based algorithm. Experiments on commodity wireless devices validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show that it consistently outperforms three baseline schemes under various resource constraints.

title: Fundamentals of Optical Fiber Sensing Schemes Based on Coherent Optical Time Domain Reflectometry: Signal Under Dynamic Temperature Conditions
summary: We present a theoretical, algorithmic, and experimental study of temperature sensing using $φ$-OTDR with coherent detection. A physics-based model is developed to relate the measured Rayleigh backscattered signal to temperature variations along the fiber, showing that the phase evolution encodes the cumulative temperature change between the interrogator and the sensing location, while the amplitude exhibits only local sensitivity. Based on this insight, we propose robust algorithms for temperature-event detection and temperature-profile reconstruction. Experimental results demonstrate reliable recovery of temperature-induced perturbations in standard single-mode fibers using coherently detected $φ$-OTDR.

title: MORIC: CSI Delay-Doppler Decomposition for Robust Wi-Fi-based Human Activity Recognition
summary: The newly established IEEE 802.11bf Task Group aims to amend the WLAN standard to support advanced sensing applications such as human activity recognition (HAR). Although studies have demonstrated the potential of sub-7 GHz Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI) for HAR, existing methods often degrade substantially under realistic variations across users, environments, and sensing configurations. This work addresses the poor generalization of Wi-Fi-based HAR by extracting motion-centered representations that reduce dependence on static, environment-specific, and non-activity-related CSI magnitude and phase patterns. CSI signals are transformed into the delay-profile space and decomposed into multiple Doppler velocity projections, which are modeled as observations of a moving point's velocity from different unknown directions, analogous to virtual cameras observing the same motion with varying degrees of clarity. This yields a richer activity representation than either a single aggregated Doppler estimate or the spurious, environment-dependent CSI patterns used in prior works. Since these projections are unordered and may recur due to random multipath propagation, we introduce MORIC, a novel order- and repetition-invariant time-series classification model for robust Wi-Fi-based HAR. Experimental results on the collected dataset show that the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in cross-user hand motion recognition, especially for challenging gestures. Incorporating only a few calibration samples further improves accuracy, demonstrating MORIC's adaptability and highlighting the potential of the proposed methodology for practical Wi-Fi sensing in real-world scenarios.

AI.title_translation: MORIC：用于鲁棒的基于Wi-Fi人体活动识别的CSI时延-多普勒分解
AI.tldr: 本文提出MORIC模型，通过将CSI信号分解为多普勒速度投影，并结合顺序和重复不变的分类算法，显著提升了Wi-Fi人体活动识别的跨用户和跨环境泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于Wi-Fi信道状态信息（CSI）的人体活动识别方法在面对用户、环境和感知配置的实际变化时，其泛化能力往往会大幅下降。
AI.method: 将CSI信号转换到时延剖面空间，并将其分解为多个多普勒速度投影（类似于从不同未知方向观察移动点速度的虚拟摄像机），从而提取以运动为中心的丰富表征。针对这些由于随机多径传播而无序且可能重复的投影，提出了一种新型的具有顺序和重复不变性的时间序列分类模型MORIC。
AI.result: 在收集的数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法在跨用户手部动作识别（尤其是具有挑战性的手势）中优于最先进的方法。此外，仅引入少量校准样本即可进一步提升识别准确率。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了MORIC的自适应性，并突出了该方法在现实世界场景中进行实用Wi-Fi感知的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 新成立的IEEE 802.11bf工作组旨在修改WLAN标准，以支持先进的感知应用，如人体活动识别（HAR）。尽管研究已经证明了低于7 GHz的Wi-Fi信道状态信息（CSI）在HAR中的潜力，但现有方法在用户、环境和感知配置的实际变化下，其性能往往会大幅下降。本研究通过提取以运动为中心的表征，减少对静态、环境特定以及非活动相关的CSI幅度和相位模式的依赖，从而解决了基于Wi-Fi的HAR泛化能力差的问题。CSI信号被转换到时延剖面空间，并分解为多个多普勒速度投影，这些投影被建模为从不同未知方向观察移动点速度的结果，类似于虚拟摄像机以不同的清晰度观察同一运动。与单一的聚合多普勒估计或先前工作中所使用的虚假、依赖于环境的CSI模式相比，这产生了一种更丰富的活动表征。由于这些投影是无序的，且由于随机多径传播可能会重复出现，因此我们引入了MORIC，这是一种新型的顺序和重复不变时间序列分类模型，用于鲁棒的基于Wi-Fi的HAR。在收集的数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的方法在跨用户手部动作识别中优于最先进的方法，特别是对于具有挑战性的手势。仅融入少量校准样本即可进一步提高准确率，证明了MORIC的自适应性，并突出了所提方法在现实世界场景中进行实用Wi-Fi感知的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于Wi-Fi的人体活动识别（HAR）泛化能力差的问题，提出了一种名为MORIC的新框架。该方法通过将CSI信号转换并分解为多个多普勒速度投影，以减少对环境和非活动相关特征的依赖。为了克服多径效应带来的投影无序和重复问题，MORIC引入了顺序和重复不变的时间序列分类模型。实验表明，该方法在跨用户手部动作识别中表现优异，且具有良好的自适应能力。
AI.keywords: 信道状态信息 (CSI), 人体活动识别 (HAR), 时延-多普勒分解, 时间序列分类, 泛化性
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将CSI信号分解为多普勒速度投影（类比虚拟相机），并设计了专门应对多径传播中无序和重复特性的MORIC分类模型，这为解决Wi-Fi感知的泛化性瓶颈提供了一个新颖且物理意义明确的视角。其局限性在于，虽然展示了在手势识别上的优越性，但对于更复杂的全身活动或更广阔的多人场景的适用性在摘要中未做详细展开。

title: Quantitative Analysis of Proxy Tasks for Anomalous Sound Detection
comments: 47 pages, 5 figures; submitted to Expert Systems with Applications; code and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/shin3875/asd-proxy-task-analysis
summary: Anomalous sound detection (ASD) typically involves self-supervised proxy tasks to learn feature representations from normal sound data, owing to the scarcity of anomalous samples. In ASD research, proxy tasks such as AutoEncoders operate under the explicit assumption that models trained on normal data will increase the reconstruction errors related to anomalies. A natural extension suggests that improved proxy task performance should improve ASD capability; however, this relationship has received little systematic attention. This study addresses this research gap by quantitatively analyzing the relationship between proxy task metrics and ASD performance across five configurations, namely, AutoEncoders, classification, source separation, contrastive learning, and pre-trained models. We evaluate the learned representations using linear probe (linear separability) and Mahalanobis distance (distributional compactness). Our experiments reveal that strong proxy performance does not necessarily improve anomalous sound detection performance. Specifically, classification tasks experience performance saturation owing to insufficient task difficulty, whereas contrastive learning fails to learn meaningful features owing to limited data diversity. Notably, source separation is the only task demonstrating a strong positive correlation, such that improved separation consistently improves anomaly detection. Based on these findings, we highlight the critical importance of task difficulty and objective alignment. Finally, we propose a three-stage alignment verification protocol to guide the design of highly effective proxy tasks for ASD systems.
comment: 47 pages, 5 figures; submitted to Expert Systems with Applications; code and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/shin3875/asd-proxy-task-analysis

AI.title_translation: 异常声音检测中代理任务的定量分析
AI.tldr: 本文定量分析了异常声音检测中代理任务与检测性能的关系，发现除源分离外，强代理任务性能并不一定会提升检测效果，并据此提出了一个三阶段对齐验证协议。
AI.motivation: 在异常声音检测（ASD）中，通常使用自监督代理任务来学习正常数据的特征。虽然直觉上认为改进代理任务性能会提升异常检测能力，但这种关系此前从未受到过系统性的定量分析。
AI.method: 定量分析了自编码器、分类、源分离、对比学习和预训练模型五种配置下代理任务指标与ASD性能的关系，并利用线性探测（评估线性可分性）和马氏距离（评估分布紧凑性）对学习到的特征表征进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，强大的代理任务性能并不一定会提高ASD性能。其中，分类任务因难度不足而出现性能饱和；对比学习因数据多样性有限而无法学到有意义的特征；仅有源分离任务展示出强正相关性（分离效果越好，异常检测性能越好）。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了任务难度和目标对齐在异常声音检测（ASD）中的关键重要性，并提出了一个三阶段对齐验证协议，以指导未来高效ASD代理任务的设计。
AI.translation: 异常声音检测（ASD）通常涉及自监督代理任务，由于异常样本稀缺，这些任务从正常声音数据中学习特征表示。在ASD研究中，诸如自编码器之类的代理任务在显式假设下运行，即在正常数据上训练的模型将增加与异常相关的重构误差。一个自然的延伸表明，改进代理任务的性能应该提高ASD能力；然而，这种关系很少受到系统性的关注。本研究通过定量分析五种配置（即自编码器、分类、源分离、对比学习和预训练模型）中代理任务指标与ASD性能之间的关系，填补了这一研究空白。我们使用线性探测（线性可分性）和马氏距离（分布紧凑性）来评估学习到的表示。我们的实验表明，强大的代理任务性能并不一定会提高异常声音检测性能。具体而言，分类任务由于任务难度不足而出现性能饱和，而对比学习由于数据多样性有限而未能学习到有意义的特征。值得注意的是，源分离是唯一表现出强正相关性的任务，即改进的源分离能够一致地提高异常检测性能。基于这些发现，我们强调了任务难度和目标对齐的至关重要性。最后，我们提出了一个三阶段对齐验证协议，以指导设计用于ASD系统的高效代理任务。
AI.summary: 本文对异常声音检测（ASD）中自监督代理任务（包括自编码器、分类、源分离、对比学习和预训练模型）的性能与最终检测效果之间的关系进行了首次系统性的定量分析。研究发现，两者的性能提升并不总是正相关。基于实验发现，作者强调了任务难度和目标对齐的重要性，并提出了一个三阶段对齐验证协议来指导设计更高效的ASD代理任务。
AI.keywords: 异常声音检测, 代理任务, 自监督学习, 源分离, 对齐验证协议
AI.comments: 本文填补了异常声音检测（ASD）领域中一个长期存在的直觉假设空白，即“代理任务性能越好，异常检测效果越好”。通过严谨的定量实验，研究揭示了不同代理任务在ASD中的实际表现和局限性，特别是发现源分离具有强正相关性，并提出了极具实用价值的三阶段对齐验证协议，对未来设计更有效的自监督ASD模型具有很强的指导意义。

title: Eccentricity Confound in EEG-based Visual Attention Decoding from Gaze-Fixated Neural Tracking of Motion in Natural Videos
summary: Objective. Decoding visual attention from brain signals during naturalistic video viewing has emerged as a new direction in brain-computer interface research. Current methods assume that stronger coupling between object motion and neural activity indicates higher attention, but this can be confounded by eye movement artifacts and stimulus properties. This study investigates how visual eccentricity (the distance between a visual object and the fixation point) affects neural responses when eye movement artifacts are controlled. Approach. EEG signals were recorded across three tasks that manipulated object eccentricity and attention conditions while participants maintained gaze fixation. Correlation analysis and match-mismatch decoding were performed to quantify the neural tracking of object motion. Main results. The analysis supports three conclusions: (1) neural tracking of object motion in natural videos works under gaze fixation; (2) the strength of this tracking under gaze fixation is predictive of attention; and (3) there exists a significant eccentricity confound in the EEG responses, with poorer neural tracking of motion at larger eccentricities. Significance. These results indicate that findings from previous free-viewing studies also reflect genuine neural processing rather than mere oculomotor artifacts. However, the identified eccentricity effect highlights a major limitation for current decoding approaches that assume coupling strength reflects attention levels alone.

AI.title_translation: 基于注视固定下自然视频运动神经追踪的脑电图视觉注意力解码中的偏心率混淆
AI.tldr: 本研究调查了在眼动伪影受控的情况下，视觉偏心率（视觉对象与注视点之间的距离）如何影响神经反应。结果表明，神经追踪在注视固定下有效且可预测注意力，但存在显著的偏心率混淆，偏心率越大，运动的神经追踪越差。
AI.motivation: 在自然视频观看过程中，从脑信号中解码视觉注意力是脑机接口研究的新方向。现有方法假设物体运动与神经活动之间的耦合越强，注意力越高，但这可能受到眼动伪影和刺激特性的混淆。本研究旨在探究在控制眼动伪影的情况下，视觉偏心率如何影响神经反应。
AI.method: 在参与者保持注视固定的情况下，记录了三种任务下的脑电图信号，这些任务操纵了物体偏心率和注意力条件。通过相关性分析和匹配-不匹配解码来量化物体运动的神经追踪。
AI.result: 1. 在注视固定下，自然视频中物体运动的神经追踪是有效的；2. 在注视固定下，这种追踪的强度可以预测注意力；3. 脑电图反应中存在显著的偏心率混淆，偏心率越大，运动的神经追踪越差。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，以往自由观看研究的发现也反映了真实的神经处理，而不仅仅是眼球运动伪影。然而，所识别的偏心率效应突出了当前解码方法的一个主要局限性，即这些方法假设耦合强度单独反映注意力水平。
AI.translation: 目标。在自然视频观看过程中，从脑信号中解码视觉注意力已成为脑机接口研究的新方向。现有方法假设物体运动与神经活动之间更强的耦合表明更高的注意力，但这可能受到眼动伪影和刺激特性的混淆。本研究调查了在眼动伪影受控的情况下，视觉偏心率（视觉对象与注视点之间的距离）如何影响神经反应。方法。在参与者保持注视固定的情况下，记录了三种任务下的脑电图信号，这些任务操纵了物体偏心率和注意力条件。进行相关性分析和匹配-不匹配解码以量化物体运动的神经追踪。主要结果。分析支持三个结论：（1）在注视固定下，自然视频中物体运动的神经追踪是有效的；（2）在注视固定下，这种追踪的强度可以预测注意力；（3）脑电图反应中存在显著的偏心率混淆，偏心率越大，运动的神经追踪越差。意义。这些结果表明，以往自由观看研究的发现也反映了真实的神经处理，而不仅仅是眼球运动伪影。然而，所识别的偏心率效应突出了当前解码方法的一个主要局限性，即这些方法假设耦合强度单独反映注意力水平。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在探讨在控制眼动伪影的情况下，视觉偏心率如何影响基于脑电图的视觉注意力解码中的神经反应。实验通过操纵物体偏心率和注意力条件，在注视固定下记录脑电图信号，并使用相关性分析和匹配-不匹配解码来量化物体运动的神经追踪。结果表明，在注视固定下，神经追踪是有效的且能预测注意力，但存在显著的偏心率混淆，即偏心率越大，运动的神经追踪越差。这提示了当前解码方法在假设耦合强度单独反映注意力水平时存在局限性。
AI.keywords: 视觉注意力解码, 脑电图, 偏心率, 神经追踪, 注视固定
AI.comments: 本文创新性地在控制眼动伪影的条件下，研究了视觉偏心率对EEG视觉注意力解码的影响。其重要性在于揭示了偏心率这一关键混淆因素，对现有基于耦合强度解码注意力的方法提出了挑战和改进方向，有助于提升脑机接口研究的准确性。局限性在于可能需要进一步研究如何补偿或消除偏心率效应。

title: Utilizing Missed Detections in Directional Sensitivity-Based DOA Estimation
comments: This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE Sensors Journal
summary: This paper introduces a signal strength-based direction of arrival (DOA) estimation approach for directional sensors that explicitly accounts for missed detections. In traditional phase-based DOA estimation frameworks, negative information from expected emitters that fall below the detection threshold fall outside the scope of standard measurement models. Unlike phase-based DOA estimation methods, the proposed approach relies only on received signal strength measurements. As a result, missed detections arise naturally from the sensing and detection process and convey valuable information via the known detection thresholds. By incorporating both detected signals and missed detections into the likelihood function, we develop a probabilistic estimation method that fully leverages the underlying measurement and detection models. Simulation results show that the proposed method significantly improves DOA estimation accuracy compared to baseline techniques, particularly in challenging scenarios with high missed-detection rates. Real-world experiments using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) signals and directional antennas further validate the effectiveness of the approach, demonstrating substantial performance gains. These findings highlight the value of modeling missed detections in sensor array processing and open new avenues for enhancing localization performance in wireless communication systems.

AI.title_translation: 利用漏检信息进行基于方向敏感度的DOA估计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于信号强度的DOA估计方法，通过显式考虑漏检信息，显著提高了方向传感器在具有高漏检率的挑战性场景中的DOA估计精度。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于相位的DOA估计框架未能有效利用低于检测阈值的预期发射器的负面信息。本文旨在通过利用漏检信息来弥补这一缺陷，因为漏检信息通过已知的检测阈值传达了有价值的信息。
AI.method: 该方法仅依赖于接收信号强度测量。它通过将检测到的信号和漏检信息都纳入似然函数中，开发了一种概率估计方法，充分利用了底层的测量和检测模型。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，与基线技术相比，该方法显著提高了DOA估计精度，尤其是在漏检率高的挑战性场景中。使用低功耗蓝牙（BLE）信号和定向天线的实际实验进一步验证了该方法的有效性，展示了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 对漏检信息进行建模在传感器阵列处理中具有重要价值，为增强无线通信系统中的定位性能开辟了新途径。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一种基于信号强度的方向到达角（DOA）估计方法，用于方向传感器，该方法明确考虑了漏检情况。在传统的基于相位的DOA估计框架中，预期发射器低于检测阈值而产生的负面信息超出了标准测量模型的范围。与基于相位的DOA估计方法不同，本文提出的方法仅依赖于接收信号强度测量。因此，漏检自然产生于传感和检测过程，并通过已知的检测阈值传达了有价值的信息。通过将检测到的信号和漏检信息都纳入似然函数中，我们开发了一种概率估计方法，该方法充分利用了底层的测量和检测模型。仿真结果表明，与基线技术相比，本文提出的方法显著提高了DOA估计精度，特别是在漏检率高的挑战性场景中。使用低功耗蓝牙（BLE）信号和定向天线的实际实验进一步验证了该方法的有效性，展示了显著的性能提升。这些发现突出了在传感器阵列处理中对漏检进行建模的价值，并为增强无线通信系统中的定位性能开辟了新途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于信号强度的方向到达角（DOA）估计方法，专为方向传感器设计，该方法创新性地显式建模并利用了漏检信息。与传统基于相位的方法不同，它将检测到的信号以及来自低于检测阈值的漏检的宝贵负面信息整合到似然函数中。通过仿真和实际实验（使用BLE信号和定向天线），该方法在DOA估计精度方面表现出显著提升，尤其是在高漏检率的复杂场景中，从而为无线通信系统中的定位性能增强提供了新途径。
AI.keywords: DOA估计, 漏检, 信号强度, 定向传感器, 定位性能
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于其独特地将“漏检”视为有价值的信息，并将其纳入似然函数进行DOA估计，而非简单忽略。这种方法对于在信号强度测量为主且漏检率较高的恶劣环境或低信噪比场景中，具有显著提升定位性能的潜力。

title: Effective Depth in Joint Source-Channel Coding: An Implicit Equilibrium Analysis
summary: A fundamental design question in deep joint source-channel coding (Deep JSCC) remains insufficiently explored: given a channel signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), what effective computation depth is required for semantic reconstruction? Existing Deep JSCC systems typically employ fixed-depth neural architectures selected through empirical hyperparameter tuning, which may lead to unnecessary computation under favorable channel conditions and insufficient refinement under severe channel noise. This paper proposes \emph{Implicit-JSCC}, an implicit equilibrium framework in which semantic encoding and decoding are formulated as fixed-point equilibrium processes. The effective encoder and decoder depths are determined by residual-based solver convergence rather than manually predefined layer numbers, while parameter sharing across equilibrium iterations enables depth-independent parameter complexity. To analyze the resulting effective-depth behavior, we develop a Gaussian-process-inspired kernel evolution framework that models equilibrium iterations as an effective-depth propagation process. Since channel noise is injected between the encoder and decoder, the analysis tracks channel-induced representation perturbations across receiver-side equilibrium iterations and derives a theory-guided depth--SNR relationship. After offline calibration of the system-specific parameters, the resulting model characterizes the required receiver-side refinement depth under different SNRs. Extensive experiments show that Implicit-JSCC achieves competitive reconstruction performance while enabling residual-based adaptive inference and controllable computation--quality tradeoffs. The depth--SNR model further provides a characterization of the SNR-dependent refinement depth required to reach a prescribed perturbation tolerance.

AI.title_translation: 联合信源信道编码中的有效深度：隐式均衡分析
AI.tldr: Deep JSCC系统中，编码器和解码器的有效计算深度通常是固定的且经验选择，导致计算效率低下或性能不足。本文提出Implicit-JSCC框架，将编解码过程建模为固定点均衡过程，通过残差求解器收敛确定深度，并开发高斯过程启发的核演化框架来分析深度-SNR关系，实现自适应推理和可控的计算-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有深度联合信源信道编码（Deep JSCC）系统通常采用通过经验性超参数调优选择的固定深度神经网络架构。这可能导致在有利信道条件下不必要的计算，以及在恶劣信道噪声下精炼不足，缺乏对语义重建所需有效计算深度的深入探索。
AI.method: 1. 提出Implicit-JSCC框架，将语义编解码公式化为固定点均衡过程。2. 通过基于残差的求解器收敛来确定有效的编码器和解码器深度，而非手动预定义的层数。3. 通过均衡迭代中的参数共享实现深度无关的参数复杂度。4. 开发了一个高斯过程启发的核演化框架，将均衡迭代建模为有效深度传播过程，以分析有效深度行为。5. 该分析跟踪接收端均衡迭代中信道引起的表示扰动，并推导了理论指导的深度-SNR关系。
AI.result: 1. Implicit-JSCC实现了具有竞争力的重建性能。2. 它支持基于残差的自适应推理和可控的计算-质量权衡。3. 深度-SNR模型在离线校准系统特定参数后，能够表征不同SNR下所需的接收端精炼深度。4. 该模型进一步表征了达到预定扰动容差所需的SNR相关精炼深度。
AI.conclusion: Implicit-JSCC框架通过将编解码建模为固定点均衡过程，并利用残差求解器收敛来确定自适应深度，解决了Deep JSCC中固定深度架构的局限性。结合所开发的深度-SNR分析模型，该系统不仅提供了竞争性的性能，还实现了自适应推理、可控的计算-质量权衡，并能理论指导不同信噪比下所需的有效深度。
AI.translation: 深度联合信源信道编码（Deep JSCC）中一个基本的设计问题仍未得到充分探索：给定信道信噪比（SNR），语义重建需要多大的有效计算深度？现有Deep JSCC系统通常采用通过经验性超参数调优选择的固定深度神经网络架构，这可能导致在有利信道条件下不必要的计算，以及在恶劣信道噪声下精炼不足。本文提出了Implicit-JSCC，一个隐式均衡框架，其中语义编码和解码被公式化为固定点均衡过程。有效的编码器和解码器深度由基于残差的求解器收敛决定，而不是手动预定义的层数，同时均衡迭代中的参数共享实现了与深度无关的参数复杂度。为了分析由此产生的有效深度行为，我们开发了一个高斯过程启发的核演化框架，将均衡迭代建模为有效深度传播过程。由于信道噪声在编码器和解码器之间注入，该分析跟踪接收端均衡迭代中信道引起的表示扰动，并推导了理论指导的深度-SNR关系。在离线校准系统特定参数后，所得模型表征了不同SNR下所需的接收端精炼深度。广泛的实验表明，Implicit-JSCC实现了具有竞争力的重建性能，同时支持基于残差的自适应推理和可控的计算-质量权衡。深度-SNR模型进一步提供了达到预定扰动容差所需的SNR相关精炼深度的表征。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Implicit-JSCC，一个用于深度联合信源信道编码（Deep JSCC）的隐式均衡框架，旨在解决现有系统固定深度架构的局限性。通过将语义编解码建模为固定点均衡过程，并利用残差求解器收敛来自适应确定编码器和解码器深度，Implicit-JSCC实现了深度无关的参数复杂度。此外，论文开发了高斯过程启发的核演化框架来分析有效深度行为，并推导了理论指导的深度-SNR关系。实验证明，Implicit-JSCC在提供竞争性重建性能的同时，实现了自适应推理和可控的计算-质量权衡，并且其深度-SNR模型能有效预测不同信噪比下的所需精炼深度。
AI.keywords: 深度联合信源信道编码, 隐式均衡, 固定点过程, 自适应深度, 深度-SNR关系
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将Deep JSCC的编解码过程重新构想为隐式均衡固定点过程，从而实现了计算深度的自适应调整，解决了传统固定深度架构的效率和鲁棒性问题。通过引入残差求解器收敛来动态确定深度，并结合参数共享，显著提高了系统的灵活性和资源利用效率。此外，开发高斯过程启发的核演化框架来理论分析深度-SNR关系，为理解和优化Deep JSCC系统的行为提供了深刻的洞察，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Computing Arlequin coupling coefficient for concurrent FE-MD approaches
summary: Arlequin coupling coefficient is essential for concurrent FE-MD models with overlapping domains, but the calculation of its value is quite difficult when the geometry of the coupling region is complicated. In this work, we introduce a general procedure for the preprocessing of a concurrent FE-MD model, given that the mesh and atoms have already been created. The procedure is independent of the geometry of the coupling region and can be used for both 2D and 3D problems. The procedure includes steps of determining the relative positions of atoms inside the FE elements in the coupling region, as well as computing the Arlequin coupling coefficient for an arbitrary point inside the coupling region or on its boundary. Two approaches are provided for determining the coefficient: the direct approach and the temperature approach.

AI.title_translation: 计算并行有限元-分子动力学方法中的Arlequin耦合系数
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种通用的预处理方法，用于计算并行有限元-分子动力学模型中的Arlequin耦合系数，该方法适用于复杂几何形状和二维/三维问题，并提供了直接法和温度法两种计算系数的途径。
AI.motivation: 计算Arlequin耦合系数对于具有重叠域的并行有限元-分子动力学模型至关重要，但在耦合区域几何形状复杂时计算困难。
AI.method: 提出了一种通用的预处理程序，用于计算Arlequin耦合系数。该程序包括确定耦合区域内原子相对于有限元单元的相对位置，并计算任意点（耦合区域内或边界上）的Arlequin耦合系数。提供了直接法和温度法两种计算方法。
AI.result: 提出了一种通用的、与几何形状无关的预处理程序，用于计算Arlequin耦合系数，适用于2D和3D问题。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种通用的预处理程序，简化了在复杂几何耦合区域中计算Arlequin耦合系数的难度，为并行有限元-分子动力学模型的开发提供了便利。
AI.translation: Arlequin耦合系数对于具有重叠域的并行有限元-分子动力学模型至关重要，但当耦合区域的几何形状复杂时，计算其值非常困难。在本研究中，我们提出了一种通用的预处理程序，用于并行有限元-分子动力学模型，前提是网格和原子已经创建。该程序独立于耦合区域的几何形状，可用于二维和三维问题。该程序包括确定耦合区域内原子相对于有限元单元的相对位置的步骤，以及计算耦合区域内或边界上任意点的Arlequin耦合系数。我们提供了两种确定系数的方法：直接法和温度法。

AI.keywords: Arlequin耦合系数,有限元-分子动力学,并行计算,预处理,耦合模型

title: Topological reconstruction of Rubin multiple imputation via coarse proximity, Seifert van Kampen gluing and Hurewicz invariants
summary: Rubin multiple imputation (MI) generates plausible data completions to account for uncertainty and statistical variability but provides little insight into their global organization. We introduce a topological reconstruction approach that complements MI by examining the ensemble of completed datasets. Individual imputations are represented as points in a reconstruction space whose coordinates summarize statistical properties. Concepts from coarse geometry and algebraic topology are then used to characterize relationships among alternative imputations across multiple scales. Coarse proximity (CP) defines large-scale neighborhoods, generating graphs in which nodes represent completed datasets and edges connect sufficiently similar imputations. Seifert van Kampen gluing provides a conceptual interpretation of how local reconstructions assemble into globally coherent structures, whereas Hurewicz-type invariants quantify persistent connectivity patterns. Synthetic multivariate biomedical datasets representing adult cardiometabolic cohorts were generated with controlled missingness levels. Multiple stochastic imputations were projected into the reconstruction space and analyzed through CP graphs, connected components, cycle descriptors and scale-dependent topological measures. MI generated structured spaces with distinct connectivity patterns rather than homogeneous clouds of solutions. Topological descriptors remained stable despite local numerical variability, whereas increasing missingness produced transitions in reconstruction-space connectivity together with progressive deterioration of reconstruction accuracy. Our approach could be applied to biological and social networks, systems medicine, ecological modeling and other domains in which large-scale structural organization contributes to reliable inference.

AI.title_translation: 基于粗邻近、Seifert van Kampen拼接和Hurewicz不变量的Rubin多重填补拓扑重构
AI.tldr: 本文将代数拓扑引入多重填补分析，揭示了填补结果之间隐藏的全局结构和连通性模式，为评估统计推断的可靠性提供了新工具。
AI.motivation: Rubin多重填补方法虽然能处理不确定性，但缺乏对填补结果集合全局组织结构的深入洞察，无法直观解释不同填补结果之间的关系。
AI.method: 提出一种基于拓扑重构的方法，将多重填补结果表示为重构空间中的点；利用粗邻近（CP）构建图模型，通过Seifert van Kampen拼接分析局部与全局结构，并采用Hurewicz型不变量量化连通性模式。
AI.result: 实验表明，多重填补结果并非均匀分布，而是呈现出具有特定连通模式的结构化空间。拓扑描述符在数值变异下表现稳定，且随着缺失程度增加，重构空间的连通性会发生显著转变。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了多重填补并非随机分布的噪声，而是具有内在的拓扑结构。通过拓扑描述符可以有效量化填补结果的稳健性，并识别缺失数据对重构空间连通性的影响。
AI.translation: Rubin多重填补（MI）生成似是而非的数据补全以解释不确定性和统计变异，但对其全局组织结构提供的信息很少。我们引入了一种拓扑重构方法，通过检查补全数据集的集合来补充MI。个体填补被表示为重构空间中的点，其坐标总结了统计属性。然后使用粗几何和代数拓扑的概念来表征跨多个尺度的替代填补之间的关系。粗邻近（CP）定义了大尺度邻域，生成了节点代表补全数据集、边连接相似填补的图。Seifert van Kampen拼接提供了关于局部重构如何组装成全局连贯结构的解释，而Hurewicz型不变量量化了持久的连通性模式。我们生成了具有受控缺失水平的合成多变量生物医学数据集，代表成人心脏代谢队列。多个随机填补被投影到重构空间中，并通过CP图、连通分量、循环描述符和依赖于尺度的拓扑度量进行分析。MI生成了具有独特连通模式的结构化空间，而不是均匀的解云。尽管存在局部数值变异，拓扑描述符保持稳定，而缺失量的增加导致了重构空间连通性的转变以及重构精度的逐渐恶化。我们的方法可应用于生物和社会网络、系统医学、生态建模以及其他大尺度结构组织有助于可靠推断的领域。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用代数拓扑和粗几何方法重构多重填补结果的新框架。通过将填补数据映射到重构空间并构建图模型，研究能够定量分析填补结果的全局组织、连通性及稳健性，从而超越传统统计指标，提供更深层的结构性洞察。
AI.keywords: 多重填补, 代数拓扑, 粗几何, 缺失数据, 数据重构
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将代数拓扑和粗几何引入统计学的多重填补领域，通过将填补结果视为重构空间中的点，揭示了传统方法难以发现的全局结构特征。这种方法为理解多重填补的不确定性提供了一个全新的维度，有助于增强统计推断的可靠性。

title: Spatial Dependence in the Self-Response: Spatial Dependence, Modeling, and Operational Consequences
summary: The U.S.\ Census Bureau's Low Response Score (LRS) is a central planning instrument for identifying places likely to require additional self-response outreach and nonresponse follow-up. The published LRS is intentionally interpretable: it is built from tract-level covariates using an ordinary least squares specification. That transparency, however, leaves open an important question for official statistics: how much spatial structure remains after the own-tract covariates have done their work, and what form does that structure take? Using the observed 2010 Census mail non-return rate for 71,076 U.S. census tracts and the twenty-five Erdman--Bates LRS predictors, this paper compares the full spatial autoregressive model family under queen-contiguity weights and validates the leading candidates with both random and spatial-block cross-validation. OLS leaves strong residual spatial autocorrelation ($I=0.399$). Formal diagnostics and model comparisons indicate that the remaining dependence is primarily error-type rather than a global endogenous lag process. Although the spatial Durbin model minimizes in-sample AIC, spatial-block validation reverses that ranking: the error-family models (SEM/SDEM) generalize best, while the AIC-best SDM is weakest out of sample. The SDEM provides an interpretable middle ground, absorbing residual spatial dependence while representing neighborhood demographic effects as local spillovers. Robustness checks show that these conclusions are invariant to the weights definition and are not an artifact of tract-size-driven heteroskedasticity. The results suggest that LRS-style response models should be evaluated with spatial validation, not only in-sample fit, and that local neighborhood context can be operationally meaningful without invoking a global response-contagion mechanism.

title: Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification for Ranked Choice Voting Polls
summary: Ranked choice voting (RCV) is a popular alternative voting method in which voters are asked to list their favored candidates in preference order, rather than vote for a single candidate. When these ballots are tabulated, candidates are successively eliminated, and their votes are reallocated to each voter's next-preferred choice. The process continues until a candidate commands a majority of the active ballots and is declared the winner. As RCV gains wider adoption, the method poses novel challenges for pollsters. Unlike plurality elections, the event that a candidate wins cannot be expressed in terms of a single population parameter. Hence, the basic concept of a margin-of-error is not straightforward to define. Moreover, a candidate's ability to win may depend on both their support across the ballot and the order in which other candidates are eliminated. Existing measures of sampling uncertainty for polls of RCV elections do not clearly quantify these path-dependent outcomes. Here, we propose a simple, Bayesian framework to quantify uncertainty in polls of RCV elections. We cast the problem as one of estimating win probabilities for each leading candidate, and leverage a simple conjugacy relationship to estimate these probabilities conditional on the poll results. We include applied analyses involving two prominent ranked choice voting elections: the 2021 New York City Democratic mayoral primary, in which Eric Adams narrowly defeated Kathryn Garcia in the final round; and the 2022 special election to Alaska's U.S. House seat, in which Mary Peltola was elected despite not being a Condorcet winner. Using the cast vote records from both elections, we demonstrate some challenges of traditional frequentist uncertainty quantification in RCV polls. We also demonstrate the utility of our approach using a poll of the NYC primary obtained from the polling firm Data for Progress.

title: Prior-informed conditional Gaussian graphical models: an application to protein interaction network reconstruction
summary: Protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks, estimated from high-throughput omics data, foster biomarker discovery and precision medicine. Gaussian graphical models (GGMs) offer a principled reconstruction framework. Yet, existing applications face two limitations: they overlook the rich existing knowledge encoded in curated biological databases, and they assume a homogeneous network structure across all individuals, neglecting the influence of covariates or confounding factors on these interactions and preventing personalised representations. Even though these limitations have been addressed separately in previous work, no current approach resolves them simultaneously. We introduce a prior-informed conditional Gaussian graphical model that integrates database-derived interaction priors with covariate-dependent network modeling in a unified, scalable framework. The key methodological innovation is a structured, weighted penalty that selectively incorporates priors into population-level network estimation, while leaving context-specific perturbations entirely data-driven, as curated databases capture canonical interactions rather than disease-specific signals. Simulation studies demonstrate consistent and robust improvements in population-level network reconstruction across diverse settings, even when prior knowledge is imperfect. Applied to UK Biobank cardiometabolic proteomics (n = 49,129, p = 366 proteins), the method recovers T2D-associated network perturbations, identifying 34 network-central candidate biomarkers, several detectable only through their connectivity, not differential expression, and revealing six biologically coherent protein communities with distinct pathway enrichments spanning metabolic, cardiovascular, and cancer-related processes. Code is available at https://github.com/AlessiaMapelli/Prior-informed-conditional-GGMs.

title: Locally stationary Argo ocean heat content estimates: Modeling, validation and uncertainty quantification
summary: Argo profiling floats measure seawater temperature and salinity in the upper 2000 meters of the ocean. These floats are uniquely capable of measuring the global Ocean Heat Content (OHC), a quantity that is of central importance for understanding Earth Energy Imbalance. Yet, producing Argo-based OHC estimates with reliable uncertainties is statistically challenging due to the complex structure and large size of the Argo dataset. Here we present an end-to-end mapping and uncertainty quantification framework for Argo-based OHC estimation using state-of-the-art methods from spatio-temporal statistics. The framework is based on modeling vertically integrated Argo temperature profiles as a locally stationary Gaussian process defined over space and time. This enables us to produce computationally tractable OHC anomaly maps based on data-driven decorrelation scales estimated from the Argo observations. Our modeling choices are validated using statistical cross-validation, which demonstrates the importance of including a climatological time trend in the mean field and accounting for time in the covariance function. We quantify the uncertainty of these maps using local conditional simulation ensembles, a novel approach that leads to principled spatially and temporally correlated uncertainty quantification. A new paired cross-validation technique is presented to validate these uncertainties. The mapping framework is implemented in an open-source codebase that is designed to be modular, reproducible and extensible. To demonstrate the mapping and uncertainty quantification capabilities of this approach, we present new Argo OHC maps with uncertainties for 2004-2022 and report on various downstream climatological estimates and their uncertainties.

title: Cross-Fitted Survey-Weighted TMLE with Design-Based Variance for Causal Machine Learning
comments: 20 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables; 120-page supplementary appendix included as an ancillary file
summary: Cross-fitting is not a refinement of survey-weighted causal machine learning but, once the nuisances are flexible, what restores valid inference. We study the population average treatment effect under a stratified multistage design, estimated by a survey-aware targeted maximum likelihood estimator (TMLE) whose variance is obtained by Taylor-series linearization of the influence function, treating the primary sampling unit as the replication unit. Our central result, established in theory and simulation, is that this validity turns on cross-fitting at the cluster level. Once flexible learners cross a complexity (Donsker) boundary, single-fit survey TMLE can severely under-cover, and internal cluster-aware cross-validation does not substitute for cross-fitting; among the estimators we evaluate, only out-of-fold fitting at the cluster level restores valid coverage. In simulations spanning a many-PSU and an NHANES-like design, on a diverse ensemble the single-fit and internal cross-validation estimators cover at about 0.89-0.91 and 0.85-0.88 while the cross-fitted estimator holds at 0.93-0.95, and an aggressively grown learner drives single-fit coverage to 0.22. Two scope choices are deliberate: survey-weighted point estimation is prior work, and the nuisance product-rate condition is assumed and probed empirically. Within these conditions we prove asymptotic normality and design-consistency of the linearization variance. Four NHANES analyses and open-source software illustrate the method.
